title: Community Engagement & Complaints Advisor
description:
Primary Location

Canberra, ACT

Job Description Summary

The Community Engagement & Complaints Advisor is responsible for planning and delivering stakeholder and community engagement activities and coordinating the effective management of enquiries, complaints and escalations associated with Service Stream’s telecommunications projects.

The role works with community members, property stakeholders, government authorities, clients and internal delivery teams to support timely project delivery, maintain accurate records, manage stakeholder impacts and meet applicable contractual, legislative and regulatory obligations. The position also identifies emerging issues and complaint trends, supports risk mitigation and contributes to continuous improvement across land access, stakeholder engagement and project delivery.

About the Role

Primary purpose of position

  • The Community Engagement & Complaints Advisor is responsible for planning and delivering stakeholder and community engagement activities and coordinating the effective management of enquiries, complaints and escalations associated with Service Stream’s telecommunications projects.
  • The role works with community members, property stakeholders, government authorities, clients and internal delivery teams to support timely project delivery, maintain accurate records, manage stakeholder impacts and meet applicable contractual, legislative and regulatory obligations. The position also identifies emerging issues and complaint trends, supports risk mitigation and contributes to continuous improvement across land access, stakeholder engagement and project delivery.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement fit-for-purpose community and stakeholder engagement plans for assigned projects.
  • Identify affected stakeholders and determine appropriate engagement, notification and escalation requirements.
  • Engage professionally with government agencies, councils, property owners, occupiers, body corporates, building managers, community members and other affected parties.
  • Receive, assess, investigate and coordinate responses to enquiries, complaints and escalations.
  • Ensure complaints are acknowledged, assigned, progressed, escalated and closed within applicable contractual or regulatory timeframes.
  • Coordinate input from design, construction, land access, environmental, legal, commercial and client teams when preparing responses.
  • Maintain complete and accurate complaint files, contact records, engagement registers, correspondence and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor complaint ageing, recurring issues and emerging stakeholder risks, and provide regular reporting to management.
  • Contribute to templates, procedures, guidance material and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other related duties that are reasonably within the position’s capability and classification.

Experience required

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience in community engagement, stakeholder management, complaints management or a comparable customer-resolution role.
  • Experience managing sensitive or escalated matters involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong written communication experience, including preparation of formal correspondence, complaint responses, briefings and records.
  • Experience maintaining auditable records and working within defined contractual, regulatory or procedural requirements.
  • Ability to interpret project information and translate technical issues into clear, audience-appropriate communication.

Desirable

  • Experience of liaising with councils and the ACT City and Environment Directorate, formerly Transport Canberra and City Services, is desirable.
  • Location in the ACT or surrounding region is highly desirable.
  • Experience in telecommunications, utilities, infrastructure, construction, property, planning or government.
  • Experience working with councils, government authorities, property stakeholders or community representatives.
  • Working knowledge of telecommunications deployment and relevant land access, notification, planning and environmental considerations.

Qualifications required

  • Relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of formal qualifications, particularly within telecommunications, property or town planning fields
  • IAP2 is highly desirable

Competencies required

The following are key attributes required for the role -

  • Working knowledge of telecommunications legislation, including Schedule 3 and statutory notification requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication, and written communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across diverse groups.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Highly organised, with proven time management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • High attention to detail, with a strong focus on compliance, accuracy, and quality outcomes.
  • Self-motivated and able to work autonomously while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and able to perform under pressure while meeting deadlines.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and supporting team success.

Department

Construction

How to Apply

If this sounds like you apply now to the Service Stream Recruitment Team via the online application button.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI solutions to our most strategic clients. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond.

You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.

Your Impact

  • Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation: Be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of complex AI solutions, personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues, while also guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.

  • Build Transformative AI Solutions: Take primary ownership of designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.

  • Engineer Bespoke Agentic AI Solutions: Work directly with customers to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Agentforce platform, ensuring they precisely meet unique business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing customer ecosystems.

  • Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimized, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.

  • Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, from intricate data integration to sophisticated model deployment and advanced agent orchestration. You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.

  • Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become a foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, pushing its capabilities to the limit. You'll lead the development of bespoke intelligent agents, automate intricate business processes, and craft intuitive user experiences. Your insights from the field will directly influence future product enhancements and help shape the strategic direction of our platform, often representing the voice of the customer in product discussions.

  • Become a Trusted Strategic Partner: Embed yourself deeply with client teams to truly grasp their operational challenges and strategic goals. You'll translate these nuanced needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and solution designs, building strong relationships as their primary technical advisor and leading technical discussions.

  • Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.

  • Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.

  • Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelize engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment

  • Computer Science or a related engineering discipline

  • Expert-level proficiency in (JavaScript, Java, Python, Apex)

  • Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks

  • Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

  • Direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development

  • A "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives

  • Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects

  • Ability to travel up to 60% of the time, as needed to customer sites

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform

  • Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions within highly regulated industries

  • Expert-level experience with Apex and/or Python coding languages in a professional setting

  • Experience in a customer-facing, hands-on technical lead or architect role

  • Advanced Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect)

  • Deep knowledge across Salesforce CRM (Service, Sales, and Marketing Clouds)

  • Extensive experience with Salesforce Flows and Lightning Web Components (LWC), including complex custom development

  • Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or libraries

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Network Systems Engineer
description:

Job Description

Data Center AI Network Engineer


Meet the Team

We are the Data Center Network Services team within Cisco IT that supports network services for Cisco Engineering and business functions worldwide. Our mission is simple – build the network of the future that is adaptable and agile on Cisco’s networking solutions. Cisco IT networks are deployed, monitored, and managed with a DevOps approach to support rapid application changes. We invest in transformative technologies that enable us to deliver services in a fast and reliable manner.

The team culture is collaborative and fun, where thinking creatively and tinkering on new ideas are encouraged.

Your Impact

You will design, develop, test and deploy DC network capabilities within Data Center Network. You are engaging and comfortable collaborating with fellow engineers across multiple disciplines as well as internal clients. You will create innovative, high-quality capabilities enabling our clients to have the best possible experience.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor of Engineering or Technology with a 5+ years of experience in designing, deploying, operating and managing scalable DC network infrastructure (using Nexus OS)
  • Experience in technologies like Routing, Switching, Nexus, VPC, VDC, VLAN, VXLAN, BGP
  • Experience on handling incident, problem and change management
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, comfortable with Agile practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNP or CCIE/DE
  • Experience with SONiC NoS including:
  • Basic configuration (both CLI and config_db.json)
  • Network troubleshooting with SONiC
  • QoS monitoring and troubleshooting, particularly for RoCEv2
  • Experience with BGP routing
  • Desirable to have experience with L3 Fabrics
  • Desirable to have familiarity with Nvidia and Linux networking
  • Desirable to have experience with Python, Prometheus, Splunk and Grafana
  • Desirable to have experience with Cisco Firepower firewalls (FTD/FMC)
  • Experience with Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller for building and troubleshooting Networks
  • Experience with VXLan based networks and troubleshooting

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Senior Logistics Specialist
description:
Responsibilities

Logistics Operations

  • Manage end-to-end freight and distribution activities for inbound, outbound, and intercompany shipments across the Asia region
  • Oversee coordination with global and regional 3PLs, freight forwarders, and couriers.
  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of materials to manufacturing sites, customers, and distribution centers
  • Track and resolve logistics issues, including shipment delays, damage claims, or documentation discrepancies

Compliance and Documentation

  • Ensure all shipments comply with international trade, customs, and local regulatory requirements (e.g., Free Trade Zone,DG regulations, HS Code classification)
  • Prepare, verify, and maintain shipping documents such as invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, airway bills, and K8/K1 forms
  • Liaise with internal trade compliance and customs brokers to ensure proper declarations and audit readiness

Freight and Cost Management

  • Coordinate spot quotes and lane-based freight negotiations in collaboration with Logistics Procurement
  • Monitor freight cost trends and contribute to quarterly freight spend reporting and budgeting
  • Support freight bill validation and cost allocation in SAP and logistics dashboards

Process & System Management

  • Execute SAP transactions for inbound/outbound flows (e.g., MIGO, MB1B, ZASO, ZVRPANGI)
  • Maintain accurate master data for shipping points, routes, and partners
  • Support ongoing enhancements to Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and 3PL integrations
  • Participate in system testing, SOP updates, and process harmonization projects

Continuous Improvement & Projects

  • Drive logistics KPIs improvement (OTD, lead time, freight spend, shipment accuracy)
  • Support warehouse migration, stock transfer, and system cutover activities
  • Lead or participate in Kaizen, 5S, and CAPA initiatives to strengthen process control and compliance

Basic Qualifications

  • Degree/Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or related field
  • 7–10 years of logistics experience within a regulated or manufacturing environment
  • 2–5 years of experience in team leadership or 3PL management
  • Strong understanding of freight forwarding, import/export regulations, and DG/HazMat compliance
  • Proficient in SAP and/or other ERP/WMS systems; advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Familiar with ISO standards and local/international product handling regulations
  • Proven ability to manage logistics budgets, lead projects, and implement process improvements
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, especially in cross-border operations
  • Prior experience in managing warehouse transitions or new site start-ups
  • Familiarity with logistics operations in Johor or Singapore–Malaysia cross-border flows
  • Continuous improvement mindset with exposure to Lean/Six Sigma tools.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail, process discipline, and problem-solving mindset
  • Stakeholder Management: Effective communicator with internal teams, external partners, and authorities
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend cost/service improvements
  • System Proficiency: Skilled in SAP, Excel dashboards, and logistics reporting tools
  • Adaptability: Able to work under pressure in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

title: WDW Analytical & Strategic Planning Intern, Spring 2027
location: Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States of America
description:
About the Role & Program

"We create happiness." That's our motto at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts. And it permeates everything we do. At Disney, you'll help inspire that magic by enabling our teams to push the limits of entertainment and create the never-before-seen!

The approximate dates of this internship are January - June 2027.

What You Will Do

As a member a Engineering team, you will help to engineer the magic. You will join a team that works every single day to craft, build, service and maintain a level of service that exceeds our client and guest expectations! Your team's responsibilities may include:

  • Work Measurement - perform time and motion studies in Textiles operation to develop labor standards for accurate evaluation of labor performance.
  • Insights - analyze data looking for trends, commonalities and other statistical characteristics to identify improvement opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce cost.
  • Execution – turn ideas into solutions by collaborating with different contributors to acquire consensus prior to implementation.
  • Analytics – become guide in Textiles data collecting, analysis and visualization, with the ability to present results to different audiences for clear and concise messaging.
  • Quality - support Quality related efforts by setting up data collection studies including sample sizes, data collection forms and reporting.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience in Excel, Access and PowerPoint (required)
  • Experience with data visualization software (Tableau or Grafana)
  • Experience with statistical analysis through SQL
  • Knowledge of work measurement techniques and method
  • Knowledge of Quality analysis methods like Fishbone diagrams, RCCA, 5Why’s

Preferred Qualifications

Successful completion of the Disney College Program or Disney Professional Internship

Education

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree at an accredited 4-year college or university majoring in an Engineering related major including: Industrial, Manufacturing, Quality, Systems or related major
  • Junior, Senior or Graduate student status by arrival date

Preferred Education

Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher (Note: Please, no rounding) as shown on a transcript.

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.
  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization
  • Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program.

Additional Information

  • Be compliant with The Disney Look appearance guidelines
  • Fully available from Monday through Friday with occasional weekends or holidays pending project need, up to 40 hours each week, early mornings or late nights are a possibility, bulk of work time will be during traditional 8am-5pm
  • Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work
  • We provide limited housing opportunities for Florida Based Professional Interns through American Campus Communities, for more information click here

The pay rate for this role in Orlando FL is $31 for undergraduate student per hour and $36 for graduate student per hour. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

- RL Algorithms for Reasoning Models：Design robust RL training recipes (PPO / GRPO / GSPO variants) for large-scale reasoning models. Tackle training instability, reward hacking, and policy collapse in long-horizon and async settings. Explore how to bridge the gap between RL post-training and genuine reasoning capability improvement.

- RL for Autonomous Agents: Build RL pipelines for long-horizon terminal agents and tool-use agents. Investigate credit assignment, exploration strategies, and self-evolving agent behaviors in complex interactive environments.

-Reward Modeling & Optimization: Develop reward signals and regularization techniques that go beyond outcome-based rewards. Explore token-level reward shaping, entropy-based regularization, and learned reward models that generalize across tasks.

Who We Look For

- Enrolled in a PhD or Master's program in computer science, machine learning or a related field.

- Solid understanding of RL fundamentals (policy gradients, PPO, GRPO, etc.) and hands-on experience applying them to LLM training.

- Strong programming skills in Python and PyTorch; experience training models on multi-GPU setups, comfortable debugging training instability at scale.

- Ability to independently read, critique, and build on recent research papers.

- Published or submitted first-author papers at top ML/NLP venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, AAAI, EMNLP, etc.), or demonstrated equivalent research maturity through preprints and technical reports.

- Familiarity with LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, GRPO), model merging, or agent frameworks (ReAct, tool-use) is a strong plus.

- Experience with large-scale distributed training (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron) and open-source contributions are welcome.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Facility Director
description:
The Facility Director is responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, operational performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of site facilities, utilities, and infrastructure. This role ensures safe, reliable, compliant, cost-effective & sustainable facility operations that support manufacturing excellence, business continuity & future site growth.

The Facility Director leads the Facilities, Engineering & Maintenance (FEM) organization & provides strategic oversight of Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) partners, contractors & service providers. The role drives operational excellence through reliability engineering, asset management, sustainability initiatives, digital transformation & infrastructure investment planning.

Key Responsibilities

Site Facilities & Operations Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership and direction for Facilities, Engineering, Maintenance, and Utilities operations.
  • Ensure reliable operation of critical facility systems supporting manufacturing and business operations.
  • Establish and maintain facility strategies, standards, procedures & performance metrics.
  • Drive operational excellence, equipment reliability & continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead response and recovery efforts during utility interruptions, facility incidents, and emergencies.
  • Ensure facility availability and operational readiness meet current and future business requirements.

Critical Utilities & Infrastructure

  • Oversee the reliability, performance, and lifecycle management of critical facility systems, including:
  • Electrical distribution systems, substations, transformers, generators, UPS & power quality systems.
  • HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, MAUs & cleanroom environmental controls.
  • Process utilities including CDA, nitrogen & vacuum
  • RO/DI & Wastewater treatment and water reclaim systems.
  • Building Management Systems (BMS), SCADA & facility monitoring systems.
  • Fire protection, life-safety & emergency systems.
  • Building infrastructure and facility support services.

Engineering & Capital Project Management

  • Lead facility engineering, infrastructure planning, and capacity expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and execute capital improvement and major repair projects.
  • Establish long-term facility master plans and infrastructure roadmaps.
  • Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget & according to required quality standards.
  • Review and approve engineering designs, commissioning plans & operational handover requirements.
  • Ensure adequate utility capacity, redundancy & resilience for future business growth.

Reliability, Maintenance & Asset Management

  • Develop and implement asset management strategies for critical facility infrastructure.
  • Drive preventive, predictive, condition-based & reliability-centered maintenance programs.
  • Monitor equipment performance, reliability trends, lifecycle costs & maintenance effectiveness.
  • Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 8D investigations & corrective action programs.
  • Ensure appropriate resilience strategies, including N+1 redundancy for critical systems.

Safety, EHS & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, health, safety, building, electrical & statutory requirements.
  • Promote a strong safety culture across employees, contractors & service providers.
  • Ensure timely completion of inspections, permits, licenses, certifications & regulatory submissions.
  • Lead risk assessments, Management of Change (MOC) & emergency preparedness programs.
  • Support site business continuity and operational resilience initiatives.

Sustainability & Environmental Performance

  • Lead initiatives related to energy efficiency, water conservation, waste reduction, emissions management & resource optimization.
  • Establish and achieve site sustainability targets aligned with corporate ESG goals.
  • Drive renewable energy, water reclaim, carbon reduction & environmental improvement programs.
  • Ensure environmental infrastructure operates reliably and meets regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs while improving environmental performance.
  • Digital Transformation & Smart Facilities

IFM, Contractor & Vendor Management

  • Provide strategic oversight of IFM partners and outsourced facility service providers.
  • Establish governance structures, service-level agreements & performance metrics.
  • Monitor contractor safety, quality, compliance, delivery & cost performance.
  • Ensure adequate staffing, competency, and technical capability to support site operations.
  • Drive service excellence, continuous improvement & cost optimization.
  • Manage escalation and resolution of critical operational issues.

Financial & Budget Management

  • Develop and manage annual OPEX, R&M & CapEx budgets.
  • Ensure spending aligns with business priorities and approved financial plans.
  • Drive cost optimization while maintaining safety, compliance & operational reliability.
  • Conduct lifecycle cost analysis and business case development for facility investments.
  • Support strategic investment decisions through robust financial evaluation and planning.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Facilities, Engineering & Maintenance organization.
  • Establish clear goals, accountability & performance expectations.
  • Develop leadership capability, technical competency & succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, teamwork, innovation & continuous improvement.

Business Continuity & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain facility business continuity and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Identify and mitigate critical facility risks.
  • Ensure adequate redundancy, contingency measures, emergency response plans, and backup utility capabilities.
  • Lead facility recovery efforts during major operational disruptions.
  • Maintain an effective facility risk register and mitigation program.

Overall Accountability

The Facility Director is accountable for ensuring the site facilities and infrastructure remain safe, reliable, compliant, resilient, sustainable, digitally enabled & capable of supporting current operations and future business growth. The role is responsible for delivering world-class operational performance while optimizing cost, reliability, risk & environmental stewardship.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience, including leadership responsibility within manufacturing, semiconductor, high-tech, or other critical facility environments.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale facility operations, multidisciplinary engineering teams & critical utility infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, cleanrooms, process utilities, water/wastewater treatment & facility infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated success leading facility reliability, asset management & continuous improvement programs.
  • Experience managing large capital projects, operating budgets, contractors & service providers.
  • Experience managing Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) partnerships is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of EHS compliance, risk management, business continuity, and sustainability practices.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication & decision-making skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Communication skills: Clear, articulate communication across technical and non-technical audiences; ability to present complex concepts to senior business leaders.
  • Relationship building: Ability to establish and maintain strong working relationships with regional cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors

Why join our team:

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with AI, Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to integrate semantic capabilities into NovaOS products and platforms.

  • Support AI initiatives by developing semantic foundations for RAG, agentic AI, reasoning engines, and contextual search.

Essential Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in semantic technologies, knowledge engineering, metadata management, or enterprise information architecture.

description:

Pay & Benefits

Benefits you’ll love

Job Summary

Join a Team where flying is more than a job; it’s a passion for connecting our People to what matters most. As a First Officer, you’ll be a key member of our Flight Operations Team, responsible for safely operating our fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft while delivering the friendly, reliable service our Customers know and love. Southwest offers one of the most flexible scheduling policies in the industry, giving all Pilots the freedom to shape their schedules to fit their lives, regardless of their seniority. First Officers play a vital role in keeping our operation running smoothly and efficiently, directly impacting the travel experience of millions of Customers while embodying the Southwest spirit in every flight.

Additional details

  • U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. is required, and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

​

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Responsibilities
  • Provides friendly service to and maintains positive relationships with all internal and external Customers
  • Works in a cooperative spirit to ensure the success of our Company
  • Works in a highly organized environment, which demands close coordination and teamwork with the Captain, Flight Attendants, Dispatcher and all Ground Personnel
  • Must comply with all regulations and directives pertaining to the conduct of the flight in a manner suitable to the Captain.
  • All Pilots must operate in accordance with Southwest Airlines FAA Approved and FAA Accepted manuals, the Operations Specifications, 14 CFRs, 49 CFRs, FAA Orders, Airworthiness Directives, Advisory Circulars, Handbook Bulletins, Directives, and Manufacturer's recommendations
  • No person may operate a civil aircraft without complying with the operating limitations specified in the approved Southwest Airlines Flight Operations Manual, markings and placards. (Reference 14 CFR 91.9(a))
  • No person may operate an aircraft in a careless and reckless manner so as to endanger the life or property of another. (Reference 14 CFR 91.13)
  • All Southwest Airlines Employees must comply with the Company's Policies on a Drug-Free Workplace and Alcohol Misuse.
  • No person may perform any function listed in 14 CFR 121, Appendix I while that person has a prohibited drug, as defined by that appendix, in his or her system. (Reference 14 CFR 121.455(b))
  • No person may perform any safety-sensitive function if the person has a verified positive drug test result on or has refused to submit to a drug test required by 14 CFR 121, Appendix I and the person has not met the requirements of that appendix for returning to the performances of safety-sensitive duties. (Reference 14 CFR 121.455(c))
  • Submit reports on irregularities or incidents, as required
  • Immediately notify the Base Chief Pilot or Assistant Base Chief Pilot of any discrepancy or incident that may affect his/her ability, or Southwest Airlines' ability, to perform within the parameters of safety, regulatory compliance, and fiscal responsibility
  • Performs as Captain should the Captain become incapacitated during flight and unable to assume command
  • A Pilot, at their discretion, from the time they pass through the security checkpoint at the start of a duty day and until they exit the secured area at the end of their duty may perform Passenger Assistance activities. These Passenger Assistance activities include but are not limited to pushing wheelchairs, assisting passengers with their luggage, and escorting passengers through the airport facility.
  • May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders
Authorities
  • Take action, as deemed necessary, to resolve any problems or situations that may compromise safety or compliance
  • When assigned by the Captain, direct the Flight Crew in a safe and efficient manner to meet the operational requirements of Southwest Airlines
  • Delegate duties and authority defined for this position; responsibilities may not be delegated
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Must be able to read documents, follow instructions, listen, comprehend and repeat detailed lengthy instructions, and understand and retain procedures, rules and regulations
  • Must successfully complete initial and recurrent training programs, proficiency checks, and evaluation period
  • Must be aware of hazardous situations and be able to handle emergencies as needed
  • Must be alert to moving equipment on the ramp and other aircraft in the air
  • Must work under tight time constraints to accomplish quick (15 to 20 minute) turns of aircraft
  • Must possess excellent interpersonal skills and be able to effectively communicate information verbally, face to face, over public address systems, via radio, and other communication equipment
  • Ability to work well with others as part of a team, meet the public and work under stressful situations
Education
  • Required: High School Diploma or GED
  • Preferred: Bachelor's Degree
Experience
  • Preferred:
    • 500 hours in a fixed-wing turbine (airplane and/or power lift)
    • Successfully completed all aspects of a Southwest Destination 225° pathway program
    • Actively flying fixed-wing turbine for the last 3 years
    • Turbine Pilot In Command (TPIC) time
    • 121 airline, military, and/or U.S. based flight experience. (Experience from foreign military organizations or foreign commercial carriers is not considered equivalent for this requirement)
    • B-737 type rating
    • Held or currently holds an aviation‑related organizational Leadership position within a flight department of 10+ pilots (e.g., FAA‑designated Chief Pilot, Director of Operations, Check Pilot; or military roles such as Commander, Director of Operations, Stan/Eval, NATOPS Evaluator, or equivalent)
    • Demonstrated history of operational excellence in training and flight experience
  • Notes on flight time:
    • Do not include simulator, WSO, RIO, FE, NAV, EWO and UAV
    • PIC time is defined as Captain or Aircraft Commander of record or pilot signing for the aircraft (not sole manipulator of the controls)
Licensing/Certification
  • Required: USA DOT/FAA Unrestricted Airline Transport Pilot Certificate. The certificate must display the following:
    • "Airplane Multiengine Land" Category and Class Ratings
    • "English Proficient" limitation
  • Required: USA DOT/FAA First Class Medical Certificate and, if applicable, any necessary Special Issuance of a Medical Certificate (Authorization) or Statement of Demonstrated Ability (SODA) issued by the Federal Air Surgeon
  • Required: FCC - Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
  • Required: Must possess a valid United States Driver's License
  • Required: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. and not require Southwest Airlines to sponsor now or in the future
  • Required: Must have a valid passport with the ability to travel in and out of the United States without restriction
  • Required: Must meet all regulatory criteria to obtain and maintain a CREW badge designation; this position requires successful and continuous enrollment in Rap Back
Physical Abilities
  • Must be able to lift and move 40 lbs.
  • Ability to communicate and interact with others in the English language to meet the demands of the job
  • Ability to bend, stand, and sit for extended periods of time
Other Qualifications
  • Must be willing to grant and share Southwest access to your Pilot Records Database (PRD) information as part of the interview and onboarding process
  • Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
  • Must be at least 23 years of age at the time of hire
  • Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines
  • Must be able to read, speak, write and understand the English language
  • Must be able to comply with company attendance standards and work rules, as described in labor agreements and/or established guidelines
  • Ability to work rotating shifts, and or overtime and travel on a constant basis

*Pay amount does not guarantee employment for any particular period of time

**The 401(k) Company match contribution is subject to the Retirement Savings Plan vesting schedule and applicable IRS limits

$125.90

title: Principal Deal Consultant, Migration and Modernization GTM
description:
In this role, you will architect and lead strategic, high-complexity deal pursuits that accelerate customer adoption of AWS cloud through partner-led and ProServe-led motions. Working directly with AWS senior leadership, enterprise account teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will own deal qualification, commercial strategy, and proposal development for large-scale migration and modernization opportunities.

This is an individual contributor role with outsized strategic impact. You will operate at the intersection of customer business outcomes, partner economics, and AWS investment strategy to structure differentiated offers that win against incumbents and drive net-new customer acquisition for AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Deal Strategy & Execution

Own deal strategy for the largest, most complex, and most strategic opportunities across APJ, from qualification through close.
Architect commercial deal structures that align partner incentives, AWS investments, and customer value realization into compelling proposals.
Lead deal qualification with rigor - applying sound judgment to prioritize pursuits that meet strategic and financial thresholds while proactively exiting low-probability opportunities early.
Guide and coach other members of the team.

Stakeholder Leadership & Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor to AWS partners, enterprise sales teams, and senior leadership on deal positioning, competitive strategy, and investment allocation.
Coach partners and account teams on developing business cases that articulate measurable outcomes for large enterprise customers.
Engage and influence customer decision makers through to CxO level.
Navigate complex approval processes and cross-functional coordination with speed

Operational Rigor & Pipeline Acceleration
Support rapid decision-making in fast-paced deal cycles, providing leadership visibility into deal health, risk, and resource needs.
Solve complex deal blockers - including supporting team members.
Build scalable processes and mechanisms that drive operational excellence and reduce resolution time for recurring deal patterns.

Commercial Impact & Measurement
Develop commercial strategies that deliver measurable business impact - quantifying cost of delay, migration economics, and long-term customer value.
Use data to assess strategic costs, benefits, and ROI of partnership investments, translating analysis into actionable recommendations for leadership.

title: Business Functional Analyst, Academic Operations
description:
Ready to start your next chapter with NAIT?

At NAIT, we’re passionate about building a team of talented, dedicated professionals who share our commitment to excellence and innovation. Your skills and experience can shape the future of education and make a real impact in our community.

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we encourage you to apply and join us in creating a brighter future – together.

Important Application Deadline Notice

Please note that Workday closes job postings at 11:59pm MST on the day before the posting end date listed above.

To ensure your application is received, submit no later than 11:59pm MST the day prior to the posting end date.

Internal NAIT Employees

Current NAIT employees are welcome to apply for this opportunity. To be considered, please submit your application through the NAIT Jobs Hub rather than the external career site.

Please Note: This position is currently under review for potential placement within the AUPE Collective Agreement. This review will not result in any changes to the posted salary.

Reporting to the Senior Business Analyst, the Business-Functional Analyst (BFA) is a blended analyst role that combines the disciplines of both business analysis and functional analysis.

The BFA supports the strategic evolution of Academic Quality and Operational Excellence (AQOE) by serving as a subject matter expert (SME) across both business and functional analysis domains. The role is responsible for understanding business processes, operational requirements, policies, and stakeholder needs (business analysis) while also developing deep expertise in how AQOE-sponsored platforms can be configured and utilized to support those needs (functional analysis).

As the business owner representative for assigned platforms, the BFA operates at the intersection of academic operations, policy and procedure, people, process, and technology. Working as part of a small team responsible for the lifecycle stewardship of AQOE-sponsored platforms, the role translates organizational requirements into practical system solutions and helps ensure platforms remain aligned with institutional objectives and operational needs, and end-users know how to leverage them.

A core responsibility of the position is driving end-user understanding, adoption, and effective use of AQOE-sponsored platforms. The BFA analyzes system usage, stakeholder needs, and operational challenges to identify gaps in training, documentation, and business processes, then develops practical enablement materials and delivers end-user training to address those gaps. This includes creating and maintaining user guides, process maps, workflows, job aids, training resources, and other artifacts that support consistent, sustainable platform use across the institution.

Role Scope and Fit Considerations

Applicants are encouraged to consider how their interests and experience align with the ongoing, facilitative, and operational nature of this role. Applicants may thrive in the role if they:

  • Are interested in ongoing stewardship of business systems and platforms, including support, refinement, and adoption after implementation

  • Enjoy working in environments where policy, process, and system considerations intersect, and where requirements may evolve over time

  • Are comfortable facilitating analysis‑driven conversations, documenting decisions, and translating complex requirements into visual materials (e.g., process maps, workflows, configuration models, training aids) to support shared understanding and system adoption

  • Thrive in highly relational roles that emphasize influence, collaboration, and operational continuity

This role is not primarily focused on:

  • Software development or purely technical system configuration

  • Short‑term or project‑only delivery assignments

  • People management or senior enterprise strategy ownership

  • Solely analytical, reporting, or data‑centric responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Business + Functional Analysis

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and business owner representative for assigned AQOE-sponsored platforms.

  • Facilitate requirements gathering with stakeholders to understand business needs, risks, dependencies, and opportunities.

  • Translate business requirements into functional requirements, process improvements, and system recommendations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of platform capabilities, configuration options, and institutional business processes.

  • Support the development of governance practices, business rules, and standard operating procedures related to AQOE systems.

Platform Stewardship and Adoption

  • Apply business and functional analysis to identify gaps in system understanding, training, and adoption, and prioritize enablement work based on operational risk and user impact

  • Develop and maintain training and enablement materials, including process maps, workflows, configuration models, and user guides, to support clear and consistent system use

  • Deliver training and knowledge-transfer sessions to end users and stakeholder groups.

  • Provide ongoing end‑user support, responding to questions, clarifying system behaviour, and identifying training or documentation gaps

  • Support platforms beyond initial implementation, including business‑led enhancements, refinements, and issue resolution informed by operational use and user feedback

Collaboration and Engagement

  • Work closely with academic leaders, operational teams, and Information Technology Services to support effective platform stewardship and system use

  • Facilitate cross‑functional conversations where policy, process, and system constraints intersect

  • Prepare clear analysis, documentation, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making

Qualifications

Required:

  • Post‑secondary diploma or degree in business analysis, information systems, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

  • Five (5) years of demonstrated experience in a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise or operational systems

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with experience working with non‑technical stakeholders

  • Experience producing process documentation and visual artifacts to support understanding and adoption

  • Ability to work effectively in complex, evolving, and ambiguous environments

Assets:

  • Experience in post‑secondary education, public sector, or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with academic operations, scheduling, curriculum processes, or quality assurance frameworks

  • Experience supporting system adoption, training, change management, or end-user adoption activities

Why Join AQOE?

  • People-first culture: In AQOE, we believe in putting our people first, supporting professional growth, and fostering an inclusive work environment.

  • Collaborative & innovative environment: Be part of a forward-thinking portfolio that values new ideas and continuous improvement.

  • Impactful work: Play a crucial role in shaping the student experience and academic operations at NAIT.

If you are an experienced people-centric analyst with strong communication skills and a passion for leveraging technology to drive business success, we want to hear from you!

Remuneration: Refer to salary range noted on this posting, plus a comprehensive benefits package.

The compensation range for this job posting is : $78,885.85 - $104,506.92

title: Quality Assurance Technician
location: States Industries Panel Plant - Eugene, OR 97402
description:
The Quality Assurance Technician provides hands-on quality assurance support throughout States Industries' hardwood plywood manufacturing process. This position spends the majority of each shift on the production floor conducting inspections, collecting and evaluating samples, performing quality testing, identifying nonconforming product, and working directly with production employees and leadership to ensure products meet company and customer requirements.

The Quality Assurance Technician works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and other departments to identify quality concerns, support root cause analysis and corrective action, improve manufacturing processes, reduce waste and rework, and maintain accurate quality records. The position serves as a visible quality resource on the manufacturing floor and helps reinforce quality standards and expectations throughout the production process.

This position requires strong attention to detail, effective communication, sound judgment, and the ability to solve problems in real time in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The Quality Assurance Technician is expected to support a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Spend the majority of each shift on the production floor monitoring product quality, manufacturing processes, and compliance with established quality standards.
  • Perform quality inspections and testing on raw materials, in-process products, and finished hardwood plywood to verify compliance with company, customer, and applicable product specifications.
  • Conduct testing including, but not limited to, moisture content, bond quality, thickness, dimensions, appearance, veneer grading, panel specifications, and other established quality characteristics.
  • Collect, prepare, label, retain, organize, and maintain quality samples in accordance with established requirements.
  • Identify mismanufactured, damaged, nonconforming, or questionable product and ensure appropriate communication, follow-up, and disposition through the manufacturing process.
  • Communicate quality concerns promptly to production leadership and other appropriate team members and assist with determining root causes and corrective actions.
  • Partner with supervisors, Mentors, production employees, Engineering, and Operations to resolve quality concerns while minimizing production disruption and preventing recurrence.
  • Serve as a quality resource on the manufacturing floor, helping employees understand and consistently meet internal and customer quality requirements.
  • Accurately document inspection and testing results and maintain required quality records using company software, forms, and reporting systems.
  • Review quality data and trends to identify recurring defects, process variation, waste, rework, falldown, and other opportunities for improvement.
  • Calibrate, maintain, verify, and troubleshoot laboratory, inspection, and testing equipment and ensure equipment is used in accordance with established procedures.
  • Assist with developing, reviewing, updating, and improving quality procedures, work instructions, inspection standards, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Participate in root cause investigations, corrective action activities, Lean Manufacturing initiatives, Kaizen events, 5S activities, and other continuous improvement projects.
  • Train and support employees on quality standards, inspection methods, testing requirements, customer specifications, and quality expectations as assigned.
  • Communicate effectively across shifts and departments regarding quality concerns, testing results, product disposition, process issues, and items requiring follow-up.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area and support good housekeeping practices throughout production and quality work areas.
  • Follow all States Industries safety policies, environmental requirements, PPE requirements, quality procedures, and company work practices.
  • Maintain required forklift certification and safely operate forklifts and other applicable material handling equipment as needed.
  • Maintain regular and predictable attendance and flexibility to support alternate shifts, overtime, weekends, or holidays as business needs require.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.

    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

  • Computer literacy and experience with documentation
  • Excellent communication skills
  • A commitment to continuous improvement
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • National NDIS worker screening check

title: Branch Administrator
description:
Make a difference.

As a Branch Administrator, you will provide centralized administrative support for Graybar Zone and Service Center locations across the United States. This role is responsible for validating and processing freight and material vendor invoices for assigned locations, researching billing discrepancies, managing invoice workflow exceptions, performing monthly reporting and reconciliations, and supporting other administrative functions that contribute to efficient Graybar operations.

In this role you will:

  • Review, validate, and process freight and material vendor invoices for Graybar Zone and Service Center locations while maintaining accurate documentation, workflow records, and audit trails.
  • Research and resolve freight billing discrepancies, overcharges, duplicate payments, and invoice exceptions.
  • Verify vendor invoice data against purchase orders, delivery documents, and carrier records utilizing Graybar systems, including SAP.
  • Process outbound freight billing adjustments, including customer debits and internal freight debit allocations, while ensuring proper approvals and documentation.
  • Communicate often with Graybar service centers, branches, carriers, suppliers, and internal departments, including Sales and Cost Services, to resolve invoice and freight-related issues.
  • Run monthly reports, research and reconcile open aging items.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
  • Perform additional administrative duties as assigned.

What you bring to the table:

  • High school education
  • 6+ months of related experience preferred
  • Knowledge of computer systems; SAP experience preferred
  • Attention to detail, data entry and organizational skills
  • Ability to interface and work well with all levels of employees and management

Monday - Thursday: 6:30 am to 4:30 pm

Friday: 6:30 am to 10:30 am

  • And More Perks that support your well-being and career growth.

Benefit eligibility may vary across locations and roles, so be sure to check in with your recruiter for more information.

Why should you join Graybar?

At Graybar, our employees are the heart and soul of our company. We believe that employees with diverse perspectives bring the ideas and innovative thinking we need to solve our biggest challenges and compete in an ever-changing world. Consistent with our values, we welcome people from all backgrounds, cultures and experiences into our company because we believe it’s the right thing to do and the right way to run our business.

Haemme kuutta (6) lähihoitajaa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle, alkusijoituspaikka ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen yksikkö Krannila Vaasassa.

Krannila on koti ikääntyneille, jotka tarvitsevat ympärivuorokautista apua ja ohjausta arjen toiminnoissa. Koti on paikka, jossa saa toteuttaa itselle tärkeitä, kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia tukevia asioita. Lähtökohtamme on tarjota ikääntyneille asiakkaillemme laadukasta, heidän itsensä näköistä turvallista elämää ja arkea.

Krannilassa lähihoitajan ensisijainen tehtävä on asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisesta hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen heidän omia voimavarojaan tukien ja toimintakykyään edistäen. Meidän asiakkaamme toivovat lähihoitajan olevan empaattinen, vastuullinen ja kärsivällinen. Meidän työyhteisö puolestaan toivoo lähihoitajalta ammatillista osaamista, positiivista työotetta sekä luotettavuutta.

Krannilan asiakkaat ja työyhteisö puolestaan tarjoaa lähihoitajalle merkityksellisen työn, vakaan ja turvallisen työympäristön, mahdollisuuden kehittyä työssä ja hyvän työyhteisön, jossa tehdään arvokasta työtä. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä.

Hakuajan päättymisen jälkeen haastatteluun kutsutut ottavat mukaansa alkuperäiset tutkinto- ja työtodistukset.


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä.

Lähihoitajatutkinnon suorittaneilta edellytetään rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston molempiin ammattihenkilörekistereihin, Terhikkiin ja Suosikkiin.

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

title: Applied Scientist, Ads Brand Safety and Suitability
description:
Amazon Ads Brand Safety & Suitability protects advertisers from exposure to unsafe, unsuitable, or policy-violating content across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio advertising inventory. Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity.

AI is fundamentally changing the content landscape. Content is now generated at unprecedented scale — faster, cheaper, and increasingly sophisticated. Low-quality, deceptive, AI-generated, and synthetic content evolves in real time, constantly adapting to evade detection. The volume and velocity of new content entering the advertising system has outpaced traditional classification approaches.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to work on the next generation of AI-powered Brand Safety and Content Classification systems designed to protect advertisers and elevate supply quality at internet scale. This is not a traditional classification problem. You will build systems that make millisecond-level decisions across billions of content signals while continuously adapting to emerging content risks driven by generative AI. You will own the science strategy for LLM-powered classification and semantic understanding, real-time multimodal content evaluation, adversarial ML and adaptive model resilience, proactive risk intelligence and content risk hunting, AI-generated and synthetic content detection, and large-scale abusive content system identification and disruption.

You will define how modern AI separates high-quality advertising inventory from unsafe, unsuitable, and policy-violating content — across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio surfaces.

What Makes This Role Unique
Generative AI has dramatically lowered the cost of producing deceptive, policy-evasive content, and the adversary evolves daily. Your detection systems must reason contextually, adapt rapidly, and generalize beyond previously seen content risk patterns. Static models fail here; you will build living systems that learn and respond in real time. You will do this at internet scale, developing low-latency ML and LLM-powered systems evaluating content safety, brand suitability, misinformation risk, and emerging content risk vectors across massive real-time traffic streams, making billions of decisions per day with single-digit millisecond latency constraints. This role sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and large-scale production engineering, combining deep science, system-wide impact, and business-critical outcomes. The models your team ships directly influence billions of dollars in advertising spend and the trust of the world's largest brands in Amazon DSP.

The Science Problems Are Genuinely Hard
You will tackle challenges including detecting sophisticated AI-generated and synthetic content, understanding nuanced contextual brand risk, identifying coordinated MFA space before they scale, balancing precision, recall, latency, explainability, and fairness, designing adaptive models resilient to adversarial evolution, and leveraging LLMs for semantic understanding in real-time, latency-constrained environments.

Why This Matters
Few roles offer the opportunity to work at the intersection of frontier AI, internet-scale production systems, adversarial environments, and business-critical impact — while tackling open-ended scientific challenges with real-world societal relevance. As AI reshapes the internet, the systems your team builds will define what trustworthy, high-quality digital systems look like for the next decade.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the science strategy for AI-powered brand safety classification.
- Build LLM-powered content classification systems making billions of decisions/day at single-digit millisecond latency
- Develop multimodal evaluation pipelines reasoning across text, images, audio, and video in real time
- Design adaptive ML systems resilient to adversarial evolution, semantic understanding for nuanced contextual brand risk.
- Define measurement frameworks and drive continuous improvement
- Translate research into production — own the path from prototype to deployed model
- Publish at peer-reviewed venues; contribute to the scientific community in adversarial ML, NLP, and content safety
- Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate successful experiments into large-scale, highly complex Amazon production systems.
