title: Sosiaalityöntekijä, Asiakas- ja palveluohjaus, Parainen
description:
Tehtäväsi

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaa sosiaalihuoltolain mukaisten huoli-ilmoitusten ja lastensuojelulain mukaisten ilmoitusten vastaanotosta ja käsittelystä sekä palvelutarpeen ja lastensuojelun tarpeen arvioinnista Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueella. Soihdussa on Varhassa seitsemän alueellista tiimiä.

Haemme Keskiseen Soihtuun Paraisten toimipisteeseen sosiaalityöntekijää, joka vastaa Paraisten ja Kemiönsaaren asiakkaiden palveluista. Sosiaalityöntekijänä vastaat omalta osaltasi sosiaalihuoltolain mukaisten ilmoitusten ja yhteydenottojen käsittelystä sekä lastensuojeluilmoitusten kiireellisyysarvioinneista. Työhön sisältyy sosiaalihuoltolain mukainen palvelutarpeen arviointi ja lastensuojelutarpeen moniammatillinen selvitystyöskentely. Tarvittaessa Soihtu-tiimin sosiaalityöntekijä tekee päätöksiä lapsi- ja perhekohtaisesta lastensuojelusta. Asiakkuuksien asianmukainen dokumentointi on osa työtehtävää. Työ on itsenäistä ja sopivasti haastavaa, mutta yksin sinun ei tarvitse pärjätä, sillä saat aina apua kokeneilta kollegoilta. Paraisten toimipisteessä on lisäksesi kaksi muuta sosiaalihuollon ammattilaista.

Työtä tehdään myös moniammatillisissa verkostoissa. Asiakastyön lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu kehittävä työote, Varhan kehittämistyöhön osallistuminen (tiimit, kokoukset, työnohjaus, täydennyskoulutus), vaikuttavuuden, toimintatapojen ja laadun arviointi, rakenteellinen sosiaalityö, yhteistyökumppaneiden konsultointi ja neuvonta. Työn liikkuvuuden vuoksi työssä tarvitaan ajokorttia.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tehtävänkuva on laaja, opit joka päivä uutta. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet, joten pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi ja vahvistamaan osaamistasi. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia mm. työ- ja perhe-elämän yhteensovittamiseen, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa työaikaasi. Työssä on mahdollisuus osittaiseen etätyöhön.

Työn merkityksellisyys, vaihtelevuus ja vastuullisuus korostuvat Soihdun sosiaalityössä. Saat tehdä töitä yhteistyössä muiden ammattiryhmien kanssa toisiaan arvostavassa tiimissä. Hyvä työyhteisö tukee ja tuo myös iloa ja huumoria työpäivään. Meillä pääset mukaan mielenkiintoiseen, energiseen ja toimintaansa kehittävään työyhteisöön!

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain 817/2015 mukainen sosiaalityöntekijän laillistus ja hyvä ruotsin ja suomen kielen taito. Lisäksi edellytämme kokemusta lapsiperhesosiaalityöstä tai lastensuojelusta. Eduksi luemme työkokemuksen arviointityöskentelystä ja Asiakasohjaus Soihdussa työskentelystä, itseohjautuvuuden, kehittämismyönteisyyden ja ratkaisukeskeisen ajattelutavan.

Keskisen Soihdun tiimissä on kaikkiaan 10 sosiaaliohjaajaa, 12 sosiaalityöntekijää, sairaanhoitaja ja johtava sosiaalityöntekijä. Tehtävät on jaettu niin, että osa tiimin jäsenistä työskentelee pääasiassa lapsiperheasiakkaiden ja osa työikäisten asiakkaiden kanssa. Keskisen Soihdun toimipisteet ovat Kaarinassa, Paimiossa, Paraisilla, Liedossa ja Loimaalla. Kyseisen viran toimipaikkana on tällä hetkellä Parainen.

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja haluat olla mukana kehittämässä asiakasohjausta sekä tukemassa lapsia ja perheitä, lähetä hakemuksesi meille. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Italy.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.

Meillä pääset kehittämään taitojasi CNC-koneistuksen parissa ja soveltamaan aiemmin hankittua osaamistasi aitoihin työelämän tilanteisiin. title: Senior Program Manager (Compliance)
description:
Position Overview:

The Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring full regulatory, customer, and corporate compliance across CREW-managed facilities, site services, and engineering operations. This role acts as the primary CREW representative for all external and internal audits, ensuring audit readiness, strong governance, and seamless coordination with stakeholders.

The position requires a proactive leader who can drive compliance culture, manage audit frameworks, and ensure all documentation, systems, and site conditions consistently meet required standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Regulatory & Compliance Governance

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable local regulations, corporate policies, and international standards related to facilities, engineering, environmental, occupational health & safety, and site services.
  • Develop, implement and continuously improve compliance frameworks, procedures, and control systems.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely implementation across CREW operations.
  • Maintain a robust compliance register for statutory requirements, licenses, and permits.
  • Host auditors during site visits, ensuring clear communication, transparency, and professional engagement, providing accurate responses to audit inquiries.
  • Own and drive closure of audit findings including root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.

Customer & External Stakeholder Compliance

  • Act as the key interface for compliance-related engagements with customers and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure customer-specific requirements are incorporated into CREW processes and services.
  • Support customer audits, assessments, and reporting requirements with high-quality deliverables.
  • Build strong relationships to enhance confidence in CREW’s compliance capabilities.

Site Readiness & Audit Preparedness

  • Ensure facilities and service areas are maintained in a continuous “audit-ready” condition.
  • Conduct internal audits, mock audits, and compliance inspections aligned with protocols.
  • Implement structured audit readiness programs covering engineering systems & facilities infrastructure.
  • Drive visual compliance standards including labeling, safety signage, and documentation boards.

Documentation Control & Compliance Systems

  • Establish and enforce document control systems compliant with standards, ensuring:
  • Controlled SOPs, policies, and procedures
  • Maintenance and calibration records
  • Inspection and testing logs
  • Contractor/vendor compliance documentation
  • Ensure traceability, version control, and accessibility of documents during audits.
  • Digitize and standardize compliance records where applicable.

IFM KPI / CPI Governance & Audits

  • Monitor IFM KPI and CPI audit frameworks across all service providers.
  • Conduct periodic performance audits to validate service delivery against contractual KPIs and CPIs.
  • Identify gaps in vendor performance and drive corrective actions with measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure alignment between compliance requirements and IFM service delivery standards.
  • Provide data-driven insights and reports on service performance, risks, and improvement areas.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify compliance risks across facilities, engineering, and site services operations.
  • Develop mitigation plans and track effectiveness of controls.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through audit findings, benchmarking, and best practices.
  • Support business continuity and risk preparedness initiatives related to compliance.

Stakeholder & Reporting Management

  • Provide regular compliance status reports, audit results, and risk updates to CREW leadership.
  • Ensure accurate data collection, analysis, and reporting for management reviews.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Quality, EHS, Procurement, HR, Legal).
  • Maintain transparency and accountability in all compliance activities.

Leadership & Culture

  • Promote a strong compliance culture across all CREW teams and vendors.
  • Coach and guide teams on audit preparedness and regulatory expectations.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and high-performance standards.
  • Lead by example with strong ethics, integrity, and professionalism.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Compliance, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in compliance, audit management, facilities, or engineering environments.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks, audit processes, and IFM service models.
  • Proven experience managing external audits and stakeholder engagements.
  • High attention to detail with a structured and systematic approach.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

Skills

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders.

  • Support the production of UGC videos, influencer content, product shoots, branded content, and performance creatives.

  • Ensure teams have the required briefs, references, equipment, and production assets.

title: Senior Map Experience Designer
description:
Our Story

Pointr is the market leader in Indoor Mapping, Location, and Analytics, and the inventor of AI-based map production. Its innovative (20+ patents) Pointr Maps™ platform is used by millions of users across offices, retail locations, airports, hospitals, and more every month.

As the top choice of Fortune 100 customers and billions of sqft. deployed globally (30+ countries), Pointr is always on the lookout for great team members to support its fast growth. Our core values are Ownership, Harmony, and Scale, and we look for Passionate, Kind, and No-Ego team members to join the team.

The Role

Senior Map Experience Designers are the visual and structural architects of how our users interact with indoor spaces. They are creative problem-solvers with strong systems thinking and a deep understanding of cartographic design, accessibility, and visual hierarchy.

At Pointr, we empower Map Experience Designers to own the end-to-end design of our maps, creating beautiful, highly readable, and intuitive spatial experiences for millions of users worldwide. To that end, they are comfortable operating in a flat, fast-paced organization and are energized by balancing aesthetics with complex technical constraints to shape the future of indoor mapping.

At its core, this role requires the Senior Map Experience Designer to combine strong technical and cartographic acumen with deep user empathy, collaborating closely with rendering engineers and cross-functional squads to turn complex spatial data into seamless, accessible, and scalable visual solutions.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the design of the map experience, with a focus on readability, accessibility, symbol design, and visual clarity for users of all ages.

  • Design map symbols, icons, labels, POIs, route visuals, zoom-level behaviors, and visual hierarchy across the map.

  • Work closely with map rendering engineers to create MapLibre-compatible design solutions.

  • Improve the treatment of 3D buildings and map layers so the map is easier to understand.

  • Create map-style guidelines, QA-implemented map designs, and document reusable rules for the rendering squad.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in product design, UX/UI, cartographic design, map design, GIS visualization, or spatial information design.

  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in map-based products, symbol design, visual hierarchy, readability, or complex data visualization.

  • Technical & Design Skills: Deep understanding of cartographic design, symbol/icon design, color theory, contrast, typography, map readability, zoom-level behaviors, labels, layers, and POIs.

  • Concepts: Solid understanding of MapLibre/Mapbox-style map concepts.

  • Core Competencies: Strong systems thinking, close attention to detail, analytical thinking, and deep user empathy.

  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to balance aesthetics and user experience against performance and technical constraints.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Tools & Frameworks: Hands-on experience with MapLibre, Mapbox GL, QGIS, ArcGIS, vector tiles, sprites, or glyphs.

  • Advanced Design: Experience working with 3D buildings, indoor maps, and complex wayfinding systems.

  • Accessibility: Strong background in designing for accessibility (e.g., color-blind-friendly designs or optimization for older users).

What We Offer

  • Senior position in a fast-growing global tech startup

  • Opportunity to work with top-notch global clients across the world

  • Friendly, helpful, and smart team

  • Hybrid working opportunity with a cozy office in Fulham, London

  • International environment and inclusive culture

  • Compensation: £78,000 – £82,000 Base

We Succeed Together

Great outcomes happen when talented, diverse people come together with a shared purpose. We value empathy, humility, and expertise, and we believe the best ideas come from collaboration, thoughtful challenges, and open feedback.

We empower our teams with clear goals and ownership, creating an environment where everyone can contribute, grow, and succeed. We take responsibility for our individual and collective development, celebrate our progress, learn from our experiences, and recognize the impact we create together.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please reach out to your recruiter or contact our team at hiring@pointr.tech.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in France.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

    • Strong ownership, problem-solving ability, organization, and willingness to take initiative in ambiguous situations.

title: Senior Consultant – ERP & Digital Transformation
description:
Position: Senior Consultant – ERP & Digital Transformation

Location: Bangalore



About Sattva


We Partner to deliver social impact at scale


Sattva Consulting is an Indian-origin, Global impact consulting firm and since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, businesses and government to deliver societal impact at scale.

We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our research & advisory services, knowledge platforms and collaborative initiatives.

Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in



The Opportunity



We are looking for a Senior Consultant – ERP & Digital Transformation with around 5–7 years of experience in ERP implementation, enterprise applications, functional consulting, and digital transformation to join our internal technology team.


The role will have a strong focus on ERP implementation, functional ownership, enhancement and continuous improvement, while also contributing to broader digital transformation initiatives across Sattva.


The person will work across the ERP lifecycle — from business requirements, process mapping and solution design through configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, rollout, stabilization and ongoing enhancements. They will become an internal ERP functional SME and knowledge owner, working closely with business teams, implementation partners and developers while retaining strong internal understanding and ownership of the platform.


Beyond ERP, the role will contribute to digital transformation by identifying opportunities to simplify and automate business processes, improving how enterprise applications work together, supporting technology adoption, and helping translate business problems into practical technology solutions.


While a strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes is required, particularly to support ERP implementations and enhancements, this is a technology and transformation role rather than a Finance position.




The Ideal Candidate

  • 5–7 years of relevant experience in ERP implementation, Financial tech implementation expertise.

  • Strong hands-on experience across ERP implementation and enhancement, beyond project or vendor coordination.

  • Experience across at least one substantial end-to-end ERP implementation or rollout, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing/UAT, data migration, integrations, go-live and stabilization.

  • Experience with Oracle NetSuite or another major enterprise ERP platform; NetSuite experience will be preferred.

  • Strong functional understanding of ERP platforms, including modules, configurations, workflows, master data, roles, transaction flows, integrations and customizations.

  • Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes and the ability to work independently with Finance stakeholders on ERP requirements. Knowledge of areas such as GL, AP, AR, billing, revenue, budgeting, project accounting, reconciliations and financial controls is expected.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into functional ERP solutions and work effectively with functional consultants, technical teams, developers and implementation partners.

  • Experience in business-process analysis and improvement, with the ability to identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation and better use of technology.


Key Responsibilities


ERP Functional Ownership & Delivery

–Act as the internal functional SME and knowledge owner for the ERP platform, developing strong understanding of its modules, configurations, workflows, master data, roles, integrations, customizations and dependencies.

--Lead or independently manage functional workstreams across ERP implementations, module rollouts, enhancements and upgrades.

--Conduct requirement workshops, process mapping and fit-gap analysis and translate business needs into functional requirements, process designs, workflows and configuration requirements.

--Participate hands-on in functional configuration, solution validation and troubleshooting, while coordinating with implementation partners or developers where technical development is required.

--Evaluate whether requirements should be addressed through standard ERP functionality, configuration, workflow, integration, automation, process change or customization.

--Maintain and prioritize ERP enhancements and ensure changes are appropriately designed, tested, documented and adopted.


ERP Data, Integrations & Release Management


--Manage ERP data migration, integrations, testing, releases, go-live and stabilization activities, ensuring data accuracy, system readiness and timely resolution of functional and integration issues.

Business Process & Digital Transformation

--Work with Finance, Projects, Operations, Procurement and other teams to understand business processes, pain points and technology requirements.

--Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify, standardize and automate processes using ERP and other enterprise technology capabilities.

--Translate business problems into practical technology solutions rather than simply automating existing processes.

--Contribute to digital transformation initiatives beyond ERP where processes span multiple enterprise applications or functions.

--Support evaluation and adoption of new platform capabilities, workflow automation and emerging technologies where they can improve business outcomes.

--Help ensure that enterprise applications and processes work together effectively rather than operating as isolated systems.


Governance, Controls & Knowledge Management

–Support appropriate ERP roles, permissions, approval workflows, segregation of duties and change controls.

–Ensure system configurations and workflows appropriately support business and financial controls.

–Maintain key functional documentation including process maps, configuration decisions, functional designs, role matrices, UAT artefacts, release documentation and known issues.

–Ensure effective knowledge transfer from implementation partners so that critical application knowledge is retained internally.

–Support user training, change communication and adoption for ERP and broader transformation initiatives.


Stakeholder & Partner Management

–Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology partner, translating business requirements into system solutions..

–Work closely with ERP implementation partners.

–Review vendor solution proposals, functional designs, estimates and recommendations and challenge them where required.

–Track implementation dependencies, risks, issues, deliverables and decisions and ensure timely closure.

–Build strong working relationships across Finance, Projects, Operations and other functions to drive adoption and continuous improvement.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on functional knowledge of an enterprise ERP platform.

  • Experience across the ERP lifecycle — requirements, solutioning, configuration, migration, integration, testing, deployment and stabilization.

  • Strong business-analysis skills, including process mapping, fit-gap analysis and translating requirements into functional designs.

  • Good understanding of Finance and Accounting processes and how operational transactions flow through an ERP.

  • Experience with ERP integrations, master data, data migration and reconciliation.

  • Ability to independently navigate, analyse, troubleshoot and validate ERP solutions.

  • Understanding of ERP access controls, workflows, approvals and basic application governance.

  • Experience working across business and technology teams and managing implementation partners/vendors.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and move comfortably between hands-on ERP work and broader transformation initiatives.

  • Experience working with enterprise applications beyond ERP, such as CRM, Professional Services Automation (PSA), project management, collaboration, or workflow automation platforms.


Why Sattva?


It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.


● Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design

● Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment

● Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can

● Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow



How to Prepare?

This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality

and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.

FAQs on the Hiring Process

Next Steps

Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all!


Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing all employees with education, training, and development opportunities to create a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and included.

Necessary tools for operating, like MS office etc, will be provided

description:

We are seeking an experienced professional to join our motivated IT team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of critical data infrastructure from day one, proactively contributing your ideas and expertise. We offer a professional environment with individual development opportunities, allowing you to make a meaningful impact from within.

Activities

We are looking for you to:

  • Design, build, and operate database integrations and RESTful APIs for system and frontend integration, contributing to the conception and implementation of backend architectures for business applications.

Requirements

We expect you to have:

Team

You will be joining a motivated IT team that offers a professional environment with individual development opportunities. You will take ownership of critical data infrastructure from day one and proactively contribute your ideas and expertise.

We keep things simple, personal, and fast. First, a 60-minute online interview with your Line Manager and a Senior Colleague to get to know each other. Inverto is one of the leading procurement and supply chain management consultancies in the world. Backed by the power of BCG, we've grown from a successful European consultancy into a global company with a distinct offering. Our Business Services Teams play a critical role in enabling our business, driving continuous improvement, and shaping how we scale. Here, you can use your expertise to make a meaningful impact from within, taking on responsibility from day one and seeing the difference your work makes. As we continue to grow, so will your opportunities, in an environment that supports your development and empowers you to grow as we grow. There's never been a better time to join Inverto and be part of what comes next.

title: Director, CABS Center
description:
As a Director, CABS Center, you will serve as the Director,Commissions and Boards (CABS) Center, and provide technical expertise and comprehensive research for human resources management services to Presidential Boards, Commissions, and small government/quasi government agencies. Location of position: Office of Human Resources Management (OHRM), Washington, D.C. We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

· Interfaces with the Office of the General Counsel, the Office of Government Ethics, the Office of Personnel Management, Office of Management and Budget, Department of State, Government Accountability Office, and other offices on behalf of CABs clients, stakeholders and partners. · Interfaces with legislative staff, the Executive Office of the president, and the Committee Management Secretariat regarding new legislation for new Commissions, Boards and small agencies. Interprets enabling and subsequent legislation impacting clients. · Provides leadership, expert assistance and authoritative advice on interpretation of governing policy in designated all human resources areas. Researches the most sensitive, complex or otherwise controversial issues, utilizing all resources available. In those cases where existing agency policy does not cover the problem or issue under review, the incumbent consults references such as United States Code and the Code of Federal Regulations, Comptroller General and GAO audit decisions, and other legal precedents available; interprets these legal sources, and develops definitive policy recommendations based on extensive analysis. Findings and recommendations ensure that agency policy remains in conformance with ongoing governmental, Presidential and/or Congressional initiatives. · Performs special assignments as directed, which may concern any phase of the CABS operation and which may require research in analyzing, appraising and evaluating operational plans and necessitate numerous contacts, clearances and arrangements with internal and external organizational entities with diversified missions. Organizes resources to carry out projects and takes necessary steps for implementation. · Advises OHRM and CABS agencies on important matters relating to the management of large, complex projects that are highly sensitive, emotionally charged or otherwise have potential far-reaching implications. Implements decisions made by higher level agency management officials, oftentimes facilitating the work of other agency employees to accomplish desired objectives. Ensures that the decisions are reflected in legislative and policy proposals, in internal and external directives and subsequently, in organizational operating procedures. · Establishes and maintains cooperative working relationships with GSA business partners and client organizations. Ensures compliance with Federal laws and regulations and GSA regulations, policies, and procedures. Participates with other OHRM officials and leadership in the development of policies, procedures, plans, objectives, goals and programs of the organization, and for input into national policies, programs, objectives and goals. · Attends staff meetings, OHRM leadership meetings and/or other conferences advising on recruitment/staffing matters, furnishing technical advice, and implementing processes. The incumbent facilitates long range recruitment and staffing missions and organizational plans/changes and/or updates. Keeps the supervisor informed of major phases of HR policy, regulatory requirements, and related administrative tools/practices. · Understands the clients' business needs and assists in the creation and application of recruitment/staffing solutions. Advises and assists clients on all human resource management issues related to recruitment/staffing. Collaborates with other GSA HR personnel regarding the enhancement and maintenance of a recruitment/staffing program designed to maintain the high competence and character of the Federal civil service and its reputation for integrity, continuity, nonpartisanship, equality of opportunity, merit and responsiveness to the public good.

Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service. Serve a one year probationary period, if required. Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level). Serve a one year supervisory or managerial probationary period, if required. Participate in the Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP), which includes attending meetings and planning activities; and carrying out mission-critical work at a designated location other than your primary work site (which may be outside of your commuting area).

title: Sr. Quality Assurance & Regulatory Compliance Analyst
description:
Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement across global clinical research operations. As a Senior Quality Assurance & Regulatory Compliance Analyst, you will play a critical role in maintaining and enhancing quality systems, supporting regulatory compliance initiatives, leading audits, and partnering with operational teams to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and company standards. This position offers the opportunity to influence quality strategy, mentor colleagues, and contribute to processes that support the successful delivery of clinical trial services worldwide.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation, benefits and incentives

  • Engaging employee events and hybrid work technology support

  • The opportunity to be part of a global inclusive team

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead and support quality assurance and regulatory compliance activities to ensure adherence to applicable regulations, industry standards, and company procedures.

  • Review, approve, and analyze corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), deviations, notes to file (NTFs), compliance reports, and other quality-related documentation.

  • Monitor, trend, and report quality and compliance metrics, ensuring issues are appropriately tracked, investigated, and resolved in a timely manner.

  • Plan, conduct, document, and report internal quality audits in accordance with established audit programs and quality requirements.

  • Perform and support external audits, including vendor, supplier, sponsor, and regulatory inspection activities.

  • Develop audit reports, communicate findings, and ensure corrective actions are implemented, monitored, and verified for effectiveness.

  • Review operational data and reports to identify quality trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Perform quality reviews of source documentation, study records, shipments, and quality-related deliverables as required.

  • Partner with operational leadership to identify, implement, and maintain enhancements to quality systems and compliance processes.

  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, training materials, and quality guidance documents.

  • Provide training, coaching, and mentorship on audit processes, compliance reporting, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

  • Escalate quality concerns and compliance risks appropriately and provide recommendations for mitigation and resolution.

  • Support sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and quality readiness initiatives across the organization.

  • Stay informed of evolving regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and quality standards applicable to clinical research and healthcare technology environments.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Healthcare, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, or a related scientific field.

  • Quality Auditor certification or equivalent quality certification preferred.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Compliance, Auditing, Inspection Readiness, or related quality functions within a regulated environment.

  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), quality management systems, regulatory requirements, and industry quality standards.

  • Experience conducting internal, external, vendor, supplier, sponsor, or regulatory audits.

  • Demonstrated expertise in CAPA management, deviation management, compliance investigations, and quality risk assessment.

  • Strong understanding of clinical research processes, clinical trial operations, and applicable regulatory frameworks.

  • Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, training programs, and quality documentation.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, assess risk, and recommend process improvements.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt effectively in a dynamic and regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, influence stakeholders, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Senior Human Subjects Protection Scientist supporting the Office of Research and Regulatory Compliance (ORRC), Office of Human Research Oversight (OHRO) at Defense Health Agency Research & Development (DHA R&D).

The ORRC OHRO is responsible for ensuring that DHA conducted, contracted, sponsored, supported or managed research, and U.S. Army Medical Command investigations involving human subjects, human anatomical substances or animals are conducted in accordance with Federal, DoD, and international regulatory requirements.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Provide regulatory-based written review of protocols using standardized checklists to ensure compliance with all applicable Federal, DoD, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), state, host nation, and DHA R&D human subjects protection requirements

  • This position is tasked with reviewing research protocols that have undergone review and approval by the local Institutional Review Board (IRB); the OHRO reviewer will delineate deficiencies and areas of regulatory noncompliance and make recommendations to the OHRO Federal Approval Authority (AAs) regarding regulatory and ethical issues in OHRO submissions. The reviewer will work with the investigator to make updates/revisions to the materials to bring the protocol into compliance for OHRO approval

  • Reviewers will be assigned a portfolio of protocols for initial review; this includes determinations of not research, research not involving human subjects, exempt research, non-exempt research, and protocols utilizing cadavers/cadaveric specimens

  • Provide accurate information, assistance, and documents to customers and OHRO Federal personnel when requested with appropriate professionalism in a timely manner

  • This will require active management of the assigned protocol portfolio; this includes data entry activities and use of OHRO specific information management systems to track information and activities related to protocol review

  • Assist the Government to develop policies, procedures, guidelines, and other materials to ensure compliance with current regulations and to update investigators, research managers and administrators, and administrative staff on human subjects protection and regulatory compliance policies and procedures as they apply to research supported by the DHA R&D

  • Assist in the development of local procedures and guidance for the OHRO and the DHA R&D in the area of human subjects’ protection

  • Support the development and implementation of effective mechanisms to communicate and interpret these regulations, policies, and guidelines

  • Assist in development and implementation of internal OHRO operating procedures and review guidelines as requested

  • Foster regulatory compliance through education and training of investigators, research managers, administrators, and OHRO staff, and provide assistance to program offices and investigators with interpretation of human subjects protection and cadaver use requirements

  • Acquire and retain knowledge of current Federal, DoD, FDA, Army, state, host nation, and DHA regulatory requirements related to the protection of human subjects in research and cadaver use and apply knowledge of these regulations and general ethical principles during OHRO reviews of assigned projects

  • Interact with colleagues, consultants, investigators, research directors, supervisors, other US Army personnel, etc., to gather or disseminate information or to provide assistance related to assigned protocols, attend meetings and conference calls as necessary, and provide education on human subjects protection regulations and OHRO requirements

  • Participate in performance improvement activities and shall task contract personnel to participate in specific working groups to improve and streamline the protocol review and approvals processes, and provide input and assistance with formulating and writing OHRO standard operating procedures and work instructions

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific, or related discipline
  • Required Experience: 3+ years of related human subjects’ protection experience
  • Required Technical Skills: Knowledge of the Federal regulations governing the protection of human research subjects, including a firm foundation in the Common Rule and FDA regulations, to allow for effective and responsible management of a caseload of research protocols submitted for DHA R&D review and oversight; Working knowledge of ethical principles related to participation of humans in research; Working knowledge of scientific research concepts and terminology to properly conduct detailed analyses of all research protocols submitted for IRB review; Following individual training and guidance, ability to become expert at applying DoD, and DHA R&D human subjects protection regulations, policies and guidelines; Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

title: Child and Adolescent In Home Therapist - Family Functional Therapist  - 00279
description:
About WellLife Network: WellLife Network is a leading health and human services organization dedicated to supporting individuals and families across New York City and Long Island. Recognized as a 2023 top-rated nonprofit, WellLife Network empowers people to overcome life’s challenges and achieve greater independence, well-being, and inclusion. We offer a comprehensive suite of programs spanning mental health, developmental disabilities, substance abuse, housing, and employment support, all grounded in a commitment to compassionate, high-quality care. Central to our mission is an unwavering dedication to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) within our organization and in the communities we serve. As a trusted community partner, WellLife Network fosters a nurturing environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and realize their fullest potential.

Position Summary: The Child and Adolescent In Home Therapist - Family Functional Therapist plays a key role within the Children and Family Treatment and Support Services (CFTSS) framework by providing intensive, evidence-based family therapy to youth ages 10–18 and their families. The clinician delivers services primarily in the home and community using the structured FFT model to strengthen family relationships, improve communication, reduce behavioral and emotional concerns, and promote long-term stability. Responsibilities include comprehensive assessment, treatment planning, weekly family and/or individual therapy, care coordination, crisis support, and ongoing documentation. The selected candidate will receive specialized training, supervision, and ongoing support in the FFT model to ensure effective and fidelity-based service delivery. New licensed graduates are welcome to apply.

This position is hybrid and allows up to two (2) remote workdays per week following successful completion of onboarding and required training. Remote work is a discretionary privilege based on program needs, performance, productivity, and compliance with agency expectations and may be modified or rescinded at any time.

Essential Accountabilities

  1. Provide evidence-based clinical services to children, adolescents, and families utilizing the Functional Family Therapy (FFT) model. The selected candidate will receive specialized training and ongoing support in the FFT model, primarily serving youth ages 10–18 and their families.

  2. Maintain a caseload of approximately 10–15 families, providing services for an average duration of 8–26 weeks, consistent with FFT model requirements and program expectations.

  3. Provide a minimum of weekly, one-hour family therapy sessions, primarily in the home and community, with scheduling flexibility, including evening and other nontraditional hours, to accommodate family availability and support treatment engagement.

  4. Conduct comprehensive clinical assessments, identify behavioral health needs, and develop appropriate diagnoses and treatment recommendations within scope of practice.

  5. Develop, implement, review, and maintain individualized treatment plans consistent with identified needs, family goals, and program requirements.

  6. Provide individual, family, and/or group clinical interventions, as clinically indicated and consistent with program requirements.

  7. Deliver services using a strength-based, family-driven, trauma-informed, and person-centered approach that promotes engagement, stabilization, skill development, and improved family functioning.

  8. Provide crisis intervention and clinical support to assigned clients and families, in person or by telephone, when available and clinically appropriate.

  9. Complete timely and accurate documentation of all clinical services, including progress notes, collateral contacts, assessments, treatment plans, telephone contacts, and other required program documentation within established deadlines.

  10. Coordinate care and maintain appropriate communication with Care Managers/Care Coordinators, schools, behavioral health providers, and other involved service providers, as applicable.

  11. Adhere to FFT fidelity standards, including required clinical practices, data collection, outcome monitoring, referral requirements, reporting expectations, and model-specific documentation.

  12. Complete all annual and as assigned required state, agency, program and FFT trainings, individual and/or group supervision, consultation, fidelity monitoring, and other professional development activities.

  13. Complete required Mandated Reporter Training and recognize and report suspected or known child abuse or maltreatment in accordance with applicable law and agency policy.

  14. Adhere to all applicable confidentiality laws, regulations, agency policies, and professional standards.

  15. Promptly report identified or suspected youth high-risk behaviors, safety concerns, significant clinical concerns, and reportable incidents in accordance with agency protocols and applicable reporting requirements.

  16. Maintain required Direct Service Units and other established productivity expectations.

  17. Submit a weekly work schedule to the Supervisor and report changes to the schedule as they occur.

  18. Utilize Paycom to accurately record all hours worked in accordance with agency policies and procedures.

  19. Accurately track and submit mileage reimbursement documentation within established agency timelines.

  20. Participate in Division-wide trainings, program meetings, staff events, workshops, conferences, OMH trainings, and other required professional development activities.

  21. Maintain reliable access to a personal vehicle throughout the workday and transport youth and/or family members when clinically appropriate and required for service delivery.

  22. Maintain required automobile insurance coverage and submit updated proof of insurance prior to expiration.

  23. Adhere to all requirements and protocols established within the agency Safety Policy and other applicable health and safety procedures.

  24. Perform all other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support effective program operations and service delivery.

title: Medical Representative
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will be a trusted scientific partner to healthcare professionals across an assigned territory in the Philippines. You will build evidence-based relationships, use local insight to improve appropriate patient care and access, and deliver territory goals. You will work closely with colleagues across medical, marketing, access and supply to create a joined-up customer experience. We value curiosity, integrity, clear thinking and a strong patient focus. This role offers clear career growth, meaningful impact for patients, and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare professionals, pharmacists and local stakeholders through regular in-person and digital engagement. - Use scientific knowledge and local treatment guidance to make patient-focused, evidence-based recommendations. - Develop and execute territory plans using data and customer insight to prioritise visits and opportunities. - Deliver sales and service objectives while tracking performance and adjusting plans as needed. - Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to ensure patients benefit from appropriate care and a consistent customer experience. - Keep accurate records, comply with local laws and company standards, and manage samples, expenses and inventory responsibly. Responsibilities and outcomes you will be measured on - Achievement of territory targets and agreed activity metrics. - Quality and credibility of scientific customer engagement. - Use of territory insights to shape and improve local plans. - Timely and accurate reporting and adherence to compliance requirements. - Contribution to team goals and cross-functional initiatives. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals - Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. - Minimum 1 year of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare field sales, or an equivalent customer-facing healthcare role. - Clear communication skills in English and Filipino for effective, patient-focused discussions. - Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel across the assigned territory. - Proficiency with common digital tools and CRM systems for planning, reporting and insight generation. - Commitment to follow local laws, industry codes and company policies in all interactions. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus - Experience working in the Philippines healthcare market or familiarity with local treatment pathways. - Experience with multi-channel engagement or digital customer interactions. - Ability to use analytics or business intelligence tools to generate actionable territory insights. - Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and local treatment guidance with healthcare professionals. - Strong planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. - Growth mindset, openness to feedback and willingness to learn. Work arrangement This role is on-site and field-based in the Philippines. Expect regular travel across your assigned territory. Office and remote reporting may be required for collaboration and administrative tasks. How to apply We would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a short note telling us why this role matters to you. If you want a role where your work helps patients and grows your career, apply now.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

title: Pharmacy Technician - Quality Assurance

Pharmacy Technician - Quality Assurance is a specialized position responsible for supporting quality program within Pharmacy Service. Primary responsibilities involve support of the Integrated quality program in compliance with audits, administrative duties, patient safety activities, and quality/performance improvement initiatives.

Collects data, analyzes, prepares reports, and presents results for routine safety, performance, and regulatory compliance monitoring or as needed for the plan-do-study-act cycle of ongoing quality improvement initiatives and medication use evaluations. ServiceStream is looking for an experienced National Warehouse Lead to join our Supply Chain team and play a key role in strengthening the performance, capability and consistency of our national warehouse operations.

This is an opportunity for an experienced warehouse leader who combines strong people leadership with excellent operational, systems and commercial capability.

Your responsibilities will include:

title: Executive Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering
description:

#LI-Hybrid

Reporting to the VP, Applied AI, Data Science, and Commercial Intelligence, the Executive Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering leads the strategy, architecture, and implementation of the enterprise semantic layer and knowledge engineering capabilities that power NovaOS. This role is responsible for creating a trusted, reusable knowledge foundation that connects data, business concepts, ontologies, taxonomies, and AI agents to enable consistent reasoning, interoperability, and scalable enterprise intelligence.

The ideal location for this role is East Hanover but remote work may be possible (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the enterprise strategy for semantic technologies, knowledge engineering, and knowledge graph capabilities.

  • Lead the development and governance of enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, business vocabularies, and semantic models that establish a shared understanding across the organization.

  • Design and implement the enterprise semantic layer that enables trusted AI, consistent analytics, interoperability, and reusable business knowledge.

  • Partner with Applied AI, Data Science, Product Management, Engineering, and Business teams to embed semantic capabilities into NovaOS products and AI solutions.

  • 10+ years of experience in semantic technologies, knowledge engineering, enterprise architecture, data management, or AI platforms, including leadership experience.

  • Deep expertise with ontologies, taxonomies, metadata, RDF/OWL, knowledge graphs, graph databases, semantic web technologies, and enterprise information architecture.

  • Experience building enterprise semantic platforms that enable AI, analytics, search, and data interoperability at scale.

  • Exceptional leadership, executive communication, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience applying semantic technologies to generative AI, agentic AI, RAG, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.

title: Senior Application Development Engineer
description:
About the Position

Key Responsibilities

A. Application Exploration & Opportunity Identification

  • Proactively explore new surface coating applications across industries such as energy, aviation, automotive and general industrial sectors.
  • Engage with customers, end users, research partners, and the broader industry ecosystem to discover pain points, unmet needs, and forward-looking opportunities.
  • Analyze real operating conditions and failure modes (wear, corrosion, thermal shock, erosion, high‑temperature exposure, etc.).
  • Build a structured Application Opportunity Pipeline with clear technical and business rationale.

B. Materials & Process Recommendation (Thermal Spray Focus)

  • Recommend appropriate powder materials for each application (e.g., WC‑Co/Cr, Cr₃C₂‑NiCr, Al₂O₃‑TiO₂, Ni‑based alloys, YSZ).
  • Select suitable thermal spray processes such as HVOF, APS, cold spray, LPPS, etc.
  • Evaluate and compare thermal spray vs. overlay welding in terms of performance, feasibility, and application boundaries.
  • Provide clear technical justification for material selection, process window, and performance expectations.

C. Validation & Sample Testing

  • Design coating validation plans covering wear resistance, corrosion behavior, thermal properties, and microstructure analysis
  • Coordinate with internal labs or external partners to execute tests.
  • Analyze test results and prepare clear technical reports with recommended design improvements.

D. Customer Trials & Technical Approval

  • Support customer trial runs and field testing.
  • Track real‑world performance, gather feedback, and drive iterative improvements.
  • Lead technical discussions to achieve customer qualification and approval.
  • Support introduction into customer/OEMs’ technical specifications.

E. Solution Packaging & Internal Enablement

  • Convert successful projects into standardized solution packages including:
    • Application scenario
    • Material & process selection
    • Key parameters
    • Testing & acceptance criteria
    • Risks & mitigation
  • Build internal knowhow to uplift team capabilities in thermal spray applications.
  • Share insights and best practices across local and global coating teams.

Qualifications & Experiences

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree in materials science, mechanical engineering, or related fields.
  • More than 5 years’ experience in surface engineering, coating materials, or thermal spray.
  • Hands-on expertise in at least one thermal spray process: HVOF, HVAF, APS, LPPS, etc.
  • Familiarity with at least two powder material families: WC-Co, Cr₃C₂ NiCr, Al₂O₃, Ni based alloys, YSZ, etc.
  • Experience taking coating solutions from concept → validation → customer approval.
  • Strong capability to analyze operating conditions and failure mechanisms.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and able to independently push projects forward.
  • Good communication skills for both internal collaboration and customer-facing engagement. fluency in written and spoken English
  • Preferred: Understanding of overlay welding vs. thermal spray boundaries.
  • Preferred: Experience in application development, technical marketing, or new business exploration.
  • Preferred: Experience with DOE or systematic validation methodologies.

Physical demands and working environment

  • Office environment
  • Regular domestic travel in China, occasional global travel.

Communication/Interface

Frequent communication with local sales team, and other stakeholders in division.

Interaction with customers, end users and partners.

Working at Höganäs

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world - and we - face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net-zero climate emissions.

More about Höganäs


Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials.

The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. title: Product Manager, Apps
description:
Howdy, we’re Heidi 👋

“The AI startup growing faster than Canva”

That’s what the Financial Review called us. In 18 months, we supported over 73 million patient visits and become one of the fastest-growing companies in the world.

We pivoted from broad healthcare AI to building Earth’s finest AI Care Partner. Today, we support over 2 million patient sessions weekly across 116 countries and over 110 languages. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians use Heidi to complete documentation.

Our mission is simple: strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.

We’ve found product-market fit with individual clinicians through our freemium medical scribe, transforming unstructured clinical visits into structured text artefacts. Clinicians and organizations quite like it. Now, we embark upon consuming more than just documentation. Every new job a clinician delegates to Heidi makes patients feel more attended to, cleans up health system logjams, and lets clinicians be clinicians again.

That’s where you come in.

The role

We’re looking for a Product Manager who obsesses over the surfaces clinicians touch hundreds of times per day. Someone who believes consumer-grade craft belongs in B2B software.

You will own Heidi’s client platforms (iOS, Android, and desktop) that over 200,000 clinicians use daily. Every interaction, every millisecond of latency, every pixel matters when clinicians are mid-consultation with patients.

You will partner closely with engineering, design, and platform teams to continuously raise the bar on quality and reliability across every surface.

This role will be based in either our Sydney or Melbourne office.

We don’t care about logos; the traditional insignia of competence. We’ll evaluate senior well-credentialed candidates and young, hungry hopefuls alike.

What you’ll do

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for Heidi’s client platforms (iOS, Android, Desktop), setting clear goals and being held accountable to achieving them

  • Obsess over performance; every frame drop, every loading spinner, every crash is personal to you

  • Navigate platform constraints and opportunities across iOS, Android, and Electron, knowing when to build native vs cross-platform

  • Own mobile monetisation strategy including App Store T&Cs, onboarding optimisation, and payment pathways

  • Think native-first: leverage iOS/Android platform capabilities (Bluetooth, native calling, camera, clipboard) for clinician workflows

  • Ship meaningful improvements by working closely with engineering and design, understanding that small changes affect millions of sessions weekly

  • Partner with hardware teams on design-engineering tradeoffs when software meets device (wearables, ambient surfaces)

  • Sweat the details that separate good software from beloved software; microinteractions most PMs wouldn’t notice

  • Maintain high standards for issue-tracking hygiene, design system consistency, and team shipping practices

  • Build strong relationships with Apple, Google, and platform teams to stay ahead of OS changes

If we’d worked together the last 6 weeks, you’d have:

  • Fixed a customer-reported crash and had them re-engage with the app within the week

  • Run a beta with 3-4 customer testers, gathered real feedback on IA/UX, and iterated based on what you learned

  • Identified a platform-specific problem (iOS tracking gap, Android performance regression) and created a clear remediation path

  • Started a project on your own initiative to improve mobile monetisation discovery

  • Submitted a code fix yourself when you got frustrated waiting (Swift tweak, Android feedback merged)

What you’ll need

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • 4+ years shipping consumer products across mobile and desktop, though we care more about what you’ve built than time served

  • A romantic streak about software and a belief that great design transforms someone’s day

  • Deep platform fluency with opinions about when to diverge vs converge across iOS and Android

  • Performance obsession; you’ve profiled apps, optimised render loops, and know what causes jank

  • Consumer product craft in B2B contexts where you refused to compromise on polish

  • You build with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, whatever ships faster) and can show what you’ve made with them

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems (prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation) and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • You default to building over requesting

  • Strong opinions, weakly held; you’ll shift the room when you’re right

  • Data fluency with diagnostic teeth; you can read Amplitude dashboards and diagnose platform-specific problems

If you answer ‘NO’ to these questions, this may not be the job for you:

  • Are you an execution powerhouse?

  • Have you shipped something this week?

  • Are you good at games?

  • Did you have a weird teenage hobby?

  • Are you able to execute without a legion of data analysts, product marketers, and research coordinators at your beck and call?

  • Does the prospect of making health systems a lot nicer make you feel fuzzy inside?

Why Heidi?

Our health systems hurt everybody. Systems are log-jammed, clinicians' lives degrade in quality, and patients churn through the meat-grinder.

This is neither a special nor interesting insight.

However, it means we're solving a real problem. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians use Heidi. Every clinician using Heidi gets hours back in their day. This is the starting point to build the product of your dreams: immense distribution, and a world of potential.

You'll join a team that doesn't celebrate fundraise milestones, imaginary valuations, and glossy PR. We live and breathe the pain of modern health systems, and won't rest until we've exacted the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, and designers who've felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like - the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

The bad news is it's not an easy job - you will tear your hair out more than once. Modern technology company concepts don't transpose into healthcare easily. The lows are really low.

The good news is you will trust and admire everybody you work with, and rest easy knowing you're doing THE defining work of your career. The highs are blindingly high.

Heidi will take care of you. We offer a $1,000 annual learning and development budget, a $150/month health and wellness allowance, a $500 home office budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to $10,000, four weeks of work from anywhere per year, and serious equity.

---

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we don't track hours or micromanage - you're trusted to perform. We value mental health and adapt to your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.
