Työskentelet osana 15 hengen Pesti-yksikköä, joka tarjoaa työnantajapalveluita verkostomaisesti yhdessä BusinessOulun muiden yksiköiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa. Tuleva tiimisi koostuu osaavista asiantuntijoista, joille laadukas asiakaspalvelu, työn ilo ja hyvä yhteishenki ovat tärkeitä. Työtä tehdään toimistollamme Sepänkadulla, asiakkaiden tiloissa sekä osittain etänä.

Haemme työnantajapalveluita tuottavaan Pesti-yksikköömme rekrytointiasiantuntijaa, jonka päävastuualueena on ICT- & terveysteknologia -toimialat. Toimit tehtävässä työparimallilla ja hoidat tarvittaessa myös muiden toimialojen asiakkuuksia. Olet osa Pesti-yksikön rekrytointitiimiä, joka koostuu eri toimialoista vastaavista rekrytointiasiantuntijoista.

Tehtävän sisältö
Rekrytointiasiantuntijana teet tiivistä yhteistyötä alueen yritysten kanssa. Kartoitat rekrytointi- ja osaamistarpeita sekä rakennat asiakaskohtaisia palveluratkaisuja sopivien osaajien löytämiseksi. Toimit virkavastuulla ja kykenet tuottamaan joustavasti lakisääteistä työnvälityspalvelua.
Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja verkostojen tarpeita mukaillen.
Työssäsi tuotat asiakaslähtöistä ja laadukasta rekrytointipalvelua:
- kontaktoit asiakkaita aktiivisesti ja vastaat heidän yhteydenottoihinsa palvelulupauksemme mukaisesti
- teet yrityskäyntejä sekä kohtaat yritysten edustajia erilaisissa tapahtumissa
- osallistut oman vastuutoimialasi ajankohtaisen työmarkkinatiedon tuottamiseen ja raportointiin yhdessä BusinessOulun eri yksiköiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Tehtävässä tarvitaan valmiutta esiintyä ja esitellä palveluitamme erilaisissa sidosryhmätapahtumissa. Pystyt toimimaan verkostoissa ja tapahtumissa koko Oulun seudun työllisyysalueella.
Vastaat asiakkaan rekrytointiprosessin etenemisestä ja seurannasta itsenäisesti, tiimisi vahvalla tuella. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä BusinessOulun asiantuntijoiden kanssa avointen työpaikkojen löytämiseksi ja sopivien hakijoiden tavoittamiseksi.

Kenelle työ sopii?
Haemme tiimiimme yrittäjämäisesti ajattelevaa tekijää, jolla on aito halu auttaa yrityksiä menestymään ja kasvamaan. Tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja osana tiimiä. Osaat kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti etkä säikähdä työlle asetettuja numeerisia ja laadullisia tavoitteita. Et myöskään pelkää tarttua puhelimeen ja soittaa uusille asiakkaille.

Tehtävässä vaaditaan rohkeutta luoda uusia asiakassuhteita, ylläpitää olemassa olevia sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa uteliaalla ja kehittävällä otteella. Olet valmis oppimaan uutta, uusia työskentelytapoja ja malleja sekä valmis ottamaan haltuun erilaisia asiakkuudenhallintajärjestelmiä. Asiakaslähtöisyys ja hyvä asiakaskokemus ovat sinulle tärkeitä. Työssä menestyminen vaatii hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja, organisointikykyä sekä kykyä työskennellä useiden tehtäväkokonaisuuksien parissa. Näkemys alueen työmarkkinoista ja elinkeinoelämän tilanteesta tukee tehtävässä onnistumista.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto.

Tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää proaktiivista verkostoitumisotetta, huolellisuutta sekä kykyä toimia muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Palvelet asiakkaita ja työskentelet verkostoissa suomen kielen lisäksi tarvittaessa myös englanniksi.

Kokemus vastaavista rekrytointitehtävistä, työskentely yritysten kanssa, alueen yritysverkostojen tuntemus, toimialaosaaminen sekä työvoimapalveluiden järjestämiseen liittyvän lainsäädännön tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn Oulun seudun elinvoiman ja työllisyyden edistämisessä. Monipuolisen tehtäväkentän lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä hyvän perehdytyksen työhön.

Oulun kaupunki käyttää vakinaisissa viroissa kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Ennen virkavaalin vahvistamista on valitun henkilön esitettävä todistus terveydentilastaan (lääkärintodistus) virkaa varten.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55A. Hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/10959/2026. Hakemukset on toimitettava 7.9.2026 klo 16.15 mennessä. Haastattelut pyritään pitämään viikoilla 38-39.

title: Tekninen päällikkö
description:
Vetovoimainen Nurmes hakee kaupunkirakennepalvelujen toimialalle tekniikan päällikköä. Teknisen päällikön vakinaiseen virkaan haetaan vastuullista ja innostavaa suunnannäyttäjää, jolla on jo hyvät näytöt onnistumisista investoinneissa ja henkilöstön johtamisessa sekä kokemusta talousasioiden hallinnasta.

Kaupunkirakennepalveluiden toimiala vastaa erityisesti toimivan ja viihtyisän elinympäristön suunnittelusta, rakentamisesta ja ylläpidosta. Tavoitteena on elinvoimainen ja toimiva kaupunki, joka vastaa asukkaiden ja elinkeinoelämän muuttuvia tarpeita.

Tekninen päällikkö vastaa teknisten palvelujen tulosalueilla (kuntatekniikka, toimitilojen kunnossapito ja kiinteistöpalvelut) laadittavista teknisistä selvityksistä, suunnitteluttamisesta ja hankkeiden rakennuttamisesta sekä hankerahoitusten valmistelusta osaltaan.

Tekninen päällikkö toimii teknisten palvelujen mestareiden ja talotekniikka-asiantuntijan esihenkilönä.
Hakijalta odotetaan kokemusta kiinteistönhoidosta, rakennus- tai talotekniikasta, rakennuttamisesta, toimitilojen hallinnasta, esihenkilötehtävistä sekä talousasioiden hallinnasta. Työ edellyttää ajokorttia virkatehtävien hoitamiseksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on virkaan soveltuva AMK-tutkinto rakennus- tai talotekniikan alalta.

Työssä edellytetään laajojen kokonaisuuksien ja talouden hallintaa, vastuullista ja innostavaa työotetta, hyviä neuvottelu-, esihenkilö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä paineensietokykyä ja taitoa priorisoida työtehtäviä.

Eduksi luetaan riittävä kokemus johtamistehtävistä sekä kunnallisen päätöksenteon ja toimintaympäristön tuntemus.

Hae tehtävää 14.9.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä Kuntarekry.fi -sivuston kautta.

Virka täytetään vakinaisesti 1.12.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Virkaan valitun on ennen viran vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Virkaa täytettäessä noudatetaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa. Palkkaus kunta-alan teknisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen TS mukaan. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4 412,49 euroa.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Greece.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Investor Relations Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Investor Relations Associate based in Canada.

This is a remote, relationship-driven role focused on building trust with family offices and high-net-worth investors.
You will support live fundraising mandates while developing and expanding your own network of allocators.
The role combines investor qualification, relationship management, research, briefing preparation, and thoughtful follow-up.
You will work closely with a senior investor team and gain hands-on exposure to live deal flow from the start.
Success depends on your ability to identify relevant investors, earn meaningful conversations, and build lasting relationships.
You will operate in a fast-moving, senior, and highly autonomous environment where discretion and sound judgment are essential.
The position also offers an opportunity to grow into ownership of your own investor network and progressively take on greater responsibility.

Accountabilities

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of allocator relationships, including family offices and high-net-worth individuals, while keeping existing relationships engaged between opportunities.
  • Support live fundraising mandates by qualifying investors, preparing concise and high-quality briefing notes, coordinating follow-ups, and ensuring strong execution throughout the process.
  • Develop a consistent pipeline of new investor relationships by identifying relevant allocators and creating a regular cadence of first conversations.
  • Research investors to understand their investment strategies, interests, and potential appetite for direct investments, particularly in US startups.
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships by providing relevant, thoughtful communication rather than relying on transactional or overly promotional outreach.
  • Work alongside senior investor professionals to observe investor conversations, contribute to mandate execution, and progressively develop independent judgment.
  • Use AI-powered tools and modern workflow technologies to streamline research, preparation, and pipeline management, allowing greater focus on relationship building.
  • Handle sensitive investor information with a high degree of discretion, ensuring names, allocations, conversations, and other confidential details remain protected.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated experience beginning to build an allocator or investor network through wealth management, private banking, family office, placement, investor relations, or another relevant environment.
    • Evidence of independently establishing relationships and opening new investor conversations rather than relying solely on an existing institutional network.
    • A clear and repeatable approach to identifying relevant investors, initiating conversations, establishing credibility, and maintaining relationships over time.
    • Strong understanding of how investors allocate capital, ideally including familiarity with direct investments in US startups.
    • Excellent listening and relationship-building skills, with a consultative approach that prioritizes investor needs and respects their time.
    • High level of discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential investor information and sensitive conversations.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple relationships, mandates, follow-ups, and priorities with consistency.
    • Comfort working autonomously in a remote, asynchronous environment while collaborating effectively with a senior team.
    • Willingness and ability to use AI tools for investor research, preparation, and pipeline management as part of a modern, technology-enabled workflow.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position with an asynchronous working environment.
      • Workday overlap with US Eastern Time for several hours rather than requiring full US working hours.
      • Meetings are generally concentrated on Mondays and Thursdays, leaving substantial time for focused, independent work.
      • Access to paid, high-quality AI tools to support research, preparation, and workflow efficiency.
      • Direct exposure to live fundraising mandates and investor deal flow from the beginning.
      • Opportunity to learn investor-relations and allocator relationship management directly from experienced senior professionals.
      • Progressive opportunity to develop and manage your own side of the investor network.
      • Full-time position with locations including Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany.

title: AVP/VP, Data Platform Engineer - SRE, Technology Group
description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Technology Group

We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies.

What impact and exposure opportunities come with this role

We are seeking a skilled Data Platform Engineer with a strong focus on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for enhancing the reliability, availability, and performance of our enterprise data platforms. You will leverage SRE best practices to streamline and automate operational tasks, ensuring seamless integration within our organization's ecosystem.

You will be actively involved in software engineering practices for fast-moving agile projects using modern DevSecOps practices (e.g. GitHub, JFrog, Jira) and will learn about data platforms (e.g. Snowflake/Databricks, distributed query engines, business intelligence).

What will you do as a Data Platform Engineer

  • Operational Excellence: Provide operational production support (e.g. incident & emergency response management, availability management, change management, configuration management) and documentation for data infrastructure platforms.
  • Automation: Bring on a mindset to identify opportunities to automate operational tasks, streamline deployment via CICD, monitoring and incident response processes, reducing manual intervention.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Design and implement mechanisms to effectively gather metrics and metadata from monitoring systems (e.g. Datadog) and enterprise data platforms to provide recommendations for targeted improvements in performance tuning and fault-finding activities.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyze system performance and implement enhancements to improve operational efficiencies (e.g. CPU utilization, latency) of data platforms.
  • Securing by Design: Partner with internal security and infrastructure teams to ensure secure and robust architectural design for our data platforms.
  • Collaboration: Become an excellent team player with a collaborative mindset; you will work directly with investment and technology professionals at all grades and across departments.


What makes you a successful candidate

Join us if you have a passion for data and want to be part of a team in building and developing GIC's data foundation and infrastructure.

  • 10 or more years of relevant technology experience preferably in financial risk services or asset management industries, and experience in leading software development teams.
  • Hands-on engineering experience in the following:
    • Programming languages (e.g. Python, Java, C# (.NET Core))
    • SQL, and relational databases (e.g. Snowflake, Postgres, Oracle)
    • Automation tools (e.g. Ansible, Terraform)
    • Scripting for automation (e.g. Bash, Powershell)
    • Monitoring tools (e.g. Data dog, Splunk, Cloudwatch)
    • Cloud technologies & IAC (e.g. AWS, EKS, S3, Kubernetes, Terraform, KMS)
    • (Prefer) Distributed query technologies (e.g. Denodo, Presto/Trino, Starburst, Athena)
    • (Optional) Data storage & EL/ETL processing (e.g. data lakes, data warehousing)
  • Experience in application support practices such as incident management, capacity management, system and security administration, database and network management, with a strong experience on automating processes using scripting and automation tools (such as Python, Bash, etc) to enhance the efficiency of operational tasks.
  • Willingness to learn with attention to detail, demonstrating a strong passion in technology and/or finance.
  • Fair presentation skills, and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Good engagement with software engineers and guide hands-on development.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-departmental business and technical partners to contribute to the delivery of business outcomes.
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) related discipline is advantageous.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer

GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.Please email (HIDDEN TEXT) at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.

Learn more about our Data Strategy Group Department here:

Our PRIME Values GIC is a values driven organization. GIC's PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Spain.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

Be a part of an innovative team and culture…

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. If you want to work in an AI-first environment, help redefine how work is done, and be part of a team that's changing an entire industry, we'd love to have you on board.

🤩 About the role

We’re looking for an ambitious Senior Product Designer to join our product team who will play a key part in shaping the future of our product.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design process—from initial discovery and ideation to high-fidelity execution. We anchor every project in deep customer insights, transforming complex hypotheses into elegant solutions. Partnering closely with other designers, product managers and engineers, as well as sales and CS, you will bridge the gap between user needs and technical implementation to deliver meaningful impact.

We love working on big visions and beautifully crafted experiences, while sometimes it’s the small features and improvements that our customers love the most. Your strength lies in turning complex problems into intuitive, powerful interfaces, especially as we design new patterns for working with AI. As a research-led team, we value rapid prototyping and iterative learning; we move fast, ship early, and prioritise progress over perfection to ensure we are always solving real problems for real people.

🎯 What You Will Do

The ideal candidate possesses a versatile skill set, moving comfortably between the big concept and the last details.

Rapid prototyping and insight-driven iteration: You will collaborate directly with customers to validate hypotheses and refine designs based on real-world feedback. By conducting user interviews and observations, you ensure that every iteration is rooted in real user needs.

Hold high product standards while staying pragmatic: You bring real taste and hold the product to a standard you'd be proud to put our name on. We're designing for two audiences at once: the HR admin and Operation leads who buy All Gravy, and the frontline employees who open the app between shifts. The second group didn't choose us and won't read a manual – they judge us against Whatsapp and Instagram, which is the standard we hold ourselves to.

Simplifying the complex: You excel at transforming complicated processes - such as onboarding, scheduling and compliance - into intuitive, effortless user experiences.

Defining new AI paradigms: We are building the future of human-AI collaboration. You will design novel interaction patterns, ensuring AI is applied where it adds the most value to the user’s workflow. We always start with a customer need, not the technology itself.

Design with systems in mind: You think beyond individual screens and consider how patterns, components and interactions scale across the product. You know when to reuse, when to extend, and when a new pattern is needed.

Ownership and collaborative leadership: You have a bias towards ownership and outcomes. You engage and interact with our developers, and value their contributions to the design process. You'll be part of a small team of Product Designers where you lift each other's work through collaboration and feedback.

As All Gravy scales, your role and responsibilities will evolve, and there will be plenty of opportunities for you to learn and grow.

🙌 You'll thrive here if you

We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning.

  • 5+ years of end-to-end product design experience, with a strong background designing user-facing products at a high growth SaaS company.

  • A passion for untangling complex problems and transforming them into seamless, intuitive user experiences.

  • Curiosity about how AI changes user behaviour and interfaces, with hands-on experience designing AI-native products.

  • A deep commitment to customer discovery, using direct feedback and data to validate hypotheses and drive design decisions.

  • Sharp visual skills and attention to detail, with real fluency in design systems and how things actually get implemented.

  • A pragmatic, results-oriented approach that prioritises shipping and iterative learning over theoretical perfection.

  • Exceptional collaborative skills, with strong preference of partnering across functions to bring ambitious product visions to life.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written.

  • Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

💎 Why All Gravy

  • Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

  • A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

  • Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

  • You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

  • The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

🙌 Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

Pune, India

title: [LTA-TRO] ENGINEER, KPE/MCE MANAGEMENT
description:
[What the role is]

ENGINEER, KPE/MCE MANAGEMENT

[What you will be working on]

Play a key role in ensuring the safe and efficient operations of Singapore’s road tunnels. You will be part of a team to oversee the integration of operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT) systems — from project planning and design review through to site supervision, installation, testing and commissioning. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders on interfacing design and manage contractors and system vendors throughout project development to ensure timely and successful system commissioning.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Engage stakeholders to gather, define, and translate business requirements into workable technical solutions.

  • Lead or participate in the design and review of integration solutions between various systems, applications, and databases using APIs, middleware, and other relevant technologies.

  • Identify potential integration risks, assess their implications, and recommend mitigating measures to minimise operational impact to support smooth and timely project delivery.

  • Identify key business processes for improvement to achieve greater efficacy and better support tunnel operations.

[What we are looking for]

  • Knowledge in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related field.

  • Good understanding of Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA systems, OT communication protocols (e.g. Modbus or Profinet) and middleware or integration platforms that bridge OT and IT environments.

  • Working knowledge of OT cybersecurity principles, risks, controls, and industry best practices to ICS will be an advantage.

  • Experience with data analytics tools such as Python, Snowflake, or Tableau will be an advantage.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

  • A proactive and resourceful approach to problem-solving, with a strong sense of ownership and analytical thinking.

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Bulgaria.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Data Scientist/Engineer (Govt SI)
description:
About the Role

Our client is a Singapore-based government-linked organisation focused on advancing digital development and driving effective, trusted public communications through technology. They are building and enhancing a suite of AI-enabled products and platforms designed to make government services more accessible, reliable, and impactful. This role offers a meaningful opportunity to apply rigorous data science, natural language processing (NLP), and generative AI practices to real-world challenges at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with policy advisors, communications officers, product owners, engineers, and domain specialists to translate user needs into well-defined analytical and machine learning problems
  • Develop and maintain robust evaluation frameworks and benchmark datasets for NLP, generative AI, and other machine learning use cases
  • Design and execute structured experiments to assess and improve model quality, accuracy, consistency, reliability, latency, and cost
  • Explore and evaluate emerging models, techniques, and technologies, providing evidence-based recommendations aligned with operational and user requirements
  • Conduct systematic error analysis, identify performance gaps across use cases and user segments, and help prioritise improvements in collaboration with the team
  • Establish appropriate automated and human-evaluation methodologies, accounting for the limitations and risks of individual metrics and AI-assisted evaluation
  • Partner with engineers to integrate validated improvements, define quality assurance checkpoints, and monitor model performance in production
  • Ensure that data pipelines, experiments, and model decisions are reproducible, well-documented, and aligned with responsible AI, data privacy, and security standards

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related quantitative discipline - or equivalent practical experience
  • Demonstrated experience applying data science or machine learning to solve real-world problems, with preference for work involving NLP, generative AI , search, or information retrieval
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, along with working knowledge of SQL, data processing workflows, version control, and software development best practices
  • Sound grounding in statistics, experimental design, evaluation methodology, sampling techniques, error analysis, and model validation
  • Ability to write maintainable, production-ready code and collaborate effectively with engineering teams to deploy data science solutions
  • Experience with multilingual NLP, translation quality evaluation, or collaboration with linguists and language reviewers (is a bonus)
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI services, vector search, MLOps, production monitoring, or responsible AI frameworks (is a bonus)

The Radiology Technician Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

  • The Radiology Technician Assistant provides support service to the technologists, nurses, and physicians and to other health care professionals related to Imaging Services. This position is pivotal in coordinating patient flow in the respective imaging departments. Duties may include setup work of exam/procedure room before patient arrival, verification of paperwork and physician orders, escorting of patient to and from the waiting and changing areas, assisting the technologists, nurses or physicians in performing the exam/procedure, and processing films and paperwork for completed exams.

Responsibilities:

  • Cares for the patient throughout the treatment/procedure according to department and hospital standards of care, age-specific sensitivities, and Patients' First guidelines.
  • Provides systems support by preparing procedure rooms for patients prior to their arrival in the department and work area
  • Assists in preparing patient for exam/procedure, including the ability to explain exams and answer basic questions, knowledge of MR Safety if assignment is MR and brings forward more detailed clinical questions to clinical staff.
  • Follows directions of technologist/nurse to assist in performing exam/procedure on patients.
  • Processes CDs as needed. Participates in lifting and escorting patients and maintains lift equipment competencies refer to NMH Safe Patient Handling Policy PC 05.0095.
  • Helps to coordinate patient care based on departmental imaging protocols. Interacts and communicates with clinical and medical staff to coordinate patient flow.
  • Reconciles physician orders to correct exam protocol and escalates discrepancies to appropriate clinical staff.
  • Prepares all necessary paperwork and information so treatment/procedure may be performed.
  • Retrieves physician orders as needed from all order systems including but not limited to EPIC, Chartview, Powerchart.
  • Assists in clarification of patient demographic information. Verifies patient information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Monitors schedule to ensure effective patient flow throughout the diagnostic areas. Informs coordinators, charge techs, and patients of delays.
  • Identifies and obtains paperwork required to start exams. Handles outside films appropriately and obtains patient films when requested.
  • Recognizes and reports problems to appropriate supervisors.
  • Uses scheduling system, Radnet and PACS proficiently. Monitors stock of supplies, including Radiology Contrast Media, in treatment/procedure rooms to assure their regular availability by timely re-ordering, rotation of dated items, and by maintenance of a clean and orderly environment.
  • Uses designated equipment effectively, skillfully and efficiently. Maintains equipment and work area as directed, and where applicable, documents safety checklists including contrast warmers, barium refrigerators, etc.
  • Follows policies and procedures to contribute to the efficiency of department.
  • Organizes and prioritizes assigned work, and schedules time to accommodate work demands, turnaround-time and commitments.
  • Provides clerical/technical support as needed and as assigned by Manager.

This role is for a Manufacturing Maintenance and Reliability Manager, responsible for ensuring the optimal functionality, calibration compliance, and reliability of manufacturing equipment across operations. The position drives zero downtime initiatives, leads preventive and breakdown maintenance programs, and manages the life cycle of critical assets through LDM, TPM, and continuous improvement strategies.

The role ensures adherence to GMP, safety standards, and validated process parameters, while promoting safety awareness and environmental compliance. It also involves managing QMS elements, audit readiness, and documentation practices.

title: ATLAS Detector Installation Technician (EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE)
description:
The EP-ATL-PO section plays a key role in the upgrade and maintenance of the ATLAS detector at the LHC. As a Junior Mechanical Technician, you will support experienced colleagues in mechanical installation and integration activities on the detector and its infrastructure during Long Shutdown 3 (LS3), while gaining hands-on experience in a cutting-edge experimental physics environment.

Your responsibilities:

  • Participate in large-scale ATLAS detector movements in the experimental cavern and in the installation of access platforms.
  • Support sub-detector installation activities, including handling, transport, and positioning using appropriate lifting and alignment techniques.
  • Prepare and set up work areas and tooling, and provide logistical support for detector interventions.
  • Read and interpret mechanical drawings, perform basic dimensional checks, and report progress to supervising engineers.
  • When required, manufacture parts and tooling using conventional machining techniques, such as drilling, milling, and turning.

Your profile:

  • Initial hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, or maintenance.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and 2D/3D CAD models.
  • Initial experience with conventional machining techniques and workshop practices.
  • Basic metrology skills, including the use of calipers, gauges, and dimensional inspection tools.
  • Awareness of occupational health and safety principles in workshop and industrial environments.

Skills:

  • Follow technical procedures, assembly instructions, and work specifications.
  • Use of standard hand and power tools for mechanical operations.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in an international and multidisciplinary environment.
  • Rigorous, detail-oriented, and safety-conscious approach to work.
  • Accurately document completed work and maintain high quality standards while following technical procedures and safety requirements.
  • Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.

Eligibility criteria:

  • You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
  • By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma.
  • You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
  • Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 14.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

Target start date: 01-November-2026

This position involves:

  • Work in Radiation Areas.
  • Interventions in underground installations.
  • A valid driving licence.
  • Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
  • Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Job reference: EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE

title: Statistical Programmer II (SDTM)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Statistical Programmer II (SDTM) based in India.

This is an opportunity to contribute to clinical research by developing and quality-controlling SDTM datasets that support regulatory submissions and important study decisions. You’ll work remotely with sponsors, data operations teams, SDTM leads, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver accurate, compliant clinical data. The role combines hands-on SAS programming with SDTM mapping, trial design domain development, and dataset programming. You’ll also contribute to submission preparation and process improvements through efficient programming practices. The environment is collaborative, fast-paced, and focused on quality and operational excellence. This role offers strong opportunities to deepen your expertise in clinical data standards and grow within statistical programming and clinical development.

Accountabilities:

  • Review clinical study protocols and Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), providing relevant feedback on SDTM mapping strategies and implementation.
  • Develop SDTM Trial Design domains and program complex SDTM datasets in accordance with applicable standards and specifications.
  • Perform quality-focused programming activities using SAS and support the development of accurate, reliable clinical data deliverables.
  • Debug simple to moderately complex macros and contribute to improving programming efficiency and consistency.
  • Support SDTM Leads with study activities, project coordination, and day-to-day statistical programming deliverables.
  • Assist with clinical study start-up activities and contribute to the preparation of regulatory submission packages.
  • Apply knowledge of efficacy endpoints and assessment concepts, including areas such as RECIST and IMWG, where relevant.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, Data Operations Leads, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
  • Follow clinical programming standards, regulatory expectations, and established quality processes throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to process improvements and share technical knowledge to strengthen programming practices and project delivery.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Pharmacy, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • At least 3 years of experience in SDTM statistical programming within clinical research or another regulated environment.
    • Strong working knowledge of SAS and clinical programming and reporting processes.
    • Demonstrated experience developing SDTM Trial Design domains and complex SDTM datasets.
    • Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry technical standards relevant to clinical trial data.
    • Familiarity with SDTM methodologies, clinical data processes, programming standards, and regulatory submission requirements.
    • Understanding of efficacy endpoints and clinical efficacy concepts, with exposure to methodologies such as RECIST or IMWG considered valuable.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a careful and quality-focused approach to programming.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong proficiency in English.
    • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to changing requirements.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders across global, cross-functional teams.
    • Experience supporting an SDTM Lead on clinical research studies is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote position based in India, with Hyderabad identified as the primary location.
      • Opportunity to work on clinical research programs supporting the development of new therapies.
      • Exposure to global sponsors, cross-functional teams, and complex clinical development projects.
      • Opportunities to strengthen expertise in SDTM, SAS programming, regulatory standards, and clinical data processes.
      • Growth and continuous learning opportunities within statistical programming and clinical development.
      • Collaborative, quality-focused, and innovation-oriented working environment.
      • Opportunity to contribute to process improvements and develop broader technical and project delivery expertise.

title: Business Executive - Hyderabad
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial activity in Hyderabad to grow the business and support better patient care. You will work closely with field colleagues and cross-functional teams to design and deliver clear territory plans. You will build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and gather practical field insights to shape local strategy. We value curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to learn. This role offers clear growth, real impact on health outcomes, and aligns with our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Develop and execute territory plans that meet commercial goals and support better patient care. - Build and maintain trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and local stakeholders. - Communicate clear and balanced scientific and clinical information to support informed care decisions. - Plan and deliver local educational activities and events that align with business and medical priorities. - Use field data and customer insight to create action plans, monitor progress and adapt activities to meet targets. - Collaborate with colleagues across sales, medical and operations to deliver coordinated local strategies and follow company policy and local laws. We welcome applicants who value inclusion to apply. Location and Working Pattern This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Working pattern is hybrid with regular travel across the assigned territory. Skills

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst based in India.

This is an opportunity to turn complex data into insights that support high-impact decisions in education and technology.
The role combines data integration, analytics, visualization, and business intelligence across multiple data sources.
You’ll build reliable pipelines, maintain data quality, and develop reporting systems that stakeholders can use confidently.
Your analysis will help uncover trends, measure performance, and inform improvements to products, content, and operations.
You’ll work closely with both technical and business teams in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The position offers the chance to work with modern data tools while contributing to products designed to expand access to education.
This is a 12-month contract role, with the possibility of extension, and offers a flexible, remote-friendly working environment.

Accountabilities

  • Automate the ingestion and integration of data from multiple sources, including Google Sheets, APIs, and internal systems, into BigQuery.
  • Design, build, maintain, and monitor scalable data pipelines and workflows while ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Perform exploratory, descriptive, and diagnostic analyses to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and potential issues.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using tools such as Streamlit, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define meaningful business metrics and establish systems for daily, weekly, and monthly KPI tracking.
  • Translate complex datasets and analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Select and maintain appropriate tools and approaches for data management, transformation, analysis, and visualization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate business questions and identify opportunities to improve products, content, and user experiences.
  • Contribute to data modeling, business intelligence, and end-to-end analytics workflows as required.
  • Maintain good data and development practices, including appropriate use of version control and collaborative workflows.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of hands-on professional experience in data analytics, ideally within education, EdTech, or a similarly data-driven environment.
    • Strong SQL skills and demonstrated ability to manipulate, analyze, and transform data using Python or R.
    • Practical experience with advanced statistical techniques such as multiple regression and hypothesis testing.
    • Knowledge of applied machine learning techniques, including clustering and decision-tree methods.
    • Experience working with data warehouses and analytics infrastructure, with BigQuery experience strongly valued.
    • Familiarity with the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data integration, modeling, analysis, visualization, and business intelligence.
    • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Streamlit, or comparable platforms is an advantage.
    • Strong analytical and business mindset, with the ability to connect data findings to practical business decisions.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong data storytelling skills and the ability to turn complex information into concise, actionable recommendations.
    • Comfortable working collaboratively across product, content, technology, and other functional teams.
    • Willingness to take ownership, work hands-on, and contribute beyond narrowly defined responsibilities in a growing environment.
    • Familiarity with Git and good practices for version control and collaborative development.

      • Benefits

      • Remote-friendly environment with the option to work from home.

      • Opportunity to work with a high-caliber, collaborative team.

      • Opportunity to work on high-impact products and data initiatives in the education sector.
      • Meaningful opportunity to contribute your skills to a mission focused on expanding access to high-quality education.

title: Facility Operations Center Eng, Facility Operations Center (FOC)
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Global Services organization is looking for an individual with proven and tested leadership skills to help bring to fruition a newly developed Facilities Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure and will serve as a facilitator for all Large Scale Events. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations. You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

Key job responsibilities
Monitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platform
Serves as a Point of Contact for internal and external teams
Assists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performance
Contributes to outage post mortem analysis
Ensures records are updated in a timely manner
Assists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery efforts
Assists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performance
Ability to support a 24X7 environment (This is shift work which requires that you work weekends and holidays)

title: Product Development Engineer - Mass Timber Hardware
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Development Engineer - Mass Timber Hardware based in Canada.

This is a hands-on engineering opportunity focused on developing innovative structural hardware for the growing mass timber industry.
You will contribute across the full product lifecycle, from identifying technical and market needs to concept development, prototyping, testing, and validation.
The role combines structural engineering, physical experimentation, CAD, technical analysis, and practical product design.
You will work on real components and connection systems, translating test results and engineering insights into commercially viable solutions.
Success requires balancing structural performance, manufacturability, installation, cost, quality, and real-world construction requirements.
You will collaborate with engineers, operations teams, manufacturers, laboratories, universities, and other technical partners.
This remote position, based in British Columbia, offers the opportunity to directly influence the next generation of mass timber connection technology.

Accountabilities:

  • New product development: Develop new structural connection products and enhancements to existing hardware, taking concepts from initial definition through prototyping, testing, and technical validation.
  • Concept development: Translate market needs, installation challenges, structural requirements, and manufacturing constraints into practical and commercially viable product concepts.
  • Engineering analysis: Perform calculations and analytical evaluations to understand structural behaviour, compare design alternatives, establish requirements, and support product-development decisions.
  • Prototyping and CAD: Create CAD models, drawings, prototypes, test fixtures, and supporting materials needed to develop and evaluate new concepts.
  • Physical testing: Participate directly in laboratory and research activities, including specimen preparation, timber component handling, prototype installation, fixture setup, instrumentation support, testing, and failure-mode evaluation.
  • Test planning and validation: Develop test plans, coordinate specimens and instrumentation, support or execute testing programs, and analyze results to validate product performance.
  • Design iteration: Refine products based on testing outcomes, engineering analysis, constructability, manufacturability, installation requirements, cost considerations, and field feedback.
  • Applied research: Investigate connection concepts, materials, testing approaches, technical standards, approval pathways, and emerging technologies relevant to mass timber construction.
  • Project ownership: Lead assigned R&D projects from initial concept through validation, managing priorities, schedules, budgets, contributors, and external partners as required.
  • Technical documentation: Prepare clear documentation covering assumptions, calculations, methodologies, test results, design decisions, revisions, and project conclusions.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with application engineering, technical service, business development, operations, manufacturers, research laboratories, universities, and other external stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • Education: Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Timber, Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.
    • Professional credentials: Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation, or EIT status with the ability to pursue P.Eng. designation in the near term.
    • Experience: Approximately 3–8 years of relevant experience in engineering, structural design, product development, physical testing, or applied research; candidates with other relevant levels of experience may also be considered.
    • Engineering expertise: Strong understanding of mechanics, structural behaviour, materials, and core engineering principles.
    • Industry knowledge: Experience with timber engineering, structural connections, fasteners, mass timber, or building products is strongly preferred.
    • Testing and prototyping: Experience with physical testing, laboratory research, prototyping, product validation, or experimental engineering is a strong asset.
    • Technical tools: Experience using CAD and engineering analysis tools.
    • Problem-solving: Ability to tackle open-ended technical problems, develop sound engineering recommendations, and turn uncertainty into practical solutions.
    • Product mindset: Ability to balance technical performance with manufacturability, cost, quality, installation requirements, and real-world construction considerations.
    • Project management: Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to take ownership of technical projects and move them forward independently.
    • Communication: Strong technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain engineering decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Collaboration: Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with engineers, technologists, operations teams, suppliers, manufacturers, and external research organizations.
    • Language: Professional proficiency in English is required.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation: CAD $80,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
      • Remote flexibility: Remote position based in Surrey, British Columbia.
      • Hands-on impact: Opportunity to develop physical products and directly influence a growing mass timber technology portfolio.
      • End-to-end ownership: Exposure to the complete product-development lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through testing and market-ready validation.
      • Technical growth: Opportunities to deepen expertise in structural engineering, mass timber, product development, testing, and applied research.
      • Collaborative environment: Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering, operations, manufacturing, research, and commercial teams.
      • Industry impact: Contribute to structural solutions used in real mass timber construction projects across North America.
      • Innovation-focused work: Join a small, agile environment where technical ideas can move quickly from concept to practical application.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description: Data Engineer

As a Data Engineer at D-SIMLAB Technologies, you will play a key role in deriving insights from large datasets to optimize semiconductor manufacturing processes. This role focuses on data extraction, analysis, and actionable insights, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop and deploy D-SIMLAB's software products as well as provide professional consultation services to our clients. The ideal candidate is someone who excels in data-driven analysis and is eager to work on high-impact projects in the semiconductor industry.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Data Extraction and Analysis :
    Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from semiconductor manufacturing environments to ensure data consistency, completeness, and correctness.
    Use statistical methods and data mining techniques to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies that impact production performance.
  • Performance Evaluation :
    Analyze the gap between planned and actual production outcomes. Identify root causes for performance deviations and recommend data-driven strategies for process improvement. Develop reports and visualizations to present findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Insights :
    Provide actionable insights based on data analysis to optimize semiconductor manufacturing processes. Work closely with clients to understand their specific needs and translate data findings into operational and strategic improvements.
  • ETL and Data Modeling :
    Build and maintain ETL processes to integrate data from various sources into D-SIMLAB's data models. Collaborate with simulation modeling teams to ensure accurate and reliable data is fed into models.
  • Consultation Services :
    Act as a trusted advisor to clients by offering data-driven recommendations for enhancing their production efficiency. Present analyses and proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and actionable takeaways.
  • Data Visualization and Reporting :
    Create dashboards and reports using advanced data visualization tools to communicate key insights and trends effectively. Continuously improve reporting mechanisms to provide real-time insights and support ongoing optimization efforts.
  • Collaboration with Teams :
    Work with Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that data insights align with product goals and customer needs. Contribute to product enhancement initiatives, focusing on the improvement of data-related components and analytics.

Candidate Requirements :

  • Education :
    Bachelor's/Master's degree in Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience :
    Strong analytical skills with a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in an industrial environment. Semiconductor experience is a plus.
  • Technical Skills :
    Proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel.
    Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is highly desirable.
    Experience with ETL processes and database management.
  • Analytical Abilities :
    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle large datasets and deliver actionable insights to improve operational performance.
  • Soft Skills :
    Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary team.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to Travel :
    Willing to travel for international projects and collaborate closely with clients and internal teams.

description:
About the Role & Program

Be a part of an innovative team and culture…

Walt Disney Imagineering is the creative force that imagines, designs and brings to life all Disney theme parks, resorts, attractions and cruise ships worldwide. Working across a spectrum of disciplines that range from creative and conceptual to scientific and technical, Imagineers blend an innovative mixture of storytelling, art, science and technology to create immersive experiences, memorable destinations, and innovative entertainment for families around the globe.

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027 and will be located in Orlando, FL.

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Show Mechanical Engineering intern to join the team that helps to dream and create many of the magical moments that our guests enjoy! The Show Systems team is responsible for delivering world class Audio- Animatronic figures, show action equipment and special effects throughout their full lifecycle. We partner with various teams to help deliver quality products, and our processes and tools help to take us from concept design to production and installation.

An intern with our department may support various phases of the engineering process from concept development through final design, production, test, installation and commissioning for a variety of theme park attractions. Our diverse needs call for many areas of specialization which allow for our engineers to learn and grow within the mechanical engineering realm. These areas include design engineering, tooling design, mechanical analysis, advanced 3d modeling, surface modeling, 3d printing, production processes, material sciences and more.

  • Digital sculpting experience

  • Portfolio showcasing work

Currently enrolled as a Junior or higher attending an accredited college/university earning a degree majoring in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Engineering Technology, or related field

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application posting OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship​

  • Possess unrestricted work authorization​

  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or Disney College Program

Additional Information

  • Able to provide reliable transportation to/from work

  • Must be fully available for the duration of the internship
