Please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Please visit our support site for additional information.

description:

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with founders and early-stage ventures. The Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) is Waipapa Taumata Rau’s platform for developing the innovators, entrepreneurs and changemakers of the future. We work across the University to help students, researchers and staff build innovation and entrepreneurial capability, turn ideas into action, develop ventures, and create social, cultural, environmental and economic impact for Aotearoa and the world.

CIE is entering an exciting new chapter. With an ambitious new strategy, we are significantly increasing the reach and impact of innovation and entrepreneurship across the University, helping realise Waipapa Taumata Rau’s ambition to be a global powerhouse of innovation, creativity and entrepreneurship, and strengthening the University’s contribution to a more innovative and prosperous Aotearoa.

We are building a team of people who are curious, collaborative, ambitious for impact and committed to turning ambition into action. If you want to help shape how a world-class research-led university develops innovative and entrepreneurial people, we would love to hear from you. .

He kōrero mōu | About you

You are passionate about entrepreneurship and enjoy working directly with founders as they navigate uncertainty, test ideas and develop early-stage ventures. Combining strong programme management and delivery skills with practical startup and venture development knowledge, you’re comfortable working with diverse founder cohorts and managing complex programmes involving multiple contributors and stakeholders.

  • Experience designing and delivering entrepreneurship, founder development, venture support or innovation programmes.

  • Strong understanding of startup ecosystems, customer discovery, experimentation, venture validation and early-stage venture development.

  • Experience coordinating mentors, facilitators, industry experts and ecosystem partners to provide founders with access to relevant expertise.

Experience in startup or venture development, research commercialisation or a university environment would be advantageous. An understanding of research-derived opportunities and the different pathways they may take towards commercialisation and venture creation would be particularly valuable.

Ammattiohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu ohjata ja tukea opiskelijoita oman vastuualueensa matalan kynnyksen kohtaajana, toimia opettajan työparina lähiopetuksessa ja tukea opiskelijaa työnhaussa- ja työssäoppimisessa. -soveltuvaa toisen asteen ammatillista tutkintoa

-kokemusta opiskelijatoiminnan suunnittelusta ja toteuttamisesta

-erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja
-joustavaa ja itseohjautuvaa työotetta
-tiimityöskentelytaitoja

Tehtävässä noudatetaan 4 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Eduksi luemme
-oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta

Tehtävässä toimitaan ensisijaisesti Nurmijärvi Keudan toimipisteessä, mutta työtä voi olla myös muissa Keudan toimipisteissä.

Tarjoamme sinulle asiantuntevan työyhteisön sekä viihtyisän työympäristön vakavaraisessa ja kehittyvässä organisaatiossa. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtäviisi. Työntekijöidemme hyvinvointia vahvistamme työterveyshuollon palveluilla sekä vireällä työhyvinvointitoiminnalla, johon kuuluu mm. ePassin liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluita.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Keuda käyttää anonyymiä rekrytointia. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytointiprosessin ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työhakemuksen avoimiin kysymyksiin ja niiden vastauksiin ei tule sisällyttää tietoja esim. iästä, äidinkielestä tai sukupuolesta. Vaikka osaa näistä taustatiedoissa kysytäänkin, eivät tiedot näy rekrytoivalle esihenkilölle anonyymissä hakijaraportissa.

Osana rekrytointia voidaan käyttää videohaastatteluja. Tämän jälkeen kutsumme soveltuvimmat hakijat haastatteluun, joka toteutetaan 23.9.2026 päivän aikana.

title: Lähihoitaja, Arvi, Säkylä
description:
Haemme Arvi Säkylään lähihoitajia, joilla kuntouttava työote näkyy asiakkaan kohtaamisessa ja työskentely on asiakaslähtöistä. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja iloinen asenne ovat tärkeitä sekä toivomme sinulta kykyä hallita nopeastikin muuttuvat tilanteet. Työvuorosuunnitteluun pääset itse osallistumaan.

Yksikössä hoidetaan asiakkaita, jotka tarvitsevat lyhytaikaista hoivaa, kuntoutusta tai arviointia. Hoidon tavoitteena on tukea ikäihmisen kotona asumista, omaishoitajan jaksamista sekä selvittää asiakkaan tilannetta, arvioida palvelujen tarvetta tai järjestää jatkohoitoa. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää vanhustyön osaamista sekä toimintakyvyn arvioinnin ja tukemisen taitoja. Hoito Arvi Säkylässä on kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa lyhytaikaista asumispalvelua. Yksikköön tullaan suoraan kotoa tai sairaalasta jatkohoitoon ja kuntoutukseen.

Perehdytys suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti tarpeidesi mukaan ja työhösi saat tukea koko työyhteisöltä sekä esihenkilöltä.

Tarjoamme sinulle liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun sekä maksuttoman kuntosalin Raumalla, Harjavallassa, Porissa ja Ulvilassa. Meillä on työterveyshuolto ja kattava sisäinen koulutustarjonta.

Olet kelpoinen tähän tehtävään, jos sinulla on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto. Ammattipätevyys on oltava tarkistettavissa (Valvira). Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä iäkkäiden kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (741/2023 28 §) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Valinnoissa noudatamme kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä.
Palvelussuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan.

Alkuperäiset työ- ja tutkintotodistukset tarkastetaan haastateltavilta. Haastattelut toteutetaan heti hakuajan päätyttyä.

Hakemukset lähetetään ensisijaisesti sähköisesti työpaikkailmoitukselta löytyvän linkin kautta.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Belgium.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Senior Statistical Programmer (SDTM)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Statistical Programmer (SDTM) based in India.

This is a senior-level statistical programming opportunity supporting clinical research and the delivery of high-quality clinical trial data and reporting solutions.
You will provide technical expertise across SDTM programming, clinical data standards, study start-up, and data mapping activities.
The role offers the opportunity to serve as an SDTM Lead or Statistical Programming Coordinator on complex clinical research projects.
You’ll collaborate with biostatisticians, data operations teams, sponsors, and other global stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely study delivery.
Your work will contribute to regulatory-compliant clinical development programs and ultimately support the advancement of new therapies.
The environment is fast-paced and highly regulated, with a strong emphasis on quality, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
This role also provides opportunities to mentor colleagues, improve programming processes, and strengthen your expertise across clinical development.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as an SDTM Lead on clinical research studies, providing technical direction and ensuring high-quality SDTM deliverables.
  • Program and deliver complex SDTM datasets in accordance with study requirements and applicable clinical data standards.
  • Develop and review SDTM Trial Design domains and related mapping specifications.
  • Coordinate study and project start-up activities, ensuring programming requirements and deliverables are clearly defined and implemented.
  • Review clinical study protocols and Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), providing informed recommendations on SDTM mapping strategies and implementation.
  • Perform programming, quality control, troubleshooting, and debugging activities, including work with moderately complex SAS macros.
  • Support clinical study analysis and reporting activities, including data import/export programming and other statistical programming deliverables.
  • Apply knowledge of efficacy endpoints and assessment methodologies, including RECIST and IMWG, when relevant to study programming activities.
  • Ensure programming activities comply with applicable CDISC standards, ICH-GCP principles, regulatory requirements, and established quality processes.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, biostatisticians, Data Operations Leads, and cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and maintain project timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve programming processes, develop reusable macros or applications, and increase efficiency and consistency.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to other team members where appropriate.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support high standards of quality management across clinical programming activities.

    • Requirements

    • Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.
    • Relevant experience within the clinical trials, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or another highly regulated environment.
    • Strong hands-on SAS programming skills and solid knowledge of statistical programming and clinical reporting processes.
    • Demonstrated experience working as an SDTM Lead, Statistical Programming Coordinator, or study/project lead on clinical research projects.
    • Proven experience developing complex SDTM datasets and working with SDTM Trial Design domains.
    • Strong knowledge of CDISC standards, SDTM mapping, mapping specifications, and regulatory submission requirements.
    • Experience reviewing clinical protocols and SAPs and translating study requirements into appropriate SDTM strategies.
    • Understanding of efficacy endpoints and assessment methodologies, including RECIST and IMWG.
    • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, regulatory requirements, System Life Cycle methodologies, and relevant industry technical standards.
    • Experience troubleshooting and debugging SAS macros of moderate complexity.
    • Strong technical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a consistent focus on data quality and compliance.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Strong organizational and project-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
    • Ability to work collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams while also operating independently.
    • 5+ years of experience in statistical programming coordination or study leadership is preferred.
    • Experience developing standard macros, applications, or other programming solutions that improve efficiency is advantageous.
    • Experience mentoring, training, or providing technical guidance to colleagues is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time, remote working opportunity in India.
      • Opportunity to contribute to global clinical research and programs supporting the development of new therapies.
      • Exposure to complex clinical studies, international stakeholders, and diverse therapeutic and regulatory environments.
      • Opportunities to strengthen expertise in SAS, SDTM, CDISC standards, and clinical data programming.
      • Potential to take on technical leadership and study coordination responsibilities.
      • Opportunities for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and professional development.
      • Collaborative environment with global cross-functional teams.

Employees at this level solve more complex problems, in GIS areas of specialization, with general supervision. Incumbents are expected to develop advanced skills and the ability to work with greater independence. GIS Technologist supports the operation and maintenance of the company GIS application by maintaining, reporting, and posting work or by gathering data to be input by others. title: Health System Administrator - Chinle
description:
Lead a dynamic IHS healthcare system dedicated to improving the health and well-being of American Indian and Alaska Native communities. As Chief Executive Officer, inspire a multidisciplinary workforce, advance excellence in patient care, quality, and safety, strengthen partnerships with Tribal leaders and communities, and champion innovative, responsive healthcare services that make a meaningful and lasting difference for the people and communities we serve.

As the Health System Administrator (Chief Executive Officer), you will provide executive leadership for a comprehensive healthcare delivery system serving American Indian and Alaska Native communities. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization, foster excellence in patient care and operational performance, and build strong partnerships with Tribal leaders and community stakeholders to advance the IHS mission. Lead Healthcare Operations: Direct the planning, administration, and evaluation of comprehensive hospital operations and clinical services, including inpatient, outpatient, emergency, surgical, nursing, behavioral health, dental, community health, and other supporting programs. Advance Quality and Excellence: Champion high-quality, safe, patient-centered care by integrating clinical and administrative operations, strengthening organizational performance, and ensuring compliance with applicable accreditation, regulatory, and healthcare standards. Drive Organizational Performance: Provide strategic leadership for financial, human capital, staffing, and operational resources; establish short- and long-range priorities; and align resources and organizational structures to meet changing healthcare needs. Strengthen Tribal and Community Partnerships: Build and sustain collaborative relationships with Tribal leaders, health boards, Federal, State, and local partners, and community organizations to identify healthcare priorities and improve services for the populations served. The Chinle Comprehensive Health Care Facility (CCHCF) is based in Chinle, Arizona (Northeast Arizona near Canyon De Chelly National Monument). The CCHCF is a 60 bed hospital which serves as the health care hub for the region. The medical staff includes Family Physicians, Internists, Pediatricians, General Surgeons, OB/GYN's, Anesthesiologists, and a Psychiatrist. In addition to routine outpatient and inpatient primary care, services available to our patients include: Adult Intensive Care, General Surgery (including laparoscopic surgery), routine and operative Obstetrics, and 24-Hour Emergency Room Services. Health care services are provided to approximately 37,000 active users. Strong Navajo cultural traditions exist within the community, offering an opportunity to learn the Navajo language, or to learn about traditional Navajo medicine. The service unit is located on the Colorado Plateau with excellent opportunities for photography, hiking, running, road biking, cross country skiing, and mountain biking. Canyon de Chelly National Monument is within 5 miles of the hospital and is a wonderful place for exploring and sightseeing, running and mountain biking. https://www.ihs.gov/navajo/healthcarefacilities/chinle/

Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify/. Background Investigation Requirement: This position requires the successful completion of a federal background investigation as a condition of employment. A background investigation is a standard process used by the Federal Government to verify an individual's identity, employment history, education, and other relevant information to determine suitability for Federal service. Upon receipt of instructions, applicants must complete all required background investigation forms within five (5) calendar days of issuance. Timely completion is critical to avoid delays in processing or a determination of unsuitability. Applicants are strongly encouraged to prioritize this requirement and to maintain regular communication with their assigned Personnel Security Specialist throughout the process. Financial Suitability Requirement: This position requires a review of the applicant's financial history as part of the personnel security and suitability determination. Applicants must demonstrate financial responsibility, maintain good standing with creditors, and satisfy all legal financial obligations prior to applying. Individuals with substantial delinquent or unresolved financial obligations, including, but not limited to, delinquent federal or state tax liabilities, defaulted federal student loans, court-ordered fines or fees, or child support arrears, may be deemed unsuitable for employment with the Indian Health Service (IHS). Prior to the appointment, candidates must present two valid forms of identification. If one of the documents is a state-issued ID or driver's license, it must be REAL ID-compliant.

title: Care Excellence Lead
description:
This role owns the operational excellence, quality, and reliability of a Care Excellence team across 24x7 support operations.

It is critical to manage provider deployments for specialised services, scale operations, improve the user experience, ensure the right care pathways for users, lead incident investigations, drive strategic care initiatives, and own Care Excellence performance, risks, and insights.

You will lead a team of Specialists & Associates, stay close to complex and sensitive work, and shape how Care Excellence operates across channels, care models, and escalation paths.

Ownership, SLAs & Performance Management

  • Own end-to-end performance of the Care Excellence team across SLAs, resolution quality, compliance, and user experience
  • Monitor team performance, productivity, QA outcomes, and SLA adherence
  • Proactively identify risks, trends, and gaps and drive corrective actions
  • Ensure consistency and reliability in service delivery, especially during peak loads or high-risk periods

Metrics, Insights & Reporting

  • Be the single owner for Care Excellence team metrics, dashboards, and insights
  • Translate operational data into clear, actionable narratives for roadmaps, decision-making, and escalations
  • Highlight key risks, trends, improvements, and trade-offs based on the insights
  • Partner with stakeholders to continuously improve metric definitions and reporting quality

High-Risk Deployments & Incident Management

  • Be directly involved in all critical deployments, launches, or operational changes impacting care excellence
  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for critical incidents, escalations, SLA breaches, or quality failures
  • Drive closure of RCA action items and ensure learnings are embedded into SOPs, training, and workflows

Strategic Projects & Care Model Development

  • Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives such as bridging operational and experience gaps with other teams
  • Own exploration and setup of Care Excellence call-based support and other care delivery mediums
  • Partner cross-functionally to design, pilot, and scale new care pathways, handoffs, and escalation models

White-Glove & Enterprise User Experience

  • Ensure elevated service standards for white-glove and enterprise users
  • Act as escalation owner for sensitive or high-impact enterprise cases
  • Align closely with Commercial, Delivery, Clinical, and Engagement teams on delivery standards and reporting

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead and develop Associates and Senior Associates through regular coaching, performance check-ins, and ongoing capability building, while partnering with Specialists on roster management to ensure effective 24/7 coverage
  • Build team readiness for complex, high-risk, and enterprise-grade care scenarios

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Identify manual, repetitive, or high-risk workflows and propose scalable improvements
  • Work with Product & Tech teams on automation and tooling
  • Maintain accurate SOPs, documentation, and knowledge bases
  • Represent Care Excellence insights in cross-functional and leadership forums

Requirements

  • 4 to 6+ years of experience in operations, support, or service delivery roles in a tech company
  • Comfortable providing shift flexibility to address or ensure coverage during critical escalations, high-risk, or no coverage situations
  • Proven experience leading remote/global teams in SLA-driven, high-volume environments
  • Strong RCA, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working with dashboards like FreshDesk, Zendesk, metrics, and operational data
  • Ability to balance empathy with decisiveness
  • Experience in 24x7 or global operations is a strong plus
  • Healthcare tech background is a plus

Benefits

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socials and communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in South Africa.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About the Role & Team

We are looking for a Head of Legal to join our Finance & Operations department in Copenhagen. In this new role, you’ll lead our overall legal strategy and execution, helping us build a scalable legal framework that supports our rapid growth across European markets. You’ll be the primary legal partner to our Sales, Finance, and Security teams, balancing fast risk-reward decisions with robust corporate governance.

Your core focus will be driving commercial SaaS contracting, corporate law, and vendor management, while eventually taking over ownership of our internal compliance function as the role evolves. You will work closely with executive stakeholders to safeguard the company while enabling business velocity. The team values extreme ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and strong cross-functional collaboration, and you’ll report directly to our Chief Financial Officer.

What you will do

  • Be the legal partner to Sales by driving commercial SaaS contracting, handling T&Cs, MSAs, DPAs, negotiating small deviations, and maintaining fallback negotiation playbooks.

  • Support the company's compliance framework in close partnership with our existing Compliance function and eventually taking over the internal compliance ownership.

  • Manage corporate legal matters, including entity management, governance, board support, and selective coordination with external counsel.

  • Own vendor and supplier contracting, reviewing and negotiating key terms on liability, security, privacy, and SLAs alongside Finance and Ops.

  • Build a scalable legal operating model by creating clear templates, internal guidance, and review triggers to keep legal operations lean and efficient.

What you bring

  • Ideally 4–8 years of relevant legal experience within a fast-growing SaaS environment.

  • Strong expertise in commercial SaaS contracting, including DPAs, security addendums, and negotiating client-facing deviations.

  • Solid understanding of data privacy and corporate law, with experience managing corporate governance and internal compliance baselines.

  • A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset that balances risk and reward to keep sales velocity high while protecting the business.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English (Danish is not a requirement)

Practicalities

Salary: Competitive and commensurate with experience. Details will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Office location: Skelbækgade 2, 2nd floor, 1717 Copenhagen V

Our salary levels are directly linked to our structured career framework, which includes regular performance reviews. As you build skills, take on new responsibilities, and progress in your role, your salary grows with you. Our framework makes development clear and transparent, so you always know what the next step looks like.

What do we offer you?

  • Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success

  • A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need

  • Continuous development through bi-annual growth talks and weekly check-ins

  • A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices

  • Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects

Our recruitment process

  • 30-minute online interview with Jonas, Talent Acquisition Partner

  • 30-minute online interview with our CFO

  • Completion of Personality Assessment & Case Presentation

  • 60-minute in-person final case interview with our CFO & other relevant stakeholders

  • Cultural interview with relevant stakeholders across the organisation

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, Munich & Paris. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Job Description

Bemidji State University (BSU) invites applicants to join our team as the Transfer Navigator. This grant-funded position is ideally centrally positioned on the Minnesota North College (MNC) Hibbing campus and would make frequent day trips to the other MNC campuses on a regular schedule. This is a BSU position funded by the Design Accelerator grant provided by Arizona State University. At this time, the position would be fixed-term though the 2026-2027 Academic year starting on or after October 1, 2026. The purpose of the position is to increase the rate of success (attainment of four-year degree) among students transferring from MNC to BSU, and to increase the rate of graduation success at the colleges (attainment of two-year degree or other award) through personalized support from very early in each college student’s enrollment at MNC.

Candidates must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to pass a driving history background check.

Responsibilities of the Transfer Navigator include:

  • Directly support enrolled and prospective students. (40%)

    • Being present on a regular basis at Minnesota North College campuses, holding appointments and being available to students on various schedules. Quickly and thoroughly answer a wide range of questions about their chosen transfer/degree pathway. Being a singular point of contact to handle all transfer questions/situations.

    • Assisting students in academic support and major/career exploration. Empowering students to develop plans for success that include understanding degree requirements and advocating for themselves.

    • Monitoring student admission and transfer progress, analyzing challenges and barriers, determining solutions, and conducting intervention activities for students experiencing impeded matriculation.

    • Providing guidance to students navigating university systems, such as undergraduate admissions applications, graduation planner, e-mail, financial aid, housing apps and procedures, and understanding the degree audit report, among others.

    • Maintaining a roster of students in the customer relationship management system(s); tracking student engagements; assisting with developing and presenting transfer reports and data.

    • Conducting workshops and classroom visits with prospective and current students to inform students about transfer requirements and processes to ensure a seamless transition to BSU.

    • Presenting university transfer information at college recruitment events, information sessions, and at various meetings.

    • Assisting in the recruitment of prospective transfer students and helping students navigate through transfer and financial aid processes. Working with students who plan to transfer but have a long road ahead (part-time enrollment) to encourage continuance and clearly illustrate ways to achieve their goals.

    • Providing individualized transfer plans for students, with special attention paid to AAS/AS students to complete the MNTC before transferring. Providing transfer information for specific programs and discussing what would be needed to complete the program at BSU. Providing planning materials showing a breakdown of remaining courses and estimated costs.

About

UNIVERSITY / COMMUNITY

WHY BEMIDJI:

It’s more than a job. It’s an opportunity for the extraordinary.

On the idyllic shores of Lake Bemidji, cradled among the limitless natural beauty of the North Woods and neighbored by Minnesota’s three largest Indigenous nations, Bemidji State University offers opportunities for the extraordinary.

Bemidji State University has been ranked as one of the top 30 public institutions in the Midwest region by U.S. News & World Report each year since 2019. BSU offers its diverse student body a comprehensive spectrum of opportunities with nearly 120 undergraduate degrees and emphasis areas in more than 50 areas of study, 14 pre-professional programs, and 14 graduate programs and certificates.

As Bemidji State continues its second century of service, our vision is simple: we educate people to lead inspired lives. To achieve this, BSU centers diversity, equity and inclusion as a core value and strives to create a campus culture in which all members are free to be their authentic selves. BSU also proactively engages with Indigenous communities in northern Minnesota and nationwide toward its goal of becoming a destination university.

BSU is a member of the Minnesota State system of colleges and universities, the third-largest system of higher education institutions in the United States. It shares a unique alignment with Northwest Technical College, with administration and student services generally having dual responsibilities to serve both campuses. Through this alignment, NTC students can take advantage of services, support, activities, and opportunities at BSU that expand and enhance their college experience — such as full access to BSU’s library and the ability to live in BSU’s on-campus resident housing.

For the first time, a joint strategic planning process will guide the future directions for both institutions. The schools are pursuing four shared strategic priorities: student success, the Nisidotaading initiative, northern distinction, and telling our story. These priorities will serve as the foundations for master planning processes for facilities, academic programs, fundraising, information technology, intercollegiate athletics, and diversity, equity, and inclusion, among others.

The Nisidotaading initiative — named for an Ojibwe phrase meaning “building mutual understanding” — is creating a statewide center of excellence. It will develop communities of practice meant to help Minnesota State colleges and universities better educate their campus communities on historical trauma and lived experiences of their Indigenous populations, and how to most effectively guide Indigenous students toward their educational goals. In addition, BSU is the first university in the United States to expose all of its students to a course on Indigenous people before graduation.

Bemidji State University acknowledges that it is located on land and water that is the current and ancestral homeland of the Ojibwe and Dakota. We acknowledge the painful history of genocide, forced assimilation, and efforts to alienate the Indigenous inhabitants from their territory here. We honor and respect the many diverse Indigenous peoples still connected to this land, retained tribal sovereignty, treaty rights, and cultural resilience. Indigenous people are spiritual and physical caretakers of this land to which we all belong. Bemidji State University respects these sacred lands, stands with the community members from these Nations, and will fight injustice in all its forms.

At Minnesota State, the work we do is more than just a job. In their pursuit of purpose, connection, and growth, our employees play a critical role on our campuses. They develop policies, provide essential services, and work to improve the well-being and quality of life for our students and for all Minnesotans. Minnesota State is committed to equity and inclusion, and we invest in our employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities. Unlock your potential through possibility.

The City of Bemidji

Bemidji State University and Northwest Technical College lie amid the lakes and forests of northern Minnesota. Bemidji State occupies a wooded campus along the western shore of Lake Bemidji while Northwest Technical College lies just three miles east, near Bemidji’s robust industrial district.

The city sits between Minnesota’s three largest American Indian tribal nations: the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe, the Red Lake Nation and the White Earth Nation. When settling the Bemidji area in 1750, the Ojibwe people named the lake Bemidjigamaag, which means “a lake with crossing waters” as the Mississippi River flows in from the south and exits on the east. Today, a city proper with a population of around 15,000 serves as a regional economic and cultural hub for about 100,000 Minnesotans.

Located just minutes away from a thriving downtown Bemidji, both the BSU and NTC campus communities have convenient access to affordable restaurants, fine-dining experiences, cozy coffee shops, grocery stores — including a natural foods co-op — city parks, and nearly unlimited outdoor recreational opportunities. Small, locally-owned shops and art sculptures line Bemidji's downtown streets, while national chains are also found in and around the area. The historic Paul Bunyan Playhouse has a calendar of classic shows, restaurants offer weekly live music performances, the First Friday Art Walk provides a tour of new monthly art exhibits, and annual festivals bring the community together throughout the year.

Additionally, the North Woods setting means students, staff, and faculty have a variety of activities available at their fingertips year-round. With more than 400 lakes — and a 240-acre research forest owned by BSU — within 25 miles of the city, there is easy access to kayaking, canoeing, swimming, boating, paddle boarding, hunting, hiking, biking, foraging, fishing, and more. An expansive network of multi-use trail systems is available for running, cross-country skiing, single-track or fat-tire biking, and skijoring. Further, downhill skiing, snowboarding, and tubing lie just north of Bemidji at the Buena Vista Ski Area.

Bemidji is also near two of Minnesota’s 66 state parks: Lake Bemidji State Park, which sits along Lake Bemidji’s northern shore, and Itasca State Park, home to the majestic Mississippi River Headwaters. Both parks are popular recreational and camping destinations where locals and tourists gather for sailing, swimming, and fishing during the summer months, and skating, hockey, curling, and—yes—more fishing in the winter.

Of course, no tour of Bemidji is complete without a visit to — and a selfie with — its two most famous residents: the iconic statues of Paul Bunyan and his trusty companion, Babe the Blue Ox. The famed duo, which has greeted visitors to Bemidji since 1937, is on the National Register of Historic Places and was once ranked by Kodak as the second most-photographed statue in America.

title: Technical Program Manager - AWS Cloud Infrastructure
description:

This is a remote opportunity for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across AWS cloud infrastructure.
You will own the execution of multiple cloud platform and cost-optimization programs from planning through delivery.
The role combines strong program management with enough technical depth to work effectively alongside engineers, engineering managers, and SREs.
You will manage dependencies, critical paths, risks, priorities, and trade-offs while keeping stakeholders aligned.
Your work will directly contribute to infrastructure efficiency, security, governance, and broader technology strategy.
The environment is collaborative, globally distributed, and focused on pragmatic problem-solving and measurable outcomes.
You will also help identify opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to transform processes and improve business impact.

Accountabilities:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of concurrent AWS cloud infrastructure programs, managing scope, schedules, dependencies, budgets, and critical paths across engineering and partner teams.

  • Lead intake and prioritization processes, maintaining accurate roadmaps, priority documentation, dashboards, and program status information.

  • Partner closely with software engineers, engineering managers, and SREs to align execution with strategic objectives and support planning activities.
  • Drive security and governance initiatives end-to-end, ensuring dependencies are managed and delivery remains on track.

title: Palveluvastaava, Päiväkoti Nestori paviljonki
description:
Oletko ruoka- ja puhtausalan moniosaaja, joka viihtyy eloisassa ja vilkkaassa työympäristössä? Nestori paviljonki etsii uutta palveluvastaavaa huolehtimaan päiväkodin keittiötehtävistä sekä yleisestä puhtaudesta. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme päivittäin hyvät eväät elämään sekä viihtyisän ja puhtaan ympäristön.

Palveluvastaavana toimit osana Palvelukeskus Helsingin monipalvelut-yksikköä, jonka henkilöstö tuottaa ruoka- ja puhtauspalveluita kaupungin eri yksiköissä. Tässä tehtävässä vastaat itsenäisesti päiväkodin keittiöstä ja puhtaudesta. Työskentelet pääasiassa itsenäisesti, mutta lasten leikki ympärilläsi varmistaa, että työpäiväsi on täynnä elämää ja iloa.

Nestori paviljongissa työskentelet pääsääntöisesti yksin vastaten koko talon ruokahuollosta ja päivittäisistä puhtauspalvelutehtävistä. Lapsia päiväkodissa on noin 40, kahdessa ryhmässä. Samassa pihapiirissä toimii Nestori päiväkoti, jonka kanssa voi tehdä tarvittaessa yhteistyötä.

Mitä pääset meillä tekemään?

Tehtäviisi kuuluu aamu- ja välipalojen valmistus sekä lounasruoan käsittely. Olet myös puhtaanapidon ammattilainen ja hoidat päivittäiset siivoustyöt rutiinilla. Itsenäisellä ja kehittävällä otteellasi suunnittelet päivittäistä toimintaa ja huolehdit tilauksista sekä omavalvonnasta. Budjetin hallinta sujuu sinulta tarkasti ja luotettavasti.

Näillä edellytyksillä menestyt tehtävässä:
Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus tai työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.
Pärjäät työssä suomen kielellä.
Olet suorittanut hygieniapassin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työpaikan, jossa työaikasi on säännöllinen ja ennakoitava, arkisin klo 7-16 välillä.

Tarjoamme Suomen suurimman työnantajan vakauden lisäksi kattavat edut hyvinvointisi tueksi, kuten runsaat lomaedut (jopa 38 arkipäivää), kokemuslisät (5 vuoden kokemuksella 3 % ja 10 vuoden kokemuksella 8 %), kaupunkipyöräedun, ePassi Flex-edun, joka sisältää liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, työsuhdematkalippuedun sekä hyvinvointiedun (maksimissaan 550 €/kalenterivuosi) ja lounasedun. Voit itse vaikuttaa ansioihisi erilaisilla palkkioilla, minkä lisäksi kaupungin työntekijöillä on etusija Auroranlinnan asuntoihin. Panostamme myös henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämiseen tarjoamalla erilaisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Miten rekrytointiprosessi etenee?

Mikäli koet, että tämä paikka voisi olla juuri sinua varten, jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Ennen työn aloittamista valituksi tulleen henkilön tulee esittää hyväksytty työterveyshuollosta saatava työhöntulotarkastuslausunto ja rikosrekisteriote.

Kiinnostuitko? Odotamme jo innolla hakemustasi!

title: Food Services Specialist
description:
The position is in the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), at a VA Medical Center (VAMC) in Nutrition and Food Services. As Food Service Specialist, the incumbent is fully responsible for the culinary technical standard ensuring that efficient, safe and high-quality food services are provided to the Veteran, both inpatient and outpatient.

Duties include but are not limited to: Identifies current culinary industry trends and incorporates state-of-the art processes, equipment, and programs in the delivery of customer-focused feeding operations. Creates and tests specialized recipes and develops specialized food preparation methods to meet customer needs. Applies advanced culinary techniques which minimize the use of restricted nutrients to develop refined and patient pleasing flavors, textures, and presentations. Adjusts menus for cultural and religious practices and preferences. Performs quality control on plate presentation, recipe compliance, taste quality control, plate waste studies and overall culinary controls. Develops culinary performance and quality improvement initiatives for food service operations. Attends focus groups and implements strategies to meet customer satisfaction within clinical nutrition services. Assesses current state of food services and makes recommendations on improvement/changes. Plans future advancements to include new techniques, procurement, and production needs. Creates specialized food menus, recipes and service techniques to include diets for multiple medical conditions, modifications in micro/macro nutrients, food allergies, sensitivities and food consistencies. Forecasts needed food items based on advanced understanding of edible portions, yield, and waste factors. Identifies issues, deficiencies, or improvements, especially in food production, productivity, safety and quality and takes immediate corrective action. Conducts product samplings with vendors, keeps current on new food product availability. Researches, advises, trains, and educates in the advancement of culinary arts. Advises on culinary standards of food service and contracts related to food and subsistence matters and operations. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking a Staff DB SRE to build the runtime foundation for NVIDIA’s enterprise AI platforms — with a strong emphasis on database infrastructure at scale. This role blends large-scale database transformation with the building and development of GPU-accelerated platforms. You'll develop the software systems, automation frameworks, and high-performance database services that power NVIDIA’s AI workloads at scale.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and operate highly available database clusters (MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle) with automated replication, failover, point-in-time recovery, and disaster-recovery strategies at enterprise scale.

  • Drive database performance engineering — own query optimization, indexing strategies, connection pooling, lock-contention analysis, and storage-engine tuning for production systems handling millions of transactions.

  • Build self-service database lifecycle automation — from one-click cluster provisioning and schema migrations to zero-downtime upgrades, blue-green deployments, and automated capacity scaling.

  • Bridge relational and AI-native data infrastructure — extend traditional database expertise into vector search, GPU-accelerated query engines, and hybrid data platforms that serve both classic workloads and AI applications.

  • Compose and build software platforms that transform legacy database systems into modern and scalable architectures.

  • Run vector & graph database services and query engines to handle AI/ML data workloads with ultra-low latency.

  • Build automation frameworks for provisioning, schema evolution, scaling, and failover integrated directly into CI/CD workflows.

  • Build developer-focused tooling for monitoring, profiling, and debugging database performance in real time.

  • Contribute to architecture, coding standards, and guidelines for long-term platform evolution.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure flawless operation of critical database services.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of Database engineering experience with deep expertise in database systems or distributed data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with one or more major relational database engines (like Oracle, MySQL, MSSQL) — including replication topologies, backup/restore strategies, and high-availability architecture.

  • Proven background in query optimization, data partitioning, and large-scale performance tuning.

  • Experience building or operating managed database services or internal Database-as-a-Service platforms — automating provisioning, monitoring, patching, and failover for database fleets at scale.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go, with a track record of building production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrable experience crafting high-performance, high-availability relational database services.

title: Senior Financial Planning Analyst
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy.

Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION

Help shape the future of growing PUMA business.

At PUMA, we're entering an exciting period of growth across Oceania, and we're looking for a commercially minded Senior Financial Planning Analyst to help drive what's next.

Supporting our Wholesale business and our growing COBRA PUMA Golf division, you'll play a critical role in helping business leaders make smarter, faster and more profitable decisions. This isn't a role focused on reporting what happened last month. It's about influencing what happens next.

Partnering closely with senior stakeholders across Wholesale, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance, you'll provide the insights, forecasting and commercial recommendations that help shape strategy and deliver sustainable growth.

For an ambitious FP&A professional looking to step into a highly visible business partnering role, this is an opportunity to make a genuine impact while building your career with one of the world's leading sports brands.

The Opportunity

As the Senior Financial Planning Analyst, you'll be the trusted finance partner to our Wholesale leadership team, providing end-to-end financial support across planning, forecasting, analysis and commercial decision-making.

Initially supporting our Wholesale business, you'll progressively assume financial ownership of the COBRA PUMA Golf business, creating a broader commercial portfolio with significant growth potential across Oceania.

You'll be relied upon to identify risks and opportunities, challenge thinking, evaluate investment decisions and provide the financial insights that help leaders confidently execute their plans.

What You'll Be Doing

Drive Financial Planning & Performance

You'll lead budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes while ensuring leaders have a clear understanding of business performance.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading annual budgets, forecasts and strategic planning processes

  • Developing rolling forecasts and identifying risks and opportunities

  • Delivering monthly reporting, analysis and performance insights

  • Building financial models that support strategic business decisions

  • Conducting scenario planning across customers, pricing, product mix and growth initiatives

  • Driving improvements across reporting and FP&A processes

Deliver Commercial Insights That Matter

You'll help leaders understand what's driving performance and where future opportunities exist.

This includes:

  • Analysing financial results and providing meaningful commercial recommendations

  • Developing customer profitability analysis and performance insights

  • Supporting investment and growth decisions through robust financial modelling

  • Preparing executive-level reporting and presentations

  • Leveraging SAP, Power BI and financial data to improve decision-making across the business

Partner With Leaders Across The Business

Success in this role will come from your ability to build trusted relationships and influence outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across:

  • Wholesale

  • COBRA PUMA Golf

  • Sales

  • Marketing

  • Operations

  • Senior Leadership Team

You'll challenge assumptions, provide independent commercial perspectives and help the business balance growth opportunities with financial outcomes.

Support Marketing Investment Decisions

Working closely with our Marketing team, you'll help maximise the effectiveness of both Brand and Trade Marketing investments by providing visibility, governance and commercial insight into spending decisions.

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants must submit a cover letter outlining how their experience, skills and qualifications align with the requirements of the role. We encourage candidates to highlight their experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, budgeting and forecasting, commercial finance, financial modelling and business partnering. Particular interest will be given to candidates who can demonstrate experience supporting Wholesale, Consumer Goods, FMCG or Retail businesses, influencing commercial decision-making, and delivering financial insights that drive business performance and profitable growth.

YOUR TALENT

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a commercially astute finance professional who combines strong technical capability with exceptional stakeholder management and business partnering skills.

You'll bring:

  • 5-8 years' experience in FP&A or Commercial Finance.

  • CA or CPA qualification.

  • Demonstrated experience leading budgeting, forecasting and planning processes.

  • Experience presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Advanced financial modelling and analytical capability.

  • Experience within Retail, FMCG or Consumer Goods environments will be highly regarded.

  • Strong Excel, Power BI and ERP system expertise.

  • A proven ability to influence decisions through financial insight and commercial business partnering.

The Kind of Leader You Are

You are:

  • Commercially astute and strategically minded.

  • A confident communicator who can influence at all levels of the organisation.

  • Curious, proactive and solutions-focused.

  • Comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity.

  • Collaborative and relationship-driven.

  • Resilient, adaptable and results-oriented.

  • A leader who takes ownership and thrives on delivering business impact.

Why PUMA?

PUMA is one of the world's most recognised sports brands, operating at the intersection of sport, culture and innovation.

This is an opportunity to join a business where finance is deeply embedded in commercial decision-making. You'll work closely with senior leaders, influence strategic outcomes, and gain exposure across a dynamic Retail and eCommerce portfolio that continues to evolve and grow.

At PUMA, you'll be empowered to challenge convention, contribute ideas and make a tangible impact. Whether you're supporting major investment decisions, driving performance initiatives or influencing long-term strategy, your work will help shape the future success of the business.

What You'll Love About PUMA

  • Strategic ownership across both Retail and eCommerce channels.

  • High visibility and engagement with senior leadership.

  • A true commercial finance business partnering opportunity.

  • Exposure to major investment, growth and transformation initiatives.

  • Opportunities to mentor, influence and lead.

  • A collaborative culture that values accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Career development within a globally recognised consumer brand.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're an experienced FP&A or Commercial Finance professional looking for an opportunity to shape strategy, influence senior stakeholders and drive commercial performance across a dynamic business, we'd love to hear from you.

Join PUMA and play a key role in driving the future success of our Wholesale functions across Oceania.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex,

gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at

PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal

opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience.To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000

employees worldwide.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Stellar ecosystem)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Stellar ecosystem) based in India.

This is a senior-level remote engineering opportunity within a fast-moving Web3 and decentralized finance environment.
You will take ownership of backend architecture, development, scalability, performance, and reliability.
The role focuses on building secure, production-grade systems that connect on-chain liquidity across blockchain ecosystems.
You will work closely with product, frontend, design, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex requirements into robust solutions.
A strong focus on the Stellar network makes this an excellent opportunity for engineers with hands-on blockchain experience.
You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, mentoring, and continuous improvement across the backend stack.
The environment values autonomy, curiosity, strong communication, and the ability to solve challenging technical problems independently.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and actively contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of backend systems and APIs.
  • Architect scalable, reliable, and secure backend solutions capable of supporting growing users, transactions, and evolving business requirements.
  • Develop production-grade services using TypeScript and Node.js within containerized environments.
  • Maintain high engineering standards through clean, readable, maintainable code, effective code reviews, and established development best practices.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize code, algorithms, data access, and backend services to improve system efficiency.
  • Implement monitoring, debugging, and observability capabilities to proactively identify issues and maintain high system availability.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites to ensure system reliability and resilience.
  • Work with blockchain integrations and contribute to systems interacting with decentralized networks and on-chain liquidity.
  • Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, designers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
  • Analyze complex technical and architectural challenges and propose practical, scalable solutions.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, helping strengthen team capabilities and engineering practices.
  • Document APIs, code, architecture, and technical processes to support knowledge sharing and efficient onboarding.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and independently recommend improvements to the platform and engineering processes.

    • Requirements

    • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in senior or lead-level backend roles.
    • Previous professional experience in the blockchain/Web3 space, with a solid technical understanding of the EVM ecosystem or other blockchain technologies.
    • Proven production experience with the Stellar network.
    • Strong professional experience with TypeScript and backend development using Node.js.
    • Strong understanding of blockchain technology, decentralized systems, and blockchain-based applications.
    • Solid knowledge of document-oriented databases and caching technologies, particularly MongoDB and Redis.
    • Experience designing backend systems and contributing to software architecture and technical design decisions.
    • Strong knowledge of software testing frameworks and engineering best practices across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
    • Ability to write scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable production-grade code.
    • Experience with cloud, containerization, or modern infrastructure environments is highly valuable, including technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub, or Cloudflare.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to diagnosing complex technical challenges.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
    • Proactive and autonomous working style, combined with the ability to contribute effectively within a distributed team.
    • Strong curiosity about emerging technologies and the ability to independently evaluate and recommend technical improvements.
    • Very strong written and spoken English.
    • Experience with Stellar Soroban smart contracts is a plus.
    • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline is an advantage.
    • Candidates should be located in EMEA, with selected APAC locations potentially considered where working hours sufficiently overlap with European time zones.

      • Benefits

      • €90,000–€130,000 annual salary on a full-time permanent contract.
      • Fully remote position for candidates in eligible EMEA or overlapping APAC locations.
      • Flexible working hours designed to support distributed collaboration.
      • 30 days of paid time off (PTO).
      • Equity participation from day one.
      • Annual team offsites.
      • Company-provided work computer with a choice of equipment.
      • €1,000 annual personal development budget after six months of employment, prorated during the first year.
      • One-time €1,000 remote-work budget for coworking, office equipment, or workspace setup.
      • Opportunity to work on Web3, blockchain, DeFi, and cross-chain infrastructure at senior technical level.
      • Exposure to modern technologies including TypeScript, Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, MongoDB, Redis, and blockchain integrations.

  • Self-motivated with a positive “can-do” attitude, creative with excellent presentation, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills including strong persuasive techniques.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Croatia.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.
