title: Investment Analyst
description:
Interested in sharing your investment experience with one of Canada's few international impact investment funds? As an investment advisor, you'll have a unique opportunity to work on private debt and equity investments with international financial services institutions in Latin America, Africa and Asia.

In this key role, you’ll have the opportunity to closely contribute to different stages of the investment process, and to offer ideas and solutions using your financial analysis capabilities and your overall knowledge of investing. Your involvement as part of the team will allow you to increase DID’s leadership in the area of impact investing, and to directly contribute to the updating of best practices.


Investing for financial inclusion

Through our commitment to impact investing, and in collaboration with numerous private and public-sector partners, we contribute to supporting the growth, viability and governance of inclusive financial institutions that work to make secure financial services available to millions of clients and their families, and to adapt them to their needs. Our resources are directed where they are likely to have the most impact: in small institutions that focus on the sustainable inclusion of women and marginalized populations in Latin America, Africa and Asia. We hope to use finance to create a more equitable, inclusive and greener world. To learn more: www.did.qc.ca.


An overview of your day-to-day…

  • You support the team and the investment process by collecting, consolidating, analyzing, and interpreting data while providing the information necessary for tracking existing investments and for promoting our efforts to increase the funds under management.
  • You complete financial analysis related to investment opportunities.
  • You contribute to preparing financial models, management and follow-up information reports/analysis on indicators and scales related to investments.
  • You participate in account reporting activities and the creation of external reports.
  • Your curiosity and your thirst for knowledge are put to use to ensure a structured monitoring of the sector in order to provide information about investment opportunities, potential countries, competitors, and any other market information that can help with decision making.
  • Your ingenuity allows you to contribute to the development and structuring of the fund, and to the development of impact measuring, and work methodologies and processes.

Do you fit this description?

  • You hold a bachelor’s degree in finance or a relevant field.
  • You have a professional designation (CFA) or are in the process of obtaining it (an asset).
  • You have at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • You are comfortable with MS Office tools and you have in-depth knowledge of Excel.
  • You stand out because of your in-depth analysis, your ability to synthesize, and your diligence. No detail escapes you.
  • A team player, you’re a self-starter and proactive thinker. You don't hesitate to help your colleagues.
  • Your curiosity and agile learning skills let you identify priorities quickly in a dynamic environment with many deadlines.
  • You are able to work in at least two of the three languages used at DID (French, English and Spanish). The ability to work in Spanish is a major asset.

Job-Related Working Conditions

  • Hybrid work arrangement (2 days in the office and 3 days working remotely).
  • Job level: NV-08
  • Permanent, full-time position (35 hours per week). Head Office, Lévis.

Why work at DID?


  • Flexible measures to support a work/life balance, such as a flexible schedule, summer hours, various holidays, and telework.
  • Comprehensive, competitive benefits.
  • Values that give your work meaning: giving back to the community, contributing to supporting sustainable development, etc.
  • Work with colleagues who show ingenuity and curiosity to develop innovative products and services.
  • Access to a large community of international exchanges and the possibility to move around the world.
  • And, above all, considerable leeway that allows you to influence how things unfold.

title: Program Analyst
description:
This position serves as a Program Analyst in the Office of Airports (ARP), Safety and Standards (AAS), Airports Safety and Operations Division (AAS-300), Airports Safety Policy Branch (AAS-310) and is responsible for managing various technical and administrative functions related to ARP's internal and external Safety Management System (SMS) programs.

Serves as a subject matter expert in the use of Safety Management Systems (SMS) and provides leadership for highly complex and challenging activities under the minimal direction of a manager or executive. Utilizes experience and expert knowledge to provide technical advice and guidance to internal and external stakeholders on Part 139 SMS requirements, and polices and procedures related to the ARP's internal SMS program. Provides support and assistance with the implementation and execution of SMS requirements, including collaborating with other inter-agency Lines of Businesses/Staff Offices (LOBs/SOs) regarding FAA and International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) SMS efforts. Represents ARP senior management, in their absence, on FAA internal SMS boards and panels; and serves as the main liaison between ARP and the Aviation Safety Management (ASM) office to integrate safety and risk management efforts, ensuring an effective and centralized SMS program. Applies experience and expert knowledge of management analysis techniques to perform a wide range of complex analytical functions related to planning, management, and evaluation for ARP programs. Reviews and analyzes complex operational analyses; develops and coordinates reports for Congressional review; conducts business planning and goal development related to SMS; and completes highly visible and controversial tasks and ad hoc projects, as required. Provides guidance and direction to staff and teams conducting complex and controversial studies; coordinates analyses which may result in recommendations to improve organizational processes, structures, policies and regulations. Conducts management inquires and/or analytical analysis throughout ARP. Provides advice and guidance to senior APR management and other agency officials on complex issues that may directly impact policy and operational decisions affecting national and international safety programs that are managed and directed by ARP. Gathers, reviews and analyzes data from various airport safety databases to determine safety trends and root causes of accidents and incidents. Performs analytical-related duties, including developing and/or evaluating complex national programs, policies and management processes; reviews, analyzes and reports national program data by determining and developing baseline performance measures and comparing performance with the baseline. Collects and analyzes data, derives conclusions and makes recommendations based on those conclusions; prepares reports, graphs and charts and provides status updates, while identifying areas requiring further analysis. Gathers, validates and inputs technical data in preparation of monthly Business Plan targets, airport safety reports and dashboards; and provides written responses to airport safety issues raised by members of Congress, the National Transportation Safety Board, Office of the inspector General and the Government Accountability Office. Serves as a sponsor for airport safety research projects assigned to the FAA Technical Center. Receives and reviews safety research reports; and collaborates with employees and leadership at all organizational levels. Contacts are internal and external to the organization. Often represents the division and LOB/SO as a principal point of contact to provide advice and guidance on the applications of policies and procedures. Formulates and recommends to senior management positions on major projects/ policies/issues. Prepares, reviews, and recommends approvals of major reports on projects, programs and other work activities for internal and external distribution. Develops briefings to convey strategic vision and/or organizational policies to internal and external audiences. Broad policies and objectives provide general guidance for addressing issues but often require the development of new approaches.

We are not accepting applications from noncitizens.

title: Master Trainer – AI & Data Analytics
description:
Job Description – Master Trainer

Role: College Mobilisation & Training

Role Purpose

The Master Trainer will play a dual role of College Coordinator and Trainer, with end-to-end responsibility for college engagement, student mobilisation, counselling, training delivery. The role will focus on building a continuous pipeline of students from colleges, preparing them for training, independently delivering assigned modules, and supporting student retention, completion and employment readiness.

Key Responsibility Areas

1. College Engagement & Partnership Development

  • Identify and establish relationships with colleges, ITIs and other educational institutions in the assigned geography. Meet College Principals, TPOs, Placement Officers, faculty and relevant SPOCs to introduce and promote the programme.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with college SPOCs to ensure continuous student mobilisation. Plan and conduct college visits, programme orientations, presentations and awareness sessions. Identify new colleges and institutions to expand the student pipeline.
  • Be willing to travel as required by the project for college engagement, mobilisation, orientations and training activities.

2. Student Mobilisation & Counselling

  • Conduct student orientation, career counselling and programme awareness sessions.
  • Explain programme benefits, eligibility, training schedule, career opportunities and expectations to students.
  • Follow up with interested students and convert leads into registrations/enrolments.
  • Ensure students are appropriately counselled before joining the programme to minimise dropouts.

3. Batch Formation & Training Readiness

  • Plan batches based on the student pipeline and project requirements.
  • Coordinate with the Centre Team for batch creation, documentation, scheduling and other operational requirements.
  • Ensure students complete the required enrolment and documentation within timelines.
  • Maintain a continuous pipeline so that the next batch is ready while the current batch is under training.

4. Training Delivery

  • Independently deliver training as per the approved curriculum, session plans and quality standards.
  • Primary training modules will include:
    • AI and Digital Productivity
    • Foundational Knowledge of Data Analytics
  • Conduct practical activities, assessments, exercises and learner engagement activities.
  • Monitor attendance, participation, learning progress and student performance.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned training batches.
  • Maintain training quality and ensure effective learner engagement throughout the programme.

6. Placement & Career Readiness Support

  • Work closely with the Placement Team to prepare students for employment opportunities.
  • Support employability, interview preparation and career guidance.
  • Encourage participation in placement drives.
  • Track student interest and readiness for employment.
  • Support post-training follow-up wherever required.

7. Centre Operations & MIS

  • Maintain accurate student, batch, attendance, training and outcome-related records.
  • Prepare required reports and provide regular updates to the Project/Centre Team.
  • Support centre activities, events, audits, documentation and other operational requirements.
  • Coordinate with Facilitators and Centre Team members wherever additional support is required.

8. Community & Outreach Activities

  • Support local outreach activities to increase programme visibility and student participation. Participate in career fairs, college events, community events and other mobilisation activities.
  • Develop local networks with relevant stakeholders to strengthen student mobilisation. Identify new outreach channels to increase registrations and enrolments.

Qualification & Experience

  • Education: Graduate in any relevant discipline. Preferable candidates with a background in IT, Computer Applications, Data Analytics, Management or related fields will be preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably in training, teaching, employability programmes, digital skills, college engagement or student mobilisation.
  • Training Exposure: Prior experience in training/facilitation is mandatory, with the ability to independently conduct classroom/online training for college students or young learners.
  • Technical Knowledge: Good working knowledge of AI and Digital Productivity tools, along with foundational knowledge of Data Analytics.
  • Should be comfortable learning and delivering new-age digital tools, technologies and concepts.
  • Mobility: Should be willing and comfortable to travel and mobilise colleges/students as per project requirements, including visits to colleges, institutions and other outreach locations.

title: WDI Set Decorator Intern, Orlando, Spring 2027

description:
About the Role & Program

Be a part of an innovative team and culture…

Walt Disney Imagineering is the creative force that imagines, designs and brings to life all Disney theme parks, resorts, attractions and cruise ships worldwide. Working across a spectrum of disciplines that range from creative and conceptual to scientific and technical, Imagineers blend an innovative mixture of storytelling, art, science and technology to create immersive experiences, memorable destinations, and innovative entertainment for families around the globe.

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027 and will be located in Orlando, FL.

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Set Decoration Intern who will work within the department that provides set decoration services for all areas our guests see when they enter our parks. This includes attractions, retail spaces, restaurant spaces, display areas, landscape, facades and area development. The Set Decoration Department interfaces and supports other divisions within WDI, as well as departments within our parks including Creative, Architectural, Engineering, Show Art, Show Ride, Park Operations and Park Maintenance. The Set Decorator amplifies and embellishes the story. It is the mission of the team to create highly entertaining environments in which the magic of each Disney story is possible! As an intern, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Support the design, production and installation effort as advised by the Principal and Senior Set Decorator Leads for the project

  • Interface and coordinate with other show related teams

  • Support design development and communicate design concepts

  • Maintain paperwork associated with the design effort and detail the implemented design

  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure placement of props and decorations

  • Assist in field installation of props and dressings when required

  • Research historical information and design technologies in support of design effort

  • Work with manager in order to adhere to budget and schedule

  • Support mock-ups and presentations including set-ups and strikes

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Ability to work within a team environment and at the direction of Senior and Principal Designers

  • Have a working knowledge of props or set decoration for theatre, film or television

  • Knowledge of storytelling with objects

  • Ability to work at heights above 30’ if needed

  • Ability to lift 15 to 20 pounds

  • Ability to periodically work third shift after the park closes

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word

  • Previous experience in the technical aspects of Theater Arts and its associated skills

  • Must be able to read architectural drawing packages

  • Working knowledge of construction materials, hardware, and tools

  • Experience working with hand tools

  • Valid Driver’s License Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and SketchUp

  • Previous WDI internship or other Disney experience

Education

Currently enrolled as a Junior or higher attending an accredited college/university earning a degree majoring in Interior/Retail Design, Technical Theater, Dimensional Design, Architectural Modeling, Applied Media Arts or related field

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application posting OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship​

  • Be at least 18 years of age​

  • Possess unrestricted work authorization​

  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or Disney College Program

Additional Information

  • Able to provide reliable transportation to/from work

  • Must be fully available for the duration of the internship

  • We provide limited housing opportunities for Florida Based Professional Interns through American Campus Communities, for more information click here

Materials Required

A portfolio review is required for this position. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applicants without a portfolio link on their résumé will not be considered a completed application packet and may not be fully considered for the position.

title: Specialty Care Access & Reimbursement Enablement Team Lead
description:
Why Patients Need You

Patient Solutions is an evolving and highly important area for the success of Pfizer Specialty Care. Due to the complexity of the patient journey in many Specialty Care therapeutic areas, up to 50% of specialty medications never get dispensed after an HCP writes the prescription. The role of Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement is to remove barriers to access through education and streamlined processes that accelerate fulfillment, helping appropriate patients get access to the medication their HCP has prescribed.

What You Will Achieve

The Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Enablement Team Lead will work across a broad, multi-disciplinary group of internal and external stakeholders to develop, evolve, and lead projects and programs to advance the Access and Reimbursement groups' mission to help patients. They will develop a process of continuous improvement measured by clearly defined key performance indicators that serve as benchmarks for success across the platform. The Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Enablement Team Lead will report directly to the Specialty Care Patient Solutions Strategy and Enablement Lead, with a dotted-line relationship to Access and Reimbursement leadership, and is responsible for leading and coaching the Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Enablement Team.

This leader brings a deep understanding of all Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement priorities, using that knowledge to compliantly drive team impact and efficiency. Key areas of focus include evolving and improving the effectiveness of the following: operational infrastructure, Ways of Working, engagement framework, project management processes, access and reimbursement models, and analytics and reporting platforms. This role requires a professional who is adept at handling multiple responsibilities, including team leadership, presentations, data reporting, and cross-functional coordination. The successful candidate will provide insights from an enterprise echelon applied to a regional and territory level of execution.

The Team Lead will partner with key cross-functional partners on AI strategy within Access and Reimbursement, which ladders up to an overall Patient Solutions AI strategy — identifying where AI can meaningfully improve the patient and customer experience, shaping the roadmap for AI-enabled tools and capabilities, and enabling the Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Enablement Team to consistently pull through that AI strategy across territories and stakeholders.

Role Responsibilities

  • Create a high performing organization through talent planning, career development and performance management.

  • Lead and be accountable for PX-related processes. To include, but not limited to consistency in interviewing and hiring practices, annual goal setting and year-end process (e.g., team performance and year end reviews), annual compensation process (i.e., merit, and LTI), career progression, talent planning (e.g. talent assessments and growth plans), and diversity initiatives.

  • Work with cross-functional partners (Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement National Lead, Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Regional Directors, Patient Engagement Enablement, Patient Services, Digital and others) to identify key themes and lead initiatives/projects needed to advance productivity, efficiency, and results.

  • Accelerate Access and Reimbursement Ways of Working with other CFC teams and within Patient Solutions — including the Patient Engagement team — to break down silos, streamline hand-offs, and create a more connected, patient-centric operating model.

  • Align, motivate, engage, coach and develop the Access and Reimbursement Enablement Team to fully support execution of the Access and Reimbursement strategies and tactics and to compliantly provide insights and assistance to the Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement Leadership Team.

  • Identify and prioritize the right continuous improvement projects, processes, and resources, working with key stakeholders to advance productivity and support the strategy and execution of operating plans and project budgets.

  • Develop partnerships and collaborate with key enablement colleagues in other functional areas and business units to ensure ongoing alignment, consistency, and efficiency across all Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement reporting and interfaces.

  • Partner cross-functionally to enable internal functions, while also partnering externally, as needed, to deliver insights and execute initiative(s) to evolve Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement approaches and results.

  • Manage Specialty Care Access Reimbursement in the following: business reviews, executive presentation support, priority lists, alerts, and measurement of strategic imperatives including improving time to fill, fulfillment and reauthorization erosion.

  • Own and continuously evolve optimal territory mapping and deployment methodology, regularly reassessing alignment, capacity, and coverage models to ensure the deployment approach remains fit for purpose as the business, brands, and patient needs evolve.

  • Develop and design engaging and informative presentations for internal and external stakeholders while collaborating with various departments, to ensure consistent content accuracy and visual appeal.

  • Champion a strong data, analytics, and reporting discipline by leading a team to build and maintain robust data, analytics, and reporting capabilities; personally model rigorous, insight-driven analysis; and coach and develop the team so they can independently generate and apply data-driven insights, working closely with IIS, Patient Insights, and other key stakeholders.

  • Analyze data and generate insights to inform strategic decisions at all levels of Specialty Care Access & Reimbursement from the territory level to executive directives.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evolve current processes and platforms to a better future state.

  • Support Specialty Care Access & Reimbursement leaders with communication strategy and change management — helping shape clear, consistent messaging and structured change approaches for major initiatives, organizational shifts, and evolving ways of working, to drive understanding, alignment, and adoption across the field and enablement teams.

  • Work cross-functionally to develop, build, and deploy the AI strategy for Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement, enabling field teams to pull it through in day-to-day execution to help accelerate patient access.

  • Lead key projects that sit above Specialty Care Access and Reimbursement, but in service of Patient Solutions overall, partnering across the broader Patient Solutions Enablement team to advance enterprise-wide priorities.

Basic Qualifications

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales with extensive external healthcare market and advanced customer/health system knowledge.

  • Previous Field Reimbursement and Leadership experience with a demonstrated track record of high performance and specialized technical skills obtained from cross-functional leadership roles.

  • Experience leading in a matrix organization with the ability to create business impact.

  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Ability to influence key stakeholders internally and externally with proven executive communication skills and leadership qualities.

  • Forward looking and results oriented with effective planning, prioritization, and organizational project skills.

  • Strong and proven project management skills demonstrating the ability to deliver multiple time horizon focused projects simultaneously in the short-term and long-term.

  • Track record of leading and managing complex programs to deliver improved outcomes.

  • Strong strategic skills including effectiveness in identifying and addressing major strategic challenges (e.g., shifting market environment) and the ability to balance ever-changing short-term needs with long-term vision.

  • Strong interpersonal skills are required, as well as excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills to address leadership and external audiences.

  • Proven experience in working with a compliance first mindset.

  • Strong data, analytics, and reporting acumen, with demonstrated ability to translate data into insight and action, and to lead and develop others in doing the same.

  • Experience with territory mapping, alignment, and deployment methodologies, with a track record of evolving deployment approaches to keep them fit for purpose.

  • Experience supporting leaders with communication strategy and change management for large-scale or evolving initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Headquarters knowledge with proven experience working across cross-functional HQ departments, teams, and business units.

  • Prior people leadership and operations experience with a strong history of achievement and performance.

  • Experience leading or shaping AI strategy within a commercial, patient services, or operations organization, including deploying and enabling teams to pull through AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

  • Advanced degree preferred.

Other Job Details:

  • Last Date to Apply: August 28, 2026

  • Work Location Assignment: Remote

  • Please Note: This position will report to Rea MacRall, Specialty Care Patient Solutions Strategy and Enablement Lead

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Console Frameworks
description:
We're building the platform that powers the Amazon Ads Console — the framework layer that drives development velocity, latency, and availability improvements for tens of product teams building advertising experiences. As the console transitions toward agentic, AI-driven workflows, we need a Senior SDE to lead the technical evolution of our platform and the new systems that will underpin this shift.

The Ads Console Frameworks team owns Pantheon (the app framework powering the console's architecture), Argus (an agentic quality evaluation platform that autonomously walks advertiser workflows to detect regressions), Compass (a self-serve product analytics platform for the console), and the shared services and components that every Ads Console page depends on. Our systems serve as the foundation dozens of teams build on.

This is not a heads-down coding role. You'll drive architectural decisions with broad ambiguity — designing how the console's frameworkS evolve to support agentic development patterns, defining how product analytics should work across 141 pages, and shaping platform contracts that other teams adopt. You'll need strong product instincts to understand advertiser workflows and form a point of view on where framework-level solutions unlock the most leverage, and either bring knowledge of the advertising business or the curiosity to develop it quickly.

The role spans technically complex domains — from front-end framework architecture and module systems, through platform services targeting 99.99% availability under peak load, to AI agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and governed data pipelines. You'll also be expected to embrace and advance AI-native development practices, using AI tools and agentic coding techniques to accelerate how the team builds software. This is a horizontal team role: you set technical direction that other teams build on, define API contracts and integration patterns across organizational boundaries, and maintain platform quality as adoption scales rapidly.

The right candidate has designed and built platform systems at scale, can operate independently in highly ambiguous problem spaces, has recent hands-on experience with AI-powered or agent-oriented systems, and brings product thinking to every technical decision.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead technical architecture and hands-on delivery across the full AI application stack — UI, services, agent infrastructure, orchestration, and evaluation — for the Ads Agent experience and integration framework used by dozens of partner teams.
- Bring product thinking to every technical decision: develop deep understanding of advertiser workflows so architecture choices reflect how advertisers actually use the product.
- Set architectural direction on a horizontal platform team: define integration patterns and API contracts that dozens of teams build on, lead design reviews, and maintain quality as adoption scales.
- Establish and exemplify best practices for building AI applications (evaluation methodologies, quality guardrails, prompt engineering, orchestration patterns) and for AI-native development (using AI tools and agentic coding to accelerate the team's delivery).
- Drive operational excellence and mentor engineers across the team.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing agent quality metrics and system health across the stack. Mid-morning you're leading a design review for a new framework capability — asking sharp questions that blend technical depth with product thinking about advertiser workflows. After lunch you're writing high-leverage code: the interface for a new extension point that partner teams will build on. Later you join a cross-team architecture discussion on whether a new capability should be a skill or a separate agent, driving alignment by making tradeoffs concrete. You close the day refactoring a service that grew complex during prototyping — because on a horizontal team, accumulated complexity compounds with every partner.

About the team
We are a team of ~50 engineers building the experience layer for the Amazon Ads Agent and Console. We own the chat interface, advertiser-facing communications, and the frameworks that enable dozens of partner teams to integrate agent capabilities across the Ads Console. This is a horizontal team — our APIs, patterns, and quality bar ripple across the organization. We're at an inflection point on two fronts: the product we build is an AI agent, and our development workflow is shifting to AI-native practices using agentic coding. Both are core to how we operate. We value technical depth, product-minded engineering, fast iteration, and building over theorizing.

title: Eksekutiv Produsent
description:
Vi er en av de raskest voksende podkast- og lydbokplattformene i Europa, og vi søker nå en Eksekutiv Produsent som vil bli med i vårt voksende team i Oslo, Norge.


Om rollen

Har du øre for den neste store podkastsuksessen - og den strategiske teften for å realisere den? Hos Podimo skal vi løfte frem stemmer og gi lyttere lydunderholdning av høy kvalitet. I denne rollen vil du være broen mellom kreativ visjon og lytterne, med ansvar for helhetlig forvaltning av våre originale og eksklusive podkaster og lydbøker.

Du blir en del av det norske innholdsteamet og vil jobbe tett med innholdsskapere og produksjonspartnere for å sikre at hver podkast finner sitt publikum, engasjerer lytterne og bidrar til vekst av plattformen vår.

Rollen har base på våre kontorer i Oslo og rapporterer direkte til vår Head of Content. Vi vurderer søknader og gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å søke så snart som mulig.What you'll do:


Dine arbeidsoppgaver

  • Du vil ha ansvar for en portefølje av redaksjonelt innhold, og skal følge innhold fra idé til lansering og videre.

  • Du skal utvikle podkaster og skaffe eksklusivt innhold som treffer våre målgrupper. Du kommer til å vurdere innkommende pitcher og gi den redaksjonelle "sparringen" som trengs for å utvikle nye suksesser.

  • Å bygge sterke relasjoner er kjernen i det vi gjør. Du skal samarbeide med uavhengige innholdsskapere, produksjonsselskaper og management, og sørge for at de føler seg ivaretatt. Du skaper tillit og en tilbakemeldingskultur som forener kreativitet med våre felles mål.

  • Du har oversikt over hele produksjonsprosessen. Dette betyr å opprettholde høye redaksjonelle nivåer samtidig som du holder god oversikt over tidsplaner, budsjetter og kontrakter.

  • I samarbeid med Head of Content vil du bidra til å definere strategier som gjenspeiler gjeldende trender. Du vil analysere data for å maksimere programmets nedslagsfelt, og ta redaksjonelle og kommersielle beslutninger som gjør lyttere til lojale fans.

  • Du vil håndtere den nødvendige administrative siden av porteføljen din, inkludert resultatoppfølging - og sørge for at alt går knirkefritt for seg i kulissene.


Dette er deg

  • Du har 3-5+ års relevant erfaring fra media-, lyd- eller underholdningsbransjen. Du har bakgrunn innen redaksjonelle roller, innholdsstrategi eller produksjon. Du har erfaring med å identifisere gode historier og vet nøyaktig hvordan du skal tilpasse et format til markedets behov.

  • Du utmerker deg innen relasjonsbygging. Du har erfaring med å lede talenter, management eller produksjonspartnere, og kan gi konstruktiv tilbakemelding på en måte som bygger tillit og fremmer utvikling.

  • Du har sterke prosjekt- og produksjonsledelsesferdigheter. Du har erfaring med å håndtere budsjetter og tidsfrister, og klarer å balansere administrative oppgaver uten å miste fokus på kvalitet.

  • Du forstår publikumsengasjement og vet hvordan du bruker innsikt til å hjelpe et program med å nå ut til publikum. Du har erfaring med å forvandle data til handlingsrettede strategier som beholder og engasjerer lyttere.

  • Du vet hvordan du balanserer kreativ formatutvikling med et sterkt datadrevet fokus, og du trives med å forstå hvordan du får programmene dine til å skille seg ut.

  • Sterke kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk (flytende) og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

Naturligvis er det et stort pluss å være opptatt av podkaster, lydinnhold, media og underholdning!


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP: Alle ansatte har mulighet til å ta del i selskapets suksess gjennom vårt aksjeprogram for ansatte (ESOP).

  • Pensjonsordning og helseforsikring

  • Foreldrepermisjon: Opptil seks måneders fullt betalt foreldrepermisjon for alle nye foreldre.

  • Fleksibilitet og trivsel: Fleksibel arbeidstid og mulighet for hjemmekontor for å sikre en god balanse mellom arbeid og fritid, tilgang til ekstern mental helsehjelp, samt ubegrensede «sykt barn»-dager.

  • Prestasjon, læring og utvikling: Tilgang til ressurser som hjelper deg med å trives og bygge karrieren din i et dynamisk selskap i sterk vekst.


This is Podimo

Podimo is Europe’s leading podcasting platform, home to award-winning exclusive originals, audiobooks, and podcasts with over 1.2 million subscribers and delivering over 700 curated episodes a month. Offering premium entertainment through a seamless experience, Podimo combines end-to-end production powered by innovative technology and a creator-first model that rewards creators for producing exceptional content that engages and entertains audiences.

Through Podimo Studios, we produce, monetise and distribute great stories and shows, either in house or via our four labels, Podads in Denmark, arc.studio in Germany, and Dutch labels Tonny Media and Dag en Nacht Media. This helps us to deliver integrated, high-quality entertainment across multiple markets

We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories and the experience our app offers. We help our creators connect directly with their fans, building communities and fandoms to bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life and increase their engagement.

We’re a courageous and curious bunch. We recognise the value every individual brings, and respect everyone’s contribution and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility, and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for sharp elbows and big egos. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it.

We are building a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means: diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams.

You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

title: Data Center Engineer (Joyent)
description:
Position Summary

Join Our Team and Shape the Backbone of the Digital World. Are you a hands-on engineer with a passion for building and maintaining critical infrastructure? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where precision and reliability are key? We're looking for a Data Center Engineer to join our dynamic team and support the growth and operation of our global data center infrastructure.

Role and Responsibilities

How you make a difference
In this role, you'll work at the heart of our operations — combining technical expertise, on-site execution, and leadership to ensure that our data centers run flawlessly. From installing and maintaining hardware to coordinating with international vendors, you'll be an essential part of the backbone that powers our digital services. You'll also play a vital role in our daily operations, working with a ticket-based support system to resolve hardware issues, perform equipment moves, and respond to incidents within defined SLAs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform on-site operational support and execute infrastructure projects, including server relocations and hardware installations.
  • Respond to daily ticket-based requests for hands-on support, primarily hardware-related, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Relocate equipment between racks or data center locations by safely unracking, uncabling, transporting, and reinstalling hardware.
  • Address system alerts such as hardware failures (e.G. replacing failed hard drives or faulty components).
  • Install servers, network and security equipment, and structured cabling in compliance with industry standards.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain physical network components and hardware systems.
  • Coordinate with third-party vendors for the delivery and installation of racks, power systems, network gear, and structured cabling.
  • Ensure all cabling and physical installations meet organizational and industry best practices.
  • Manage inventory and liaise with suppliers and logistics partners for domestic and international shipments.
  • Document and continuously improve standard operating procedures.
  • Handle Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) with vendors for faulty equipment.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support for emergency incidents or outages.

Your team
As a Data Center Engineer, you'll join a small, experienced team of three based in the Netherlands. The other two team members have similar roles and will support you as you settle in. Your manager is based abroad.

Skills and Qualifications

What are your assets
As our new Data Center Engineer, you're technically strong and a self-starter who works well with little supervision. Your organizational and communication skills help you lead on-site and collaborate smoothly with vendors and remote teams. You're proactive, detail-oriented, and flexible with your hours, including on-call support. You ensure quality results while keeping the team running efficiently.

We also request:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience working in data centers, including working with data center and network vendors, coordinating service provisioning and equipment installations.
  • Strong hands-on experience installing and troubleshooting server hardware, network circuits, and cables, including familiarity with structured cabling standards.
  • Experience in project coordination within data center environments.
  • Experience with inventory control and remote hands coordination.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, especially complex spreadsheets and shared documentation.
  • Broad technical understanding of data center hardware, networking, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proficiency spoken and written in Dutch and English.
  • Working 5 days a week in the Data Center and the willingness to travel internationally (up to 10%).

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive compensation & benefits package to reward you for your work in supporting our company to grow. Including health insurance, 100% reimbursed by Samsung, 6% personal contribution to pension and an internet allowance of €29.42 per month.
  • Bonus system where you can earn up to 2 additional month's salary per 6 months. *
  • A position for 40 hours a week.
  • NS Business Card is included, and you're allowed to use it for personal travel as well.
  • 25 vacation days + Good Friday and the possibility to buy 5 extra vacation days.
  • Telephone from Samsung with unlimited calling and 10GB data, within the EU and a Laptop of Samsung.
  • Discount on the purchase of Samsung products via our employee portal, up to a purchase amount of €2,500 per year
  • Extensive Development, Health & Wellbeing programs (for example Samsung University, young talent & leadership programs, we have our own fitness on site (SEBN Schiphol office), we have an online mental health portal, personal gym sessions which you can join and many more because we care about your development and wellbeing).

About us

Our story begins in 1969, when Samsung saw the light of day with the ambition to help people achieve the impossible. After more than 50 years, we are still innovating and creating boundless technology that helps people make the impossible possible. We remain driven by our purpose, which is why we put people and what they care about at the center of everything we create.

We do this by staying true to our global values.

  • Human experiences (We put people first, at the center of everything we do).
  • Progressive Innovation (We are constantly finding new ways to improve the way people live by creating inventive products and services).
  • Rebellious Optimism (We challenge ourselves and the status quo to change the world).
  • Integrity & transparency (We always strive to do the right thing by being open and honest with our customers and partner ecosystem).
  • Social improvement (We believe that technology should benefit everyone. It should be accessible, sustainable and used for good).

Ready to drive innovations as our next Data Center Engineer ? Join us and make an impact, apply today!

* Please visit Samsung membership to see Privacy Policy, which defaults according to your location. You can change Country/Language at the bottom of the page. If you are European Economic Resident, please click here.

title: Technology Strategist
description:
The Technology Strategist will play a pivotal role in shaping NCS's technology vision and driving strategic initiatives that align with business objectives. This role requires a forward-thinking professional who can bridge the gap between emerging technologies and business value, enabling NCS and our clients to navigate digital transformation, AI adoption, and technological innovation in a rapidly evolving landscape.

A unique aspect of this role is the need for "bilingual" expertise—candidates who have successfully built and delivered both AI products and AI-enabled services. This dual perspective is critical as NCS evolves from a people-intensive services company toward strengthening its product offerings. The ideal candidate will bring insights from both product-centric environments (such as Big Tech firms) and service-delivery models (such as global system integrators and consulting companies), enabling them to guide NCS's strategic transformation effectively.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and clients to develop technology roadmaps, assess market trends, evaluate emerging technologies, and provide strategic recommendations that drive competitive advantage and sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product-to-Service Translation & Innovation

  • Leverage product and service delivery experience to guide NCS's evolution from a services-led to a product-enhanced organization
  • Translate product development methodologies and best practices from Big Tech environments into scalable service offerings
  • Advise on building productized AI solutions that can be deployed across multiple clients while maintaining service customization capabilities
  • Bridge the gap between rapid product innovation cycles and enterprise-grade service delivery requirements
  • Identify opportunities to package NCS's AI and digital capabilities into reusable, scalable product offerings

AI & Digital Resilience Strategy

  • Lead strategic initiatives around AI adoption and digital resilience, leveraging frameworks such as the 'AI-Digital Resilience Matrix' to assess and enhance organizational capabilities
  • Draw on experience building AI products to inform the development of NCS's AI service offerings and productized solutions
  • Provide guidance on balancing AI innovation with robust digital frameworks, including cybersecurity, data governance, infrastructure scalability, and ethical AI practices
  • Apply product thinking to service design, ensuring AI solutions are scalable, maintainable, and deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Evaluate AI systems against evolving regulations, emerging threat vectors, and transparency requirements
  • Advise on sovereign AI strategies, particularly for government and regulated sectors, ensuring compliance with frameworks like PSPF, ISM, and SOCI

Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience with demonstrated "bilingual" expertise across both AI product development and AI service delivery:

Product Experience

  • Proven track record of building, launching, and scaling AI products in Big Tech firms, product companies, or innovation-led organizations
  • Experience with product lifecycle management from ideation through to market delivery
  • Hands-on involvement in AI/ML product development, including defining product vision, roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies
  • Understanding of product metrics, user experience design, and rapid iteration methodologies

Service Delivery Experience

  • Substantial experience delivering AI-enabled services, digital transformation programs, or technology consulting in global system integrators (GSI) or management consulting firms
  • Track record of implementing enterprise-scale AI solutions for clients across multiple industries
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder service delivery programs
  • Understanding of service economics, resource management, and client relationship dynamics

Ideal Background:

  • Candidates who have worked in both Big Tech firms (e.g., Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Apple) AND global SI/consulting companies (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, Capgemini, IBM) are highly preferred *TA will have to review and refine this point for publishing
  • This combination provides the unique "bilingual" perspective needed to help NCS strengthen its product offerings while maintaining excellence in service delivery
  • Experience transitioning between product and service roles, or working in hybrid product-service organizations, is particularly valuable

Additional Experience Requirements:

  • Experience working with government, telco, or large enterprise clients preferred
  • Demonstrated experience in AI/ML, cloud technologies, digital services, or emerging technology domains
  • Experience in the Asia-Pacific region, particularly Singapore, Australia, or Greater China markets is advantageous
  • Track record of advising C-suite executives on technology strategy and digital transformation

Skills & Competencies

Product-Service Duality:

  • Ability to think in both product and service paradigms, understanding when to apply product thinking versus service customization
  • Experience balancing standardization (product approach) with customization (service approach)
  • Understanding of how to build reusable components and platforms that support both product and service delivery models

Strategic Thinking:

  • Ability to think holistically, connect technology trends to business outcomes, and develop actionable strategies
  • Capability to translate product innovation approaches into service delivery contexts and vice versa

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:

  • Strong capability to analyze complex data, identify patterns, and derive insights
  • Experience with both product analytics (user metrics, adoption, retention) and service metrics (utilization, delivery efficiency, client satisfaction)

Communication & Presentation:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to create compelling presentations and reports for diverse audiences
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both product teams and service delivery teams, bridging different organizational cultures

Stakeholder Management:

  • Proven ability to work with multiple stakeholders, build relationships, and influence decision-making
  • Experience managing stakeholder expectations in both fast-paced product environments and structured service delivery contexts

Agility & Adaptability:

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities
  • Ability to adapt approaches based on whether the context requires product velocity or service reliability

Initiative & Ownership:

  • Positive attitude with willingness to learn, take initiative, and drive results independently
  • Entrepreneurial mindset combined with enterprise delivery discipline

Collaboration:

  • Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across functions and geographies
  • Experience collaborating across product and service organizations, understanding different working styles and priorities

Why This Role Matters

This Technology Strategist position represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of NCS as we evolve our capabilities. Your "bilingual" experience in both building AI products and delivering AI services will be instrumental in:

  • Guiding NCS's transformation from a purely services-led organization to one with strong product offerings
  • Bringing product innovation velocity to our service delivery excellence
  • Helping our teams understand how to build once and deploy many times, while maintaining the customization our clients expect
  • Bridging cultural and operational differences between product and service mindsets
  • Positioning NCS competitively in a market that increasingly demands both product innovation and service reliability

Why Join NCS

  • Lead high-impact AI management consulting programs for major enterprises and public sector clients.

  • Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation.

  • Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

  • Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

  • Ensure infrastructure monitoring, security patching, endpoint protection and compliance.
  • Provide L3 support for critical network, server and infrastructure incidents.
  • Lead infrastructure upgrades, office expansions, migrations and technology-refresh projects.
  • Manage OEMs, ISPs and service providers and ensure SLA compliance.
  • Maintain IT asset records, SOPs, network diagrams and infrastructure documentation.

  • Support internal, client and information-security audits.
  • Guide infrastructure engineers and coordinate with internal stakeholders.

description:
Company description

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Philippines – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.

We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.


Job description

About the job

Reporting to the Restaurant Manager, this Associate role is responsible for attracting visitors to the stores by encouraging IKEA store visitors to stay longer and enjoy more. He/She strives towards making people smile and build trust for the IKEA store among customers, co-workers, and suppliers. He/She also provides irresistible food offers in a welcoming atmosphere that gives our customers a good reason to return.

Your assignment

  • You ensure that our customers are always in focus and strive to make them smile by supporting them with an attitude based on the IKEA values;
  • You are a good ambassador for the IKEA store in all contact with our customers and gives them a good reason to return again and again;

  • You comply with and follow internal rules, policies, and daily operational routines set by the management;
  • You execute IKEA store operations and do your part to make sure that our operations are in line with the Functional Commercial Review standards.

Qualification

Your profile

  • You are sales-driven and passionate about food and people;
  • You have experience in food management and industry and willing to learn new skills;
  • You enjoy working in a vibrant fast-paced retail environment;
  • You are service-minded and always keep the customer in focus;
  • You are flexible and open to change;
  • You are confident in approaching and talking to people in a friendly manner;
  • You take personal initiative and have good attention to details;
  • You have good communication and interpersonal skills, able to influence and collaborate with others;
  • You are computer literate, specifically in MS Office system.

More Information

This role requires flexibility in work hours, work schedule is approximately 25 hours per week on the average, depending on store operational requirements. Working on public holidays and weekends.

We offer many benefits at IKEA other than just having the opportunity to work for a global company! Along with a focus on your personal and career development goals and being a part of an inclusive culture driven by values, you will be entitled to great initiatives including Annual leave, Medical and Dental, Family & Community leave, Co-worker discount, subsidized meals in our Co-worker Restaurant, Bonus program, full training and inductions.

title: Kotisiivooja
description:
Etsimme kotisiivoojaa siivousalan asiakasyritykseemme!


Asiakasyrityksemme on turkulainen yritys, joka on erikoistunut erilaisiin kodeissa ja toimistoilla tapahtuviin siivouspalveluihin Turussa ja lähialueilla. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen luotettavaa ja monipuolista osaamista joustavasti asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Heille tyytyväinen asiakas ja laadukas työnjälki on kaiken toiminnan perustana, ja yritys pyrkiikin aina tarjoamaan asiakkailleen parhaat mahdolliset siivousratkaisut.

Työn kuvaus:

Työ sisältää pääsääntöisesti kotisiivouksia. Kotisiivoojana tehtävänäsi on siivota asiakkaan koti hänen toiveidensa mukaisesti. Tavallisten siivoustöiden lisäksi työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi myös ikkunoiden pesua. Koska työtä tehdään asiakkaiden kodeissa, olethan asiakaspalveluhenkinen, luotettava, huolellinen ja tartut töihin reippaasti. Tätä työtä ei myöskään tarvitse tehdä yksin, sillä mukana on aina työpari, jonka kanssa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä ja yhdessä varmistatte laadukkaan työn toteutumisen.

Työkohteesi sijaitsevat Turussa ja lähialueilla ja kohteiden välillä liikutaan autolla.

Työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkeen ma-pe, työtä tehdään mukavasti aamuvuorossa klo 8.00-17.00 välillä ja työtunnit viikossa noin 33-36.

Odotamme:

* Odotamme, että omaat iloisen ja reippaan asenteen työntekoon sekä aiempaa siivoustyön kokemusta ammattimaisesta siivouksesta, eduksi lasketaan nimenomaan kotisiivoustyötausta.

* Omaat liikkuvaan ja fyysiseen työhön sopivan hyvän peruskunnon sekä omatoimisen ja tehokkaan työotteen

* Sinulla on sujuva suomen kielen taito, jolla pystyt kommunikoimaan luontevasti niin asiakkaiden kuin tiimin kanssa

* Sinulta löytyy B-ajokortti ja pääset autolla kulkemaan työpaikalle

* Haluat tehdä laadukasta siivoustyötä asiakkaiden arjen helpottamiseksi ja pystyt sitoutumaan pitkäaikaiseen työhön

* Eduksi katsotaan myös mahdollisuus aloittaa nopeallakin aikataululla

Tarjoamme:

Miksi tätä työtä kannattaa hakea ja liittyä satojen tyytyväisten henkilöstöliigalaisten joukkoon?

Tarjolla on nyt mielenkiintoinen ja pitkäkestoinen työ siivousalan yrityksessä. Työtä tehdään aamuvuoroissa arkisin ja vaihtelevat vuorojen pituudet tarjoavat mukavaa joustoa arkeen. Saat tehtävään hyvän perehdytyksen ja tukenasi on totta kai myös mukava työyhteisö. Voit olla jo alalla kokemusta kartuttanut tekijä taikka vasta aloittanut, jolla on halu kehittyä alan ammattilaiseksi. Tehtävän palkkaus on kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan alkaen 12,59€/h, kokemus ja koulutus huomioiden.

Työntekijämme Henkilöstöliigalla ovat antaneet erityisesti positiivista palautetta hyvin toimivasta yhteistyöstä Henkilöstöliigan, vuokratyöntekijöiden ja asiakasyritysten välillä, joten liity sinäkin iloiseen joukkoomme!

Haku:

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Jätäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian, niin olemme kaikkiin kriteerit täyttäviin hakijoihin yhteydessä mahdollisimman pikaisesti.

Täytäthän hakemuksen ensisijaisesti kotisivuillamme www.henkilostoliiga.fi [http://www.henkilostoliiga.fi]

Valitettavasti emme pysty tietoturvasyistä käsittelemään sähköpostihakemuksia.

Henkilöstöliiga:

Henkilöstöliiga on Etelä-Suomen vahvimpia henkilöstöpalveluyrityksiä ja työllistää vuosittain yli 1000 avainpelaajaa työelämän pelikentille! Työntekijöidemme joukosta löytyy teollisuuden, logistiikan- ja kiinteistöalan osaajia, sekä toimistotyön ja palvelualan työntekijöitä. Olemme Henkilöstöalan yritysten liiton (HELA) jäsenyritys ja toimimme reilusti työelämän yhteisten pelisääntöjen mukaan. Työntekijöiltämme saamme kiitosta tasa-arvoisesta ja ystävällisestä kohtelusta sekä aktiivisesta uusien työmahdollisuuksien tarjoamisesta.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in United Arab Emirates.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

About the opportunity

The Faculty of Medicine and Health is looking for an Education Administration Officer to provide a broad range of administrative and operational support to academic and teaching staff in the delivery of the Doctor of Medicine (MD) program.

Working as part of the Westmead Clinical School team, you will support the effective coordination of teaching and learning activities, ensuring academic staff and students have access to the information, resources and administrative support required for a positive educational experience.

This position requires you to be onsite a minimum of four days per week. Hybrid working arrangements may be considered in consultation with your manager.

This is a Targeted Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Position. While we welcome applications from all candidates, this is a targeted role for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. As part of our commitment to diversity and inclusion, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates will be assessed as a priority. This Exemption is claimed under Section 21 of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • provide administrative and operational support to academic and teaching staff across the MD program.

  • support the coordination of teaching activities, including timetabling, room bookings, teaching resources and other logistical requirements.

  • assist with the preparation, coordination and distribution of academic content and teaching materials, including uploading information to Canvas and other online systems.

  • liaise with academic staff, professional staff, clinicians and other stakeholders to support the smooth delivery of teaching and learning activities.

  • support the administration of assessments, examinations and other education-related activities.

  • maintain accurate education and student information and support relevant reporting and administrative processes.

  • provide timely and professional responses to enquiries from academic staff, students and other stakeholders.

  • support accreditation and compliance requirements for relevant programs of study.

  • contribute to the review and improvement of administrative processes, systems and workflows to improve efficiency and the experience of staff and students.

  • ensure relevant University policies, procedures and legislative requirements are followed and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment.

About you

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • demonstrated experience providing high-quality administrative and operational support, ideally within a complex education, health or professional environment.

  • excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and maintain accuracy.

  • demonstrate initiative and sound judgement when managing day-to-day administrative matters and resolving issues.

  • strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with academic, professional and clinical stakeholders.

  • ability to work on multiple systems and digital platforms, with strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 and the ability to learn and use new systems effectively.

  • strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and information.

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to be eligible to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Your employment is conditional upon the successful completion of all pre-employment or background checks required for the role in terms satisfactory to the University. Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. title: Data Center Chief Engineer
description:
Job Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. AWS is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.
As the Data Center Engineering Operation (DCEO) Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site's Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
As the DCEO Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

  • Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
  • Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
  • Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
  • Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
  • If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. Work/Life Balance
When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.
Please ensure you apply with your CV in English.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

  • Experience in a data center or other critical environment
  • Experience in data center engineering or operations
  • Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • operating engineering license such as DC II, DC III, or equivalent
  • Experience in construction or project management
