title: Elintarviketyöntekijä , Toivala
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Kuopion ja Siilinjärven alueelle elintarviketyöntekijöitä. Töitä on tarjolla asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan, jopa vuoden loppuun saakka.

Etsimämme henkilö on oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen sekä ennen kaikkea ripeä ja tehokas. Työtä tehdään tiiviillä porukalla ja on tärkeää, että homma sujuu saumatta eri työvaiheissa. Töitä tehdään pääasiassa aamuvuorossa (7-16 välillä) mutta vko 29 alkaen työtä tehdään myös iltavuorossa. Alustavasti työajat 7-15 ja 14:30-22:30. Työpäivät saattavat sesongin aikana venyä, joten arvostamme joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu kalankäsittelyyn liittyvät tuotantotyöt linjastolla kuten tuoreen kalan käsittely, savustus, erilaiset valmistustehtävät sekä esimerkiksi pakkaaminen.

Työ vaatii hygieniapassin ja salmonellatodistuksen. Tarvittaessa autamme hygieniapassin hommaamisessa. Palkkaus määräytyy elintarvikealan TES mukaan.

Haethan paikkaa pian, sillä tarpeita voi tulla nopeallakin aikataululla!

title: Asiakkuusvastaava Jokilaakso
description:
Kiinnostaako sinua esihenkilörooli sekä vastuu oman vastuualueesi isännöintiasiakkuuksista?

Etsimme Kodin Isännöintiin asiakkuusvastaavaa Jokilaakson alueelle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen. Tässä roolissa vastaat sekä esihenkilötyöstä että oman vastuualueesi isännöintiasiakkuuksien kokonaisuudesta. Vastuualueeseen kuuluvat Jokilaakson toimipisteet, kuten Ylivieska, Oulainen, Haapajärvi ja Kärsämäki. Lopullinen vastuualue muodostetaan liiketoiminnan tarpeet sekä valittavan henkilön osaaminen huomioiden.



Keskeiset tehtävät

Tehtävässä toimit Jokilaakson alueen asiakkuusvastaavana. Vastaat oman tiimisi menestyksellisestä johtamisesta sekä vastuualueesi isännöintiliiketoiminnan tuloksesta, suunnittelusta ja strategian mukaisesta toteuttamisesta. Työssäsi hoidat omaa asiakassalkkua asunto- ja kiinteistöosakeyhtiöissä sekä vastaat uusien asiakkuuksien hankinnasta ja asiakassuhteiden pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä omalla alueellasi.

Toimit työssäsi ennakoivasti ja huolehdit asiakkaiden arjen sujuvuudesta, asukkaiden viihtymisestä sekä kiinteistöjen arvon ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä. Kehität toimintaa ja palveluita hyödyntäen nykyaikaisia teknologisia ja digitaalisia ratkaisuja. Raportoit tehtävässäsi isännöintiliiketoiminnan johtajalle, ja esihenkilönäsi toimii Kokkolan alueen asiakkuuspäällikkö. Tehtävässä onnistumisen tukena sinulla on ammattitaitoiset kollegat, asiakkuuspäällikkö, isännöintiliiketoiminnan johtaja sekä HR-organisaatio.



Odotamme sinulta

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää isännöintialan tuntemusta ja kokemusta. Arvostamme tehtävään soveltuvaa ITS- tai AIT-tutkintoa sekä aiempaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja valmentavasta johtamisesta. Pidät sekä asiakastyön että johtamisen tuomista mahdollisuuksista, haluat saada aikaan tuloksia ja toimit aktiivisesti, vastuullisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.

Odotamme sinulta hyviä neuvottelu- ja yhteistyötaitoja, kokonaisuuksien hallintakykyä sekä kykyä priorisoida tekemistäsi muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Johdat tiimiäsi nykyaikaisella ja laadukkaalla otteella, siedät hyvin painetta ja hallitset ajantasaiset tietotekniset taidot. Tiimin menestyksellinen johtaminen edellyttää läsnäoloa vastuualueen toimipisteissä, mutta yhdistämme työssämme sujuvasti lähi- ja etätyötä. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta ja matkustusvalmiutta.



Lisätietoja

Kokkolan asiakkuuspäällikkö Petri Heikkinen (petri.heikkinen@kodinisannointi.fi / puh. 010 7395 410) antaa mielellään lisätietoja tehtävästä ja meillä työskentelystä. Petrin tavoitat parhaiten seuraavina soittoaikoina: 26.8.2026 klo 12-14 tai 31.8.2026 klo 9-11.

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 6.9.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana, ja olemme yhteydessä sopiviin hakijoihin mahdollisimman pian. Hakijoille ilmoitetaan rekrytointiprosessin etenemisestä. Rekrytointiprosessin loppuvaiheessa hyödynnämme mahdollisesti soveltuvuusarviointia osana valintapäätöksen kokonaisarviointia. Valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot ja yritysyhteydet sekä teetetään huumausainetesti.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta!


Tarjoamme

Meillä pääset osaksi osaavaa ja kehityshaluista työyhteisöä. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja haastavan tehtävän, jossa pääset suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan isännöintiliiketoiminnan strategiaa ja luomaan yhtenäistä yrityskulttuuria, sekä valmentamaan tiimiäsi kohti parempia tuloksia. Tehtävässäsi onnistumisen tukena sinulla on ammattitaitoiset kollegasi, johtaja sekä HR-organisaatio. Panostamme henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämiseen ja koulutamme henkilöstöämme aktiivisesti. Käytössäsi ovat erinomaiset henkilöstöedut, kuten pankki- ja vakuutusedut, lounas-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietuudet, työterveyshuollon palvelut sekä laaja vakuutusturva.


Kodin Isännöinti Oy

Kodin Isännöinti Oy on OP Koti Pohjoinen Oy LKV:n omistama, turvallista ja asiantuntevaa isännöintipalvelua tarjoava yritys. Toimimme laajalla alueella Kokkolasta Kuhmoon ja Saariselälle, ja tunnemme vahvasti paikallisten asiakkaidemme tarpeet. Meille asiakas on aina keskiössä – kuuntelemme, ennakoimme ja huolehdimme, jotta arki taloyhtiöissä sujuisi mahdollisimman huolettomasti. Ammattitaitoinen henkilöstömme tekee sen, mitä on sovittu – ja usein enemmänkin. Kodin Isännöinti on toimintavarma, luotettava ja aidosti lähellä asiakasta.

Askelta edellä yhteisellä polulla!

title: Data Modeller
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, implement, and maintain conceptual, Logical and Physical data models that meet business data/process and technology requirements, by using designs and data strategies across a wide selection of platforms.

Accountabilities

  • Analysis and documentation of business requirements to translate them into data models aligned with organisational goals.
  • Development and maintenance of data dictionaries and glossaries to define data elements and their usage.
  • Analysis and monitoring of data usage patterns to identify opportunities for data optimisation and improvement, in partnership with the Data Base Administrator.
  • Strategic architecture definition and product selection.
  • Production of logical designs in relevant subject area (technical, data, operational), showing for example: processes, objects, data flows, inputs, stored data and outputs. Identifying common components.
  • Implementation of architectures and Identification, ownership and resolution of design related issues.
  • Definition and documentation of data architectures standards, principles and strategies.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a “Data Modeller " at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.

To be successful as a “Data Modeller", you should have experience with:

Basic/ Essential Qualifications:

  • Strong logical data modelling skills, including the ability to create, review and integrate enterprise-level logical data models.
  • Strong business data knowledge, including the ability to understand business concepts, definitions and requirements across different business units.
  • Strong data analysis skills, including the ability to assess data structures, identify inconsistencies.
  • Translate business data requirements into clear model content.

Desirable skillsets/ good to have:

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Finland.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer | Kanji IT

Own the Network. Solve the Hard Problems. Keep APAC Connected.

Kanji IT is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to take ownership of enterprise network operations, infrastructure, and L3 escalation across a complex APAC environment.

Based in Sydney CBD, this is a hands-on senior role for an engineer who is equally comfortable troubleshooting BGP and OSPF, diving into Linux networking, analysing packet captures, and solving complex infrastructure issues.

You’ll work as part of a follow-the-sun technical team across Sydney, Auckland, and Perth, collaborating closely with infrastructure, security, development, and support teams.

About the Role

You’ll be a key technical escalation point responsible for keeping Kanji IT’s LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data centre networks reliable, secure, and highly available.

This role combines network engineering, Linux administration, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement. You’ll have genuine ownership of the environment and the opportunity to improve how the network is designed, monitored, documented, and operated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the L3 escalation point for complex network incidents and problems
  • Operate, troubleshoot, and optimise enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data centre networks
  • Design, peer-review, implement, and validate network changes
  • Troubleshoot BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, LACP, MLAG/VPC, QoS, and policy-based routing
  • Perform packet captures, traffic analysis, and root-cause investigations
  • Manage enterprise WiFi infrastructure, including Extreme Networks controllers
  • Troubleshoot 802.1X, RADIUS, WPA2/WPA3, roaming, and guest networks
  • Administer Linux environments across CentOS and Ubuntu
  • Troubleshoot Linux networking using iproute2, nftables/iptables, tc, namespaces, bonding, bridging, and VLANs
  • Manage enterprise firewalls, VPNs, and Linux-based firewalling
  • Support network monitoring, logging, and observability platforms
  • Develop automation and tooling using Bash and Python or Go
  • Maintain accurate network architecture and operational documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, automation, performance, and support processes

About You

You’re a senior network engineer who enjoys getting into the detail and solving problems properly.

You’ll bring:

  • 5+ years’ network engineering experience, including 2+ years at senior/L3 level
  • Strong production experience with BGP and OSPF
  • Advanced Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3 troubleshooting skills
  • Strong Linux administration skills, with the ability to troubleshoot networking from the command line
  • Experience managing enterprise wireless environments
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP and network fundamentals
  • Experience with enterprise firewalls and VPNs
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Excellent documentation and incident communication skills
  • Experience with Bash and at least one scripting language such as Python, Go, Ruby, or PowerShell
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical teams

Nice to Have

  • Ansible or other network automation experience
  • Experience with Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, or similar monitoring platforms
  • CCNP, CCIE, RHCE, or relevant industry certifications
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Why Join KGIT?

  • Senior technical role with genuine ownership of the network
  • Work across a complex APAC environment
  • Sydney CBD location at 37 York Street
  • Be part of a follow-the-sun technical team across Sydney, Auckland, and Perth
  • Work closely with infrastructure, security, development, and technology leaders
  • Opportunity to drive automation and improve network reliability
  • Solve challenging technical problems across a Linux-heavy environment

If you’re a senior network engineer who likes getting to the root cause, improving systems, and taking ownership of critical infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and join Kanji IT

Kanji IT is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities.

Customer Journey Expert – Credit Risk Operations (Definition of Default)

Help improve the future of risk management at ING

Banking should empower people to focus on what matters most in their lives and businesses. At ING, we work every day to make that possible.

We're looking for a Customer Journey Expert to join our Credit Risk Operations team and help strengthen one of the bank's most important risk management processes: Definition of Default. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of credit risk, data analysis, operations, and stakeholder management while contributing to the reliability of ING's global credit portfolio.

Role Summary

As a Customer Journey Expert, you'll play a key role in improving the effectiveness of ING's default monitoring process. You will analyze client defaults, investigate data quality issues, collaborate with stakeholders across the bank, and ensure default policies are applied accurately and consistently.

You won't just monitor processes. You'll help shape them.

As part of a newly established team, you'll have the opportunity to influence operating procedures, drive process improvements, and support strategic risk initiatives that impact ING globally.

About the Team

COO Risk is responsible for managing systems, processes, tools, and data across ING's Risk domain.

You'll join a growing team focused on enhancing default monitoring capabilities, improving credit risk data quality, and providing meaningful portfolio insights to stakeholders. As one of the early members of the team, you'll help define how the function operates and evolves.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyze monthly and quarterly credit portfolio default data
  • Investigate client default cases and validate source system logic
  • Partner with Risk Management, Lending, Business, and IT teams to review findings
  • Support credit risk committees and model owners with portfolio insights
  • Coordinate recognition and remediation activities for default cases
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and prevent unnecessary defaults
  • Collaborate across front-office, middle-office, and back-office teams to strengthen risk processes
  • Contribute to improving data quality used in credit risk models and reporting

What You'll Bring

  • Experience within banking, financial services, or credit risk environments
  • Understanding of credit risk processes and lending operations
  • Strong analytical mindset with experience working with data
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience using data analysis tools
  • Exposure to SQL, SAS, Power BI, or similar tools is an advantage
  • Ability to connect business requirements with technical solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a global and multicultural environment
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a financial, business, technical, or related discipline
  • Excellent English communication skills

What We Offer

At ING, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help build and shape a new global risk operations capability
  • Work with experts across Wholesale Banking, Risk, and Technology
  • Gain exposure to global credit portfolios and risk management practices
  • Develop your data analysis, stakeholder management, and process improvement expertise
  • Work in a collaborative, diverse, and supportive environment where continuous learning is encouraged

How to Apply

Ready to help us improve the future of banking?

Click the apply button on our careers site and submit your application through Workday.

Equal Opportunity

Don't meet 100% of the qualifications? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show some candidates apply only when they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience is close to what we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Application Safety Reminder

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms. ING uses Workday as its internal recruitment system.
  • Check the sender's email carefully. Legitimate communication will always come from@ing.com and/or@myworkday.com.
  • No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it's a scam.

About ING

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Portugal.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Training Area Range (TAR) Operator
description:
Primary Location

SA - Cultana Training Area

Job Description Summary

We are growing - join our Defence division.

About the Role

We are proud to become a new Australian Department of Defence partner, offering career opportunities to support the delivery of Property and Asset Services across South Australia and the Northern Territory.

We have an opportunity available for a Defence Training Area Range Operator to join our Defence division. This will be offered as a permanent full-time position based at Cultana Training Area, approximately 385km north-west of Adelaide in SA.

About us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected.

Your next role comes with these perks:

  • Career development – we offer growth opportunities and support internal mobility. You will have access to skill enhancement through our online learning system and onsite training.

  • Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program.

  • Paid leave - parental, cultural, community service, defence, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave available.

  • Culture – we are dedicated to fostering a workplace environment that values safety, diversity and inclusion, and meaningful recognition. You will play a key role in building the culture of our new team.

About the role

You will ensure the readiness and functionality of Defence Training Areas.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Coordinating contractor tasks for the Training Area Range (e.g. land care, cleaning, waste, estate upkeep).

  • Planning, deploying, testing and recovering live fire targets with Defence Units.

  • Managing TAR gates/flags per approved firing schedules.

  • Building and repairing targets using Defence supplies.

  • Conducting non-technical inspections and supporting contractor technical checks.

  • Maintaining TAR readiness (e.g. weed control, facility upkeep).

  • Operating DART, MTR, SMR & new target systems.

  • Managing inventory, stock control & storage.

About you

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in planning, placing, testing and recovering range live fire target equipment would be highly desirable.

  • Ability to operate and maintain various target systems such as DART, MTR, and SMR.

  • Experience in inventory control, stock management, and storage maintenance.

  • Range Officer Accreditation or relevant safety training would be highly regarded.

  • Previous experience in the ADF or Defence industry would be highly regarded.

You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance.

How to apply

Please submit your interest with the apply button where you will be directed to create a profile on our system. Applications may be reviewed before the closing date, so please don’t hesitate to apply!

We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with a disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. Applications are unable to be accepted via email. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please email talent.defence@servicestream.com.au.

Department

Field Services

How to Apply

If this sounds like you apply now to the Service Stream Recruitment Team via the online application button.

title: Taloushallinnon assistentti, Suomen MediTuote Oy
description:
Suomen MediTuote Oy on terveydenhuollon, hoivan ja puhtaanapidon tuotteiden tukkuliike. Toimitamme laajan valikoiman tuotteita asiakkaille Suomen laajuisesti. Asiakaskuntaamme kuuluvat julkiset toimijat, yritykset sekä kolmannen sektorin organisaatiot. Olemme alalla tunnettuja laadukkaasta ja nopeasta palvelustamme. Työllistämme yli 50 henkilöä ja liikevaihtomme oli n.30 miljoona euroa vuonna 2025. Olemme osa Berner-konsernia. Berner on vuonna 1883 perustettu vakaa kotimainen monialakonserni, jonka liikevaihto vuonna 2025 oli noin 677,6 miljoonaa euroa.

Olisitko sinä etsimämme taloushallinnon assistentti laskutuksen ja reskontran tehtäviin?

Onko sinulla kokemusta laskutuksesta, reskontrasta tai muista taloushallinnon tehtävistä? Viihdytkö työssä, jossa tarvitaan tarkkuutta, itsenäistä otetta ja kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia myös muutostilanteissa? Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi Suomen MediTuote Oy:n taloustiimiä ja mukaan vaiheeseen, jossa taloushallinnon järjestelmiä ja toimintatapoja kehitetään aktiivisesti.

Taloushallinnon assistenttina työskentelet monipuolisissa laskutuksen, reskontran ja avustavan kirjanpidon tehtävissä. Arkeesi kuuluu muun muassa osto- ja myyntilaskujen käsittelyä, osalaskutuksia, ostolaskujen maksatusta sekä reskontran seurantaa. Lisäksi hoidat laskuihin liittyviä selvityksiä, korjauksia ja reklamaatioita sekä palautusten, liikasuoritusten ja hyvityslaskujen käsittelyä. Tehtäviisi sisältyy myös avustavia kirjanpidon tehtäviä, kuten tiliöintejä.

Työ on luonteeltaan itsenäistä, mutta et tee sitä yksin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun taloustiimin, asiakaspalvelun, kirjanpitäjän ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Perehdytyksen alkuvaiheessa työskentely tapahtuu pääosin toimistolla, mutta jatkossa tehtävässä on mahdollisuus hybridimalliin. Suomen MediTuote Oy:n uusi toimipiste sijaitsee Leppävedellä Taipaleenkadulla.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Toivomme, että sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista taloushallinnon tehtävistä. Tehtävässä menestymistä tukevat huolellinen ja tarkka työote, kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä halu ottaa vastuuta omasta tekemisestä. Alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta arvostamme vahvasti myös käytännön osaamista. Tietty koulutustausta ei siis ole edellytys, jos sinulta löytyy tehtävään sopivaa kokemusta.

Aiempi kokemus taloushallinnon ohjelmien, kuten Procountorin, käytöstä sekä ERP-järjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi. Odoo-järjestelmän osaaminen on hyödyksi, mutta sitä tärkeämpää on valmius omaksua uusia järjestelmiä ja toimintatapoja.

Organisaatiossamme käynnissä olevat järjestelmä- ja prosessimuutokset tuovat tehtävään kiinnostavan lisän. Tässä roolissa pääset halutessasi mukaan myös arjen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen. Etsimämme henkilö suhtautuu muutokseen myönteisesti ja näkee kehittämisen mahdollisuutena.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme monipuolisen määräaikaisen tehtävän kasvavassa yrityksessä osana lämminhenkistä, kannustavaa ja huumorintajuista työyhteisöä. Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen, ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi.

Palkkaus tehtävässä on 2500 €/kk. Työsuhteen toivottu aloitusajankohta on viimeistään marraskuun 2026 alussa. Kyseessä on määräaikainen sijaisuus, jonka kesto on alustavasti lokakuun 2027 loppuun. Työsuhde solmitaan Biisonin kanssa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos kiinnostuit, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 13.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonin henkilöstökonsultti Anniina Perä: anniina.pera@biisoni.fi

title: Salgsassistent til Hobbii Odense  - 6 timer - Vikariat
description:
Er du vild med garn, og drives du af at give kunderne en god oplevelse, hvor service og salg går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i vores butik!

Butikkerne er Hobbiis ansigt udadtil. Det giver et særligt ansvar, som vi er stolte af at løfte. Vi har i forvejen super flotte resultater i vores kundetilfredshed, men vi hviler ikke på laurbærerne. Vi arbejder hele tiden på at finde den perfekte balance, hvor vi yder topservice, sikrer en effektiv butiksdrift og inspirerer kunderne til de uendelige muligheder, der findes i garnverdenen🔥🧶.

En stor organisation med plads til lokal passion

Når du arbejder hos os, bliver du en del af en stor, velsmurt e-commerce-organisation. Men ude i selve butikken vil du opleve et hyggeligt fristed, hvor den fælles passion for garn og glæden ved at hjælpe kunderne er det, der driver os.

Vi vægter det kollegiale enormt højt - vi har det rigtig sjovt sammen, og vores høje trivselsmålinger taler for sig selv. Det er afgørende for os, at du er glad, når du går på arbejde.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

  • Skabe gode kundeoplevelser: Du byder kunderne velkommen og sørger for, at de får den rette hjælp og vejledning - samtidig med at du har fokus på butikkens salg og performance📊.

  • Faglig rådgivning: Du guider kunderne igennem strikke- og hækleopskrifter og hjælper dem med at vælge det helt rigtige garn🧶.

  • Butiksdrift: Du sørger for, at butikken altid er ren, ryddelig og inspirerende at gå på opdagelse i.

  • Praktiske opgaver: Vareopfyldning og diverse ad hoc-opgaver i hverdagen🤓.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er over 18 år.

  • Er aktiv inden for strik og hækling og kan rådgive kunderne ud fra dine egne erfaringer.

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice (eller salg) og ved, hvordan man håndterer forskellige kundetyper med et smil.

  • Er en udpræget holdspiller, der har lyst til at bidrage til vores gode arbejdsmiljø.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af kundekontakt og praktisk erfaring.

  • En plads i et stærkt team, hvor vi forener den klassiske garnverden med moderne trends og nye, unge strikkere🪡.

  • Løn efter gældende butiksoverenskomst.

  • Et fedt fællesskab med kollegaer, der deler din store passion for garn.

Det praktiske

Stillingen er på 6 timer om ugen frem til 31.3 2027 og vi ser gerne, at du kan starte hurtigst muligt.

Vi har ikke brug for en lang, formel ansøgning. Du skal blot uploade dit CV, og så vil du møde et par korte spørgsmål i vores ansøgningsformular, så vi kan lære dig lidt bedre at kende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Verkoopmedewerker nachtdienst (32-38 uur p/w)
description:
Jouw hart klopt voor de retail en je wilt graag actief betrokken zijn bij de verdere ontwikkeling van ons tankstation?

Onder het merk Circle K bedienen wij 400 shops op tankstations in heel Nederland. Word jij onderdeel van 's werelds toonaangevende retailer en geef samen met ons vorm aan de toekomst van het tankstation! Onze visie voor medewerkers is om samen te groeien.

Ben jij klaar om jouw carrière vooruit te helpen? Solliciteer dan bij ons!

Wat ga je doen?

Als verkoopmedewerker ben je hét gezicht van het tankstation. Jouw gastvrijheid is bij ons onmisbaar. Je bent pas tevreden wanneer de klanten met een glimlach de winkel verlaten. In deze rol heb je te maken met veel verantwoordelijkheden, zoals:

  • Het afrekenen van brandstof en winkelproducten aan de kassa.
  • Het helpen van klanten met informatie over producten en diensten.
  • Het bereiden van koffie, snacks en hartige snacks.
  • Het aanvullen en netjes houden van de winkel en het buitenterrein.
  • Het naleven van veiligheidsvoorschriften en het melden van verdachte activiteiten.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je hebt zin om te werken en bent op zoek naar een parttime dienstverband.
  • Je bent inzetbaar op onze locatie Shell Hondsiep te Haps.
  • Je zoekt een baan van minimaal 32 uur per week.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar, zowel door de weeks als in het weekend (om de week een weekenddienst).
  • Je bent bereid om nachtdiensten te werken, werktijden zijn van 22:00 tot 6:00 uur zijn.
  • Je bent gastvrij, servicegericht en vindt het leuk om met mensen een praatje te maken.
  • Je kunt voor deze functie worden gevraagd om een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG). Daarnaast worden alle kandidaten gecontroleerd in het FAD-register.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van €17,12 per uur (incl. vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van leeftijd en ervaring.

  • Een ruime keuze aan opleidingen en trainingen op het gebied van veiligheid, verkoop, voedselveiligheid en management.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,23/km vanaf 10 km.

  • Een prettige werkomgeving waarin je onderdeel bent van een gezellig team dat samen met jou de teambonussen wil behalen.

Dit is nog niet alles:

  • Jouw carrière bij Circle K kan snel groeien! We bieden diverse opleidingen en trainingen zodat je jezelf voortdurend kunt ontwikkelen. Of je nu verkoopmedewerker, assistent-manager of manager wilt worden, wij ondersteunen jouw groei.;

  • Met ons bedrijfsfitnessplan kun je tot wel 40% besparen op je abonnementskosten bij meer dan 4.000 sportlocaties. En met ons fietsplan kun je voordelig een nieuwe fiets aanschaffen.

  • Spetterende personeelsfeesten: Jaarlijks is er een spetterend personeelsfeest in een thema.

  • Incentive reizen: Je maakt kans op het winnen van een exclusieve incentive reis, in 2026 zijn we naar Parijs geweest.

  • Lunchkorting: 50% personeelskorting tijdens je dienst op een geselecteerd assortiment. Lekker!

  • Extra werken: Werk je meer uren dan de uren die we in je contract hebben afgesproken, dan worden deze uren de volgende maand uitbetaald.

Geen ervaring als verkoopmedewerker in een tankstation, maar wel gemotiveerd? Ben jij nu aan het werk als winkelmedewerker of verkoopmedewerker en ben jij op zoek naar een baan met meer zekerheid waarbij jij kan doorgroeien naar een functie als assistent-manager? Of heb jij nu een functie als productiemedewerker, zorgmedewerker of in de schoonmaak en zoek jij meer afwisseling in je werkzaamheden? Kom dan werken als verkoopmedewerker bij Circle K Nederland.

Let op! De locatie is alleen goed te bereiken met de auto en deze kun je hier gratis parkeren.

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, ADSP: Identity
description:
Amazon's Advertising Technology team builds the technology infrastructure and ad-serving systems to manage billions of advertising queries every day. The result is better quality advertising for publishers and more relevant ads for customers. Our infrastructure supports millions of Internet users and handles billions of queries per day, all delivered in milliseconds. Our data platform processes massive data sets to develop business intelligence and analytics that are critical for the efficiency and profitability of our advertising business.

As a Principal Product Manager on our Ad-Identity team, you’ll define and execute cross-functional products that power Amazon’s advertising infrastructure, serving billions of queries daily. You’ll leverage your deep expertise in digital advertising, technical product management, and business strategy to drive innovation in identity solutions that enhance ad relevance, improve publisher quality, and support Amazon’s advertising ecosystem.



Key job responsibilities
Define and execute product strategy by identifying new business opportunities, working backward from customer needs, and developing products and initiatives that scale across the advertising ecosystem

Drive continuous improvement by owning key metrics, analyzing performance data, and collaborating closely with engineering and stakeholders to optimize ad-identity solutions

Define product vision and strategy, creating a clear multi-year roadmap that guides engineering, science, and design efforts across the organization

Manage cross-functional stakeholders by balancing business needs with technical constraints, influencing priorities, and providing clarity in ambiguous situations across Amazon Advertising teams

Partner with industry leaders by engaging with ad-tech companies and industry bodies to explore collaborations and advance Amazon's position in the advertising identity space

Translate insights into product strategy, ensuring our solutions remain at the forefront of the advertising identity industry


A day in the life
As a Principal Product Manager on our ad-identity team, you'll work at the intersection of business strategy and technical innovation. Your day might include conducting customer interviews to uncover unmet needs in the advertising identity space, collaborating with engineering teams to evaluate technical feasibility of new product concepts, or presenting market insights to senior leadership to inform our roadmap priorities. You'll balance deep dives into industry trends with cross-functional planning sessions, working alongside data scientists, engineers, and business partners to move initiatives from concept to launch. You'll also engage with external ad-tech partners and industry organizations to understand emerging standards and position Amazon as a thought leader in advertising identity solutions.

About the team
Our Ad-Identity team forms the backbone of Amazon's programmatic advertising business and supports multiple teams in the advertising ecosystem. You'll join a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that leverages Amazon's scale and resources to deliver innovative solutions.

title: Growth Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Growth Associate based in Brazil.

This is an opportunity to own net-new revenue within a high-growth, technology-enabled professional services environment.
You will engage directly with founders, engineers, and individuals navigating complex immigration decisions.
The role combines consultative selling, relationship building, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution.
You will diagnose client needs, understand requirements, and help design solutions alongside cross-functional teams.
Working closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, and Legal, you will contribute to continuously improving the customer experience.
Success requires strong emotional intelligence, confidence in high-trust conversations, and a genuine advisory mindset.
This role is ideal for someone energized by building relationships, taking ownership, and delivering measurable growth.

Accountabilities:

  • Own net-new revenue generation for talent immigration clients, managing opportunities from initial engagement through conversion.
  • Engage founders, engineers, and individuals to understand their circumstances, diagnose needs, map requirements, and help architect appropriate solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with prospective clients, recognizing that immigration decisions can be complex, personal, and high-stakes.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Operations, and Legal to create a seamless client experience and improve sales and advisory processes.
  • Plan and manage accounts systematically across complex customer groups, maintaining strong organization and follow-through.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of sales and advisory methodologies through feedback, experimentation, and execution.
  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution while maintaining accountability for ambitious revenue targets.

    • Requirements:

    • 1+ years of experience in SDR, sales, business development, or another client-facing role.
    • Experience engaging individuals around complex, high-consideration decisions, ideally in areas such as legal, financial services, healthcare, or similarly consultative environments.
    • Confidence leading high-stakes and high-trust conversations with diverse audiences.
    • Strong emotional intelligence and a natural ability to establish meaningful relationships.
    • Excellent organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage cross-functional initiatives from start to finish.
    • Ability to operate strategically while remaining comfortable with detailed, hands-on execution.
    • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and motivation to achieve ambitious revenue goals.
    • Comfort working in an evolving environment where processes are continuously tested, refined, and improved.

title: Test Development Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Our team is a passionate group of professionals dedicated to accelerating innovation in high-speed optical transceiver testing. We thrive on collaboration across hardware, software, and product disciplines to ensure quality and efficiency in every phase of product ramp-up. Leveraging advanced automation and AI-driven tools, we continuously enhance test coverage and operational excellence. Together, we tackle challenges with resilience and creativity, driving improvements that directly contribute to faster time-to-market and customer satisfaction. Joining us means becoming part of a forward-thinking team that values technical expertise, problem-solving, and a commitment to delivering impactful results.

In this role, you will design, develop, and implement automated test solutions for the characterization and reliability screening of semiconductor laser dies, such as Distributed Feedback (DFB) lasers. Your primary focus will be on Light-Current-Voltage (LIV) characterization and Burn-In (BI) testing at the wafer level. You will collaborate closely with Optical Design, Reliability, and Manufacturing teams to ensure the production of high-yield, high-reliability laser components that support next-generation optical transceivers and silicon photonics products. This position plays a critical role in advancing the quality and performance of cutting-edge optical technologies through rigorous testing and cross-functional partnership.

Your Impact

  • Design, develop, and validate automated test systems （hardware and software） for laser die LIV characterization and Burn-In testing at wafer level.

  • Develop robust test software using languages such as Python, LabVIEW, C# to control optical and electrical instrumentation (SMUs, optical power meters, spectrometers, thermal controllers).

  • Design and optimize test fixtures, probe cards, and optical coupling interfaces for high-throughput, repeatable testing at wafer level.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Electric Engineering, Computer Engineering, or other relevant major.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in optoelectronic device testing, specifically with semiconductor lasers (DFB, EML, VCSEL, or Silicon Photonics).

  • Hands-on experience with optical and electrical test equipment: Source Measure Units (SMUs), Optical Spectrum Analyzers (OSAs), integrating spheres, photodetectors, and temperature controllers (TECs).

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor laser physics, optical waveguides, and reliability physics (e.g., degradation mechanisms, Arrhenius acceleration models).

  • Proven experience with LIV characterization and Burn-In (BI) system architectures.

  • Proficiency in automated test software development （specifically Python or LabVIEW）.

  • Experience with wafer probers (semi-automatic or fully automatic) and optical alignment algorithms.

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with database queries (SQL) and data visualization tools.

  • Familiarity with high-volume manufacturing (HVM) environments and test time optimization.

  • Knowledge of silicon photonics testing and grating coupler alignment techniques

title: Linux Embedded Development Expert
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Linux Kernel Systems Engineer with deep expertise in low-level OS internals, storage and memory subsystems, and the hardware/software boundary. The ideal candidate has production experience with Linux kernel subsystems such as the block/IO layer, memory management, or device drivers - and a track record of solving hard systems problems in performance-critical environments.

The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of kernel internals, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team.

The candidate should be comfortable working directly in kernel source code - reading, modifying, and contributing to kernel subsystem code - and have demonstrated experience solving complex, multi-layer system problems from application down to hardware.

A research-oriented mindset, curiosity about emerging systems technologies (tiered memory, CXL, high-bandwidth interconnects), and the ability to evaluate and integrate new approaches into a Linux kernel development workflow are essential. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tooling (code review, static analysis) is a plus, though not a prerequisite.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Linux Kernel Subsystem Work: Develop and optimize within Linux kernel subsystems - block/IO layer, memory management, device drivers, or storage stack. Engage with kernel internals at the source level, including subsystem APIs, locking models, and performance-critical paths.
  • Performance Analysis & Optimization: Profile and tune system behavior under production workloads; identify bottlenecks across the full stack from application to hardware; optimize for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
  • Complex Full-Stack Debugging: Debug hard, multi-layer system problems - from application behavior through kernel internals to hardware - using kernel tracing, hardware counters, and low-level analysis tools (ftrace, perf, eBPF).
  • Open Source Collaboration: Engage with upstream kernel and storage communities; contribute patches; participate in mailing-list design discussions; stay updated with the latest developments and best practices in the open-source ecosystem.
  • Version Control: Use Git at depth - patch series management, bisect-based debugging, and clean commit history suited for upstream submission, following kernel coding style and review conventions.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with hardware, algorithm, and platform teams. Contribute to design reviews and architectural decisions. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team meetings.
  • Independent Work: Demonstrate the ability to work independently on complex kernel projects, manage tasks efficiently, and solve problems with minimal supervision.

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on low-level systems or Linux kernel development, with at least 5 years working directly in kernel space (drivers, subsystem code, or kernel-adjacent infrastructure).
  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in C; working knowledge of C++. Comfort with kernel coding style, memory safety, and lock-ordering discipline.
  • Kernel Subsystem Depth: Demonstrated expertise in at least one major Linux kernel subsystem — memory management (reclaim, swap, page migration), block/IO layer, device drivers, or high-performance networking (DPDK/RDMA). Surface-level exposure does not qualify.
  • Storage Stack: Hands-on experience with the Linux block layer, NVMe, or storage backend technologies (SPDK, Ceph/RBD, or similar). Familiarity with IO path internals - submission queues, completion, and caching layers - is strongly preferred. This is a core requirement, not an advantage.
  • Full-Stack Debugging: Proven ability to debug complex system issues across the application→kernel→hardware boundary, including use of kernel tracing infrastructure (ftrace, perf, eBPF) or hardware-level analysis.
  • Open-Source Involvement: Proven experience engaging with the open-source kernel or storage community (upstream contributions, mailing-list participation, or public patch history).
  • Version Control: Deep Git proficiency - patch series, bisect, rebase workflows, and managing review cycles for upstream-quality commits.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively in a team environment as well as independently. Excellent communication skills to interact with cross-functional teams and contribute to discussions and documentation.

Differentiating Skills (strong plus):

  • Virtualization / Hypervisor Internals: Experience with x86 VT-x/AMD-V, KVM, IOMMU, device pass-through, or distributed SMP systems.
  • High-Bandwidth Interconnects: Familiarity with RDMA, InfiniBand, DPDK, or RoCE in storage or networking contexts.
  • Tiered Memory & Caching: Experience with CXL, DRAM/NVMe tiering, block-layer caching, or cache-tier design (OpenCAS or similar).
  • ARM Architecture: AArch64 experience including SIMD/NEON optimization or KVM stage-2 memory virtualization on ARM-based servers.
  • Upstream Kernel Contributions: Patches accepted to mainline, sustained mailing-list engagement, or subsystem maintainer interaction.
  • Academic Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering from a research-oriented institution.

title: East Area Development Program Manager
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

Employee Contract Type: Open-ended contract

Location: Based in Khentii province

Reports to Opeartions Director.

The Area Development Program (ADP) Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight of integrated development programmes across assigned geographic areas, ensuring effective programme design, implementation, monitoring, learning, and adaptive management in alignment with World Vision Mongolia’s strategy and the Future Ready Sponsorship (FRS) model. The position leads FRS implementation by strengthening sponsorship integration, community engagement, evidence-based decision-making, and programme quality through the Adaptive Programming Approach (APA). The ADP Manager oversees a multi-sectoral programme portfolio that integrates child well-being, child protection, education, livelihoods, resilience, disaster risk reduction, and GEDSI principles, while building strong partnerships with government, communities, donors, sponsors, and other stakeholders. The role provides leadership in programme management, people development, resource stewardship, and accountability, ensuring programmes remain responsive to evolving needs and contribute to sustainable outcomes for vulnerable children and communities. The position fosters cross-functional collaboration and ensures that all work reflects World Vision’s core values: Christ-centred, child-focused, and community-empowering.

20% Leadership & Strategic Management

  • Contributes to the planning and implementation of World Vision Mongolia’s East Region development programmes by co-developing and implementing issue-based projects and initiatives.
  • Manages the alignment of Child Sponsorship programming with Global Centre’s and Support offices' new strategic initiatives, including the Future Ready Sponsorship (FRS), by integrating core elements such as EWV, CP, and GEDSI, Adaptive Program Approach, Sponsorship initiatives (SI) into Area Development Program operations and planning.
  • Provides strong and positive leadership to the Area Development Program, ensuring competent and motivated staff are hired and retained, and high-performers are identified and nurtured.
  • Supports professional and personal development of Area Development Program staff, emphasizing on-the-job coaching and facilitating ongoing action learning and reflection.
  • Lead annual staff development planning for alignment with National office competency frameworks, and hold regular performance conversations in line with World Vision’s processes.
  • Serve as a role model in living out the Witness to Jesus Christ policy, demonstrating Christ-centred leadership to the ADP team.

20% Program and project management

  • Lead staff coordinating with Technical Program Coordinators in planning and implementing technical programs in the ADP and ensuring scope, quality, budget, and schedule are met as per plan
  • Lead Development Facilitators in developing Individual Plans for their Target Areas, monitor progress and inform the Operations Director on critical issues, and implement the decisions
  • Analyse Technical program and Community Engagement and Sponsorship Program guidelines, Plans, implementation processes, and progress in the Area Development Programs, and inform the Operations Director on critical issues with recommendations for collaborative decision-making with NO specialists.
  • Analyse problems of the community along with the Development Facilitator and develop plans on sustainability, crosscutting elements, disaster risk reduction, and advocacy.
  • Ensure Most Vulnerable Children assessment and mapping are done within the program area and ensure their involvement and benefit from technical project interventions/ models.
  • Conduct reflections and analyses of implementation mechanisms for developing/adopting/sharing best practices, Lessons learned, Innovations, and Changes in the Projects and Project management approaches

20% Accountability and quality assurance

  • Appropriate estimation, allocation, coordination, spending, and distribution of all program resources, including monetary resources.
  • Program effectiveness is regularly assessed and evaluated to ensure follow-up on program review/audit.
  • Promote World Vision International’s core values of stewardship throughout the Area Program and Operations areas.
  • Guide inclusive consultations (e.g., Indabas, CWB consultations), ensuring the meaningful participation of communities, especially the most vulnerable groups.
  • Apply standard WV planning tools such as the Area Development Programme Plan Template, Partnership Agreement Checklist, and context monitoring tools.
  • Lead community needs assessments, stakeholder mapping, and vulnerability analysis using templates like the DMEAL Assessment and Design Template.
  • Use real-time data to guide programming decisions; ensure frequent reviews and learning loops (e.g., Community Review and Planning meetings).
  • Child Protection Leadership: Facilitate the formation and strengthening of CP Partner Groups; ensure safeguarding systems are in place and functioning.
  • GEDSI Competency: Promote gender equality, disability inclusion, and social inclusion across all programmatic work. Apply GEDSI-sensitive analysis, inclusive planning, and risk management.
  • Empowered Worldview (EWV) Facilitation: Equip community champions and integrate faith-based empowerment activities and messaging into programme delivery.

15% Liaison/ Networking

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with major (government/private) donors and World Vision Support Offices
  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, civil society organizations, faith-based groups, and community leaders across multiple provinces to enhance programme impact, advocacy, and sustainability.
  • Effectively represent World Vision’s identity, values, and programming approach to diverse audiences, including local communities and government actors, to co-develop shared projects and foster local ownership and sustainability.
  • Assess and strengthen partners’ institutional and technical capabilities (e.g., using BUILD tools).
  • The ADP Manager leads local advocacy efforts aligned with World Vision Mongolia’s strategy, ensuring priorities like child protection, sanitation, ENOUGH, and climate resilience are integrated across programs and drive policy change.

10% Resource acquisition

  • Actively contribute to the development of new projects by sharing proven local best practices, exploring innovative methodologies, and recommending priority target areas.
  • Coordinate multi-sector and multi-funded programme planning in alignment with global models, sponsorship requirements, and donor commitments.
  • Contribute to donor engagement, resource acquisition, and fundraising efforts through proposal development, programme evidence, and knowledge sharing.

10% Reporting and Knowledge Management

  • Timely submission of Area development programs’ reports, compiling staff reports, and providing information for annual/ semi-annual reporting to the Support Office
  • Share AIM assessment results with local stakeholders annually and ensure that priority indicators requiring improvement are incorporated into annual planning and implementation for targeted action.
  • Ensure program quality through effective use of Partnership systems (e.g., iMPAQ)
  • Ensure financial reports and explanations of Technical Programs are adequately prepared and reported
  • Lead the process of continuous learning of Area development programs staff on the Adaptive Program Approach (APA), TD principles, and TD core elements such as EWV, CP, and GEDSI, program quality, humanitarian action, and development aspects.

Job description:

Job Summary:

The purpose of this position is to maintain the SEM at a high level of performance and maximum availability by performing simple repairs and the calibrations necessary for its proper operation. This role also involves developing and calibrating mineralogical databases to ensure the high quality of results delivered by the mineralogy laboratory. Finally, the role includes supporting all technical teams to foster excellence and facilitate the transfer of expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure that the person, immediate environment, team and work performed are accident/incident free
  • Compliance with internal procedures
  • Lead initiatives to streamline SEM data management workflows, including the development of SOPs to ensure data consistency, traceability, archiving, and efficient access to information

  • Initiate and lead projects to assess SEM analytical performance, including accuracy, precision, and reproducibility in order to reach international best standards
  • Development of a mineralogical database, with the goal of achieving 0% unclassified results in the Kansanshi stream analyses
  • Calibration of the databases using the chemistry lab to achieve a perfect correlation between the two analyses
  • Implement a data management system to make all data accessible and organized
  • Develop and implement improvements to enhance data quality and analytical capabilities
  • Supporting the sample preparation team to achieve an excellent polished surface
  • Training for members of the mineralogy team on how to use the microscope
  • Involvement in other projects relevant to mineralogical understanding of Kansanshi e.g. ore characterisation projects and mineralogical circuit surveys
  • Assisting plant metallurgists and operations teams to use mineralogical results for plant diagnostics that include identification of mineralogical reasons for significant fluctuations in recovery and/or grade

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical/Process/Metallurgical Engineering or Geology with demonstrable expertise in Mineralogy. Laboratory or Plant Experience in Mineral Processing and Hydrometallurgy is advantageous. Must be a member of the engineering institute of Zambia as per Act No.27 of 1992.

Experience

  • A minimum of 2 years relevant experience in a mineralogical laboratory, with a strong demonstrated knowledge of SEM.
  • Experience in data management using Microsoft applications like PowerBI and Excel
  • Excellent communication skills to handle daily discussions with peers, management, the technical team and suppliers

BEHAVIOURAL TRAITS

  • Results orientated – balance quality and quantity of work

OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Trusted Supply, Amazon Ads
description:

The Trusted Supply organization has the charter to safeguard advertiser trust and ensure high-quality ad impressions across all Amazon Advertising surfaces. We develop advanced algorithms and infrastructure systems to protect advertisers from unsafe content adjacency, low-quality inventory, fraud and privacy threats. Our scope spans a wide variety of problems in computational advertising including brand safety classification, content suitability scoring, risk hunting and proactive threat detection, viewability prediction, Made-for-Advertising (MFA) detection, malvertising identification, and privacy-preserving measurement and integration.

We are looking for an exceptional Principal Applied Scientist to define and drive the science vision across Brand Safety, Suitability, and Risk Hunting as primary areas of focus, while contributing to broader Supply Quality challenges around viewability, privacy-preserving solutions, and data leakage prevention. This is a high-visibility leadership role where your models and systems will process billions of ad impressions daily, directly impacting advertiser confidence, customer experience, and a multi-billion dollar business.

Key job responsibilities
Set the science vision — defining multi-year research directions, establishing the publication roadmap, and driving innovations

Operate across programs — influence modeling frameworks across brand safety, MFA detection, traffic quality, viewability, and 3P integrations; break down silos between science and engineering teams

Act as a thought leader — anticipate industry shifts (privacy regulations, adversarial evolution, GenAI-powered threats), propose counter-strategies before they become critical, and represent Amazon in industry forums (TAG, MRC, IAB)

Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of applied scientists and research engineers; establish a culture of scientific rigor, peer-reviewed publications, and rapid experimentation

Partner with engineering leaders to build efficient, scalable, low-latency production systems that serve models at billions-of-requests-per-day scale

Influence product and business strategy — translate science capabilities into advertiser-facing products (targeting controls, transparency reports, quality guarantees) and quantify business impact

title: WDI Show Mechanical Engineering Intern, Orlando, Spring 2027
location: Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States of America
description:
About the Role & Program

Be a part of an innovative team and culture…

Walt Disney Imagineering is the creative force that imagines, designs and brings to life all Disney theme parks, resorts, attractions and cruise ships worldwide. Working across a spectrum of disciplines that range from creative and conceptual to scientific and technical, Imagineers blend an innovative mixture of storytelling, art, science and technology to create immersive experiences, memorable destinations, and innovative entertainment for families around the globe.

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027 and will be located in Orlando, FL.

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Show Mechanical Engineering intern to join the team that helps to dream and create many of the magical moments that our guests enjoy! The Show Systems team is responsible for delivering world class Audio- Animatronic figures, show action equipment and special effects throughout their full lifecycle. We partner with various teams to help deliver quality products, and our processes and tools help to take us from concept design to production and installation.

An intern with our department focuses on mechanical engineering tasks related to the creation of animatronic figures and show action equipment, where fantastic show, lifelike performance, durability, reliability and safety are a must. We are responsible for bringing the creative intent (look, feel & sound) of our stories into physical reality. The intern will support different phases of the engineering process from concept development through final design, production, test, installation and commissioning for a variety of theme park attractions. Our diverse needs call for many areas of specialization which allow our engineers to learn and grow within the mechanical engineering realm. These areas include design engineering, machine design, mechanical analysis, advanced 3d modeling, 3d printing, production processes, material sciences, and more. Candidates are not expected to have experience in each space but should be passionate about growing their skills in these areas as they relate to themed entertainment.

We are looking for candidates who are excited to solve hard problems and grow in the mechanical sciences in service to bring the Walt Disney Company’s stories to life! As an intern on the team, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Design mechanical components under the direction of others

  • Create models and drawings in Solidworks

  • Perform calculations for machine designs such as development of loads, stress analysis, and motor and component sizing

  • Provide production support for animated figures and show action equipment

  • Support test and commissioning of animated figures and show action equipment

  • Generate drawings and engineering reports to document engineering designs

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Ability to perform basic engineering analysis and calculations

  • Possess a basic knowledge of mechanical components and manufacturing processes

  • Experience with SolidWorks or equivalent 3d modeling tools

  • Availability to work various shifts commensurate with global project requirements (typically 8am – 5 pm)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated/proven strong leadership, technical and interpersonal skills

  • Self-starter with demonstrated initiative - able to handle multiple tasks and priorities

  • Familiar with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is desired [ANSYS is preferred]

  • Familiar with mechanical system modeling tools [MATLAB or Simulink is preferred]

Education

Currently enrolled as a Junior or higher attending an ABET accredited engineering program in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Engineering Mechanics

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application posting OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Possess unrestricted work authorization

  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or program.

Additional Information

  • Able to provide reliable transportation to/from work

  • Must be fully available for the duration of the internship

  • We provide limited housing opportunities for Florida Based Professional Interns through American Campus Communities, for more information click here


The pay rate for this role in Florida is $31.00 per hour for undergraduate students and $36.00 per hour for graduate level students. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits.
