The Patient Account Resolution Specialist is responsible for resolving outstanding patient balances and supporting the overall financial health of the organization's self-pay accounts receivable portfolio. This role works directly with patients to collect outstanding balances, establish payment arrangements, answer billing questions, and provide exceptional customer service throughout the resolution process.

The Patient Account Resolution Specialist serves as a key liaison between patients, billing teams, clinic staff, and revenue cycle leadership to improve collections, reduce aging accounts receivable, and ensure patients receive accurate information regarding their financial obligations. This position plays a critical role in maximizing reimbursement while maintaining a positive patient experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Patient Account Resolution and Collections

  1. Contact patients regarding delinquent account balances through telephone, Artera, MyChart, letters, and other approved communication methods.
  2. Collect outstanding patient balances and establish payment arrangements in accordance with organizational policies.
  3. Negotiate and establish patient payment plans within approved guidelines.
  4. Monitor active payment plans and perform monthly follow-up to ensure compliance.
  5. Send patient statements, collection notices, and correspondence regarding outstanding balances.
  6. Review patient accounts and determine appropriate collection actions to improve self-pay accounts receivable performance.
  7. Maintain accurate documentation of collection activities, payment arrangements, and patient communications.
  8. Work assigned accounts receivable work queues to support collection and resolution efforts.

Customer Service and Patient Support

  1. Respond to patient billing inquiries and explain account balances, payment options, and billing information.
  2. Assist patients in understanding financial responsibilities and available payment solutions.
  3. Resolve routine patient account concerns while maintaining professionalism, empathy, and confidentiality.
  4. Assist front desk staff with patient billing inquiries and account-related questions.
  5. Assist with obtaining updated patient demographic and contact information when necessary.

Billing Support and Account Maintenance

  1. Initiate and respond to billing inquiries and requests for additional information.
  2. Perform approved write-offs, adjustments, refunds, and account corrections.
  3. Prepare itemized billing statements and supporting documentation as requested.
  4. Process medical records requests related to payer, attorney, or patient billing inquiries.

Collaboration and Communication

  1. Collaborate with Patient Account Leads, Patient Account Managers, Billing Specialists, and Revenue Cycle leadership to prioritize collection efforts.
  2. Participate in team meetings, training activities, and special projects as assigned.
  3. Communicate account concerns, trends, and process improvement opportunities to leadership

Compliance and Quality

  1. Maintain compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, HIPAA, and all applicable billing and collection regulations.
  2. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure proper handling of protected health information (PHI).

General Expectations

  1. Meet established daily, weekly, monthly, and annual productivity goals.
  2. Demonstrate initiative, ownership, and continuous effort toward improving reimbursement outcomes.
  3. Perform other duties as assigned.

Success Indicators / Key Performance Metrics

Success in this role may be measured by:

  • Self-pay AR days
  • Special program AR days
  • Collection dollars recovered
  • Payment plan compliance rates
  • Timely account follow-up activity
  • Customer service and patient satisfaction
  • Documentation accuracy

Top performers consistently demonstrate persistence in collections efforts, excellent customer service, strong communication skills, timely payment plan management, and proactive problem-solving while maintaining positive patient relationships.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Romania.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

  • Advanced analytical problem-solving capabilities, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about continuous learning, innovation, and keeping abreast of industry trends.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • Microsoft Certified: Data Scientist Associate (preferred)

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (preferred)

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals (preferred)

  • Relevant certifications or training in Machine Learning, AI development, Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing (advantageous)

Required Experience:

  • Advanced expertise in AI model development, fine-tuning, and optimization using Python and relevant frameworks.

  • Advanced demonstrated experience implementing prompt engineering methodologies and optimizing model performance.

  • Advanced demonstrated experience in API development and secure integration of AI-driven solutions with enterprise systems and platforms.

  • Advanced experience building robust data pipelines, managing structured/unstructured data, and leveraging vector databases.

  • Practical experience deploying and scaling AI applications within cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

  • Advanced demonstrated success applying DevOps and MLOps best practices to manage AI model lifecycle and deployments efficiently.

  • Advanced proven track record ensuring security, privacy, compliance, and responsible use of AI solutions within regulated environments.

  • Advanced experience engaging directly with clients and stakeholders, translating business requirements into effective technical solutions.

title: Senior Industrial Security Representative (ISR)/Contractor Program Security Officer (CPSO)
description:
The Digital Modernization Sector at Leidos is seeking a Senior Industrial Security Representative (ISR)/Contractor Program Security Officer (CPSO) supporting work in Alexandria, VA.

The ISR/CPSO is responsible for safeguarding industrial installations, resources, utilities, materials, tools, and information essential to the organization’s operations. Protects and manages classified information and equipment developed by, or entrusted to, the organization, requiring in-depth understanding of security policies, procedures, and oversight requirements for the proper classification, access, handling, storage, and destruction of classified or sensitive material. Responsible for developing, implementing and analyzing programs ensuring adherence to federal laws, regulations and directives for the classification management. Responsible for management of clearance prescreening, verification and maintenance, including upgrades or downgrades, crossovers of existing clearances, continuous vetting, and periodic reinvestigations at all clearance levels. Responsible for foreign visitor and facility access, special and restricted access programs, briefing and debriefing individuals on requirements and responsibilities of privileged access to sensitive programs. Senior levels may also include oversight of threat mitigation, including the planning, development and management of corporate asset protection programs.

The ISR/CPSO works under the guidance of the Leidos Defense & Intel IT, Business Area Security Manager in the application of Leidos security standards and practices to existing government facilities identified by the contract.

The ISR/CPSO is responsible for implementing the industrial security program and ensuring company and customer security requirements are met. The ISR/CPSO will directly support the customer and be committed to protecting classified information, assets, and secure spaces. The candidate will serve as a security team member and will directly interface and collaborate with key leaders and customers. Specifically, the candidate will safeguard all assets and information and process/manage OSS and SCIF access control requirements and visit requests. This position will provide security management and implementation of security policies and procedures within the facility. Areas of emphasis are physical security, information security, OPSEC, and verification of clearances/accesses. The ISR/CPSO will be required to interact with and provide security support to DoD officials. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

Primary Responsibilities
• Conduct ISR/CPSO duties in the following areas: Management, maintenance and accreditation preservation of Open Storage Spaces (OSS) and Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs).Processing of Prime and Sub DD254s; escorting uncleared personnel/visitors; update and maintain facility checklists; conduct routine/annual inspections; maintain databases; respond to emerging security-related issues; process outgoing visit requests and validate incoming visit requests;
• Conduct Personnel Security processing actions including requesting, reviewing, approving, and submitting clearances packages up to and including SCI nomination packages in accordance with customer requirements.
• Maintain Personnel Security databases to track new employee security clearance actions and annual security training completion status.
• Conduct security self-inspections, apply risk mitigation methodologies, support customer assessments, and implement security measures to meet requirements.
• Coordinate within Leidos with security professionals, program managers, capture managers, counterintelligence investigators.
• Coordinate with external stakeholders, such as government customers, oversight authorities (e.g., DCSA, IC SSOs and AOs), OSS & SCIF accreditation inspections.
• Document compliance activities in accordance with the governing authority approved authorization package.
• Use centralized services and databases to record clearances, incident reports, movement of personnel, visit requests, etc. to inform the collection of robust performance metrics and location of personnel around the globe.
• Ensure cleared personnel are completing and maintaining required security education and training.
• Ensure proper protection and corrective measures are taken when an incident or vulnerability is discovered.
• Conduct customer required inspections of OSS & SCIFs, upload results to customer databases.

Basic Qualifications
• Typically requires a BA degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 - 10 years of prior relevant experience. Additional years experience may be used in lieu of a degree.
• Prior experience as a Facility Security Officer and CPSO through working knowledge of the NISPOM, other relevant DoD security guidance as well as the Intelligence Community Directives (ICD) and Security Executive Agent Directives (SEADs).
• The position requires a self-motivated candidate that is capable of working in an independent or team environment with minimal direction, customer service orientated.
• Commitment to security - creating and delivering the highest value to customers.
• Ability to interpret company and government security policies and apply them to program operations.
• Strong understanding of Physical Security requirements for OSS, SCIFs, and collateral Restricted Areas. Specifically ICD 705 standards.
• Experience with and working knowledge of ICD705 Working knowledge of SF-86, SF-312, DD-254, SF700, SF702 and other required forms.
• Thorough understanding and working experience with government and corporate security databases such as NISS, DISS, eQIP and SIMS
• Thorough experience consolidating SCI nomination packages for submission to customer. Experience reviewing SF 86s, Foreign Contact Forms and other supplemental forms
• Experience creating and conducting initial security briefings, debriefings, indoctrinations, pre/post foreign travel briefings and refresher briefings, as appropriate.
• Ability to develop and establish an effective security awareness, training, and education program. Assist in executing the requirements set forth in the Technology Control Plan (TCP) for foreign visitors.
• Communicates with parties within and outside of own area, which may include external constituents depending upon the area. Requires ability to influence others outside of own area on policies, practices, and procedures.
• Candidate must possess an active TS/SCI access with a CI poly.
• Extensive experience with classified and unclassified networks and facility clearance requirements.
• Demonstratable experience communicating information security and risk-related concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills and demonstrate poise and ability to act calmly and competently in high-pressure, high-stress situations.
• Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy are a must.
• Must be able to work in a constantly changing regulatory environment with short-, mid-, and long-term timelines for remediating any non-compliance.
• Must be highly organized with excellent oral and written communication skills; excellent time management and multitasking skills.
• Must be able to proofread for accuracy, completeness, grammar, and format.
• Computer literacy: Proficient in Microsoft Suite to include Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access.
• Prior experience in Personnel and Industrial Security.
• COMSEC Custodian certificate or experience
• Must have a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Qualification
• FSO training certificate for possessing facilities from DCSA
• Industrial Security Professional (ISP) Certification or Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
• Courier preparation procedures
• Experience developing and implementing SOPs, EAPs and OPSEC plans.
• Knowledge of Access Control and Intrusion Detection Systems
• Experience conducting Security incident inquiries.
• Professional Certifications/Affiliations

description:

title: Enterprise Data Architect
description:
Leidos is seeking an Enterprise Data Architect to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of the Leidos Common Automation Platform (L-CAP). L-CAP is a mission-critical, future-ready automation platform built on a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture, enabling next-generation air traffic management capabilities. You will lead enterprise data architecture for a hybrid cloud data mesh platform supporting real-time air traffic management and next-generation aviation services. We are building with an AI-first engineering mindset, embracing emerging AI capabilities and modern development practices to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and continuously evolve how we design and build mission-critical systems. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.

This role is part of a growing program, and hiring will depend on available funding. We review applications on a rolling basis, but the timeline for interviews and offers may vary. In some cases, we may extend contingent offers that become active once funding is confirmed.

This position is located in Gaithersburg, MD; Egg Harbor Township, NJ; or Eagan, MN. This is an opportunity to contribute to projects that impact millions of air travelers.

This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days remote work. Candidates should reside a commutable distance to one of the above locations.

What You'll Do

  • Define the data mesh architecture including domain boundaries and data products

  • Establish the enterprise data governance framework and standards

  • Design real-time streaming data pipelines for operational aviation data

  • Architect event-driven data integration patterns across platform services

  • Define data product standards including contracts, quality, and discoverability

  • Develop the data integration strategy across legacy and modern systems

  • Plan and oversee legacy data migration to the new platform architecture

  • Establish data quality standards, monitoring, and remediation processes

  • Coordinate cross-ART data architecture decisions and dependencies

  • Implement metadata management and data cataloging solutions

  • Define data architecture for operational ATC data including real-time processing pipelines and low-latency data access patterns

  • Establish schema governance and data contract management ensuring interoperability across modernized and legacy services

  • Design latency management strategies for time-critical ATC data flows supporting real-time operational decisions

  • Implement data lineage tracking providing traceability from source operational systems through processing to consumption

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture by identifying and applying AI-assisted development capabilities, automation, and emerging software engineering practices that improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, and delivery.

Core Technical Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of relevant data architecture experience or 10+ years with a Master's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Enterprise data architecture leadership for large-scale platforms

  • Data mesh architecture design and implementation experience

  • Data governance framework development and enforcement

  • Event streaming expertise (Apache Kafka or equivalent) at scale

  • Real-time data pipeline design for mission-critical applications

  • Expertise across SQL and NoSQL database technologies

  • Distributed data systems architecture and performance optimization

  • Advanced data modeling for complex operational domains

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; US citizenship required; subject to government background investigation

  • Experience with real-time data processing architectures and low-latency streaming systems

  • Knowledge of operational data semantics in complex system environments

  • Experience with schema governance, data contracts, and data lineage implementation

  • ​Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust

  • U.S. citizenship required

  • Successful completion of background investigations as required by the government customer

Preferred / Desired Qualifications

  • Aviation or FAA data systems experience

  • Graph database design and implementation

  • Data lake architecture and governance

  • Master data management (MDM) strategy and tools

  • GDPR and data privacy compliance experience

  • Cloud-native data services (AWS/Azure)

  • DataOps and data pipeline automation

  • Experience with ATC or aviation operational data systems and real-time processing requirements

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns for safety-critical operational environments

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.

Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.

  • Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.

  • Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.

  • Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.

  • Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.

  • Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.

  • Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.

  • Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.

  • Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.

  • Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.

  • Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.

  • Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.

  • Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.

  • Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.

  • Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.

  • Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.

  • Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 27, 2026.

description:

    • Self-motivated and comfortable owning initiatives, working autonomously, and adapting to changing priorities.

Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid

Reporting to the Executive Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering, the Associate Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering designs, builds, and governs enterprise semantic models, ontologies, taxonomies, business vocabularies, knowledge graphs, metadata services, and semantic APIs. The role enables AI, analytics, enterprise search, interoperability, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, contextual search, and reasoning engines by embedding reusable semantic capabilities into products and workflows across Strategy, Platforms & Transformation.

The ideal location for this role is East Hanover but remote work may be possible (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. If associate is remote, all home office expenses and any travel/lodging to specific East Hanover for periodic live meetings will be at the employee’s expense. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 10% travel.

There are 2 positions available.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise semantic modeling and knowledge engineering

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, business vocabularies, and semantic models that establish consistent meaning across products, data, and AI capabilities.

• Build and enhance knowledge graphs, metadata services, and semantic APIs that support AI, analytics, enterprise applications, and commercial decision enablement.

Semantic capabilities for AI and product workflows

• Collaborate with Product, Applied AI, Analytics Engineering, and Platform Engineering teams to embed semantic capabilities into products, workflows, platforms, and reusable solution patterns.

• Support semantic foundations for RAG, agentic AI, contextual search, reasoning engines, enterprise search, analytics, and interoperability initiatives.

Metadata governance and knowledge lifecycle management

• Implement metadata governance, semantic quality controls, stewardship practices, and lifecycle management for enterprise knowledge assets.

• Promote quality, consistency, reuse, transparency, and governed evolution of semantic assets across the SPT ecosystem.

Technology evaluation and architecture evolution

• Evaluate emerging semantic technologies, standards, graph capabilities, and knowledge engineering approaches to inform the evolution of the enterprise knowledge architecture.

• Contribute reusable engineering patterns and technical guidance that reduce duplication and improve scalability across semantic and knowledge engineering work.

Technical mentorship and cross-functional collaboration

• Mentor semantic and knowledge engineers while promoting reusable engineering patterns, technical excellence, disciplined documentation, and pragmatic implementation.

• Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to product, engineering, analytics, AI, and business stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in semantic technologies, knowledge engineering, metadata management, data/information architecture, data product engineering, or AI-enabling data platforms.

Job Summary:

The Commis 1 plays an essential role in food preparation and station support across the kitchen. This is a skilled junior position suited for someone with foundational culinary training and professional kitchen experience. The Commis 1 is responsible for preparing mise-en-place, assisting in cooking, and ensuring food quality and hygiene in line with Four Seasons standards. This role is a stepping stone toward becoming a Demi Chef de Partie.

Principal Responsibilities & Essential Functions:

Food Preparation & Cooking

Prepares ingredients and cooks basic dishes under guidance. Ensures food quality, consistency, and presentation.

35%

Mise-en-Place

Completes mise-en-place for the assigned station before and during service. Ensures readiness of sauces, vegetables, garnishes, etc.

25%

Support to Station Head

Works closely with the Demi Chef or Chef de Partie to execute daily production needs efficiently.

15%

Cleaning & Maintenance

Maintains cleanliness of kitchen area, utensils, and equipment as per hygiene and HACCP guidelines.

10%

Stock Control & Storage

Helps with receiving and storing ingredients properly. Practices FIFO and maintains labelling/rotation procedures.

10%

Training & Development

Learns and refines culinary techniques under the guidance of senior chefs.

5%

Supportive Functions:

  • Supports other kitchen sections as needed during busy service periods.
  • Assists with staff meals or special events.
  • Participates in departmental meetings and training sessions.
  • Completes checklists, and basic food production logs when required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Able to stand and walk for up to 8 hours per shift.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, and move items weighing up to 20 kg.
  • Requires repetitive hand movements, bending, stooping, and working in hot, fast-paced environments.

Other Duties:

  • May be assigned to different outlets or shifts (breakfast, lunch, dinner, banquets).
  • Flexible to work shifts, weekends, holidays, overnight, during cyclone warnings and overtime based on business demands.
  • Performs any other duties as assigned by senior kitchen management to support overall kitchen operations.

Safety Requirements:

  • Adheres to all Four Seasons safety and sanitation policies.
  • Maintains personal hygiene and uses proper protective gear (gloves, hats, etc.).
  • Reports any equipment issues, injuries, or hazards immediately.
  • Practices safe knife handling, hot surface awareness, and proper lifting techniques.

Specific Job Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Solid culinary knowledge and knife skills.
  • Understanding of food hygiene and safe handling procedures.
  • Ability to follow recipes and instructions accurately.
  • Dependable, detail-oriented, and quality-driven.
  • Team-oriented with good communication and time-management skills.
  • Willingness to learn and take feedback positively.

Qualification Standards:

Education:

  • Certificate in culinary arts or food production from an accredited institution preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum 1–2 years of professional experience in a hotel, resort, or restaurant kitchen.
  • Exposure to multiple kitchen sections (garde manger, hot kitchen) is an asset.

Licenses or Certificates:

  • Food Handler’s Certificate (required).

GROOMING & UNIFORMS

All employees must maintain a neat, clean and well-groomed appearance. Specific uniform guidelines and/or required articles of clothing will be explained to you as a part of the orientation process.

NOTICE:

The hospitality business functions seven days a week, twenty-four hours a day. In addition, this is a hospitality business, and a hospitable service atmosphere must be projected at all times.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Brazil.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: RPA Developer & Support
description:
RPA Developer & Support | Kanji IT

Kanji IT Division (KGIT) is looking for a practical, hands-on RPA Developer & Support Engineer to join our Automation team in Sydney. This role is all about building reliable automation, keeping bots running in production, and delivering real business impact through UiPath.

You’ll work closely with the Automation Lead, Digital Innovation Leads, and business stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand to design, support, and continuously improve automation solutions that are stable, scalable, and cost-effective.

What you’ll do

  • Build and support UiPath automations
    Design, develop, and maintain UiPath workflows for small to mid-sized processes. Fix issues, enhance existing bots, and follow consistent development standards.
  • Work within REFramework
    Support structured automation using UiPath REFramework, including transaction handling, logging, retries, and exception management.
  • Support Document Understanding
    Work with OCR, classification, extraction, and validation workflows. Help improve accuracy using Validation Station and Action Centre.
  • Manage UiPath Orchestrator
    Handle assets, queues, triggers, deployments, and monitoring. Keep bots healthy and running as expected.
  • Production support (L1/L2)
    Monitor daily bot performance, troubleshoot failed jobs, investigate logs, and resolve issues quickly. Provide first-level support to business users and escalate when needed.
  • Improve and optimise
    Identify automation improvements, support enhancements, and contribute to post-implementation reviews focused on ROI and performance.
  • Keep documentation sharp
    Maintain runbooks, support guides, and technical documentation that actually makes sense and helps keep things running smoothly.
  • Optional Power Platform work
    Support Microsoft PowerApps development and integrations where required.

What you bring

  • Hands-on UiPath Studio experience (professional, academic, internship, or personal projects).
  • Basic understanding of UiPath Orchestrator (queues, assets, triggers).
  • Exposure to REFramework concepts.
  • Familiarity with Document Understanding.
  • Basic coding skills (VB.NET, C#, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
  • Clear communication and a willingness to learn fast.

Nice to have

  • UiPath certifications (UiRPA, Advanced Developer, DU Specialist).
  • Experience supporting bots in production.
  • SQL, APIs, or scripting exposure.
  • ERP or enterprise system experience.
  • Basic Windows server or desktop support skills.
  • Agile delivery experience.

Why this role

This is a hands-on automation role where your work actually runs in production and directly improves how the business operates. You’ll be part of a team focused on building repeatable, scalable automation that delivers measurable ROI.

title: Lead Operator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Under limited supervision of the Foreman, the Lead Operator is fully competent in all operational areas and serves as a subject-matter expert across multiple well routes. This role fills in for the Foreman during periods of PTO and acts as a key liaison with the Operations Foreman to communicate operational issues, successes, and opportunities to improve efficiency.

The Lead Operator is responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of a designated group of oil and gas wells, ensuring safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant operations while maximizing production and sales volumes. This position independently resolves most operational issues, escalating only those requiring engineering support. As the Lead Operator provides guidance, training, and best-practice leadership to less experienced Lease Operators.

This role requires the ability to coordinate, plan, and execute short- and long-term work activities to meet production and LOE goals while multitasking across multiple assignments and performing effectively under pressure.

Schedules will be assigned as needed by Foreman's, which may include OT, night & day work schedules.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the safe, efficient, and environmentally sound operation of leased equipment and production facilities.
  • Perform daily operational checks of assigned wells and production/injection facilities as scheduled.
  • Supervises well work to the level assigned by the Foreman or Operations Foreman.
  • Operate and perform advanced troubleshooting on production equipment, compressors, and standard artificial lift systems.
  • Maintain regulatory, environmental, and safety compliance in close coordination with Foreman's, Production Coordinators, and the EHS Department.
  • Support and comply with all company policies and procedures.
  • Secure, maintain, and properly utilize all company-issued equipment, including vehicles, computers, and testing/analysis equipment.
  • Capable of climbing stairs, ladders and various equipment during production and drilling operations as required.
  • Operate and maintain assigned wells to maximize profitability while ensuring safe and environmentally sound conditions.
  • Actively participate in company safety programs and initiatives.
  • Exercise authority to stop unsafe work by employees or contractors at any time.
  • Collaborate with engineering, accounting, completions, construction, EH&S, planning, land, and regulatory teams to improve operations, reduce operating expenses, implement recent technologies, and mitigate safety and environmental risks.
  • Assist the production team with maintenance, operations, field measurement, and accurate production reporting.
  • Train, mentor, and develop less experienced operators in all aspects of their responsibilities.
  • Supervise roustabouts and service crews as needed, ensuring proper work execution and adherence to procedures.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with vendors, contractors, landowners, and community stakeholders.
  • Perform and ensure completion of all required maintenance tasks using internal resources when possible, engaging contractors only when necessary.
  • Demonstrate a strong working knowledge of oil and gas production operations, including surface equipment, surface electrical systems, electronic controls, and gas flow measurement.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Work extended hours and overtime as required, in accordance with company policy.
  • Serve as a field-wide point of contact during emergencies or significant operational events.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects assigned to support departmental and company objectives.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as acting Foreman when required.
  • Mentor and train new operators, documenting performance issues, or concerns as appropriate.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for the Central Platform Group. You will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of customer-facing capabilities spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and shared cloud platforms.

You will also help build secure, reliable AI experiences that connect customers with assistants and agents across Sophos products. This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for production code, cross-team architecture, engineering quality, and technical direction.

AI-driven engineering is a core expectation for this role. You will use AI coding agents as part of day-to-day software development and help establish effective agentic workflows that improve delivery speed and quality while preserving security, human review, and engineering accountability.

Team Summary

The Central Platform Group builds the shared customer-facing capabilities at the heart of Sophos Central and Sophos Fusion. This includes web experiences, backend services, APIs, identity and access capabilities, platform integrations, and AI-powered interactions used across the Sophos portfolio.

What you will do

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of end-to-end customer-facing features across web UI, backend services, APIs, and integrations.

  • Write production code, build prototypes, review designs and code, and remain directly involved in solving the most complex engineering problems.

  • Evolve shared frontend and backend platform capabilities so product teams can deliver consistent, accessible, and maintainable customer experiences.

  • Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data contracts, integration patterns, and versioning strategies for capabilities used across multiple Sophos products.

  • Design cloud-native, multi-tenant systems for security, scalability, availability, performance, resilience, and cost efficiency.

  • Apply secure-by-design principles to authentication, authorization, role-based access, tenant isolation, privacy, auditability, and customer-data handling.

  • Build a consistent and secure experience for customers to discover and interact with AI assistants and agents across Sophos products.

  • Develop reusable AI platform capabilities for request routing, context management, tool integration, orchestration, access control, and human oversight.

title: HRIS Analyst – Workday
description:

This role will partner closely with HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation and IT teams to ensure data integrity, system efficiency, and an exceptional employee experience.
The ideal candidate will have strong Workday expertise, experience supporting HR processes and configurations, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Workday Administration & Support
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Workday support and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain Workday configurations, business processes, security roles, basic reports, and dashboards.
  • Support Workday modules including Core HCM, Absence, Compensation, Talent and Benefits as applicable.
  • Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.
  • Manage system updates, feature releases, and regression testing activities.
  • Business Process & Configuration Management
  • Configure and maintain Workday business processes, notifications, validations, and workflows.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into system solutions.
  • Support implementation of new Workday functionality and enhancements.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve HR processes and employee experiences through technology.
  • Deep, hands-on experience specifically in the Advanced Compensation module - Configure compensation matrices, merit/bonus grids, eligibility rules, and the Compensation Review business process.
  • Proficient with EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builders) for bulk data loads and complex Calculated Fields.
  • Configure & maintain security set up, specific security segments and business process permissions.

Data Integrity & Compliance:

  • Support data governance initiatives and maintain data quality standards.
  • Assist with security audits, access reviews, and compliance requirements.

Integrations & Vendor Management:
  • Support Workday integrations with third-party systems such as Payroll, Benefits, ATS, Identity Management, and Finance applications.
  • Partner with IT and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues.
  • Participate in testing and validation of inbound and outbound interfaces.

Project & Change Management:
  • Support Workday implementations, upgrades, and enhancement projects.
  • Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and deployment activities.
  • Create user guides, training materials, and process documentation.
  • Provide end-user training and support where required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 3 - 6 years of HRIS experience with at least 2 years supporting Workday.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Workday Security Administration.
  • Experience with Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, PECI, etc.).
  • Experience supporting global HR processes.

Key Competencies:

  • HR Technology & Systems Thinking
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Process Improvement
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Attention to Detail
  • Ability to handle pressure and multitask

title: Rakennussiivoojia kolmivuoroon, Lahti
description:
Etsimme rakennussiivoojia kolmivuoroon Lahteen.

Asiakkaamme etsii itsenäiseen työhön pystyviä rakennussiivoojia Lahteen työmaalle.

Työt alkaa nopealla aikataululla.

Työajat ovat: 06.00-14.00, 14.00-22.00 ja 22.00-06.00

Tehtävän kuvaus

Työssä tulet toimimaan isolla rakennustyömaalla ja tehtävässä tärkeä noudattaa työturvallisuutta. Hyvästä fyysisestä kunnosta ei ole haittaa!

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Kokemusta rakennusalalta
* Voimassa olevat ammattikortit (työturvallisuuskortti)- jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan
* Pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Päijät-Hämeessä työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Lahdesta käsin Ville, JP ja Lilli.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Päijät-Häme on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

description:
Tule tekemään kanssamme tulevaisuuden Järvenpäätä! Rakennamme sujuvaa arkea 1500 ammattilaisen voimin. Täällä kaikilla on mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittää omaa työtään. Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajille
Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajille
Erityisavustajille/avustajille
Koulunkäynninohjaajille
Iltapäivätoiminnanohjaajille
Luokanopettajille
Aineenopettajille

Palvelussuhde ja palkkaus

Noudatamme varhaiskasvatuksen ja koulunkäynninohjaajien sijaisuuksissa KVTES:iä ja opettajien sijaisuuksissa OVTES:iä. Maksamme sijaisille tuntipalkkaa sijaisen tekemien tuntien perusteella.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Vähintään 18-vuoden ikää
- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
- Oma-aloitteisuutta
- Rohkeutta
- Ryhmänhallintataitoja
- Kykyä mukautua erilaisiin työyhteisöihin ja tilanteisiin
- Halua oppia uutta

Katsomme eduksi alan koulutuksen, aiemman kokemuksen lasten ja/tai nuorten parissa työskentelemisestä sekä mahdollisuuden keikkailla säännöllisesti. Ilmoitathan pitkistä poissaoloistasi meille, sillä poistamme sijaiset, jotka eivät keikkaile aktiivisesti vähintään kuukausittain. Huomioithan, että tarjoamme sijaisuuksia arkisin klo 7-17 välisenä aikana, sekä satunnaisesti muina aikoina.

Näin haet meille:

Hae meille, kun keikkailu on sinulle ajankohtaista, koska käsittelemme hakemuksia viikoittain. Hakuprosessi etenee seuraavasti:

1) HAKEMUS

Jätä meille hakemus ja vastaa esittämiimme kysymyksiin huolellisesti. Tilaa itsellesi rikosrekisteriote täältä: [https://asiointi2.oikeus.fi/oikeusrekisterikeskus/#/](https://asiointi2.oikeus.fi/oikeusrekisterikeskus/)
Rikosrekisteritaustaote on esitettävä ennen työn aloitusta. Varhaiskasvatuksen sijaisille tehdään tuberkuloosiselvitys.

2) VIDEOHAASTATTELU

Lähetämme kutsun videohaastatteluun hakijoille työhakemuksen perusteella. Vastaa videohaastattelun kysymyksiin kuukauden sisällä haastattelukutsun saamisesta. Muuten hakemuksesi poistetaan.

3) PUHELINHAASTATTELU

Osan hakijoista kutsumme lisäksi puhelinhaastatteluun.

4) PEREHDYTYS

Videohaastattelun tai puhelinhaastattelun perusteella valitsemme osan hakijoista suorittamaan perehdytyksen.
Kun olet suorittanut perehdytyksen hyväksyttävästi ja toimittanut kaikki tarvittavat asiakirjat, saat aloittaa sijaistamisen.

Huomaathan, että poistamme hakemukset kuukauden sisällä hakemuksen jättämisestä, jos hakija ei vastaa videohaastatteluun, suorita perehdytystä ajallaan, tai toimita pyydettyjä asiakirjoja, tai jos emme saa hakijaan yhteyttä.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa Resina Sijaisvälitys resina@jarvenpaa.fi

Järvenpään kaupunki sitoutuu työnantajana edistämään työyhteisöjen monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Toivomme hakijoiksi henkilöitä erilaisilla taustoilla, kuten eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolta olevia ja eri kieli-, kulttuuri- tai vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia.

title: International Talent Programme (ITP) 2026 - Technology
description:
Ready to launch your global career and engineer the future of banking?

Step into ING's International Talent Programme (ITP) - Technology (CIO), an 18-month graduate experience designed for ambitious technology graduates who want to accelerate their careers while working on real-world challenges that impact millions of customers.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, architects, product specialists and technology leaders, solving complex problems, building innovative solutions and developing the skills needed to thrive in a fast-paced digital environment.

Your career, accelerated

Our ITP is more than a graduate program. It's an opportunity to explore different areas of technology, discover where your strengths lie and build the foundation for a successful career in engineering, platforms, data and digital innovation.

Throughout the programme, you'll complete three rotations designed to broaden your experience and accelerate your development:

  • First rotation: immerse yourself in a technology team and gain hands-on experience delivering solutions, improving systems and contributing to real projects from day one.
  • Second rotation: expand your perspective through a new challenge, with the opportunity to undertake an international assignment within ING's global technology network.
  • Third rotation: deepen your expertise by joining a different technology team, building broader capability across engineering, platforms, data, cloud or digital delivery.

Beyond your rotations, you'll contribute to strategic technology initiatives that support ING's growth and transformation, collaborate with technology professionals and fellow graduates from around the world, and receive structured learning, mentoring and coaching throughout the programme.

From modernising banking platforms and enhancing customer experiences to leveraging cloud technologies, automation, data and AI, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.

What we're looking for

We're seeking curious, driven and adaptable graduates who are passionate about technology and excited by the opportunity to learn, grow and solve meaningful problems.

You'll bring:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree completed within the last two years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Cybersecurity or a related discipline.

  • Strong academic results.

  • Up to two years' professional work experience, with demonstrated workplace experience highly valued.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to build strong relationships.

  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to challenge the status quo.

  • An interest in people, culture, leadership and the future of work.

  • A global mindset and openness to international experiences.

We'd also love to hear about any coding projects, hackathons, internships, certifications, university projects, leadership activities, volunteering or other achievements that demonstrate your potential and passion for technology.

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to complete an international rotation within ING's global network.

  • Structured learning, development, mentoring and coaching to accelerate your career growth.

  • Exposure to senior leaders, strategic projects and meaningful work from day one.

  • Access to ING's extensive learning platforms and development resources.

  • A supportive and inclusive culture where you can be yourself and thrive.

  • Competitive employee benefits, including discounted ING Health Insurance, an additional Rest Day and an IMPACT Day to support volunteering.

  • A permanent role at ING upon successful completion of the programme.

How to apply

Please include:

  • Your resume

  • Academic transcript

  • A cover letter telling us:

    • Why you're interested in the International Talent Programme

    • Why Human Resources interests you as a career

    • What sets you apart from other candidates

    • What you would bring to ING

    • Any relevant internships, work experience, leadership activities, volunteering or international exposure

Please note: Applicants must be Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents at the time of application.

Our International Talent Programme is scheduled to commence in late October 2026.

If you're ready to help create a workplace where people can grow, thrive and do their best work, apply today.

About Us

At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding - for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us, and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed - it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive, and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can do your thing.

Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values - not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace(opens in new window) where everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply

Sound like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!

(One last note: We operate using a direct talent sourcing model, so no agency introductions, please.)

title: Project Manager - Content Operations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager - Content Operations based in India.

This role is an opportunity to drive the operational excellence behind a rapidly scaling educational content ecosystem.
You will coordinate projects, documentation, publishing workflows, and cross-functional initiatives across content teams.
The position combines project management, stakeholder coordination, content operations, and quality control.
You will help ensure that hundreds of content assets move efficiently from creation through their final publishing stage.
You’ll also coordinate interns and vendors while maintaining high standards for accuracy, consistency, and platform readiness.
Working remotely, you’ll collaborate with teams across India and internationally, with occasional travel required.
The role is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who enjoys creating structure and keeping complex initiatives moving forward.

Accountabilities

  • Maintain a centralized, well-organized repository covering partner interactions, agreements, project documentation, and project statuses, ensuring continuity when team members or consultants transition.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned Jira requests, triaging and routing tickets to the appropriate Math, Science, or Localization leads and ensuring deadlines are tracked and met.
  • Own the final stage of content publishing, including video descriptions, SEO optimization, thumbnails, timestamps, and other platform-readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate interns and external vendors performing content operations tasks, providing clear direction and quality control while allowing specialist content teams to remain focused on content creation.
  • Drive cross-functional projects involving multiple teams by establishing timelines, following up on deliverables, identifying blockers, and ensuring accountability across stakeholders.
  • Maintain alignment with established platform and publishing standards as the content library scales to more than 1,300 videos.
  • Monitor project progress, surface risks and dependencies, and communicate relevant updates to stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
  • Support operational improvements that make content workflows more efficient, scalable, consistent, and resilient.
  • Maintain strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices so project context and operational decisions remain accessible to relevant teams.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated experience in project management, content operations, program coordination, publishing operations, or a similar cross-functional role.
    • Strong organizational and project-tracking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and workflows simultaneously.
    • Experience coordinating projects across teams where responsibilities and decision-making authority are distributed.
    • Strong communication and follow-up skills, with the confidence to drive accountability without direct managerial authority.
    • Experience working with project-management or ticketing tools such as Jira, along with strong proficiency in documentation and collaboration platforms.
    • High attention to detail and a strong understanding of content quality, publishing workflows, SEO, metadata, and digital content hygiene.
    • Experience managing interns, contractors, vendors, or other distributed contributors is an advantage.
    • Ability to identify process gaps, resolve operational issues, and introduce practical improvements as workflows scale.
    • Comfortable working in a remote environment with distributed and potentially international teams.
    • Proactive, dependable, adaptable, and capable of working independently while maintaining strong cross-functional collaboration.
    • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and functional stakeholders.
    • Experience in education, digital content, technology, media, or nonprofit environments would be beneficial.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary.
      • Fully remote working opportunity from within India.
      • Flexible home-based work environment.
      • Full-time, 12-month contract.
      • Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven educational organization serving millions of learners.
      • Exposure to large-scale content localization, publishing, and education technology initiatives.
      • Collaboration with diverse, cross-functional teams in India and internationally.
      • Fun team events and virtual social activities, including board game sessions.
      • Some work-related travel may be required, approximately 2–3 times per quarter.

title: Lähihoitaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Ympärivuorokautinen palveluasuminen, Turku
description:
Työskentelet Liinahaka 2:ssa, joka on osa Liinahaan ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista Vätin kaupunginosassa Turussa. Yksikkö koostuu kuudesta ryhmäkodista (Liinahaka 1 & 2), joissa kussakin asuu 12 asiakasta. Toimit viihtyisissä tiloissa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä, ja myös omalla autolla saapuminen on vaivatonta.

Arjessasi kohtaat monisairaita ikäihmisiä, jotka tarvitsevat paljon tukea päivittäisissä toiminnoissaan. Työssäsi korostuvat asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeus, arvokas elämä ja yksilöllinen hoito. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä omaisten kanssa.

Lähihoitajana toteutat itsenäisesti perushoitoa, osallistut lääkehoitoon suoritettuasi lääkeluvan sekä arvioit asiakkaan toimintakykyä ja hoidon tarvetta. Laadit hoitosuunnitelmia RAI-laatujärjestelmää hyödyntäen ja toimit aktiivisena jäsenenä moniammatillisessa tiimissä. Osallistut myös opiskelijoiden ohjaukseen. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle työn, jossa et jää yksin vaan tukenasi ovat kokeneet kollegat ja saat kattavan, yksilöllisen perehdytyksen. Pääset vaikuttamaan työvuorosuunnitteluun ja kehittämään osaamistasi monipuolisen vanhustyön parissa. Arvostamme ammatillista kehittymistä ja tarjoamme siihen mahdollisuuksia käytännön työn kautta.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta itseohjautuvaa ja vastuullista työotetta sekä kykyä toimia osana tiimiä. Innostus oppia uutta ja kehittää asukkaiden arkea on työssä tärkeää, sinulla voi olla jo kokemusta tai voit olla myös vastavalmistunut. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä hyvä suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen osaaminen.

Eduksi luemme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan (voi suorittaa myös työsuhteen aloittamisen jälkeen sovitussa määräajassa), RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen sekä työkokemuksen ikääntyneiden palveluista.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

Hae tehtävään ja tule osaksi Liinahaan arkea rakentamaan hyvää elämää ikäihmisille! Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.
