title: RN - Emergency Department, 11am-11pm
description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.

We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Job Title

RN - Emergency Department, 11am-11pm

Location

Akron

Facility

Akron General Medical Center

Department

Emergency Department-Cleveland Clinic Akron General

Job Code

AK9855

Shift

Evenings

Schedule

11:00am-11:30pm

Job Summary

Job Details

Join us at Cleveland Clinic Akron General Hospital where we have been providing world-class care to our community for over 100 years. Here, we strive for patient-centered care and comfort with our collaborative team of healthcare professionals. We are committed to serving the community and treat our patients as family.

Akron General’s Level I Emergency Department offers the technology, expertise and staffing necessary to treat all injuries, regardless of severity. As an RN in this unit, you will gain extensive hands-on experience and exposure from a fast-paced and highly trained team of caregivers. This position offers you endless opportunities to enhance your skills and grow as a nurse.

A caregiver in this position works FT, 11:00am—11:00pm.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Complete Emergency Department Assessment Data Base upon patient arrival, inclusive of psychosocial, educational and age specific needs of patient/family.

  • Complete ongoing assessments according to departmental/unit policies and recognize significant changes in patient condition.

  • Initiate an individualized plan of care based on assessment of patient needs and Emergency Department standards of care.

  • Include plan for appropriate teaching for patient/family.

  • Review individualized plan of care and goals with patient/family.

  • Review and document care and discharge goals with physician and patient/family.

  • Maintain a safe, comfortable environment for patients.

  • Accurately administer and document IVs and medications according to established standards of care and policies and procedures.

  • Appropriately intervene when changes in patient condition occur.

  • Provide individualized and timely interventions in accordance with age specific needs and Department of Nursing/hospital policy.

  • Accurately document nursing interventions and patient responses, in accordance with policy.

  • Serve as patient/family advocate to facilitate patient care, communication and resolution of problems and ethical dilemmas.

  • Evaluate current interventions and responses to plan of care.

  • Evaluate and modify plan of care as necessary, based on assessment by other disciplines and patient response to nursing interventions, established age specific standards of care/expected patient outcomes.

  • Establish priorities for delivery of patient care to individual patients and for assigned groups of patients.

  • Participate in and document discharge planning.

  • Communicate information in shift and unit reports regarding patient plan of care and current outcomes.

  • Using appropriate chain of command, communicate information in a timely fashion to the Director, physician, or Nursing Coordinator regarding changes in patient condition and patient care/unit issues.

  • Utilize research findings in clinical practice and/or participate in research activities.

  • Assign/delegate appropriate patient care activities to other nursing caregivers based on patient needs and skill level/qualifications of staff members.

  • Function in triage nurse positions according to established Emergency Department policy.

  • Care for patients and family members during emergency or crisis situations in a calm and professional manner.

  • Provide appropriate care for alleged rape/sexual assault and/or geriatric abuse victims utilizing established Emergency Department protocols.

  • Initiate appropriate community referral for patients and families.

  • Interact in a professional manner with law enforcement, paramedics and other pre-hospital care personnel.

  • Function as Flow Manager according to Emergency Department policy.

  • Assist in the orientation of RNs and other hospital personnel.

  • Participate in clinical instruction programs to provide learning experiences for students.

  • Share knowledge and expertise by participating in in-services and patient care conferences.

  • Attend unit meetings, nursing grand rounds and in-services/conferences identified or required for maintaining clinical competence.

  • Serve on committees within the Department of Nursing, participate in nursing grand rounds presentations, and remain aware of activities of shared governance councils.

  • Satisfactorily complete AGMC RN and critical care orientation programs and Critical Care course.

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Graduate from an accredited School of Nursing (ADN or BSN program)

  • Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in the State of Ohio

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross

  • Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification or ALS certification through the American Red Cross upon hire or within one year of hire

  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross upon hire or within one year of hire

  • Completion of a Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC) within one year of hire

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Nursing (BSN)

    Physical Requirements:

  • Requires full range of body motion including handling and lifting patient, manual and finger dexterity, and eye-hand coordination.
  • Requires standing and walking for extended periods of time.
  • Requires corrected vision and hearing to normal range.
  • Requires working under stressful conditions and irregular hours.
  • Exposure to communicable diseases and/or body fluids.
  • Medium Work - Exerting 20 to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Physical Demand requirements are in excess of those for Light Work.

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required

title: BPL Senior Payment Specialist
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To generate revenue and promote the bank's diverse product and service offerings to various customer segments.

Accountabilities

  • Identification of potential customers, analysing their needs and preferences, and staying abreast of emerging market trends and competitor strategies.
  • Creation of detailed profiles for target customer segments, outlining their demographics, financial habits, and pain points to tailor sales approaches and product recommendations.
  • Relationship management of potential and existing customer relations through the execution of high-quality customer support, by responding to queries and resolving issues, gaining their customer trust, and understanding their financial goals and challenges.
  • Understanding of the features, benefits, risks, and compliance requirements of various banking products and services offered. Understanding of the key features, benefits, risks, enhancements, and regulatory requirements of new and existing banking products, and communicate insights clearly to potential customers to address their financial needs.
  • Development of compelling sales pitches and proposals that showcase the value proposition of the bank's offerings to convert leads into customers, and negotiation of terms that are beneficial for both the client and the bank.
  • Collection and analysis of customer feedback on various products, services, and overall experience, to support the development of reports that communicate key findings to relevant stakeholders, to inform product development and sales strategies.
  • Monitoring of lead conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and other relevant metrics to assess sales performance and identify areas for improvement.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Senior Payments Specialist where you will play a key role in delivering our acquiring acquisition ambition within the London region. You will be responsible for generating new business within the SME segment through face-to-face client interactions. This is an exciting Sales role within a fast growing and ambitious part of our business and we are looking for a candidate that can match that ambition and bring a combination of sales skills, experience and energy to the table.

To be successful in this role you will have:

  • Extensive knowledge of the SME industry with a clear understanding of how to communicate strongly with SME customers.

  • Demonstrated success of exceeding target expectations in both volume/value of new business.

  • Demonstrable experience in self-generating new business opportunities.

  • Ability to work at a fast pace and demonstrate strong pipeline management via CRM.

  • Can deliver a quality experience to both the external customer market and satisfy internal measures/processes

  • Experience of business-to-business sales, including industry knowledge to fully understand each client's needs

  • Strategic networking and relationship building

Desirable skills include:

  • Knowledge of the SME Payments Industry – a view on Barclaycard’s position in the market alongside that of our competitors.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in London and will require you to be out seeing customers across the South East of England a minimum of 3 days per week.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years.

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

title: Senior Development Officer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Development Officer based in Canada.

This is an opportunity to lead diverse fundraising portfolios within a mission-driven organization focused on advancing equality, human rights, and meaningful social change.
You will manage relationships across individual, corporate, and foundation giving, helping strengthen long-term donor engagement and revenue growth.
The role combines relationship management, strategic communications, fundraising campaigns, stewardship, events, and planned giving.
You will work closely with senior leadership, donors, prospects, Board members, and internal teams to turn philanthropic relationships into lasting impact.
As a senior member of the Development function, you will also supervise and mentor a Development Coordinator while helping strengthen team practices and processes.
The ideal candidate is an experienced fundraiser who brings strong judgment, excellent communication skills, creativity, and exceptional organizational discipline.
This role is well suited to someone who is passionate about 2SLGBTQI rights, social justice, and building an inclusive and equitable future.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the Individual, Corporate, and Foundation Giving portfolios through strategic relationship management, prospecting, cultivation, solicitation, reporting, and stewardship.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with donors, prospects, corporate sponsors, foundations, Board members, and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute two annual digital fundraising campaigns, including campaign planning, communications, donor engagement, and performance follow-up.
  • Lead donor communications, gift processing and acknowledgment, recognition initiatives, stewardship activities, and donor-facing events.
  • Manage planned giving activities, including estate and bequest administration, prospect identification, relationship development, and planned giving marketing initiatives.
  • Develop and coordinate compelling proposals, donor reports, event/project reports, and other fundraising communications.
  • Ensure corporate sponsorship commitments and contractual obligations are fulfilled accurately and on time.
  • Conduct prospect research and identify opportunities to grow and diversify philanthropic support.
  • Maintain accurate donor information and use CRM systems and other tools to support effective relationship management and reporting.
  • Provide supervision, mentorship, advice, and direction to the Development Coordinator, helping strengthen skills, accountability, and overall team effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with the Development Director and broader team to align fundraising priorities with organizational strategy and impact.
  • Manage development projects from initiation through delivery, balancing multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and feedback channels.
  • Contribute to recognition and stewardship strategies that strengthen donor loyalty and long-term engagement.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in business, marketing, communications, education, educational technology, or a related discipline is preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.
    • 4–5 years of fundraising experience across individual giving, donor relations, philanthropy, sponsorship, planned giving, events, or related development functions, with a demonstrated record of success in relationship management, reporting, stewardship, and donor/client engagement.
    • Previous experience working in a senior development or comparable fundraising role.
    • Familiarity with the 2SLGBTQI community and related human rights issues, with a genuine commitment to advancing equality and social justice.
    • Experience in a nonprofit, 2SLGBTQI, social justice, or similarly mission-driven environment is strongly valued.
    • Understanding of intersectionality and demonstrated commitment to working within an anti-oppression and anti-racism framework.
    • Strong writing and editing abilities, with the capacity to create persuasive fundraising communications, proposals, reports, and donor correspondence.
    • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work effectively with donors, prospects, senior leaders, Board members, consultants, and colleagues.
    • Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage projects from initiation through completion.
    • Proven ability to prioritize competing demands, work independently with minimal supervision, meet time-sensitive deadlines, and remain effective under pressure.
    • Strong attention to detail and a high standard of quality across donor records, communications, reports, and administrative processes.
    • Demonstrated ability to supervise, mentor, motivate, and support colleagues while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
    • Experience with CRM software is an asset, along with proficiency in common productivity tools such as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
    • Strong judgment, adaptability, conflict-resolution skills, and the ability to respond constructively to changing priorities and feedback.
    • Lived experience as a member of the 2SLGBTQI community is an asset.
    • Bilingual English/French capabilities are an asset.
    • A valid driver’s license is an asset.
    • Ability and willingness to work flexibly, including occasional alternative hours when required by events, campaigns, or organizational priorities.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to contribute directly to fundraising initiatives supporting 2SLGBTQI equality, human rights, and social justice.
      • Meaningful senior-level responsibility across individual, corporate, and foundation giving.
      • Opportunity to build and strengthen long-term relationships with donors, foundations, corporate partners, and community stakeholders.
      • Leadership and mentorship responsibilities, including supervision and development of a Development Coordinator.
      • A collaborative, mission-driven environment where diverse perspectives and lived experiences are valued.
      • Opportunities to work closely with senior leadership, Board members, donors, and external partners.
      • Flexible working environment that accommodates changing priorities and the needs of fundraising campaigns and events.
      • Professional growth opportunities through exposure to strategic fundraising, planned giving, sponsorship, digital campaigns, and donor stewardship.
      • Commitment to an inclusive, anti-oppressive, and anti-racist workplace culture.
      • Opportunities to help shape fundraising strategies and contribute to long-term organizational sustainability.

title: Levyseppähitsaaja
description:
Marine Alutech on globaalisti johtavana tunnettu korkealaatuisten ja suorituskykyisten hyötyveneiden toimittaja. Marine Alutechilla olemme ylpeitä veneistämme. Asiakkaitamme ovat eri puolella maailmaa meriliikennettä palvelevat ja turvaavat ammattikäyttäjät, jotka käyttävät tarpeisiinsa räätälöityjä veneitämme mm. maanpuolustuksessa ja rajavartioinnissa sekä erikoistarkoituksiin kuten luotsipalveluissa, palon- ja öljyntorjunnassa sekä meripelastuksessa.

Toimintamme kasvaessa voimakkaasti tarvitsemme tiimiimme energisiä huippuosaajia. Etsimme nyt tiimimme tarkkaa ja vastuullista ammattilaista Levyseppähitsaajan tehtäviin.

Tehtävä sisältö

Levyseppähitsaajana osallistut alumiinirunkojen, kansi- ja rakenneosien valmistukseen, kokoonpanoon ja hitsaukseen osana ammattitaitoista tuotantotiimiämme. Työssäsi valmistat ja kokoonpanet alusten rakenteita sekä suoritat laadukasta MIG-hitsausta piirustusten ja työohjeiden mukaisesti. Olet keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että aluksemme valmistuvat vaativien laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä alumiini-, kone-, varustelu ja sähkötiimien kanssa sekä osallistut veneiden viimeistelyyn valmistuksen eri vaiheissa .

Tehtävässä vastaat mm.

  • rakenteiden sovittamisesta, mittaamisesta ja kokoonpanosta ennen hitsausta

  • MIG-hitsauksesta työohjeiden ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti

  • runko-, kansi- ja varusterakenteiden hitsaamisesta

  • hitsien laadun tarkastamisesta ja mahdollisten poikkeamien korjaamisesta

  • poraus-, kierteitys-, sahaus- ja muista metallin koneistustöistä

  • valmistuksessa käytettävien koneiden, laitteiden ja mittavälineiden käytöstä

  • yhteistyöstä muiden tuotantotiimien kanssa tuotannon eri vaiheissa

Työ on kokoaikainen, 40 h / viikko.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • vakituisen työpaikan kansainvälisesti tunnetussa venealan huippuyrityksessä

  • mahdollisuuden osallistua maailman vaativimpiin käyttöolosuhteisiin suunniteltujen alusten rakentamiseen

  • monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen työn modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

  • osaavan työyhteisön tuen ja hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi monipuolisissa varustelutöissä

  • kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, bonusjärjestelmän sekä henkilöstöetuina mm. liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä lounasedun

Odotamme sinulta:

  • sähkö- tai automaatioalan perustutkintoa

  • kokemusta sähköasennuksista teollisessa ympäristössä tai ajoneuvo- tai laivasähköstä

  • kykyä lukea sähköpiirustuksia ja kytkentäkaavioita

  • huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

  • hyviä yhteistyö- ja tiimityötaitoja

  • valmiutta työskennellä tarvittaessa kaksivuorotyössä

  • sitoutumista laatuun ja työturvallisuuteen

Jos sinulla on jo kokemusta hitsaustyöstä ja haluat siirtyä telakkateollisuuden pariin, sopii tehtävä sinulle erinomaisesti. Aikaisempi venealan kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä perehdytämme sinut työtehtäviisi.

Asiakasympäristömme edellyttää yrityksessämme työskenteleviltä työsuhteen alussa laadittavaa turvallisuusselvitystä.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Entain is fearlessly transforming the global racing, sports and wagering industry, creating unforgettable customer experiences and pushing beyond traditional boundaries. Part of a FTSE 50 company with nearly 30,000 employees across 30+ countries including Europe, the USA, Australia and New Zealand, Entain ANZ powers leading brands like TAB, Trackside and Ladbrokes. At Entain, our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and Finance underpins the commercial decisions that drive performance, sustainable growth, and world-class customer experiences.

Your Impact

As part of the Data Engineering team, you’ll help operate, maintain, and expand Entain’s corporate data warehouse. You’ll contribute to improving the capability, performance, reliability, and quality of the data platform.

You’ll take ownership of development tasks, identify opportunities to optimise existing processes, and actively contribute ideas that make the way we work more efficient. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you’ll deliver practical, high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment where timeliness and responsiveness are important.

This role is suited to someone who is curious, eager to learn, and motivated by the opportunity to work across a broad range of data engineering challenges.

A Day in the Life

  • Own and optimise the Snowflake data warehouse, ensuring strong performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and reliability.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver practical data solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across a variety of data sources.
  • Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Use modern engineering tools and AI-enabled practices to enhance the way we build and support data solutions.
  • Support testing frameworks, version control, and collaborative development practices.

Your Strengths

  • Strong SQL- you can write and optimize stored procedures and functions confidently.
  • Solid experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  • Data warehousing and dimensional modelling fundamentals (Kimball or similar).
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines, ideally with a tool like Matillion.
  • Comfortable working with structured and semi-structured data (JSON, XML).

Life at Entain

At Entain, it’s more than a job - it’s a place to grow, connect, and make an impact. We value individuality, celebrate collaboration, and create space for bold ideas that move people. Here, you’ll help shape the voice of some of Australia and New Zealand’s most recognised brands - while developing your own craft in a supportive, ambitious team.

Perks You’ll Love

  • Hybrid & Flexible: Balance your life and work.
  • Recognition & Rewards: Celebrate wins and enjoy retailer discounts.
  • Wellbeing Perks: Support for your health and happiness.
  • Workday Extras: Free breakfast, snacks, and onsite barista.
  • Office Vibes: Pool table, live sports, and fun social activities.

There’s nothing like it.

For more information, please reach out to us at careers@entaingroup.com.au or hit apply now.

Due to the wagering aspect of our industry, applicants must be a minimum of 18 years to apply.

title: Innovation Programmes Lead
description:
Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

This is an exciting time to join innovation and entrepreneurship at Waipapa Taumata Rau.

As Innovation Programmes Lead, you will lead CIE’s portfolio of programmes that develop innovation and entrepreneurial capability in students, researchers and staff. You will shape how people from across disciplines develop the mindsets, skills and practical capabilities to recognise opportunities, navigate uncertainty, experiment and create meaningful change.

This is a people and portfolio leadership role. You will lead a multidisciplinary team, including CIE’s Technology & Prototyping function, and bring coherence and quality across a diverse portfolio of experiential programmes, professional development and hands-on experimentation.

You will build on strong existing programmes while making informed choices about what should be strengthened, evolved, scaled, developed or retired to deliver CIE’s strategy. The focus is developing people and innovation capability at scale; CIE’s dedicated Venture & Founder Development team leads the pathway for those who choose to progress ideas into venture creation.

As a member of the CIE Leadership Team, you will also share responsibility for CIE’s overall strategy, performance, culture and organisational development.

You will:

  • Lead the strategic development, delivery and continuous improvement of CIE’s innovation and entrepreneurship programme portfolio.

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team and create the conditions for high-quality, disciplined delivery.

  • Ensure programmes provide high-quality experiential learning for diverse audiences across the University.

  • Build strong relationships with academics, practitioners and University partners, drawing on relevant expertise and leading practice.

  • Use evidence, participant insight and evaluation to inform portfolio decisions and continuously improve quality and impact.

  • Strengthen connections across programmes and with other opportunities across CIE and the wider University.

This is a full-time (37.5 hours per week), permanent role. This is a salary band I role with a salary range from $114,400 pa up to $140,000 pa depending on skills and experience.

The nature of CIE’s programmes and events means the role requires flexibility to work outside normal business hours, including evening work as required and occasional weekend work.

For more detailed information, please refer to the Position Description.

Mō tō mātou rōpū | About the team

The Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) is Waipapa Taumata Rau’s platform for developing the innovators, entrepreneurs and changemakers of the future. We work across the University to help students, researchers and staff build innovation and entrepreneurial capability, turn ideas into action, develop ventures, and create social, cultural, environmental and economic impact for Aotearoa and the world.

CIE is entering an exciting new chapter. With an ambitious new strategy, we are significantly increasing the reach and impact of innovation and entrepreneurship across the University, helping realise Waipapa Taumata Rau’s ambition to be a global powerhouse of innovation, creativity and entrepreneurship, and strengthening the University’s contribution to a more innovative and prosperous Aotearoa.

We are building a team of people who are curious, collaborative, ambitious for impact and committed to turning ambition into action. If you want to help shape how a world-class research-led university develops innovative and entrepreneurial people, we would love to hear from you.

He kōrero mōu | About you

You are an experienced people and programme leader who combines strategic thinking with exceptional planning, organisation and execution. You thrive in a fast-paced and varied environment and can lead a busy portfolio serving diverse audiences, while establishing the clarity, priorities and operating rhythm that enable your team to perform at its best.

You think ahead, anticipate dependencies and pressure points, and know how to translate strategy into a coherent portfolio of high-quality programmes and experiences. You remain close enough to delivery to understand what is working, where quality can be strengthened and when intervention is needed, while creating space for your team to lead and succeed.

You are an influential relationship builder who can work credibly with academics, University leaders, practitioners and external partners. You understand different perspectives and needs, can influence across organisational boundaries, and know how to turn opportunities and relationships into practical outcomes.

You are also a collaborative organisational leader. You bring your expertise and perspective to collective decisions, value different viewpoints and take shared responsibility for the success of CIE as a whole.

You will bring:

  • Significant experience leading innovation, entrepreneurship, learning, professional development or capability-building programmes.

  • Demonstrated success leading and developing people and building high-performing, collaborative teams.

  • Exceptional forward planning and portfolio-management capability, with experience leading multiple programmes or workstreams in complex, fast-moving environments.

  • Strong innovation and entrepreneurship capability and an understanding of experiential approaches to learning and capability development.

  • Outstanding stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the credibility to work effectively with academics, University leaders, practitioners and external partners.

  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate organisational priorities into high-quality execution, using evidence and insight to inform decisions and continuous improvement.

  • The confidence to lead a specialist Technology & Prototyping function, including appropriate oversight of physical infrastructure, health and safety and operational risk, while drawing on the technical expertise within the team.

  • Experience managing budgets, resources and operational planning.

  • A relevant tertiary qualification in innovation, entrepreneurship, business, education, management or a related field.

Experience in a tertiary education, research, innovation or entrepreneurship environment would be advantageous. An understanding of education within a research-led university context would be particularly valuable, including an appreciation of educational quality, research and scholarship, and the different contexts and motivations of students, researchers and academic staff

What we offer | Ngā āhuatanga kei a mātou

The University of Auckland is New Zealand’s leading university and maintains significant computational, laboratory and analytic facilities.

The University is committed to providing an excellent working environment through:

  • Flexible employment practices (including working from home, flexible hours)

  • Up to 6.75% company superannuation scheme

  • A competitive salary ($114,400 pa up to $140,000 pa) reflecting experience with five weeks’ annual leave

In addition, we also offer career development programmes, discounted car parking, a generous parental leave allowance, childcare, and a number of other discounts on internal and external services.

For more information, please visit Staff Benefits

Applications must be submitted online, by the closing date of Sunday 6th September, 2026 to be considered. Please include your CV and a cover letter highlighting how you meet the skills and experience outlined above, what attracts you to this opportunity, what you would bring to CIE and its leadership team, and how your experience has prepared you to lead a complex and diverse programme portfolio within a University context.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineering
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Department Description

The mission of Solutions & Builders CoE team is to build, deliver and support IDO/GDO environments for use by our Solution Engineers (SEs) and Builders here at Salesforce. These environments incorporate the latest product capabilities that Salesforce has to offer, tailored to meet the needs of specific product or industry. With these demo environments, SE’s and Builders have the tools that they need in order to deliver a best practice demo for a given product or industry and enable our SE’s to scale, innovate and provide the best product demonstrations of their careers.

Role Overview

As a Solution Developer on the Solutions CoE team, you will play an important role in building, enhancing, and supporting demo assets used by Salesforce's global Presales organization. You will use your technical and product expertise to make demo assets scalable, reliable, and deployable on demand using the Salesforce and NextGen platforms.

You will primarily align with a specific industry or product area and develop expertise in the associated business processes, Salesforce capabilities, and demo experiences. The role includes front-end and back-end development, integrations, automation, troubleshooting, and supporting the adoption of new Salesforce product capabilities.

As Salesforce continues to innovate, you will have the opportunity to work with the latest Salesforce AI capabilities and modern AI-powered development tools to improve productivity and build innovative demo experiences.

We are looking for a talented, curious, flexible, and creative developer with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for learning and working as part of a global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Align to a specific industry or product area, develop relevant domain and technical expertise, and support incoming technical requests through established support channels.

  • Deliver planned enhancements and technical improvements for assigned industry or product areas, aligned with team priorities and V2MOM objectives.

  • Review and address assigned GitHub pull requests and technical requests within established service-level expectations.

  • Communicate effectively and collaborate with stakeholders through established team channels and workflows

  • Build reusable utilities and automation that reduce manual effort, prevent common errors, and improve the reliability of demo deployments and experiences.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve demo quality, process, deployment reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency

Required skills and qualifications

  • This is a Salesforce Platform engineering role. We are looking for a 4-6 years experience developer with strong hands-on experience building solutions on the Salesforce platform, including technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, SOQL, Flows, and Salesforce platform development tool

  • Experience working with Salesforce Products like Agentforce, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics

  • Good to have experience working with Git and GitHub workflows, SFDX, Cumulus CI, CLI

  • Must have certifications - Salesforce Admin, App Builder, Platform Developer - 1

  • Experience using AI-powered developer tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools to improve development productivity, problem-solving, code quality, and automation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Strong collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams across different time zones.

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Good to have Salesforce Sales / Service / Other consultant certifications

  • Any certifications related to AI tools like Claude, Cursor, etc.

  • Good knowledge of Python

  • Bachelor of science degree (or equivalent) in computer science, engineering, or relevant field

  • Global Collaboration: Work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across different time zones, contributing to planning, technical discussions, and team priorities.

title: WDI Ride Development Engineering Intern, Spring 2027
location: Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States of America
description:
Be a part of an innovative team and culture…

Walt Disney Imagineering is the creative force that imagines, designs and brings to life all Disney theme parks, resorts, attractions and cruise ships worldwide. Working across a spectrum of disciplines that range from creative and conceptual to scientific and technical, Imagineers blend an innovative mixture of storytelling, art, science and technology to create immersive experiences, memorable destinations, and innovative entertainment for families around the globe.

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027 and will be located in Orlando, FL.

Ride Engineers build the most advanced systems that create magical and immersive attractions around the world. We work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment to develop unique experiences. The studio is comprised of Control (Software and Hardware) and Mechanical departments to accomplish that goal.

What You Will Do

As a Ride Development Engineering Intern, you will work within the WDI studio that designs and develops rides that provide memorable, moving experiences to Disney’s Guests worldwide. The intern may be involved in various project phases from concept to detailed design to testing. Although the Ride Development Engineering intern is responsible for various engineering activities, emphasis is placed on learning. Throughout the internship, the Ride Development Engineering Intern will be exposed to experts in various engineering disciplines. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Be part of an engineering team involved in ride system development, prototyping, simulation, or testing for a specific attraction or development project
  • Provide mechanical analysis of components and systems
  • Assist in the design of mechanisms and machines
  • Perform CAD model manipulation and creation!
  • Provide ride system interface information to other groups within Imagineering

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Ability to understand and implement basic mechanical system design and their associated control system elements
  • Ability to understand and adapt general engineering principles
  • Ability to prepare technical documents and CAD drawings
  • Possess basic knowledge of mechanical components and manufacturing processes
  • Proven understanding of SolidWorks and AutoCAD
  • Ability to perform basic calculations in: Statics and dynamics, Kinematics, Strength of material and Energy
  • Hands-on experience building and testing mechanisms, machines, or vehicles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of systems modeling, vibrations, and composites
  • Solid understanding of MATLAB

Education

Currently enrolled as a Junior or higher attending an accredited college/university earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace, Mechatronics, or related field

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application posting OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship
  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization
  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or program.

Additional Information

  • Able to provide reliable transportation to/from work
  • Must be fully available for the duration of the internship
  • We provide limited housing opportunities for Florida Based Professional Interns through American Campus Communities, for more information click here


The pay rate for this role in Orlando, FL is $31per hour for undergraduate students and $36 per hour for graduate level students. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits

title: Public Safety Telecommunicator
description:
CLOSES: 9/4/26

TESTING DATE: Wednesday, September 23, 2026 from 9:00-11:00 am & 1:00-5:00 pm. Carlton County Transportation Building 1630 County Road 61, Carlton, MN 55718

INTERVIEW DATE: Wednesday, September 30, 2026. Carlton County Justice Center 1780 Justice Dr, Carlton, MN 55718 - ******For those that pass the testing and move onto the next phase.*******

HEALTHCARE BENEFITS

  • Family Health Insurance - Monthly Premium of $350.58
  • Single Health Insurance - Paid in Full by Employer
  • HEALTH INSURANCE DEDUCTIBLES COVERED IN FULL WITH A VEBA ACCOUNT FUNDED BY EMPLOYER

BASIC FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform skilled communication dispatch work receiving requests for emergency assistance, determining type and level of response necessary, and dispatching the appropriate law enforcement/fire/EMS units and personnel to the incident.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Dispatch

  • Evaluate the nature of calls and text messages received, determine proper response, prioritize actions to be taken, dispatch appropriate response units, and respond to requests for information from police patrol units.
  • Utilize combination of diplomatic skills, de-escalation techniques, and policy to evaluate dynamic situations involving persons, who may include those suffering from mental health conditions, agitated persons, victims under duress, children, and persons with language barriers.
  • Operate multi-channel radio, multi-line phone system and 9-1-1 emergency phone system; respond to emergency and non-emergency calls by either handling directly, transferring to appropriate agencies, or communicating emergency telephone cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) procedures as needed.
  • Perform emergency telephone cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) procedures as needed
  • Provide pre-arrival instructions and life-saving guidance over the phone according to EMD protocols and/or procedures.
  • Monitor the computer terminal and notify the appropriate response unit with a verbal assignment based on the nature, magnitude, and degree of priority of a call.
  • Monitor status of vehicles, equipment and responders on active calls for service.
  • Provide on-going updates to responding field personnel as information is received.
  • Call for backup, medical, or support services in response to requests from field personnel.
  • Monitor radio traffic from neighboring jurisdictions and inform officers of necessary information.
  • Monitor weather conditions, watches, and warnings and communicate disaster information to appropriate personnel.
  • Receive transmitted requests for police emergency assistance and determine type and level of response necessary
  • Enter all pertinent information about the incident in the computer-aided dispatch system.
  • Maintain current information on the location, availability, and status of all police squads on duty.
  • Operate multiple computer terminals to enter and obtain information.
  • Alert appropriate supervisory personnel when units fail to clear or respond.
  • Answer questions and look up information for field personnel regarding license numbers, arrest warrant information, etc.
  • Contact emergency service organizations, public works crews, utility companies, etc. as directed or in response to the requests of field personnel and the public.
  • Notify and coordinate activities of special units such as CART, Field Force, CERT, K-9, etc. by locating on-duty and off-duty personnel and monitoring location status of the incident.
  • Monitor special events such as parades and marathons; monitor alarm systems and take appropriate action when these alarms are activated.
  • Perform call-out procedures to maintain minimum staffing levels on a work shift as assigned.
  • Manage and update key holder, common place and premise information in the computer aided dispatch database.
  • Responsible for warrant entry into local and national database by set time limits to include second party checks, verification, confirmations and clearing.
  • Responsible for OFP servicing information update to national database and updating local database with dismissal and cancellation information. Responsible for upkeep of local hard copy OFP files.
  • Maintain District Court Orders such as Domestic Abuse No Contact (DANCO) and Harassment Restraining (HRO) hard copy files and update local database with expiration and dismissal dates.
  • Send alert notifications through the county-wide emergency mass notification system for employees and the public.
    • Activate civil defense alert system when required.
    • Coordinate with cellular phone companies for cell location searches as needed.
    • Attend mandatory training and maintain required certifications; attend staff and committee meetings as assigned.
    • In the absence of 9-1-1 Administrator and/or 9-1-1 Dispatch Supervisor assume a leadership role in setting up communication resources following NIMS and ICS Principles.

Other Duties

  • Maintain the state and national computer files for Carlton County on missing persons, stolen vehicles, stolen articles and other required areas.
  • Assist in maintaining jail security by overseeing automatic door control. Monitor security camera feeds from jail, courthouse and Sheriff’s Office.
  • Operate and maintain recording equipment.
  • Maintain all required logs, records and actions taken as required by department policy on a daily basis.
  • Keep supervisor advised of operational needs.
  • Testify truthfully in court when required.
  • Assist staff in on-the-job training of new telecommunicators by instructing, monitoring, evaluating and reporting progress of trainees.
  • Perform monthly civil defense tests and weekly pager tests for all public safety departments within the County. Perform other equipment tests as needed.
  • Run, review, and interpret criminal histories and background checks as requested.
  • Operate and cooperate with other public safety agencies through shared radio channels.
  • Assign all radio Talk Groups as needed.
  • Enter/retrieve information from national, state and local computer systems.
  • Conduct 9-1-1 information sessions and tours for community groups and schools as assigned.
  • Monitor generator/building and computer backups. Implement backup procedures in a timely fashion.

title: Head of AI Architecture
description:
Head of AI Architecture

Bexhill

Full time


Posted 2 Days Ago

60013777

Hastings Direct is an agile, data and digitally focused general insurance provider to the UK market, offering a full range of car, van, bike and home insurance products. But it's our attitude and the way we run our business that makes us different.

It's a dynamic, flexible, fun and constantly changing environment, so it takes a certain kind of individual to thrive here - just ask any of our ~4700 colleagues. If you're clearly a Hastings Direct person, you'll enjoy the scope to make a real difference for our customers, influence our company, benefit the communities we work in and have some fun along the way!

About the role

As a member of the Group Architecture Leadership Team, the role contributes to enterprise-wide architecture strategy, governance, technology investment decisions, talent development and the evolution of architecture practice across Hastings Direct. The Head of AI Architecture is accountable for turning AI ambition into safe, scalable and value-led technology choices that support CIO priorities and deliver measurable value for customers, colleagues and the business. The role provides architecture leadership across CIO, business functions and technology partners, ensuring AI capabilities and solutions are aligned to business priorities and the target architecture, including effective use of Azure, Snowflake, third-party AI and SaaS-based AI capabilities.

About you

You will bring strong AI architecture expertise, senior technology leadership and the ability to turn business strategy into practical architecture direction.

  • Strategic vision and alignment: Strong track record of defining current state, target state, transition roadmaps, standards, patterns and architecture guardrails that guide AI delivery at scale using Azure, Snowflake, third-party AI and SaaS-based AI capabilities.
  • AI solution and platform architecture: Strong understanding of how AI solutions are designed, integrated, monitored and operated across enterprise platforms, including Azure, Snowflake, APIs, data pipelines, orchestration, observability, model lifecycle management and production support.
  • Generative AI and automation delivery: Experience shaping architectures for generative AI, automation, agentic AI and AI-assisted capabilities, including retrieval augmented generation, tool use, orchestration, knowledge grounding, guardrails and secure use of third-party AI services.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Ability to build strong partnerships across business, technology, delivery, data, risk, compliance and supplier teams, creating shared accountability and integrated problem-solving.
  • Change leadership: Proven ability to lead architecture in a large, complex, fast-moving organisation, balancing business ambition with risk, resilience, cost and long-term technology health.
  • Innovation and market awareness: Strong awareness of AI trends, supplier capability, architecture practices and innovation opportunities that can improve business, customer and colleague outcomes.
  • Culture and talent development: Experience building, leading, coaching and improving architecture teams, creating clear standards, strong collaboration and a high-performance culture.
  • Risk and governance oversight: Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk, privacy, explainability, auditability, human oversight, resilience, security and ethical delivery, with the judgement to apply controls pragmatically.

Regrettably we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and £6k car allowance
  • Flexible working - we champion a flexible hybrid working approach - please speak to your recruiter to discuss in more detail
  • Competitive bonus scheme - all colleagues are eligible for our annual 4Cs performance bonus
  • Physical wellbeing - as a Band 5 colleague, Hastings pay for you to receive private medical Insurance (also known as PMI). This gives you flexibility and convenience to see a specialist or consultant and allows you to decide when and where you will be seen
  • Financial wellbeing - as well as providing you with 4x your salary with our life assurance cover, income protection at no extra cost, and matched pension contributions up to 10%, we are proud to provide you with an award winning package which includes - discounts, cashback, free independent mortgage advice and free access to financial wellbeing support
  • Mental wellbeing programme - we have the thrive mental health app, our colleague assistance programme available 24/7, our own in-house mental health first aiders, support groups and a dedicated team to make sure we are covering your needs
  • There's more! - 27 days annual leave + bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell one of your weeks, access to our health care cash back plans, dental plans, discounted health assessments, Cycle to work and tech schemes, discounted and free onsite facilities, social events throughout the year and much more ….

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

  • Feedback & influence product design for the definition and implementation of new requirements/ performances
  • Plan test schedules or strategies in accordance with project scope and delivery dates

Validation Strategy

  • Definition of test cases to verify that functional and non-functional requirements are complying to system requirements
  • Identification of PASS/FAIL criteria for test cases in term of number of cycles, statistical and temperature
  • Enable shift-left efforts to move detection of failures from customer tests to internal-developed and maintained test frameworks

Test Implementation

  • Define, plan and implement a test automation strategy, to supply to the ongoing development of in-house automation frameworks/tools.

  • Monitoring of test time – Test time reduction
  • Results analysis – Bin Pareto
  • Report Generation - Report data in a clear format including concise comments about findings
  • Track document revision to provide historical reference.

Defect Management

  • Root-cause and drive failures to a closure by working with associated teams.
  • Implement systematic clear steps to reproduce failures while providing traceability to the bugs/gaps/escapes.

title: Disney Signature Experiences Pricing & Revenue Management Intern, Spring 2027
location: Celebration, Florida, United States of America
description:
About the Role & Program

Do you have a passion for learning and working in a dynamic environment? Do you want to be part of a world-class organization, learning new skills and applying your knowledge to real-world projects? Do you want to be part of incredible teams of diverse and talented professionals?

As a DSE Pricing & Revenue Management intern, you will have a wide array of responsibilities supporting the identification, measurement, and estimation of critical consumer demand trends that drive performance. If you enjoy analyzing and working with numbers, this is the role for you!

This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the Orlando, FL area from January 2027 – June 2027.

What You Will Do

Disney Signature Experiences Pricing and Revenue Management is responsible for pricing, yield management, and inventory control for Disney Cruise Line and Disney Vacation Club. Whether implementing yield management strategies in Disney Cruise Line’s reservation system or using data analysis and industry research to explore opportunities for future vacation experiences, interns can expect to develop their skills in analytics and business strategy while making meaningful contributions to Disney Signature Experience’s revenue goals.

  • Researching incremental revenue opportunities and presenting insightful recommendations to leadership.

  • Analyzing historical pricing and booking data.

  • Completing ad hoc projects and data analysis to assist in achieving short- & long-term revenue goals.

  • Researching and reporting on industry news and pricing.

  • Supporting Analysts with inventory management and/or pricing implementation.

  • Monitoring reports and developing reporting for various teams.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Demonstrated Excel and PowerPoint proficiency.

  • Able to communicate effectively across different environments (in-person, video, written).

  • Curiosity about using data to answer questions and communicate recommendations, with a desire to develop skills in a variety of data tools (SQL, VBA, Tableau, and/or Python).

  • Self-motivated and detail oriented, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.

  • Demonstrated creativity in solving complex data analysis problems.

  • Desire to learn more about Disney Signature Experiences and the travel industry.

Preferred Qualification

  • Familiarity with SQL, VBA, Tableau, and/or Python.

  • Experience working with large data sets.

  • General knowledge or previous experience in the Cruise, Airline or Travel & Tourism industry.

  • Disney College Program or Internship Alumni.

Education

  • Junior or Senior year preferred.

  • Major or previous coursework in Data Analytics, Finance/Accounting, Statistics, Math, Economics, Computer Science/Information Technology, Industrial Engineering or related major preferred.

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.

Additional Information

  • This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the Orlando, FL area from January 2027 – June 2027.

title: Director of PMO, Transformation & Strategic Delivery
description:
Minor Hotels Australasia is looking for an experienced and strategic Director of PMO, Transformation & Strategic Delivery to join our Brisbane City Head Office.

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this senior leadership position will play a key role in shaping how Minor Hotels Australasia delivers strategic initiatives, transformation programs and enterprise-wide projects, ensuring our priorities translate into measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

Working closely with the Executive Committee, Senior Operational Leaders and Corporate Services, this role oversees the strategic project portfolio and drive operational transformation, business readiness and deliver excellence across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Lead and evolve the Minor Hotels Australasia PMO, establishing enterprise-wide project governance, delivery standards and portfolio disciplines.
  • Own the strategic project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are prioritised, aligned to business strategy and appropriately resourced.
  • Lead the delivery of strategic projects, transformation programs and enterprise initiatives from initiation through to implementation.
  • Establish consistent project management frameworks, methodologies, tools and reporting standards across the organisation
  • Chair portfolio governance forums, driving effective decision-making, prioritisation and accountability.
  • Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, resource constraints and competing business priorities, while providing clear recommendations to the senior leadership team.
  • Provide executive reporting, insights and decision support on portfolio performance, delivery risks and strategic priorities.
  • Drive cross-functional operational transformation, process improvement, cost-efficiency and productivity initiatives across the hotel portfolio.
  • Identify operational barriers and partner with leaders to redesign processes and implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Lead business readiness and change governance for major strategic initiatives, system implementations and enterprise change programs.
  • Support operational planning and readiness for new hotel openings and major operational initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted adviser to the Chief Operating Officer and Senior Leaders on enterprise delivery, transformation and execution risk.
  • Influence outcomes across a complex matrix environment, driving accountability and delivery without relying solely on direct reporting authority

To be successful you will require the following experience:

  • Significant experience leading a PMO, strategic delivery, transformation and/or enterprise project portfolio function within a complex organisation.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale projects, programs and cross-functional transformation initiatives from strategy through to implementation.
  • Strong commercial and strategic acumen, with the ability to translate organisational priorities into practical delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing project governance frameworks, methodologies, reporting standards and portfolio management disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of business transformation, operational improvement, change management and benefits realisation.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with Executive and Senior Leadership teams.
  • Highly developed analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capability, with strong attention to risk, dependencies and business impact.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence within a complex, matrixed environment and bring diverse stakeholders together around common outcomes.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Business, Project Management, Transformation, Commerce or a related discipline will be highly regarded

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys turning organisational priorities into successful delivery outcomes. We are looking for someone who can build capability, bring structure to complex initiatives, influence at an executive level and drive meaningful transformation across a dynamic hospitality organisation.

At Minor Hotels, we value our people as the heart of our success. Joining Minor means, you’ll enjoy a rewarding package designed to support your professional growth, wellbeing, and work-life balance:

  • Banking and Insurance: Exclusive health insurance offers and workplace banking benefits.
  • Generous Leave: Parental and birthday leave.
  • Wellness Boost: EAP and tailored wellness support.

Our people drive the success of our business; We are a dynamic organisation dedicated to delivering exceptional guest experiences. We invest in your skills and foster a workplace culture that celebrates innovation, collaboration, and personal growth.

Currently, we are only accepting applications from candidates who have working rights within Australia or New Zealand.

title: Head of Growth
description:
About Fetch

Fetch is how modern pet parents give their pets the best care. One pink app 🩷 for insurance, health and care.

We’ve raised our Series A from Lightspeed and Airtree, we’re rated 4.9⭐️ on Google, #1 by CHOICE, and we’re growing fast.

Now we’re turning Australia’s fastest-growing pet insurance brand into Australia’s most-loved consumer pet health brand.

The role

We’re looking for an exceptional Head of Growth to own how Fetch grows: the strategy, system, and team.

This is a senior player-coach role across acquisition, conversion, lifecycle, referrals, partnerships, website, and new channels. Your job is to build the engine that gets Fetch in front of every pet parent in Australia - in ways that are creative and clever.

Growth has to feel like Fetch: crafted, warm, fun, trustworthy, and a little bit magic. The ad, the website, the landing page, the first 30 seconds in-app, the referral loop all matter.

  • Location: Sydney, hybrid, 3–4 days in office

  • Employment type: Full time

  • Compensation: Series A salary and equity

  • Working with: Reports to a co-founder and leads a small growth team. We’re flat, fast and care about the best idea.

What you’ll build and own

  • A growth engine that compounds: weekly testing rhythms across creative, paid, website, product, and lifecycle

  • A website and funnel that converts: thoughtful, clever, personal

  • New growth routes: vets, breeders, rescues, partnerships, community, and channels no one else in the category is trying

  • A scalable paid engine: Meta, TikTok, Google etc. with unit economics that hold as spend grows

  • An AI-native testing system: agents and workflows that test creative, landing pages, offers, and lifecycle ideas every week

  • A small team: hired, coached, and led by you

  • A clear view of what’s working: CAC, LTV, payback, conversion, retention

About you

You’ve scaled something before to hundreds of thousands of people, and you have the ambition and drive to make it happen again at Fetch.

This might look like:

  • 5+ years in growth, ideally in a venture-backed consumer business

  • Ownership across growth strategy, budget, team, and targets

  • Experience building a creative or growth-testing operation

  • Strong understanding of CAC, LTV, payback, cohorts, and conversion

  • Good judgement across copy, design, websites, landing pages, offers, and customer experience

  • A sharp eye for creative that works on Meta, TikTok etc.

Nice to have: subscription, referral, product-led growth, you don’t need insurtech or fintech experience!

You’ll probably love this role if:

  • You’re super ambitious and want to grow very fast!

  • You’re all in on AI

  • You’re optimistic and ambitious, and you make people around you want to go harder

  • You’re clever and creative, and come up with ideas others don’t

  • You care about tiny details that make a brand loved

  • You love pets 💗

You probably won’t love this role if:

  • You want a big team, big agency roster and distance from the work

  • You need perfect data, briefs or structure before moving

  • You’re uncomfortable being challenged, or think people should stay in their lane

  • You think growth is just numbers

What it’s like here

  • The Fetch team vibe is ambitious, smart, hard-working, thoughtful, and kind.

  • You’ll be involved early in strategy, with room to debate ideas with founders and the team

  • You’ll work on a product genuinely loved by pet parents, vets and the broader pet community

  • We’re growing fast, and you’ll directly shape the future of Fetch

Perks

  • Competitive Series A salary + meaningful equity

  • Hybrid working (3 days Sydney office, flexible WFH)

  • Latest MacBook Pro and a top setup

  • Two team retreats each year

  • Office dogs for cuddles and interruptions

  • Bean to cup coffee machine, unlimited fruit and snacks. Toblerone on-tap

  • Inclusive parental leave policy

  • 5 weeks annual leave

How to apply

Apply via the link. Attach your CV and anything that shows your work.

Tell us your 2–3 best achievements, the metrics, and the specific role you played in each.

title: Tontti-insinööri
description:

Haemme maankäytön palveluyksikköön tontti-insinööriä toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen.

Tontti-insinöörin tärkeimmät työtehtävät ovat omakotitonttien myynti ja vuokraus sekä siihen liittyvä asiakaspalvelu, neuvottelut ja luovutuspäätösten valmistelu. Tontti-insinöörin tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4119,01 euroa/kk, jonka lisäksi maksetaan mahdolliseen työkokemukseen perustuvaa ammattialalisää. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta.

Kelpoisuusehtona on maanmittausalan tai muun soveltuvan alan amk-insinöörin tutkinto tai sitä vastaava aiempi tutkinto tai muu soveltuva korkeampi koulutus.

Eduksi luetaan kokemus kuntien kiinteistötekniikan ja sopimusjuridiikan osaamisesta tai vahva työkokemus kiinteistökaupoista. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kokemusta rekisteri- ja paikkatieto-ohjelmista. Edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Meet the Team

Become part of Cisco's Product Operation team under Global Supply chain org —a high visible group dedicated to driving excellence in hardware programs. You will work closely with key hardware engineers within the Business Unit, as well as external suppliers, Global Strategic Management (GSM), and Supply Chain Finance. This collaborative environment is essential to ensuring that cost savings and gross margin performance expectations are met and fully aligned with our broader Business Unit strategy.

Your Impact

As a Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM), you will serve as the primary driver for supply chain readiness, total cost management, and BOM resiliency for all hardware programs from pre-concept through First Hardware Ship (FHS), holding accountability for the assigned product portfolio’s total cost and margin management, cost reduction programs, and risk mitigation.

As a SCPM you will validate the integrity of costed BOMs and forward costing to articulate main cost drivers, support standard and gross margin management through value engineering, commodity analysis, and BOM optimization, and lead ramp plans to ensure continuity of material supply and delivery between prototype and early production phases.

You will be Working with:

  • External Partners: EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) and other supply chain partners.

  • Bachelor’s Engineering degree and 5–7+ years of professional experience in Supply Chain and Cost Management or an equivalent field.
  • Cost Management Expertise: Proven experience with cost avoidance, cost reduction, and value engineering.
  • BOM Proficiency: Deep expertise in understanding, analyzing, and managing product Bills of Material (BOM) and costing structures.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong capability in root cause analysis and complex problem-solving within a technical environment.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Effective communication and interpersonal skills required to collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams in an interactive, global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Manufacturing Excellence: Experience in manufacturing and process improvements to drive cost-down and lead-time improvements.
  • Systems Knowledge: Knowledge of PLM processes and experience with the Agile or similar PDM system.
  • Analytical & Presentation Skills: Advanced analytical capabilities and strong presentation skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Organizational Skills: Efficient organizational and multi-tasking abilities to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.
  • Industry Trends: Knowledge and application of industry innovations and trends as they relate to product or program development.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
