title: Sr SQL Administrator
description:
The Senior SQL Administrator is responsible for the administration, performance, availability, security, recoverability, and integrity of enterprise database platforms across on-premises and cloud-based environments. This position designs, implements, monitors, optimizes, and supports highly available database platforms used by businesses, manufacturing, quality, reporting, integration, and infrastructure systems.


Serving as a database subject matter expert, the Sr. SQL Database Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Applications, Security, Quality, and business teams to maintain stable, secure, scalable, and compliant database services across on-premises and cloud environments.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

Database Operations, Availability & Performance:
• Manage the day-to-day operations of enterprise database platforms, including configuration, maintenance, patching, backups, restores, performance, security, and capacity.
• Administer, maintain, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server environments across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud-hosted platforms.
• Monitor database health, performance, job execution, storage utilization, blocking, deadlocks, replication, availability groups, and backup success.
• Perform database performance tuning, including query analysis, indexing strategy, execution plan review, statistics maintenance, wait analysis, and resource optimization.
• Implement and support high availability and disaster recovery solutions, including SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, clustering, log shipping, replication, backups, and restore testing.
• Plan and execute database maintenance activities, including index maintenance, integrity checks, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
• Support database capacity planning, storage forecasting, performance baselining, and scalability planning for business-critical systems.
• Provide after hours on-call support on a rotation schedule with other staff members.

Security, Access Control & Data Integrity:
• Maintain database security controls, including authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, role-based permissions, encryption, auditing, and privileged access review.
• Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support secure database connectivity, certificate use, service accounts, firewall rules, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
• Protect the integrity of enterprise data through routine DBCC checks, backup validation, restore testing, change review, and controlled release practices.
• Review and support database changes, schema updates, stored procedures, SQL Agent jobs, integrations, and application releases to reduce operational risk.
• Maintain database inventory, configuration standards, operational documentation, recovery procedures, and support runbooks.

Troubleshooting, Automation & Continuous Improvement:
• Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex database incidents, performance degradation, failed jobs, restore issues, connectivity problems, and application-impacting database events.
• Develop and maintain automation for database maintenance, monitoring, alerting, reporting, backup validation, user access review, and operational support activities.
• Create tools, dashboards, procedures, and documentation to support IT, Applications Development, Client Support, Quality, and business teams.
• Recommend database design, configuration, indexing, monitoring, security, and resiliency improvements to strengthen performance, reliability, security, and scalability.
• Stay current with developments in database administration, SQL Server, Azure SQL, backup and recovery practices, automation, security, and enterprise compliance technologies.

Compliance, Governance & Collaboration:
• Follow established change management, release management, incident management, security, and governance practices for database platforms.
• Adhere to the Company's Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures.
• Understand relevant security, privacy, and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company.
• Ensure other members of the department to follow the QMS, regulations, standards, and procedures.
• Ensure database administration activities are documented, controlled, auditable, and aligned with applicable IT and quality system requirements.
• Collaborate with IT, application owners, business partners, vendors, and support teams to maintain reliable database operations and resolve issues effectively.
• Communicate technical and complex database information clearly, both verbally and in writing.
• Perform other work-related duties as assigned.


Position Qualifications - Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field with 8+ years of enterprise-level database administration and/or database engineering experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 5+ years of experience supporting high availability, disaster recovery, backup, restore, and database recovery strategies for business-critical systems.
• Strong experience with SQL Server performance tuning, indexing, query optimization, execution plans, wait statistics, SQL Agent jobs, and database maintenance plans.
• Experience administering SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, log shipping, replication, or equivalent high availability technologies.
• Experience with database security practices, including least privilege access, role-based permissions, encryption, auditing, service accounts, and privileged access controls.
• Experience with PowerShell, T-SQL scripting, automation, monitoring, alerting, and operational reporting.
• Experience with enterprise backup platforms, restore validation, database integrity checks, and disaster recovery testing.
• Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, networking fundamentals, storage, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure as they relate to database services.
• Ability to plan, organize, and document complex database administration activities and configure systems in alignment with institutional policies and procedures.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle concurrent projects, respond effectively to urgent or complex operational issues, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, data stewardship, documentation discipline, and organizational skills.

Position Qualifications - Preferred
• Experience supporting Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or SQL Server hosted in Microsoft Azure is preferred.
• Experience supporting integrations with ERP, MES, LIMS, QMS, reporting, data warehouse, or enterprise application platforms is preferred.
• Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Power BI gateways, or related reporting and integration technologies is preferred.
• Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Database Administrator Associate, or equivalent database certification is preferred.

Working Conditions

• Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

Annual Base Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000/ year
We offer a competitive compensation package plus a benefits and equity program, when applicable.
Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

What We Offer

title: Sr. Director, Cloud and Infrastructure Transformation
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

At the heart of Pfizer's Digital transformation sits Infrastructure & Cloud, enabling modern cloud platforms and engineering capabilities that accelerate scientific discovery, empower researchers, and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

Pfizer is seeking a highly accomplished technology leader who combines enterprise-scale strategic thinking with deep technical expertise in cloud, infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering. This role will shape the future of Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure ecosystem, enabling AI/ML-powered research, advanced analytics, and next-generation digital capabilities that support breakthrough science and drug discovery.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business strategy with executive leadership, guiding large-scale transformation initiatives, and engaging directly with architects and engineers on critical technical decisions. This is a leadership role for someone who has not only led transformation programs but has personally helped design, build, and scale modern cloud platforms and infrastructure capabilities.

At Pfizer, your work will directly contribute to the technologies that enable scientists to accelerate research, unlock insights from complex data, and develop innovative medicines for patients around the world.

Pfizer seeks individuals who are highly self-motivated, intellectually curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and growth.

What You Will Achieve

The Senior Director, Cloud & Infrastructure Transformation serves as both a strategic technology executive and a technical thought leader for Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure landscape. This leader will define future-state infrastructure strategy while ensuring the successful execution of complex, enterprise-scale initiatives spanning cloud, networking, data center modernization, platform engineering, and AI infrastructure.

You will lead a team of senior leaders, architects, and engineering organizations while helping establish the technology vision, engineering standards, and operating models required to support Pfizer's digital future.

You will be expected to drive business outcomes through technology strategy while maintaining the technical depth and credibility necessary to guide architecture decisions, challenge assumptions, and ensure engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute Pfizer's multi-year cloud and infrastructure transformation strategy, aligning technology investments with business and scientific priorities.
  • Lead enterprise-wide modernization initiatives spanning multi-cloud environments, AI/ML platforms, network transformation, infrastructure automation, and data center evolution.
  • Serve as a senior technical authority, providing guidance on architecture, platform engineering, cloud operations, resiliency, security, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Partner with architects and engineering leaders to evaluate and influence critical technology decisions, ensuring scalable, secure, and operationally resilient solutions.
  • Drive adoption of cloud-native architectures, Infrastructure as Code, automation, observability, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering practices.
  • Establish technology roadmaps and engineering standards that support innovation, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Build strong partnerships across Digital, Security, Research, and Business organizations to accelerate enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Lead and develop high-performing teams of Directors, Senior Managers, and technical leaders while cultivating a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence. Mainly influencing to start, followed by a larger team over time.
  • Influence senior executive stakeholders and drive alignment across a complex, global, matrixed organization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify opportunities that improve Pfizer's technology capabilities and business outcomes.
  • Balance strategic priorities, execution risks, operational demands, and technical considerations to drive sustainable transformation at scale.

Leadership Expectations

Candidates should demonstrate a breadth of leadership experiences and capabilities, including:

  • Influencing executive leaders, peers, and technical teams to achieve enterprise outcomes.
  • Building organizational capability and developing future technology leaders.
  • Creating an environment that promotes innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Leading through ambiguity and driving execution in highly complex environments.
  • Translating technology strategy into measurable business impact.
  • Establishing credibility with both senior executives and highly technical engineering teams.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in cloud, infrastructure, networking, platform engineering, or related technology functions.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale cloud and infrastructure transformation programs at enterprise scale.
  • Deep expertise in public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), with a proven history of designing, building, and operating production environments supporting critical business workloads.
  • Strong technical foundation spanning cloud architecture, networking, platform engineering, infrastructure operations, automation, and security.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in architecture reviews, challenge technical design decisions, and influence engineering standards through technical expertise and credibility.
  • Experience leading organizations responsible for cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, architecture, operations, and reliability.
  • Proven success developing and leading senior technology leaders, including Senior Managers, Directors, and Architects.
  • Extensive experience driving results through influence across business, security, engineering, and executive stakeholder groups.
  • Expertise in cloud-native architectures, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu), automation, DevOps, observability, resiliency engineering, and modern operating models.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management practices within large enterprise environments.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
  • Proven ability to simultaneously lead strategic planning and execution across multiple complex initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or enabling AI/ML infrastructure, advanced analytics platforms, or high-performance computing environments.
  • Experience supporting research, scientific computing, or large-scale data science workloads.
  • Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, or Business Administration.
  • Industry certifications in cloud architecture, engineering, security, or infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience leading global organizations across multiple regions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale migrations, data center exits, platform modernization initiatives, or mergers and acquisitions.
  • Demonstrated success driving technology transformation through both strategic vision and deep technical leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technology strategist and engineer at heart. They have built credibility through hands-on technical leadership, can engage deeply in architectural discussions, and have successfully led large-scale transformation efforts that delivered measurable business value. They are equally effective influencing executive stakeholders, mentoring technical leaders, and driving execution across complex enterprise environments.

Most importantly, this leader brings both the strategic mindset to shape Pfizer's future and the technical depth to help build it.

Other Job Details

  • Last day to apply: 9/7/2026

  • Work location assignment: Hybrid - onsite at NY Headquarters an average of 2.5 days per week or as the business requires

  • 10-20% Travel

In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. title: Esihenkilö, Mäntykalliokoti, Kankaanpää
description:
Haemme esihenkilöä ikääntyneiden ympärivuorokautiseen palveluasumiseen Pohjois-Satakunnan alueelle

Johtamasi yksiköt ovat Kankaanpäässä sijaitseva Mäntykalliokoti, jossa on 28 asiakaspaikkaa sekä Karviassa sijaitseva Iltarusko, jossa on 16 asiakaspaikkaa.

Asumisyksikkömme tarjoavat kodinomaista asumista turvallisessa ympäristössä elämän loppuun saakka. Hoidon ja hoivan tarkoituksena on, että asukas voi kokea elämänsä turvalliseksi, merkitykselliseksi sekä arvokkaaksi ja, että hän voi ylläpitää sosiaalista vuorovaikutusta ja osallistua mielekkääseen, hyvinvointia ja toimintakykyä ylläpitävään toimintaan.

Tehtävääsi sisältyy asiakkaiden tarpeista lähtevän laadukkaan, tehokkaan ja vaikuttavan ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen yksikön toiminnan suunnittelu, arviointi ja kehittäminen sekä asiakkaiden palvelutarpeiden mukaisesta riittävästä henkilöstöresurssista vastaaminen. Yksikön työntekijöiden lähiesihenkilönä toimiminen ja yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (tai vastaava aiempi opistotasoinen tutkinto) täydennettynä soveltuvilla johtamisen ja hallinnon opinnoilla tai sisältyen tutkintoon sekä sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä (817/2015) ja/tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain (559/94) mukainen laillistus.

Eduksesi luemme aiemman kokemuksen esihenkilötehtävistä. Lisäksi arvostamme erinomaisia yhteistyötaitoja, innovatiivisuutta, kehittämissuuntautuneisuutta, itsenäistä työskentelyotetta ja päätöksentekokykyä sekä joustavuutta. Kielitaitovaatimuksena hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito.

Virka täytetään toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Valinnoissa noudatamme kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.
Palvelussuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle liikunta, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun sekä maksuttoman kuntosalin Raumalla, Harjavallassa, Porissa ja Ulvilassa. Meillä on laajennettu työterveyshuolto ja kattava sisäinen koulutustarjonta.

Hakemus lähetetään ensisijaisesti sähköisesti Kuntarekry-järjestelmän kautta. Alkuperäiset työ- ja tutkintotodistukset tarkastetaan haastateltavilta.

description:

title: Clients & Pursuits Director
description:
The impact you’ll make:
As the Clients & Pursuits Director you will lead a nationally critical capability that enables Deloitte Partners to win, retain and grow our most important client relationships. Your role is deliberately balanced, with approximately 50% of your time focused on leading, coaching and developing a team of experienced account and pursuits professionals, and 50% acting as a trusted Pursuits Coach to Partners on Deloitte’s most complex and high value opportunities.

Your typical day might include:

  • Acting as a senior Pursuits Coach to Partners and pursuit teams on priority opportunities, shaping pursuit strategy, win themes, value propositions and positioning across the full sales lifecycle.
  • Facilitating senior level pursuit strategy workshops with Partners to diagnose client needs, competitive dynamics and relationship strength, and to agree focused, disciplined win strategies.
  • Bringing deep knowledge of sales and bid processes, methods and tools, together with hands on practical experience to lift pursuit quality, consistency and confidence across the firm.
  • Working closely with senior stakeholders to continuously strengthen Deloitte’s account management and pursuit methodologies, tools and standards.
  • Embedding a disciplined approach to pipeline management, pursuit governance, win/loss reviews and insight generation to inform future market strategy and capability investment.
  • Leading and developing a team of 3 Bid Managers and 6 Client Account Managers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a high performance, inclusive culture focused on quality, impact and results.
  • Providing regular coaching, feedback and career development for team members, including performance management, capability uplift and succession planning across the accounts and pursuits disciplines.

Your expertise:
Bring your deep experience in complex B2B sales, account leadership and competitive pursuits at a senior level, and see what impact you can make.

You’ll also have:

  • Significant experience in professional services or similar complex, matrixed corporate environment, with a strong track record in leading and winning major pursuits (at least 10-12 years).
  • Advanced knowledge of sales and bid methodologies, with the ability to translate theory into practical, actionable coaching for senior leaders from bid qualification through to effective presentation coaching
  • A proven track record in sales, business development, account management, project management or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated empathetic but action-oriented people leadership capability, including leading, coaching and developing experienced practitioners and building sustainable team capability.
  • Strong executive level communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with credibility and confidence when partnering with senior Partners and leaders.
  • Sound commercial judgement, strong project leadership skills, and the ability to work across multiple high stakes priorities with discipline and clarity.

Making an impact that matters, together:

We are driven by our desire to create positive outcomes for our clients, communities, and people. Everything we do is with intent - the intent to make a meaningful difference.

Our shared values are at the heart of everything we do. Living these values, including ‘taking care of each other’ and ‘fostering inclusion’, is essential to ensuring everyone feels included at work and able to reach their full potential. For us to succeed and thrive as an organisation, we understand the importance of creating a culture where diverse perspectives matter and where everyone is given an equal opportunity to grow and develop.

How you’ll be rewarded:

We hold a simple belief – that our people’s hard work should be recognised and rewarded beyond their remuneration. The Deloitte experience is founded on concepts of trust, balance, wellbeing and the importance of personal connection.

We offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits you, us and our clients best

  • 22 days annual leave

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Helsinki Ruoholahti
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt sairaanhoitajaa Helsinkiin, Terveystalo Ruoholahteen.

Mitä työ sairaanhoitajana Ruoholahden Terveystalossa pitää sisällään?

Ruoholahden Terveystalossa pääset tekemään monipuolisia sairaanhoitajan tehtäviä sekä hyödyntämään ja kasvattamaan osaamistasi eri asiakkuuksien parissa. Työtehtävät koostuvat sairaanhoitajan itsenäisestä vastaanotosta ja toimenpidehoitajan tehtävistä useiden eri erikoisalojen lääkäreiden työparina. Etäpalvelut ovat myös yksi osa hoitajan jokapäiväistä työtä. Tässä työtehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus toteuttaa jo sinulla olemassa olevaa osaamistasi. Terveystalossa asiakkaina ovat yksityis-, vakuutus- ja työterveysasiakkaat. Työssäsi sinulla on tukena iloinen ja kokenut tiimi sekä esihenkilö, joka tukee sinua onnistumaan työssäsi. Terveystalossa työhyvinvointi on avainasemassa ja meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeimmän tekijä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.
- sairaanhoitajan itsenäinen vastaanottotyö - lääkäreiden avustaminen toimenpiteissä eri erikoisaloilla - päivystysluonteinen sairaanhoitajan työ - matkailijan rokotukset ja neuvonta - etävastaanotot

Työsuhde on määräaikainen ja tarvittaessa työhön kutsuttava 24.8.2028 saakka. Työvuoroja tarjotaan pääasiassa akuuttien poissaolojen paikkaamiseen ja työvuorojen määrä vaihtelee 0-2 vuoroa viikossa. Yksikössämme sairaanhoitaja tekee kaksivuorotyötä. Työvuorot sijoittuvat ma-to klo 7.30-20.30 ja pe klo 7.30-18.30. Työvuorosuunnittelussa toteutetaan 6 viikon sykleissä.

Terveystalon kokonaispalkitseminen muodostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta ja mahdollisesta henkilökohtaisesta palkanosasta sekä työsuhde-eduista.
Työtehtävässä noudatetaan yksityisen terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES), jonka mukaan tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu. Tehtävä on määritetty Terveystalossa vaativuusryhmään 4, jonka mukainen vähimmäispalkka sairaanhoitajalle on 2847,85€/kk, ja palkka voi nousta kokemuksen, osaamisen ja työn sijainnin mukaan.Lisäksi palkkaan vaikuttavat mahdollinen henkilökohtainen osuus (erityinen osaaminen, aiempi työkokemus) ja erityistekijälisät (lisävastuut työssä) sekä vuosisidonnaisuus (4 vuotta +6 %, ja 7 vuotta +11 % tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta). Tämän päälle maksetaan TES:n mukaiset vuorolisät.Terveystalon tärkeimmän tekijät pääsevät myös nauttimaan monipuolisista työsuhde-eduista, joihin kuuluvat lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, kumppanialennukset sekä kattava työterveyshuolto. Työterveyshuolto sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, kuten lyhytpsykoterapian.
Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Pätevyysvaatimuksena on sairaanhoitajan tutkinto ja kokemus työskentelystä yksityisellä terveyspalvelualalla. Toivomme hakijalta osaamista itsenäisen sairaanhoitajan vastaanoton pitämisestä ja toimenpideavustuksista ja mahdollisesta päivystävänä sairaanhoitajana työskentelystä. Kipsimestarin tai kipsiteknikon osaaminen ja skopiaosaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta viimeistään 3.9.2026 Meille jokainen hakija on tärkeä. Siksi meillä jokaisen hakemuksen lukee aina ihminen. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaan mielellään arkisin klo 13-15, palveluvastaava Anniina Fors (puh. 0505311884 anniina.fors@terveystalo.com).

title: Head of Corporate Development
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Corporate Development based in Canada.

This is a senior leadership opportunity to own and accelerate a high-impact M&A strategy within a global consumer and prosumer software business.
You will lead the full acquisition lifecycle, from identifying attractive targets and developing investment theses to negotiating transactions and driving them through close.
Working directly with executive leadership and investment partners, you will have significant influence over portfolio strategy and long-term growth.
The role combines sophisticated financial analysis with commercial judgment, relationship building, and hands-on transaction execution.
You’ll operate across the US, Canada, and Europe, developing relationships with founders, bankers, advisors, and technology businesses.
The environment is lean, entrepreneurial, and fast-moving, with multiple opportunities and transactions progressing simultaneously.
This position is well suited to an accomplished M&A professional who can operate with executive presence while remaining highly hands-on.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and own the M&A pipeline, identifying consumer, prosumer, and desktop software opportunities across the US, Canada, and Europe through banker relationships, direct outreach, and thematic research.
  • Lead acquisition processes end-to-end, including target evaluation, valuation, financial modeling, IOI/LOI development, transaction structuring, negotiation, signing, and closing.
  • Develop investment theses, market maps, valuation analyses, deal memos, and board-ready materials in partnership with executive leadership and investment stakeholders.
  • Direct cross-functional due diligence across finance, legal, tax, product, and technology, coordinating internal teams and external advisors to maintain momentum and rigor.
  • Build and maintain a strong network of technology bankers, founders, investors, and advisors to ensure early access to attractive opportunities.
  • Assess strategic fit, commercial potential, valuation, and operational considerations to determine how potential acquisitions support broader portfolio objectives.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams spanning pipeline development, active diligence, negotiations, and transaction execution.
  • Partner with integration leaders following acquisitions to help ensure transactions deliver against their original strategic and financial theses.
  • Communicate clearly with senior executives, boards, sponsors, and external stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle.
  • Contribute to a culture centered on accountability, customer impact, constructive debate, speed, pragmatism, and disciplined execution.

    • Requirements:

    • 8+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, venture/growth investing, corporate development, or a combination of these fields.

title: Security Engineering Lead
description:
Dovetail is the Customer Intelligence Platform for the entire organization. We unify fragmented feedback from every touchpoint, including sales calls, support tickets, and research, into a single AI-powered intelligence layer that empowers every team to build, sell, and serve with confidence. Founded in 2017, we are a team of 100+ across our offices in Sydney and San Francisco, working with thousands of teams from Fortune 500 companies to the world’s most innovative startups.

The best never guess. We help teams turn the noise of thousands of customer interactions into the signal required to move faster, prioritize better, and drive revenue.

The role

Roughly 15% of the Fortune 500 trust us with their customer data. That trust is the product. As our Security & Compliance Lead you own the governance, risk and compliance function that proves it, end to end, across SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001.

This is a compliance role in a company that ships every day. The certifications matter, but so does what sits underneath them, and we would rather automate a control than evidence it by hand twice a year. You will start with deep GRC ownership and we expect you to push hard into security engineering from there, building the tooling and automation that makes compliance a by-product of how we work rather than a quarterly scramble. Dovetail is one of Australia's most AI forward engineering teams and you will have the runway, the tooling and the support to make that move.

You will also be shaping what governance looks like for AI products that are genuinely new. We were early to ISO/IEC 42001 and the questions our enterprise customers ask about model use, data handling and agentic workflows do not have settled answers yet. You get to write them.

This is an individual contributor role reporting into engineering leadership. It is in person first (4 days a week) from our Surry Hills HQ.

What you'll do here

  • Own security risk. Maintain the risk register, run risk assessments on new products and features, drive mitigations to close with the teams who own them, and manage third party and vendor risk as our supply chain grows.

  • Own our compliance programme. Run SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 certification and surveillance cycles end to end, including scoping, control design, evidence, internal audit and the external auditor relationship.

  • Be the technical voice in enterprise deals. Handle security questionnaires, customer trust reviews and due diligence for some of the largest companies in the world, and work with sales and legal to unblock them quickly.

  • Automate the boring parts. Build and improve tooling that collects evidence, monitors control drift and reports posture continuously, working alongside platform engineering rather than handing them a ticket.

  • Grow into hands-on security engineering. Pick up detection and response tooling, cloud security posture work across AWS, and vulnerability management, with the support to build genuine engineering depth.

  • Set the standard for AI governance. Define how we assess, document and control AI systems, model providers and agentic features, and stay ahead of where frameworks like the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework are heading.

  • Be part of security incident response. Contribute to our response process and help mature how we detect, escalate and learn from incidents.

  • Build the security culture. Work with and mentor engineers, product and design so that good security decisions get made without you in the room.

Your background

  • Deep GRC experience. You have run compliance programmes against SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 in a software business, not just supported them. You know the difference between a control that satisfies an auditor and a control that actually reduces risk, and you care about both.

  • Comfortable with AI compliance, or hungry to own it. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 and emerging AI assurance frameworks is a real advantage. If you do not have it yet, you are excited by the chance to become one of the people who does.

  • Technical credibility. You can hold your own with engineers on cloud architecture and security controls. Exposure to AWS security tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector and Detective, and to EKS, TypeScript or infrastructure as code like Pulumi or Terraform, will set you up well here.

  • Wants to build, not just assess. You are looking for a role where the natural answer to a manual process is to write something that removes it, and you want to spend the next few years getting materially more technical.

  • Enterprise fluency. You have been across the table from large customers, their procurement teams and their security reviewers, and you know how to move a deal forward without overcommitting.

  • You are pragmatic and flexible. Like your new teammates, you are used to doing what is necessary to get the job done. You will need to be comfortable with ambiguity, be resourceful in solving problems, and adjust to shifting deadlines and goals.

  • When you do it, you nail it. You share our keen eye for quality. What you ship is top notch, and you cut scope before cutting quality.

  • Excellent, concise communicator. You can explain a risk to an engineer, a board member and a customer's CISO on the same day, and articulate effort versus impact clearly to each of them.

Why you'll love it here

We hire smart people and look after them well! Here's the deal:

📈 Equity for everyone. Competitive base salary plus options, so every builder is aligned on long-term impact.

🏢 A place to do your best work, wherever you are. Our Sydney office is built for in-person first collaboration. Our US team runs on a flexible remote setup. Either way, you've got what you need.

title: SENIOR DESIGN ENGR
description:

Design and Verify high-performance, low-power, high-reliability RISC‑V CPU cores for SoCs used in various edge products like automotive, IoT and mobile.   • Perform performance analysis / bottleneck identification and drive optimizations
  • Collaborate with physical design to meet timing, power, and area targets

  • Carry out a thorough analysis of existing defects, change requests and new features and develop related Testbench components and execute Test plan for the core.
  • Shall be capable to own & perform the complete sign off process for the core modules including 100% Code & Functional Coverage targets, Assertions, writing and updating test plans, Verification Guides, regression management etc.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Ads Brand Safety and Suitability
description:
Amazon Ads Brand Safety & Suitability protects advertisers from exposure to unsafe, unsuitable, or policy-violating content across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio advertising inventory. Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager who possesses stakeholder management, program management, and well-rounded technical capabilities. You will drive the execution of complex, cross-organizational programs that protect advertiser trust at scale - including vendor integrations, enhancing capabilities across evolving supply types such as CTV, audio and gaming. You will work across multiple teams with evolving priorities, define clarity where ambiguity exists, and make trade-offs to drive program delivery. As a Sr. TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. You will work across engineering, science, product, policy, legal, and external partners to deliver programs that directly impact advertiser confidence.

Key job responsibilities
Program Execution & Delivery
- Drive end-to-end execution across engineering and science teams
- Own delivery of cross-organizational initiatives
- Define program milestones, manage dependencies across all stakeholders, and drive teams to deliver on commitments
Technical Depth & Architecture Influence
- Understand the real-time ad serving infrastructure
- Evaluate technical proposals, identify risks in system design, and ensure appropriate trade-offs.
- Drive technical integration programs with third-party vendors.
- Partner with science teams on ML model deployment experimentation frameworks, and signal validation.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Org Alignment
- Manage relationships and alignment across senior leaders and stakeholders
- Drive executive communications through monthly and quarterly updates, and escalate to leadership effectively as needed.
- Navigate competing priorities across advertiser protection, publisher relationships, and business growth imperatives
- Represent Brand Safety programs in cross-org forums
Operational Excellence
- Create mechanisms that ensure long-term program success with or without direct involvement — documentation, runbooks, audit trails
- Own program-level metrics and reporting for leadership visibility

A day in the life
You will work with cross functional stakeholders across engineering, product and data science leadership to define engineering and product strategy. You will deliver state of the art machine learning based technical solutions that will power several contextual advertising products across Amazon Ads.

title: Total Rewards Specialist
description:

You will help administer benefits programs spanning APAC, EMEA, and the Americas while contributing to foundational compensation analysis.
The role combines hands-on administration with data analysis, reporting, auditing, and process improvement.
You will work closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, external vendors, and employees across multiple regions.
Accuracy, confidentiality, and strong data management will be essential when handling sensitive employee information and financial records.
The position is well suited to an analytical HR professional looking to deepen their expertise in global compensation and benefits.
You’ll also gain exposure to annual reward cycles, international programs, system improvements, and broader Total Rewards projects.

Accountabilities:

  • Coordinate end-to-end benefits administration, including enrollments, employee status changes, onboarding documentation, leave-related administration, terminations, and insurance continuation processes across US and international platforms.

  • Prepare billing schedules, process and validate premium invoices, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate with Payroll and insurance carriers to resolve issues.
  • Calculate benefits premium adjustments and coordinate monthly employee deductions and employer contributions with regional Payroll teams.
  • Perform benefits and compensation data audits across HRIS and vendor systems, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for HR, Finance, and leadership, including compensation and benefits data analysis.
  • Support compliance activities, including benefits reporting, pay transparency requirements, retirement and savings plan updates, and other applicable regional obligations.
  • Maintain Total Rewards documentation, process guides, FAQs, employee resources, and internal knowledge-management materials.
  • Help create and localize employee communications, support benefits webinars, and contribute to wellness initiatives and international holiday-calendar updates.
  • Contribute to special projects such as HR system implementations, benefits program redesigns, vendor evaluations, and other evolving Total Rewards priorities.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–2 years of experience in compensation, benefits, Total Rewards, or a related HR function.
    • Working knowledge of compensation fundamentals, including base pay, bonuses, market pricing, salary structures, and pay equity concepts.
    • Exposure to benefits administration or the ability and willingness to quickly learn varied global benefits and statutory frameworks.
    • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, sorting, filtering, data manipulation, and reconciliation.
    • Experience or exposure to modern HRIS platforms; ADP experience is preferred.
    • Strong data-validation, reporting, auditing, and reconciliation skills with exceptional attention to numerical accuracy.
    • Experience maintaining organized documentation and working with digital document-management or signature platforms is advantageous.
    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, HR teams, vendors, and international stakeholders.
    • Strong discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive personally identifiable information and protected health information.
    • Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a global environment.
    • Willingness to work evening calls approximately 2–3 days per week to collaborate with team members based in the US and Mexico.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration and follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position for candidates located and authorized to work in India.
      • Opportunity to work within a global Total Rewards function supporting employees across multiple regions.
      • Exposure to international compensation and benefits programs across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
      • Professional development opportunities across compensation, benefits, HR operations, analytics, compliance, and global reward programs.
      • Collaborative environment with cross-functional exposure to HR, Payroll, Finance, and external partners.
      • Opportunity to contribute to HR technology implementations, program redesigns, vendor evaluations, and other strategic projects.
      • Flexible remote-first working environment designed to support collaboration across global teams.

title: Studio Coordinator- Fort Collins
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others

  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment

  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support

  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team

  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week

  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.

  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community

  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio

  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​

  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio

  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards

  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:

  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk

  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc

  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team

  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team

  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value

  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required

  • Experience in Customer Service required

  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred

  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred

  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.

  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines

  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel

  • Excellent Time Management skills

  • Ability to take initiative and prioritize

  • College (BA/BS) preferred

THE FINE PRINT

  • Availability must match the needs of the business and leadership zig-zag schedules – morning, evening, weekend and some holiday availability and flexibility required

  • Must be able to move around the studio space, crouch, reach, and lift up to 25 lbs.

  • If certified to teach, must be able to step in to teach class with little to no notice while scheduled in the studio

COMPENSATION

  • $21.75 per hour

THE PERKS

  • Free All Access Membership - use anytime, in studio or online

  • Free All Access Membership for a Plus One - bring someone along!

  • Retail Discounts

  • Continued Education Offerings

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 1.5x Holiday Pay: Earn time-and-a-half pay for hours worked on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

WHO WE ARE

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

title: Senior Product Manager-Tech, Advertising
description:
Shape the future of advertising at Amazon by leading large-scale solutions that connect advertisers with customers across the web, mobile, and connected TV devices. You'll drive the technical design and roadmap for a significant portion of Amazon's advertising business, working at the intersection of technology, data, and customer needs to deliver measurable impact for thousands of advertisers.

Key job responsibilities
Define Product Vision & Strategy – Drive product strategy and roadmap development by working backwards from customer needs, analyzing data to uncover insights, and defining the vision for how advertisers will connect with supply sources to optimize campaign performance. Create a clear multi-year roadmap that guides engineering, science, and design efforts across the organization.

Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration – Prioritize features and align stakeholders on direction, coordinating complex product initiatives across engineering, design, data science, sales, and business teams. Partner with sales and account management teams to understand advertiser challenges, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for adoption and iteration.

Develop Product & Business Requirements – Translate customer needs and market opportunities into comprehensive product and business requirements that guide development and launch.

Solve Complex Challenges – Investigate technical and business challenges using data-driven analysis to inform decision-making and identify creative solutions that address root causes.

Drive Adoption & Iteration – Work with global sales and account management teams to ensure successful product adoption, gather customer feedback, and continuously refine solutions based on real-world performance and advertiser needs.



A day in the life
Your day blends strategic vision with hands-on execution. You'll start by analyzing campaign performance data to identify optimization opportunities, then collaborate with engineers and designers in a feature review to refine a new capability. You'll facilitate cross-team discussions to align on priorities, navigate technical trade-offs, and document product requirements that guide development. Throughout the day, you'll engage with sales and account management teams to gather real-world customer insights, validate assumptions, and iterate on your roadmap. Your work spans the complete product lifecycle—from initial strategy and prioritization through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement based on feedback.

About the team
We're a team of product, engineering, data science, sales, and business leaders building large-scale systems that integrate across multiple sources to deliver unique advertising solutions. Our mission is to connect advertisers with the supply sources and capabilities that drive optimal performance for their campaigns. We're committed to solving complex problems and creating products that matter for advertisers of all sizes. We're building the next generation of advertising technology and looking for thoughtful, analytical leaders who can navigate ambiguity, influence across organizations, and champion customer-centric solutions.

title: Emergency Management Specialist

The Office of Emergency Management provides policy direction and coordination for nationwide emergency management activities across the Department of the Interior and its bureaus and offices.

Leads the preparation of classified/sensitive national security communications briefing memos for the Assistant Secretary (AS), Deputy Assistant Secretary (DAS), OEM Director, or other leadership in preparedness, response, national security, continuity, and other meetings. Drafts memos and directives for the OEM Director for Department-wide dissemination. Accomplishes emergency management and national security special projects in support of the office's strategic goals and initiatives related to classified national security operations and information flow. Identifies an inventory of secure communications spaces for senior leaders while they are on travel. Collaborates and maintains close coordination with OEM Divisions on secure national security communications requirements, roles, and responsibilities. Develops and updates training and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for secure communications coordination with Watch Officers during off-hours coverage. Support other OEM Divisions during preparedness, response, and recovery. Perform duties common to all Department of the Interior emergency management personnel, including but not limited to the following: Preparing emergency management policies, plans, and procedures; Understanding, complying with, providing guidance, and interpreting National and Departmental emergency management-related directives, regulations, policies, standards and guidance; Evaluating and inspecting emergency management and continuity activities; Planning, evaluating, controlling and participating in exercises in accordance with an established Departmental design and planning framework, providing or coordinating emergency response and preparedness training and exercises; Performing reporting and coordination activities to support operations center activities during emergencies. May serve on response teams (i.e., incident management teams, occupant emergency teams, continuity of operations teams).

Must provide proof of U.S. citizenship. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. Waipapa Taumata Rau | The University of Auckland

The University of Auckland creates globally transformative impacts through its distinctive strengths in world-leading research, scholarship, teaching and collaborative partnerships, inspired by its unique position in Aotearoa New Zealand and the Asia-Pacific.

Join New Zealand’s top-ranked and triple-crown accredited Auckland Business and Economics School, with an international reputation for shaping the future of research and teaching excellence, and be part of its continued growth as you embark on the next phase of your academic career. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong research potential and a commitment to excellent, research-informed teaching, enhanced by appropriate learning technologies. You will be encouraged to build research partnerships, seek external funding and engage with professional, academic and non-academic communities. You will contribute to an intellectually vibrant academic environment through interdisciplinary collaboration, knowledge exchange and departmental service, with opportunities to work across and beyond the Department.

The faculty attracts high-calibre students to our world-class undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Lecturer (L): NZ$99,788 - NZ$119,204
Senior Lecturer (SL): NZ$126,863 - NZ$158,904
Associate Professor (AP): From NZ$165,808

You will be a collegial academic with excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate your ideas, research, and future plans.   • International Trade

  • Open Economy Macroeconomics
  • Financial Economics

  • Fintech

Auckland is a vibrant cosmopolitan and growing city with a population of 1.8m (greater Auckland area). title: Systems Analyst - Cervical Screening
description:
Mō tēnei tūranga | About the role

The Systems Analyst plays an important role in supporting the National Cervical Screening Programme by ensuring the National Cervical Screening Programme Register (NCSP-R) remains accurate, reliable, and fit for purpose. Working at the intersection of data, systems, and quality, you'll use analysis and reporting to identify trends, investigate issues, and support informed decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with complex information, and driving continuous improvements that contribute to better health outcomes for communities across Aotearoa. This role is based in our Wellington CBD office.

Ngā haepapa matua | Key responsibilities

  • Maintain the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of information held within the National Cervical Screening Programme Register (NCSP-R).
  • Conduct data validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and assurance activities to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Investigate system issues, data discrepancies, and anomalies, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports, analysis, and insights to support operational, clinical, and programme decision-making.
  • Monitor system performance, exception reports, and work queues to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to provide specialist advice on register processes, system functionality, and data integrity.

Ngā hua mōu | What's in it for you

  • Be part of a collaborative team working towards better health outcomes for all of Aotearoa
  • Grow your career with ongoing development and learning opportunities
  • Wellbeing support including EAP and a half-day off every month
  • Access exclusive discounts with Boost and Samsung
  • Benefit from birthday leave and additional leave

Mōu ake | About you

You're a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys working with data, systems, and technology to solve complex problems. You have experience managing data within systems, investigating issues, and turning insights into practical improvements. Comfortable working independently and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders, you're a clear communicator with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement. You'll bring sound judgement, technical confidence, and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality and cultural safety. Most importantly, you'll have a genuine commitment to Te Tiriti o Waitangi, health equity, and supporting positive outcomes for the diverse communities we serve across Aotearoa.

Ōu wheako ōu mātauranga hoki | Qualifications and Experience

  • Proficiency in the usage of the Microsoft office products (Outlook, Excel and Word).
  • Experience with managing data within a data collection system, including writing queries, analysing data sets, and checking data integrity.
  • Experience managing and working IT system error queues.
  • Experience with Salesforce is highly desirable

Ōu āheitanga ōu pūkenga hoki | Skills and Competence

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience investigating system issues, managing error queues, and identifying practical solutions.
  • Confident working with technology and able to quickly learn new systems, processes, and applications.
  • Technically capable, with the ability to administer, troubleshoot, and support multiple systems while maintaining data integrity and accuracy.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Highly organised and methodical, with strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate documentation and work outputs.
  • Able to work independently, use initiative, and manage competing priorities while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and sound judgement, with a commitment to confidentiality, cultural safety, and continuous learning.
  • Strong awareness and application of Te Tiriti o Waitangi, with a commitment to health equity and supporting the diverse communities and priority populations of Aotearoa.

Ō mātou uara | Our values

E kimi ana mātou i ētahi tangata e kaha whakanui i ēnei uara - We are looking for people who align naturally with these values and will champion them

  • Mahia te mea tika / Do the right thing
  • Hihiri e te kounga / Motivated by quality
  • Ngākau nui ki te pai ake / Passion for better
  • Pokohiwi ki Pokohiwi / Shoulder to shoulder

Join us at Cleveland Clinic Akron General Hospital where we have been providing world-class care to our community for over 100 years. Here, we strive for patient-centered care and comfort with our collaborative team of healthcare professionals. We are committed to serving the community and treat our patients as family.

Akron General’s Level I Emergency Department offers the technology, expertise and staffing necessary to treat all injuries, regardless of severity. As an RN in this unit, you will gain extensive hands-on experience and exposure from a fast-paced and highly trained team of caregivers. This position offers you endless opportunities to enhance your skills and grow as a nurse.

A caregiver in this position works FT, 3:00pm—3:00am.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Complete Emergency Department Assessment Data Base upon patient arrival, inclusive of psychosocial, educational and age specific needs of patient/family.

  • Complete ongoing assessments according to departmental/unit policies and recognize significant changes in patient condition.

  • Initiate an individualized plan of care based on assessment of patient needs and Emergency Department standards of care.

  • Include plan for appropriate teaching for patient/family.

  • Review individualized plan of care and goals with patient/family.

  • Review and document care and discharge goals with physician and patient/family.

  • Maintain a safe, comfortable environment for patients.

  • Accurately administer and document IVs and medications according to established standards of care and policies and procedures.

  • Appropriately intervene when changes in patient condition occur.

  • Provide individualized and timely interventions in accordance with age specific needs and Department of Nursing/hospital policy.

  • Accurately document nursing interventions and patient responses, in accordance with policy.

  • Serve as patient/family advocate to facilitate patient care, communication and resolution of problems and ethical dilemmas.

  • Evaluate current interventions and responses to plan of care.

  • Evaluate and modify plan of care as necessary, based on assessment by other disciplines and patient response to nursing interventions, established age specific standards of care/expected patient outcomes.

  • Establish priorities for delivery of patient care to individual patients and for assigned groups of patients.

  • Participate in and document discharge planning.

  • Communicate information in shift and unit reports regarding patient plan of care and current outcomes.

  • Using appropriate chain of command, communicate information in a timely fashion to the Director, physician, or Nursing Coordinator regarding changes in patient condition and patient care/unit issues.

  • Utilize research findings in clinical practice and/or participate in research activities.

  • Assign/delegate appropriate patient care activities to other nursing caregivers based on patient needs and skill level/qualifications of staff members.

  • Function in triage nurse positions according to established Emergency Department policy.

  • Care for patients and family members during emergency or crisis situations in a calm and professional manner.

  • Provide appropriate care for alleged rape/sexual assault and/or geriatric abuse victims utilizing established Emergency Department protocols.

  • Initiate appropriate community referral for patients and families.

  • Interact in a professional manner with law enforcement, paramedics and other pre-hospital care personnel.

  • Function as Flow Manager according to Emergency Department policy.

  • Assist in the orientation of RNs and other hospital personnel.

Hastings Direct is an agile, data and digitally focused general insurance provider to the UK market, offering a full range of car, van, bike and home insurance products. But it's our attitude and the way we run our business that makes us different.

title: Finance Director
description:
Position Summary
The Finance Director directs the financial and administrative operations of the Dauphin County Library System (The Library). Prepares and analyzes financial statements and related reports. Prepares the budget and 990 and coordinates the annual audit. Responsible for asset management. Works with Senior Management Team to recommend, implement, coordinate, and evaluate programs and services for the development of The Library. Staff liaison with Executive and Finance Committees of the Board. Provides financial leadership to the Capital Area Library District.

Required Performance Standards
• Communications: Writes and speaks clearly, logically and concisely. Listens effectively. Demonstrates small and large group communication skills. Keeps colleagues, team members and supervisors well informed. Participates in group discussions.
• Customer Service: Presents welcoming behaviors. Remains helpful and professional with customers. Responds quickly and cooperatively to requests from staff or public. Follows Dauphin County Library System’s (The Library) guidelines and training for customer service approach. Demonstrates ability to determine customer's needs. Follows up on customer transactions.
• Analytical Skills/Problem Solving/Decision Making: Uses sound judgment in making decisions. Constructively manages conflict. Works with others to solve problems and achieve results.
• Technological Skills: Demonstrates ability to use computers. Demonstrates ability to access and use the Internet and electronic databases. Demonstrates ability to use and maintain equipment basic to job.
• Workplace Maintenance/Management: Maintains and manages workplace security and safety. Pays attention to personal workspace housekeeping.
• Flexibility and Adaptability: Remains calm in difficult, ambiguous, and challenging situations. Responds appropriately to changes in direction and priorities. Adapts personal style to work situations. Takes corrective action when required.
• Interpersonal and Group Relationships: Willing to work with and for others. Supports and facilitates cooperation among others.
• Professional Standards and Ethics: Protects and values patron confidentiality and organizational security. Supports mission and vision of the library. Upholds American Library Association's Library Code of Ethics as interpreted by The Library. Works toward furthering a library-conscious community.
• Professional Development and Leadership: Seeks opportunities to pursue one's personal goals and those of the organization. Sets and models high performance standards. Encourages others to make good decisions and take ownership in decision-making and problem-solving.
• Time and Workflow Management: Manages personal time effectively. Manages workflow effectively.

Environmental Conditions
Primarily works indoors, seated at a desk, using a computer. Travels among facilities. Provides own transportation and is reimbursed accordingly.

Essential Functions

1. Manages the staff of Finance Department. Communicates system goals and priorities
and changes in policies and procedures for staff.
2. Plans, directs, and coordinates the financial operations of The Library. Responsible for the annual audit, 990, and preparation of the financial part of the Annual Report to the Commonwealth Libraries. Responsible for asset management, including insurance program renewals
3. Plans, directs, and coordinates the financial operations of The Library, including oversight of accounts receivable and payable, payroll and related taxes, investment, and account maintenance. Additionally, responsible for the annual audit and preparation of the financial part of the Annual Report to the Commonwealth Libraries.
4. Prepares administrative and budgetary reports for board action and staff planning. Advises Executive Director on fiscal and budgetary problems and other fiscal matters. Specifically oversees the budget for the Finance Department, and has oversight responsibility of all department budgets, calling attention to unusual or questionable items.
5. Works with The Library’s Board of Trustees, specifically with the Finance and Executive Committees, to provide financial information so that the board can fulfill their fiduciary responsibility.
6. Maintains records and ensures compliance with federal and state laws, including but not limited to, tax status, grant and special project reports, and employer tax returns.
7. Evaluates and audits workflow and quality in the finance department of The Library, adjusting procedures and policy as necessary to maintain quality service to The Library.
8. Works with Senior Management Team to review and develop policies, procedures, and long-range plans to fulfill the vision and goals of The Library.
9. Provides training to department managers in financial management and budgeting pertinent to their daily functions.
10. Prepares monthly reports of finance related items. Prepares other reports as required, including but not limited to the required surveys from various government agencies.
11. Provides guidance to Capital Area Library District on financial matters.
12. Speaks to community groups and other libraries.
13. Attends staff meetings and continuing education workshops.
14. Performs other related duties.
15. Lives by the Core Values.

title: Myyntikoordinaattori, Turun kaupunginmuseo
description:
Etsimme myyntikoordinaattoria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen 1.10.2026 alkaen.

Myyntikoordinaattori vastaa Turun kaupunginmuseon liiketoimintapalveluiden toteuttamisesta ja koordinoinnista. Tehtävään sisältyy vastuu museokauppojen ja lippukassojen operatiivisten toimintojen koordinoinnista. Tehtävään sisältyy yhteistyötä ravintola- ja kahvilayrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi koordinaattori osallistuu markkinointiviestintätoimenpiteiden suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen yhteistyössä Turun kaupungin viestinnän kanssa. Koordinaattori vastaa lisäksi omalta osaltaan museon verkkokaupasta ja osallistuu digitaalisen asiakaspalvelutyöhön ja sen kehittämiseen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava aikaisempi opistoasteinen tutkinto tai toisen asteen tutkinto.

Lisäksi edellytetään kokemusta monipuolisista myynti- ja markkinointitoimenpiteistä. Työssä tarvitaan myyntiosaamista, asiakaslähtöistä ajattelua ja kokemusta eri sidosryhmien kanssa työskentelystä sekä riittävää tietojärjestelmien hallintaa. Onnistunut suoriutuminen tehtävässä edellyttää lisäksi sosiaalisen median kanavien tuntemusta sekä mainonnan ja markkinoinnin osaamista.

Eduksi luetaan hyvä verkostoitumisosaaminen. Tehtävän hoitamisessa on eduksi myös myynnin ja markkinoinnin koulutus sekä kielitaito (erityisesti englanti ja ruotsi).

Turun kaupunginmuseo vastaa viiden yleisölle auki olevan museon toiminnasta. Suurimpina yleisökohteina ovat Turun linna ja Luostarinmäen museokortteli. Lisäksi museo on alueellinen vastuumuseo ja ylläpitää suurta kulttuurihistoriallista esinekokoelmaa. Kävijöitä museokohteissa on vuosittain noin 300 000.

Työsuhde-etuina Turun kaupunki tarjoaa mm.:
- monipuolisia koulutuksia
- Fölin työmatkakortin edullisempiin bussimatkoihin
- Tyky-rannekkeen Turun kaupungin liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluihin

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Turun kaupunki suosii anonyymiä rekrytointia. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytointiprosessin ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työhakemuksen avoimiin kysymyksiin ei tule sisällyttää tietoja esim. iästä, äidinkielestä tai sukupuolesta. Vaikka osaa tiedoista taustatiedoissa kysytään, nämä tiedot eivät näy rekrytoivalle lähijohtajalle anonyymissä hakijaraportissa. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet, joten pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi ja vahvistamaan osaamistasi myös jatkossa. Työ on itsenäistä 3-vuorotyötä ja sopivasti haastavaa, mutta yksin sinun ei tarvitse pärjätä, sillä saat aina apua kokeneilta kollegoilta. Haluamme tarjota mahdollisuuksia mm. perhe- ja työelämän yhdistämiseen, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus esittää työvuorotoiveita yhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelun puitteissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Sairaanhoitajamme toivovat tulevalta kollegalta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joiden ansiosta työ sujuu jouhevasti kehitysmyönteisessä tiimissä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Monipuolinen kokemus sairaanhoitajan työstä, potilastietojärjestelmien hallinta sekä kehitysmyönteinen asenne auttavat sinua pääsemään nopeasti sisälle tähän työhön. Edellytämme suomen kielen osaamista ja ruotsin kielitaitoa tarvitset hoitaessasi ruotsinkielisiä potilaitamme. Tärkeintä kuitenkin on, että haluat olla sydämelläsi mukana antamassa tules-potilaillemme parasta mahdollista hoitoa.

Jos tunnistat itsesi tästä kuvauksesta ja haluat liittyä iloiseen joukkoomme, täytä hakemus Kuntarekryssä.
