title: Trainee, Salkunhoito
description:
Mandatum on rahan ja hengen erikoisosaamisen yhdistävä merkittävä finanssipalvelujen tarjoaja. Yhtiö tarjoaa asiakkailleen laajan valikoiman palveluita kattaen omaisuuden- ja varainhoidon, säästämisen ja sijoittamisen, palkitsemisen ja sitouttamisen, eläkeaikaan varautumisen sekä henkilövakuuttamisen. Mandatumin liiketoiminnan menestyksen keskiössä ovat osaava henkilöstö, vahva brändi ja onnistuminen sijoitustoiminnassa.

Mandatumissa panostetaan inspiroivaan ja hyvinvoivaan työyhteisöön ja toimitaan yhtenä joukkueena. Työ meillä on tavoitteellista, mielenkiintoista ja täynnä haasteita. Monipuolisissa tehtävissämme työskentelee yli 600 innostunutta ja kehittymisestään kiinnostunutta rahan ja hengen ammattilaista.

Haemme nyt Mandatumiin useita Traineeta työskentelemään salkunhoidon ja sijoittamisen tehtävissä eri tiimeissämme. Työ Mandatumissa on tavoitteellista ja mielenkiintoista. Jos olet innokas oppimaan uutta ja tavoitteenasi on kasvaa finanssialan huippuosaajaksi, löydät meiltä monipuolisia uramahdollisuuksia. Tutustu tehtäviin ja hae viimeistään sunnuntaina 6.9.2026. Kaikkiin tehtäviin haetaan yhdellä hakulomakkeella, jossa voit valita sinua ensisijaisesti kiinnostavat tiimit ja tehtävät.

Trainee-jaksomme kestävät 4–12 kuukautta ja sijoittuvat vuosille 2026–2027 tehtävän mukaan. Meillä on tarjolla paikkoja niin opintojensa loppuvaiheessa oleville kuin jo valmistuneillekin osaajille. Mandatumin Traineena saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä jännittävässä, nopeatempoisessa ja monipuolisessa ympäristössä. Opit lisää finanssialasta ja saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa verkostoasi alalla.

Sinun roolisi

Trainee, Allocation Products
Traineena Allocations Products -tiimissä osallistut sijoitusratkaisujen ja kvantitatiivisten sijoitusstrategioiden kehittämiseen sekä ylläpitoon eri omaisuusluokissa. Olet täysivaltainen tiimin jäsen ja tuet tiimiä analyysien, tutkimuksen ja kehitystyön kautta sijoitusprosessin eri vaiheissa.

Työssäsi analysoit sijoitusmarkkinoita, eri omaisuusluokkia ja sijoitussalkkuja sekä tuotat analyyseja sijoitusratkaisujen ja kvantitatiivisten sijoitusstrategioiden tueksi. Osallistut portfolioanalyysien toteuttamiseen sekä sijoitustuotteiden kehittämiseen ja seurantaan. Lisäksi olet mukana kehittämässä raportointia, viestintää ja analyysityökaluja sekä tuotat analyyseja ja esitysmateriaaleja myynnin ja asiakastyön tueksi.

Trainee, Private Equity
Traineena Private / Growth Equity -tiimissä pääset kehittämään keskeisiä taitoja pääoma- ja kasvusijoittamisessa. Työssäsi teet yritys- ja markkina-analyysejä, rakennat taloudellisia malleja sekä osallistut kaupallisiin due diligence -prosesseihin. Lisäksi olet mukana edistämässä salkkuyhtiöidemme arvonluontia niiden aktiivisen kehittämisen kautta sekä osallistut uusien sijoituskohteiden tunnistamiseen ja arviointiin.

Trainee, Real Estate Investment
Traineena Real Estate -salkunhoitotiimissä pääset osallistumaan laaja-alaisesti kiinteistösijoittamiseen sekä suorien että epäsuorien sijoitusten parissa. Työskentelet osana kokenutta tiimiä, joka vastaa kiinteistösalkkujen kehittämisestä ja tuoton optimoinnista.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu kiinteistö- ja markkina-analyysien tekeminen, sijoituskohteiden arviointi, taloudellisten mallien laatiminen sekä due diligence -tarkastuksiin osallistuminen. Lisäksi avustat asiakasraportoinnin sekä myynti- ja markkinointimateriaalien valmistelussa.

Osallistut suorien kiinteistösijoitusten hallinnointiin ja arvonluontityöhön sekä epäsuorien sijoitusten, kuten kansainvälisten kiinteistörahastojen, arviointiin sekä sijoitusprosessimme eri vaiheisiin. Pääset tutustumaan laajaan kansainväliseen manageriverkostoomme ja osallistumaan tapaamisiin alan johtavien toimijoiden kanssa. Lisäksi olet mukana uusien sijoitusmahdollisuuksien tunnistamisessa sekä raportoinnin ja salkun seurannan kehittämisessä.

Onnistumisen edellytykset

Etsimme oma-aloitteisia ja analyyttisiä henkilöitä, joilla on aito kiinnostus sijoittamista, rahoitusmarkkinoita ja yritysten analysointia kohtaan. Omaksut nopeasti uusia kokonaisuuksia, työskentelet systemaattisesti ja tuot rohkeasti esiin omia näkemyksiäsi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen vaatii lisäksi:

  • Soveltuvaa korkeakoulutusta (opintojen loppuvaihe tai maisterintutkinto) sekä vahvaa akateemista suoriutumista

  • Kiinnostusta sijoittamiseen, rahoitusmarkkinoihin ja taloudelliseen analyysiin

  • Aikaisempi työkokemus sijoitustoiminnasta, investointipankkitoiminnasta tai muulta relevantilta alalta katsotaan eduksi

  • Hyviä analyyttisiä taitoja ja kiinnostusta taloudelliseen mallinnukseen

  • Erinomaisia viestintätaitoja sekä kykyä tuottaa selkeitä ja laadukkaita esitysmateriaaleja

  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa; muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

  • Huolellista, proaktiivista ja tavoitteellista työskentelyotetta

Johda urasi Mandatumiin

  • Panostamme palkittuun työntekijäkokemukseemme. Mandatum on valittu useasti Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa Suomen parhaiden työpaikkojen joukkoon suurten organisaatioiden sarjassa ja on viime vuosina ansainnut Siqni-henkilöstökyselyyn perustuvan Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin erinomaisesta työntekijäkokemuksesta.

  • Osaamispääoman kasvattamista tuetaan. Työsuhteen alussa saat kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi sekä panostamme jatkuvaan osaamisen kehittämiseen. ﻿Tukenasi on valmentava esihenkilö sekä positiivinen ja motivoitunut tiimi.﻿

  • Työyhteisössämme positiivisuus ja tekemisen asenne tarttuu. Menestyäksemme tarvitsemme toisiamme ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita. Työskentelemme joustavassa hybridityömallissa, jossa kohtaamme toimistolla vähintään kolmena päivänä viikossa. Modernit toimitilamme sijaitsevat Helsingin Bulevardilla. Yhdessä olemme enemmän kuin osiemme summa.

  • Monipuoliset henkilöstöedut käytössäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle peruspalkan lisäksi kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten lounasedun, työmatkaedun sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassissa. Käytössämme on monipuoliset työterveyspalvelut sekä vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus. Lisäksi toimistollamme on tarjolla aamiainen kaksi kertaa viikossa, voit osallistua joogaan joogasalissamme tai hybridinä kotoa käsin, voit hyödyntää kuntosaliamme sekä rentoutua hierontatuolissamme.

Oletko sinä tuleva mandatumlainen?

Tutustu avoinna oleviin tehtäviin tarkemmin tästä. Jos jokin tehtävistä herätti kiinnostuksesi ja näet itsesi tulevaisuuden mandatumlaisena, hae mukaan viimeistään sunnuntaina 6.9.2026. Hakulomakkeella voit kertoa ensisijaisen ja toissijaisen tiimitoiveesi sekä kuvata kiinnostustasi ja motivaatiotasi eri rooleihin. Voit myös kertoa, milloin voisit aloittaa ja kuinka pitkään olisit käytettävissä trainee-jaksolle. Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Trainee-jaksomme sijoittuvat eri ajankohtiin vuonna 2027, ja aloitus sekä jakson pituus sovitaan erikseen.

Tutustu tyypillisen rekrytointiprosessimme vaiheisiin urasivuillamme.

Lue lisää yrityksestämme ja katso viimeisimmät kuulumisemme some-kanavissamme sekä osoitteessa .

title: GenAI Specialist Solutions Architect, Solutions Architect
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. You will craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing an entirely new cloud-based system.
SSAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.

Key job responsibilities
• The GenAI Specialist SA builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operates as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organization.
• You'll support the technical relationship between AWS and our customers, working alongside senior team members to make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency to help accelerate their GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
• Internally, you will collect and relay customer feedback regarding their usage of our GenAI/ML and Agentic services, contributing insights that help inform product and engineering roadmaps.
• In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to apply and recommend proven cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
• You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content, and reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and help evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, or online content).
• If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.
Technical Contribution: Participate in hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing code samples, documentation, and reusable technical assets within your team.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Israel.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.
You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.
The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.
The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.
  • Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.
  • Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.
  • Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.
  • Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.
  • Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.
    • Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.
    • Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.
    • Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.
    • Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.
    • Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.
    • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.
    • SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
    • Experience with distributed systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
    • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive, market-aligned compensation.
      • Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.
      • Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.
      • Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.
      • Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
      • International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.
      • Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

description:
Work Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Hours

40

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Details

We're committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to all our colleagues. As a candidate, we encourage you to have an open dialogue with a member of our HR Team and ask compensation related questions, including pay details for this role.

Job Description

TD Prime Services is seeking an experienced Front Office Full-Stack Trading System Developer to join our expanding engineering team.

The shortlisted candidate will work across our backend trading services, APIs, and front-end client applications, helping to design and deliver scalable, high-performance systems used by institutional clients. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across the stack and has an interest in electronic trading.

As the team covers multiple aspects of the business, the candidate will have to wear many hats, so the ability to multi-task, as well as strong communication and organizational skills, are critical. The individual must also balance an independent, proactive work ethic with a strong team mentality. Collaboration across the organization, communication, and idea generation are key, as are strong technical skills.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services using C# (.NET 8/10).
  • Build intuitive, responsive user interfaces in React + TypeScript.
  • Design, develop, and optimize SQL Server schemas, queries, and stored procedures.
  • Implement new features across full-stack trading applications.
  • Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams on API design and integration.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues across services, databases, and UIs.
  • Work with modern DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, and cloud tooling.
  • (Optional but valuable) Work with FIX protocol, order routing, drop copies, and trading workflows.

Required Skills

  • Strong proficiency in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Web API, background services, messaging).
  • Solid experience with React and modern front-end development (TypeScript, hooks, state management).
  • Robust understanding of SQL Server, query optimization, and relational schema design.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Strong debugging skills and comfort working in distributed systems.
  • Ability to own features from design to deployment.

Bonus / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with FIX protocol
  • Experience in trading systems, fintech, OMS/EMS, or market data.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).
  • Experience with Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to low-latency or high-throughput environments.

Who You Are

  • A strong communicator who can work independently.
  • Someone who enjoys problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working in a small, high-ownership team.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. title: Sr. Program Manager - POD, Pay on Delivery
description:
We are the cash people!

Cash / Pay on delivery is the largest instrument of choice by customers on Amazon.in (and in other similar emerging markets where we are expanding) – this despite the rapid advances in digital payments technology space. Customers continue to prefer Pay on Delivery (POD), not only because they want to pay by cash (indeed half of our COD customers pay digitally at doorstep!) – but because it solves many other needs for them – Building trust in the Amazon marketplace, peace of mind to only pay when the item is delivered, and not block money until then, ordering for friends and family who are not digitally savvy etc.

On the other hand, POD also has its down-sides: it leads to low-intent purchases, casual rejects and abuse from some customers, which impacts the sustainability of the instrument. Hence there is a need to continuously shape the POD offering, to make it available for the good customers, while reducing its access to the not-so-good customers, and make it an overall more sustainable business lever for Amazon.

Our mission is to make POD a sustainable and profitable payment instrument for Amazon's flywheel, enabling more and better POD access to all Amazon customers providing a first-class payment experience better or at least at par with prepaid instruments.
Our vision is to build POD into an APP that enables customers to pay using cash/ digitally at doorstep seamlessly, for physical goods as well as digital services on Amazon as well as external merchants, helping businesses to scale faster and sustainably.
We work on improving Customer experience and sustainability for POD – across onsite availability and experience, post-order payment experience, doorstep experience, refund experience and managing overall instrument P&L.

This role will own the management of the Cost-to-Serve for Pay on Delivery. You will need to identify and run interventions to reduce cost of offering POD - across reducing rejects, optimizing POD availability to spur growth, and managing POD 3P vendors.

The role will be also be the primary interface for both global and cross-functional, cross-departmental teams to conceptualize, execute, track and report progress on the program interventions - including Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Finance, Last Mile Operations, Shopping Experience and Technology.

Key job responsibilities
• Program interventions to reduce POD rejects: Research on why customers are rejecting on POD, build the right reject attribution to differentiate between customer controllable vs non-controllable rejects and run targeted interventions through Weblabs to reduce POD rejects
• GTM of POD Initiatives: Identify what would increase the adoption of POD Initiatives with customers, run GTM (Go-To-Market) plan, improve customer targeting and iterate through experiments to increase OPS/GMS while keeping POD Rejects in check
• POD PnL: Establish POD PnL and Identify opportunities to increase the bottom-line, increasing revenue and cutting down costs
• Vendor management - Work with POD 3P vendors to optimize the cost of POD operations, communication channels like SMS/ WhatsApp to reduce POD OpEx
• Cross-functional stakeholder management: Work with Cost of Business Waste, Category teams to identify drivers, opportunity areas for POD rejects, track actions through WBR/ MBRs

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing POD performance metrics on POD availability, POD share, POD rejects and POD overall P&L and costs.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Category, Shopping Experience teams to refine customer segmentation models, meet with operations teams to optimize delivery processes, and analyze data to identify trends in customer payment preferences.

You will be required to ideate, research on customer needs/pain points, thoroughly analyze data, generate insights, develop proof of concepts, write compelling business cases and gain agreement from Leaders across levels & functions, to implement the solutions.

title: Actuarial Analyst – 2027 Internship - Montreal
description:
Company:

Mercer

Description:

We are seeking talented individuals to join our teams at Mercer Canada. These roles will be based in Montreal. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. The below listed teams are looking for Actuarial Analyst Interns for 2027 Internships:

  • Retirement Consulting Business and Global Actuarial Services Delivery
  • Investments Consulting Business
  • Health & Benefits Consulting Business
  • Pension Administration Services
  • International Consulting Business

In Retirement Consulting Business and Global Actuarial Services Delivery, we will count on you to:

  • Perform retirement and post-retirement benefits actuarial valuation including validation of data, analysis of the plan’s gains and losses, analysis of the plan’s asset performance, and preparation of the valuation report and related forms
  • Production of year-end accounting disclosure and projection of expenses for plans under various financial reporting standards including IFRS, CPA and FAS
  • Complete benefit calculations, review plan documents, produce employee benefit statements and prepare annual government forms
  • Participation in the design and pricing of client’s employee pension plans and executive pension benefits, including cash flow modelling, demographic projections and evaluation of liabilities within an asset-liability framework
  • Production of various experience studies to refine demographic and financial assumptions used in actuarial valuations
  • Designing and implementing strategies to manage defined benefit pension plan volatility, including funding strategy, plan design and risk transfer solutions
  • Work in an integrated team of professionals from different offices to resolve modern actuarial problems in the Canadian retirement benefits landscape, including union negotiations, risk transfer and public policy

In Investments Consulting Business, we will count on you to:

  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis utilizing Mercer proprietary tools
  • Produce quarterly performance reports for our clients
  • Critically analyze different investment markets, managers' investment styles, and portfolio characteristics, and evaluate their impact on investment performance each quarter
  • Communicate with investment managers, record keepers and custodians to gather and/or clarify client-specific data for reporting
  • Play an important role in investment manager searches, asset allocation studies, and other ad-hoc investment-related projects
  • Support consultants in servicing existing clients and prospects
  • Demonstrate ease and effectiveness when dealing with clients and colleagues at all levels
  • Represent and promote the “face” of Mercer, both internally and externally

In Health & Benefits Consulting Business, we will count on you to:

  • Develop strategies and solutions related to the costs and funding of group insurance plans
  • Participate in actuarial valuations of post-retirement benefits, including data validation, setting assumptions, analyzing plan gains and losses and preparing the valuation report
  • Validate and compare premiums for group benefit plans under renewals, quotes or benchmarking exercises with other companies in the industry
  • Produce quarterly experience monitoring reports for clients and analyze the impact of any recent changes
  • Analyze financial statements of group insurance plans and review the financial agreement to suit the client needs
  • Evaluate employer obligations by participating in each step of an actuarial valuation
  • Assist in updating national databases of Mercer clients
  • Work in collaboration with professionals to resolve technical actuarial problems specific to group insurance and the business sector
  • Familiarize oneself with Mercer products and services as well as group benefit market trends in order to meet client needs
  • Understand group benefit coverage by reviewing contractual documents for the employer and employees

In Pension Administration Services, we will count on you to:

  • Calculate pension benefits and prepare statements of entitlements resulting from various events (termination of employment, retirement, death, divorce, transfer, etc.) for members of pension plans
  • Update and manage client’s databases
  • Prepare annual statements for active and inactive members
  • Calculate pension adjustments (PA) and pension adjustment reversals (PAR)
  • Prepare annual information returns for submission to governmental authorities
  • Work in collaboration with professionals to meet the needs of our clients and their employees
  • Participate in the continuous improvements of systems and procedures
  • Act as a resource person for clients and their employees on plan benefits and other administration processes
  • Understand the provisions of the plans and the various applicable laws

In International Consulting Business, we will count on you to:

  • Work as a global benefit coordinator for a multinational client foreign benefit renewals activities
  • Work in collaboration with a consultant to consolidate worldwide pension and other post-employment benefits financial reporting
    • Coordinate phases of the project with local actuaries across the globe
    • Review disclosures and assumptions provided by local actuaries for reasonableness, consistency and compliance with appropriate accounting standard
  • Work in collaboration with a consultant for benefits review projects
    • Research Mercer internal documentation and surveys on market practices information in foreign countries, such as recent benefit trends and legislative changes
    • Coordinate benefit review projects with the involved parties (i.e. client local office and HQ, Mercer international consultant, local Mercer specialist, etc.)

What you need to have:

  • Completion of one (1) year towards a bachelor's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, finance, administration or a related field when internship begins
  • Superior analytical skills and working knowledge of Excel and others MS-Office software programs.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Intellectual curiosity; seeking opportunities to develop new skills.
  • Strong aptitude for teamwork and a willingness to be adaptable to meet deadlines and accommodate shifting client needs.
  • Superior organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in French and English, as the position requires regular interaction with clients and other third-parties outside of Quebec, as well as collaboration with colleagues outside of Canada.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities including our actuarial education program, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

What’s next?

In order to be considered, submit your complete application by providing a cover letter, your resume and your most recent transcript in PDF format, via our Early Careers Section of our website at by September 17th, 2026. Please note that applications that are missing any of these documents may not be considered.

title: Project Manager
description:
Viridien () is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead and support a portfolio of projects across Viridien's global operations. Based within our Houston team, this role is responsible for driving project delivery from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, manage project risks and dependencies, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives while helping enhance the efficiency, governance, and successful execution of strategic business and operational projects.

About the Team

You will join our global Project Management Office (PMO) team, responsible for driving the successful delivery of strategic business and operational projects across Viridien's worldwide operations. Working closely with engineering, finance, and operations stakeholders, you will help manage project charters, schedules, budgets, and risk registers that keep our portfolio on track from initiation through completion.

The team combines strong project governance with a collaborative, hands-on, and delivery-focused culture. We value ownership, clear communication, data-driven decision-making, and teamwork across regions, helping ensure every project we support is delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate multiple mid-level projects throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring successful delivery aligned with business objectives, scope, budget, schedule, and quality expectations.
  • Develop and maintain project charters, plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers, while monitoring financial performance and resource allocation to ensure effective cost control and successful project delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and maintain effective stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle, while proactively identifying, managing, and mitigating project risks and issues, escalating when necessary.
  • Lead cross-functional project teams, ensuring clear task ownership and accountability, while monitoring project performance, tracking progress against KPIs, and providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate stakeholder communication and cross-functional alignment across engineering, finance, and operations teams, while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies to support successful project delivery.
  • Manage project changes and governance processes, ensuring proper evaluation, approval, and documentation, while maintaining PMO records, SharePoint documentation, and portfolio reporting through dashboards, scorecards, and regular status reports.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field
  • 1–5 years of project management experience, with working knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, Scrum, and Hybrid methodologies
  • Experience supporting or managing project budgets, with strong analytical skills to interpret data and trends
  • Proven ability to coordinate and engage cross-functional teams across diverse regions, with confident, customer-focused stakeholder communication
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain data quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Project; experienced with Jira; familiarity with EPIC Supply Chain System is a plus

Preferred:

  • Certification in project management such as CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, or APM PMQ is a strong plus
  • Agile-focused certifications, such as PMI-ACP or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), are also valued

Why work with us ?

  • Yearly Performance Bonus
  • Hybrid & Flexible Work: One remote day per week
  • Generous Time Off: Three weeks of vacation to recharge, plus three personal days and eight sick days to use when you need them most
  • Retirement Benefits: Excellent 401k match program – contribute up to 5%, and we’ll match up to 7%!
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, vision, and supplemental benefits to support you and your family’s wellbeing
  • Parental Support: Paid parental leave for all parents, plus fertility care coverage to support every unique journey
  • Wellness & Wellbeing: EAP and Wellness Program to support mental and emotional wellbeing, with a free, onsite fitness center to help you stay active
  • Free Lunches: Take a break from meal prep – we provide lunch three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays)!

Learning and Development

At Viridien, we foster a culture of continuous learning and provide tailored training programs through our Learning Hub, designed to enhance technical, commercial, and personal growth.

We Care About The Environment

We encourage and actively support a strong sense of community, through volunteering and various company initiatives, as well as a strong company commitment to protecting our environment through sustainable solutions, energy saving and waste reduction enterprises.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

Tässä roolissa otat teknisen vetovastuun kriittisistä tunnistautumisratkaisuista ja toimit samalla syväosaajana tietosuoja- ja tietoturva-asioissa.

Mitä on luvassa?

Digitaalisen asiakassuhteen alueella pääset työskentelemään Ylen digipalveluiden ydintoimintojen ja keihäänkärkituotteiden parissa. Työpöydälläsi kohtaavat monipuoliset ja laajalle yleisölle näkyvät kokonaisuudet: Ylen design system, jonka tarjoamia komponentteja suunnittelijat ja kehittäjät hyödyntävät toteutuksissaan, Yle-sovelluksessa ja Yle Areenassa näkyvät chat- ja kommentointituotteet sekä satojatuhansia pelaajia ja miljoonia käyntikertoja keräävät pelit, kuten kesän jalkapallon MM-kisojen Futistietäjä.

Tuoteajattelu on kiinteä osa toimintamalliamme: asiakaskeskeisyys, liiketoimintatavoitteet ja teknologia muodostavat kokonaisuuden. Tech Leadina et ole pelkästään teknologiaosaaja, vaan osa tuotejohtoa ja siten myös määrittelemässä sitä, mitä kokeilemme ja miten tuotteemme kehittyvät.

Tämän lisäksi otat teknisen vetovastuun tunnistautumisratkaisuja kehittävästä tiimistä. Tunnistautumisen ytimessä hallinnoidaan yli 3,5 miljoonaa Yle Tunnusta, mikä tekee siitä yhden Ylen kriittisimmistä järjestelmistä. Vastaat tiimin teknisestä suunnasta arkkitehtuurilinjaustemme mukaisesti ja varmistat, että ratkaisut ovat korkealaatuisia ja suorituskykyisiä. Huolehdit myös siitä, että tekninen velka pysyy hallinnassa ja päätökset perusteluineen dokumentoidaan.

Otat myös laajaa omistajuutta tietoturvakäytäntöjen ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä kaikissa Ylen digitaalisissa palveluissa ja digitaalisessa viestinnässämme. Koska tunnistautumisessa käsitellään sensitiivistä käyttäjädataa, vastaat teknisten riskien arvioinnista, uhkien ennaltaehkäisystä ja hallintasuunnitelmista. Toimit myös tietosuojakäytäntöjen teknisenä asiantuntijana muille tiimeille, jotta vaatimukset muuttuvat kestäviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme Tech Leadiä, jolla on kokemusta suurten järjestelmäkokonaisuuksien parissa työskentelystä. Olet erinomainen kommunikoija ja pystyt perustelemaan monimutkaiset tekniset ratkaisut selkeästi niin kehittäjille kuin tuotejohdollekin. Kykenet arvioimaan riskejä kylmäpäisesti ja tekemään kestäviä päätöksiä myös suurtapahtumien aiheuttaman paineen ja epävarmuuden keskellä.

Tässä roolissa toimit laajan sidosryhmäverkoston keskipisteenä. Johdat tiimiäsi muutosten ja kehityshankkeiden läpi liiketoiminnan määrittämään suuntaan. Odotamme sinulta kykyä viedä asioita eteenpäin tuotejohtamisen periaattein. Tehtävä edellyttää vahvaa kykyä jaettuun johtajuuteen sekä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri ammattiryhmien, roolien ja kumppaneiden kanssa myös muutoksen keskellä.

Odotamme, että sinulta löytyy:

  • Vahvaa näyttöä tietoturvakäytäntöjen ohjaamisesta ja teknisestä riskienhallinnasta laajassa mittakaavassa.

  • Syvää ymmärrystä tietosuojasta sekä kykyä kääntää GDPR-sääntely (kuten anonymisointi ja datan elinkaari) kestäväksi tekniseksi toteutukseksi.

  • Syvällistä ymmärrystä modernista identiteetin- ja pääsynhallinnasta suuren kävijämäärän kuluttajapalvelussa.

  • Vahvaa ymmärrystä suuren mittakaavan pilvi-infrasta sekä sen toimintavarmuudesta ja skaalautuvuudesta.

  • Kykyä hahmottaa ja arvioida tekoälypohjaisia ratkaisuja sekä tuoda AI-natiivi toimintamalli osaksi järjestelmäsuunnittelua.

  • Ymmärrystä martech-ratkaisuista ja niiden arkkitehtuureista (meillä on käytössä Braze).

  • Kykyä strategiseen teknologiajohtamiseen ja alueellisen tekkistrategian rakentamiseen sekä taitoa tehdä perusteltuja valintoja tuotejohdon kumppanina ja osana Ylen laajempaa teknologiajohtoa.

  • Riittävää ymmärrystä alueemme ydinteknologioista (erityisesti Clojure ja Scala) kokeneiden kehittäjien tukemiseksi ja ratkaisujen arvioimiseksi, vaikka et itse päivittäin koodaa.

Työkielemme on suomi. Toivomme myös, että näet kasvotusten tapahtuvan ideoinnin ja yhteistyön arvon, ja olet valmis työskentelemään Pasilan toimipisteessämme vähintään kolmena päivänä viikossa tai siten kuin tiimissä erikseen sovitaan.

Miksi meille?


Yle on ainutlaatuinen talo, jolla on ainutlaatuinen tehtävä; tavoitteemme on tarjota puolueetonta tietoa, edistää demokratian toteutumista ja tarjota maan parasta mediapalvelua kaikille taustasta, äidinkielestä ja lompakon paksuudesta riippumatta. Koska haluamme tehdä järjestelmämme viimeisen päälle hyvin, on työlle varattu riittävästi aikaa.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset ohjaamaan ja vaikuttamaan merkityksellisesti organisaatiomme kehitykseen.

Saat työkavereiksesi osaavat muotoilu-, teknologia- ja tuoteammattilaiset. Arjen moniammatillisissa tiimeissä kehityt asiantuntijana, ja pääset tekemään työtä yli tiimirajojen. Pääset vahvistamaan kulttuuriamme, jossa rohkaistaan kokeiluun ja oppimiseen. Olet varmistamassa, että asiakaskeskeisyys ohjaa tekemistä ja uusien ideoiden testaaminen on arkipäivää.

Julkiselle puolelle ominaisesti meillä on tarjota pidemmät vuosilomat (6−7 viikkoa aiemmasta kokemuksesta riippuen) sekä muita mukavia etuja hammaslääkäristä kuntosaliin. Yle on perheystävällinen ja joustava työpaikka, jossa ymmärretään, että elämääsi kuuluu muutakin kuin työ. Ja koska olemme tuotetalo, pääset unohtamaan, miten projektikohtaisia tunteja kirjataan.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos kolahti, lähetä meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi 6.9.2026 mennessä. Haastattelut aloitetaan mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana.

Palkkaukseen eteneville henkilöille toteutetaan heidän suostumuksellaan turvallisuusselvityslain tarkoittama henkilöturvallisuusselvitys.

title: Customer Identity Engineer - CIAM (Full Stack & Security) - Contract
description:
We are seeking experienced Customer Identity Engineers (CIAM) for a major enterprise digital transformation program based in Sydney.

In this hands-on engineering role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying secure, scalable customer authentication, authorization, and identity management solutions. Working at the intersection of full-stack software development, API security, and digital channels, you will play a central role in delivering seamless, frictionless, and secure identity experiences for millions of digital customers.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • CIAM Platform Engineering: Build, integrate, and optimize enterprise Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions across high-volume, customer-facing digital channels.

  • Full Stack & API Development: Develop robust, secure services and APIs using Java or Node.js alongside modern web frameworks and microservices architectures.

  • Authentication & Authorization: Implement modern identity standards including OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and emerging Passkey / Passwordless workflows.

  • Identity Verification & Security: Integrate identity verification capabilities, biometric flows, and fraud detection mechanisms into customer onboarding and authentication journeys.

  • DevOps & Quality Engineering: Embed CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, continuous testing, secure coding practices, and ongoing operational support for identity services.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Security Architects, Enterprise Solution Designers, and Digital Product Squads to deliver end-to-end identity features.

Core Requirements:

  • CIAM Expertise: Strong, proven background engineering customer-facing identity, authentication, and access management solutions.

  • Full Stack Development: Hands-on experience developing backend APIs and integrations using Java or Node.js, alongside modern digital web/mobile technologies.

  • Identity Protocols: Deep practical understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SSO, MFA, and secure token management.

  • Modern Auth Features: Experience building or integrating Passkeys, Passwordless authentication, or customer identity verification/KYC workflows.

  • API & Application Security: Strong knowledge of OWASP standards, secure API engineering, encryption, and threat mitigation in customer platforms.

  • Delivery & CI/CD: Familiarity with automated CI/CD pipelines, unit/integration testing, and maintaining production platform health.

  • Location: Must be strictly based in Sydney and available to start ASAP.

Highly Regarded:

  • Prior experience delivering CIAM solutions within Telecommunications, Banking, FinTech, or high-volume enterprise digital customer environments.

  • Experience with major enterprise identity platforms (e.g., Ping Identity, Okta, ForgeRock, Auth0, or AWS Cognito).

title: Analyst Risk
description:
Marmon Technologies India Private Limited

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

The Third-Party Risk Analyst is responsible for supporting the implementation and ongoing management of the Marmon Medical Group’s third-party due diligence and compliance risk management program. This position conducts risk-based anti-corruption due diligence reviews of distributors, sales agents, consultants, customs brokers, logistics providers, healthcare intermediaries, lobbying firms, suppliers, acquisition targets, and other third-party business relationships that may present a risk of bribery and corruption.
The specialist role serves as a key member of the compliance function, partnering with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Internal Audit, and business leaders to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor anti-corruption, healthcare compliance, sanctions, trade compliance, and reputational risks associated with third parties globally.
This role supports compliance with the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act, applicable healthcare compliance laws, global anti-corruption regulations, trade sanctions requirements, and Marmon policies governing third-party risk management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Third-Party Due Diligence

  • Manage end-to-end anti-corruption due diligence reviews for distributors, consultants, sales agents, customs brokers, freight forwarders, healthcare intermediaries, joint venture partners, and other third-party intermediaries.
  • Review and validate due diligence questionnaires, corporate records, ownership documentation, financial information, references, and supporting documentation.
  • Conduct risk assessments using established risk-ranking methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate corruption, fraud, sanctions, export control, healthcare compliance, and reputational risks.
  • Review ownership structures and beneficial ownership information.
  • Analyze relationships involving government officials, healthcare professionals, and state-owned entities.
  • Escalate potential red flags and high-risk relationships for legal and compliance review.

Risk Assessments and Investigations

  • Perform risk-based assessments of proposed third-party engagements.
  • Evaluate geographic, transactional, industry, compensation, and government interaction risks.
  • Analyze adverse media, litigation history, enforcement actions, sanctions screening results, and other public records.
  • Conduct enhanced due diligence for high-risk third parties.
  • Participate in remediation planning and risk mitigation activities.
  • Document investigation results and recommendations.

Screening and Monitoring

  • Conduct sanctions screening and restricted party screening reviews.
  • Support screening activities involving third parties, beneficial owners, banking institutions, and key personnel.
  • Monitor due diligence renewals and periodic reviews.
  • Manage annual certification processes for medium and high risk third parties.
  • Identify and investigate compliance alerts, adverse media findings, and monitoring exceptions.

Compliance Program Support

  • Support implementation and administration of third-party risk management systems such as Blue Umbrella, E2Open/Amber Road, Dow Jones, Refinitiv, World-Check, or similar platforms.
  • Assist with development and maintenance of due diligence procedures, work instructions, templates, and guidance documents.
  • Generate metrics and reports for senior management and compliance committees.
  • Maintain due diligence records and supporting documentation in accordance with record retention requirements.
  • Support internal audits and compliance assessments.

Mergers & Acquisitions

  • Support compliance due diligence activities for acquisitions, investments, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships.
  • Review anti-corruption, healthcare compliance, transparency, privacy, sanctions, and trade compliance risks associated with acquisition targets.
  • Assist in preparing compliance risk assessments and integration recommendations.

Training and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Educate business stakeholders regarding third-party compliance requirements.
  • Provide guidance to procurement, commercial, and operational personnel regarding due diligence obligations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business functions regarding third-party engagements.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, Law, Criminal Justice, Compliance, Political Science, International Studies, or related field.

Experience

  • 3-7 years of experience in compliance, legal, internal audit, risk management, investigations, procurement compliance, or due diligence.
  • Experience conducting third-party anti-corruption due diligence reviews.
  • Experience working with compliance screening databases and due diligence platforms.
  • Experience creating and maintaining accurate records.
  • Strong Excel skills (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data reconciliation)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and Teams
  • Experience supporting global compliance programs preferred.
  • Medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, or multinational corporate experience preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Knowledge of:

  • Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA)
  • UK Bribery Act
  • Anti-corruption regulations
  • Third-party risk management principles
  • Sanctions and export control compliance
  • Healthcare compliance requirements
  • Due diligence methodologies
  • Risk assessment frameworks
  • Internal controls and auditing concepts
  • Corporate investigations

Preferred Qualifications

One or more of the following:

  • Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP)
  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE)
  • Certified Third-Party Risk Professional (CTPRP)
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or Paralegal certification

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking
  • Investigative skills
  • Risk assessment expertise
  • Attention to detail
  • Professional skepticism
  • Strong written communication
  • Stakeholder management
  • Project management
  • Data analysis
  • Judgment and decision making
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 10–15% domestic and international travel as needed.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Web - Backend
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Desenvolvedor(a) Web - Backend based in Brazil.

This is an opportunity for a backend developer to build and evolve Web and Mobile applications within a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment.
You will contribute to projects where technical quality is balanced with product needs, business impact, and user value.
The role encourages ownership, proactive problem-solving, and a broad understanding of how backend systems interact with databases, front-end applications, and network layers.
You will work with technologies such as PHP, Golang, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL databases.
There is also room to explore cloud, containers, automation, microservices, and scalable architectures.
The environment values continuous learning, constructive technical discussions, experimentation, and knowledge sharing.
This is a strong fit for someone passionate about technology who wants autonomy while growing alongside an engaged engineering team.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain Web and Mobile backend applications, delivering solutions that address real product and business needs.
  • Work with technologies such as PHP, Golang, and Node.js, with the opportunity to expand expertise across the technology stack.
  • Design and implement backend solutions using frameworks such as Symfony and Laravel where applicable.
  • Work with relational databases including PostgreSQL and MySQL, ORMs, and non-relational databases.
  • Apply engineering practices such as TDD, Clean Code, Design Patterns, and structured Git workflows.
  • Participate in code reviews, branching strategies, pull requests, issue management, and collaborative development processes.
  • Consider the interaction between backend services, front-end applications, databases, network layers, and overall application performance.
  • Analyze technical challenges and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, architecture, and development practices.
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools, bringing relevant innovations that can be applied to ongoing projects.
  • Contribute to scalable architectures, including microservices and hexagonal architecture, when appropriate.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure technical decisions support sustainable product and business outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional knowledge of at least one of the following languages, with an interest in learning and developing across the others:
      • PHP 7.2+, preferably with experience in Symfony and/or Laravel.
      • Golang.
      • Node.js.
      • Experience with Git and GitHub workflows, including branching, issues, and pull requests.
      • Experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
      • Familiarity with ORMs and NoSQL databases.
      • Knowledge of TDD, Clean Code, and Design Patterns.
      • Basic knowledge of HTML and template engines, such as Twig or Blade.
      • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to understand the broader impact of technical decisions.
      • Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to development.
      • Strong ownership mindset and accountability for the quality of delivered work.
      • Collaborative communication style and willingness to participate in constructive technical discussions.
      • Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn new technologies and development practices.
      • Basic Bash scripting knowledge is a plus.
      • Familiarity with Docker, virtualization, AWS services such as EC2 and S3, command-line tools, cloud platforms, code analysis, automation, and CI is desirable.
      • Experience designing horizontally scalable microservices and/or hexagonal architecture is an advantage.

        • Benefits:

        • Unimed Nacional health insurance, with the company covering 100% of the premium for a plan with 50% co-participation.
        • Life insurance, with 50% of the cost covered if the employee opts in.
        • Flexible working hours within a 40-hour workweek, based on prior agreement with the team.
        • Transparent career development plan with clear progression opportunities.
        • Annual bonus based on the impact of individual contributions.
        • Quarterly internal learning events featuring talks, hackathons, and social initiatives.
        • Internal team and culture events.
        • R$2,000 annual education/home-office budget for courses, conferences, books, furniture, computer equipment, or other relevant materials.
        • Optional weekly English classes of 1.5 hours.
        • Collaborative culture focused on knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and sustainable professional growth.

title: Change Management Specialist
description:
The Office of the Director (OD), Office of Management (OM) is looking to fill two Change Management Specialist positions within their NIH Business Systems(NBS). This position serves as a Change Management Specialist with responsibility for a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods to identify, assess, analyze and improve team effectiveness, efficiency and work products. The position is located in the Organizational Change Management Branch.

As a Change Management Specialist your duties will include, but not be limited to: Analyzing and evaluating the effectiveness of program operations and procedures. Developing and recommending procedures or policies to address changes in the organization. Developing and recommending ways to improve program and operational effectiveness and efficiency. Establishing plans to communicate to and train identified target audiences, with appropriate messages, activities, training materials, and resources needed to be effective over the project life cycle. Providing advice and assistance to change management staff on workflow policies and procedures.
